arbeitnow:risk-manager-in-frankfurt-am-m.description:
Location

Frankfurt am Main

About Us

About AllUnity

AllUnity is a regulated e-money institute building Europe’s digital payments infrastructure for instant cross-border payments, digital asset markets, and seamless liquidity flows. Established by DWS, Flow Traders, and Galaxy, AllUnity delivers fully backed, MiCAR-compliant stablecoins (EURAU, CHFAU and SEKAU) that provide regulatory certainty and robust reserve backing for secure, frictionless capital movement across markets.

About the Role

We are looking for a Risk Manager/in (m/f/d) with experience in structured risk management within a regulated financial services environment and a strong interest or exposure to blockchain-based products. The role focuses on risk framework development, new product and change assessments, and technology-related risk analysis in a digital asset context.

You will act as a key contributor to the Institute’s second-line risk function, supporting the evaluation of new blockchain integrations, product developments and outsourcing arrangements under MiCA and DORA. The role combines traditional operational risk management with digital asset specific risk considerations.

You will manage defined risk workstreams, particularly in the assessment of new blockchain integrations and product developments.

Key Responsibilities

1. Core Risk Management & Governance

  • Conduct inherent and residual risk assessments in line with the Institute’s risk methodology
  • Maintain and enhance the risk inventory, including control mapping and documentation standards
  • Assess control design and effectiveness across operational and technology-related processes
  • Monitor KRIs and risk appetite thresholds, including follow-up and escalation where required
  • Support tracking and monitoring of recovery indicators and related governance processes
  • Contribute to material change assessments and structured risk papers for management

2. New Product & Process Risk (NPP)

  • Perform end-to-end risk assessments for new blockchain integrations (e.g., L1/L2 chains, bridge solutions)
  • Assess impact on existing operational processes, governance structures and control frameworks
  • Evaluate smart contract-related risk exposure at a conceptual level (e.g., mint/burn controls, upgradeability, governance mechanisms)
  • Identify operational, ICT, outsourcing and concentration risks arising from new initiatives
  • Support the preparation of clear, decision-ready risk assessments for internal approval committees

3. Technology, ICT & Outsourcing Risk (MiCA / DORA)

  • Support alignment of ICT and outsourcing risk management with MiCA and DORA requirements
  • Evaluate third-party providers (e.g., custody, bridge, oracle and technology providers) from a risk and criticality perspective
  • Assess resilience, dependency, concentration and exit strategy considerations
  • Contribute to operational resilience testing and scenario development
  • Ensure technology and outsourcing risks are consistently reflected in the overall risk profile

4. Digital Asset Risk Structuring

  • Translate technical setups into structured, risk-relevant documentation
  • Identify key risk drivers such as governance risk, third-party dependency and single points of failure
  • Challenge control design constructively and propose practical mitigation measures
  • Support stress scenario development (e.g., bridge exploit, de-pegging, chain halt)

Key Requirements

Experience

  • 4 - 6 years of professional experience in Risk Management, Operational Risk, Internal Audit or Risk Advisory
  • Experience in a regulated financial services environment (e.g., bank, EMI, fintech or comparable institution)
  • Practical exposure to risk assessments, control evaluations and governance processes
  • Experience supporting new product approvals or material change assessments is a strong advantage

Technical & Regulatory Knowledge

  • Solid understanding of risk assessment methodologies (inherent/residual risk, control effectiveness, risk appetite frameworks)
  • Familiarity with blockchain fundamentals (e.g., token issuance, smart contracts, L1/L2 chains, bridge concepts)
  • Understanding of operational and technology risk in digital asset environments
  • Knowledge of MiCA and/or DORA requirements is strongly preferred
  • Awareness of outsourcing and third-party risk principles in regulated institutions

Skills & Working Style

  • Strong analytical and structured thinking
  • Excellent documentation and drafting skills in German & English
  • Proficiency in German is required
  • Ability to translate technical and regulatory topics into clear risk documentation
  • Independent and solution-oriented working style
  • Confidence to challenge constructively while collaborating across functions
  • High attention to detail and ownership mindset

Why You Should Apply

In this role, you will not only monitor risk, you will actively contribute to the development and refinement of the risk framework of a BaFin regulated euro stablecoin institution operating under MiCA and DORA.
You will gain hands-on experience at the intersection of traditional financial risk management and blockchain-based infrastructure, working closely with senior leadership in a highly regulated environment.
This role offers meaningful ownership, regulatory depth and exposure to one of Europe’s most innovative digital financial initiatives.

Introduction

Deine Liebe zur Gastronomie kann nur noch als Stockholm-Syndrom verstanden werden? Du suchst nach neuen Wegen, aber der gewohnt raue Umgangston weckt inzwischen ein Gefühl von Vertrautheit in Dir? Dein Fetisch dafür ist sogar so ausgeprägt, dass Du es kaum erwarten kannst, morgens pünktlich um 9 Uhr mit dem Hörer am Ohr die großen und kleinen technischen Herausforderungen unserer Kund*innen zu lösen?

Wir suchen Mitarbeiter*innen für unseren Support, die die derbe, aber herzliche Art unserer Kund*innen aus der Gastronomie schätzen und ihnen bei allen Fragen zu unserer Kassen-App zur Seite stehen.

Klingt gut für Dich? Dann freut sich Karo auf Deine Initiativbewerbung inklusive Fun Fact!

Über orderbird: Gastronomie bringt Menschen zusammen. Wir leben diese Branche aus eigener Erfahrung. Deshalb gestalten wir die komplexen Prozesse so einfach wie möglich durch intuitive und zuverlässige Technologie.

Mit über 17.000 Kund*innen in Deutschland, Österreich, Frankreich und der Schweiz zählen unsere Gastro-Kasse orderbird PRO und die mobile Kassenlösung orderbird MINI zu den führenden Kassensystemen in Europa.

What you can look forward to

  • Deutschlandticket, Egym Wellpass, JobRad und eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 100% Zuschlag von orderbird

  • Ein Callcenter Job, der kein Callcenter Job ist, denn bei uns darfst Du noch selber denken - oft auch um die Ecke!

Wer wir sind

Die Mayflower GmbH ist ein mittelständischer Dienstleister für Individualsoftware mit Schwerpunkt “Generative AI”. Seit 1998 in Gründerhand, entwickeln wir Software und beraten Kunden aus allen Branchen. Wir setzen auf Cloud Native, modernisieren Software und unterstützen unsere Kunden mit maßgeschneiderten AI-Lösungen.

Bei Mayflower arbeiten wir in agilen Teams und legen großen Wert darauf, Wissen zu teilen und gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern. Wir übernehmen Verantwortung für das Produkt, pflegen eine professionelle Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden und legen Wert auf eine offene Feedback- und Weiterbildungskultur. Dazu bieten wir spannende Use Cases, großen Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, echten Einfluss beim Kunden zu nehmen.

Wir bauen unseren Businessbereich „Generative AI" aus und suchen dich, um gemeinsam agentische AI-Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für unsere Kunden echte Probleme lösen.

Neugierig geworden? Dann lies einfach weiter!

Was dich erwartet

  • Anspruchsvolle Projekte mit LLMs, Agentic RAG und AI-Agent-Frameworks wie LangGraph oder OpenAI Agent SDK. Du baust Evaluation-Pipelines und Observability (Logging/Tracing mit LangSmith, Langfuse o. Ä.) auf und arbeitest mit modernem MLOps-Stack und Vector Databases.
  • Du berätst Kunden als vertrauenswürdiger Partner auf Augenhöhe und führst sie strategisch bei der Umsetzung innovativer AI-Vorhaben.
  • In Workshops erarbeitest du gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden die AI-Architektur für die jeweiligen Use Cases, ermittelst die Business-Anforderungen und stellst eine Roadmap auf, die einen schnellen Start mit kurzfristigen Ergebnissen ermöglicht.
  • Mit Begeisterung nutzt du moderne agentische Entwicklungsmethoden, entwickelst mit deinem Team Best Practices und förderst kontinuierlich den Wissenstransfer zu moderne AI-Architekturen, Model Optimization und Enterprise-AI-Integration.
  • Du verfolgst relevante Trends und bringst Inhalte für Whitepaper, Landing Pages, Workshop-Konzepte und AI-Produkte ein, um Kunden für uns zu begeistern.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Mindestens 10 Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise bei einem Individual-Software-Dienstleister oder in der IT-Beratung.
  • Projekterfahrung mit LLMs und Agentic-RAG-Implementierungen sowie mit AI-Agent-Frameworks – ob im Python-Umfeld (LangGraph, Deepagents), im TypeScript-Bereich (Eve, Flue, Mastra) oder im Microsoft-Ökosystem (Semantic Kernel / Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure AI Foundry). Erfahrung mit Vector Databases und MLOps ist von Vorteil.
  • Die Kompetenz, Kunden AI-Konzepte und Architekturen anschaulich und praxisnah zu vermitteln.
  • Fähigkeit zur Integration von AI-Systemen in bestehende Architekturen.
  • Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse auf dem Level C1.
  • Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands: 1-2 Mal im Monat für Workshops und Konferenzen.

Das haben wir zu bieten

  • Kompetitive Vergütung: Je nachdem welche Erfahrungen und Kompetenzen du mitbringst, vergüten wir die Stelle mit einem Bruttojahresgehalt von 80.000 € bis 90.000 € bei 40 Wochenstunden.
  • Sinnhafte Projekte: Entwickle Software, die relevante Kundenprobleme löst und Usern das Leben leichter macht.
  • Gute Software bauen: Hier wird echter Wert auf Code- und Softwarequalität gelegt.
  • Kein 08/15: Bei uns hast du Abwechslung durch unterschiedliche Branchen, Use-Cases und Technologien.
  • Kundenbeziehung auf Augenhöhe: wir pflegen eine ehrliche und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden.
  • Mache einen Unterschied: Du hast bei uns viel Verantwortung und einen großen Gestaltungsspielraum. Wir sind ein mittelständisches Unternehmen, in dem dein Beitrag unseren wirtschaftlichen Erfolg beeinflusst.
  • Lerne immer dazu: Weiterbildung (intern und extern), Training-on-the-job und regelmäßige Weiterentwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche stellen sicher, dass du dich stets weiter entwickelst.
  • Wir arbeiten selbstorganisiert: Mit einem hohen Grad an Selbstorganisation und soziokratischen Strukturen hast du alle notwendigen Freiheitsgrade, um die gesetzten Ziele zu erreichen. Wir geben dir den Freiraum, den Rahmen für gute Arbeit selbst mitzugestalten – im Team wie beim Kunden.
  • Werde berühmt: Du hast eine technische Redaktion, die dich beim Schreiben und Publizieren unterstützt, sodass du als Experte nach außen sichtbar wirst. Teile deine Erfolge und bringe dich und andere weiter.
  • Du musst nicht die klügste Person im Raum sein: Bei uns findest du echte Sparring-Partner, die mehr sind als Rubber Ducks - Kolleg*innen, die deine Ideen gemeinsam mit dir auf die Probe stellen und weiterentwickeln.
  • Schalte einfach ab: Niemand erwartet, dass du nach Feierabend erreichbar bist, Nachrichten beantwortest trotz Krankmeldung oder im Urlaub noch ein paar Kleinigkeiten erledigst. Viele Überstunden und überlange Arbeitszeiten sind bei uns nicht üblich.
  • Gut für die Psyche: unsere das und ein offener Umgang mit psychischer Gesundheit unterstützen dich dabei gesund zu bleiben.
  • Freiraum für dein Privatleben: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, bis zu vier Tage Homeoffice die Woche, spontan einen Tag frei, Arbeiten aus dem EU-Ausland, Sabbatical oder 4 Wochen Urlaub am Stück sind kein Problem.

Darauf freuen wir uns bei Ihnen

SERVIEW ist mehr als ein Unternehmen – es ist gelebte Leidenschaft! SERVIEW steht für Persönlichkeit, Wachstum und Fortschritt. arbeitnow:site-reliability-engineer-ai-a.description:
At our company, it's all about #OneTeam! Join gridscale and help shape the future of the cloud together with OVH.

As a leading tech company, we've been working for over two decades to reduce our environmental footprint - with innovative solutions and an open cloud designed to be sustainable from the ground up: #SustainableByDesign.

Within our #OneTeam, you'll shape the automation-first framework that lets every product team ship securely and at speed on top of OPCP, our On-Prem Cloud Platform.

Our Tech Stack 🚀

· Kubernetes · GitOps · FluxCD / ArgoCD · Ansible · Terraform · OpenStack · Linux · CI/CD

· Python · Bash · Go · Observability (Metrics, Logs, Traces) · LLMs · Agentic Coding Tooling

Your Role💻

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of platform engineering, AI-driven tooling and security by design. Together with your team, you'll build the framework to package and deploy software solutions on top of OPCP - turning vague product ideas into repeatable, observable and self-healing services. You'll work on the conception, automation and operation of the platform, drive continuous improvements and help new teams onboard with the framework and OPCP. Working hand in hand with developers, security specialists and AI researchers, you keep an overview in ambiguous situations, analyze systems and make well-founded decisions based on that analysis.

AI-assisted engineering is part of our daily toolchain because it materially improves how we build and operate the platform – from spec-driven development with LLM assistance and knowledge-base-driven retrieval for incident response and design to agentic coding workflows and faster runbook authoring and review. We are investing in this direction as a structural part of our engineering practice and are looking for teammates who already work this way – not because it is trendy, but because they have seen it compound their own output.

Your Tasks

  • Design, build and maintain the Cloud Store packaging framework that standardizes how software is delivered on OPCP.

  • Extend and evolve the AI substrate - LLM-driven code assistants, knowledge-base retrieval and agentic coding hooks - that amplifies our engineering output.

  • Create and curate agentic coding environments: custom agents and sub-agents, slash commands, hooks and prompt engineering pipelines that become everyday developer tools.

  • Own the knowledge-base layer that powers AI-driven incident response, design assistance and runbook generation.

  • Drive our Kubernetes stack forward and implement robust GitOps pipelines (FluxCD / ArgoCD) for continuous delivery.

  • Write, publish and continuously improve OPCP onboarding runbooks and best-practice guides for internal product teams.

  • Analyze opaque system behavior, surface root causes and deliver concrete, data-backed improvement proposals - even when initial requirements are unclear.

  • Develop, version and operate the Infrastructure as Code stack (Terraform, Ansible) that underpins the platform, and take part in our on-call rotation.

What we offer you💼

  • AI-augmented engineering as a first-class workflow - including agentic coding tooling, knowledge bases as the backbone of our AI workflows and room to push our engineering practices further

  • Exceptional team spirit across all departments and national borders; we live #OneTeam

  • Exciting work in a highly innovative and international environment with cutting-edge technologies

  • 32 vacation days, increasing with length of service

  • Flexible working hours, home office options, and a secure permanent position with market- and performance-based compensation

  • Employer-funded pension plan and an attractive insurance package

  • OVHcloud covers 50% of public transportation costs

  • Up to €400 annual financial contribution from OVHcloud towards sports activities (gym membership, sports classes, etc.)

  • Through Corporate Benefits, you receive attractive discounts at numerous shops and companies

  • We contribute to the leasing of your cargo bike

  • Regular company events and free cold and hot beverages


  • 4+ years of experience in infrastructure or platform engineering, ideally in a security-focused, highly automated environment

  • Proven practice of AI-assisted engineering - you use LLMs for spec-driven development, runbook authoring or agentic coding and have seen it compound your own output

  • Deep knowledge of Linux/Unix internals, system administration and performance tuning

  • Hands-on experience with OpenStack (or a comparable cloud platform) for infrastructure provisioning and management

  • Strong skills in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform and Ansible and the ability to model complex environments as code

  • A solid background in Kubernetes and GitOps workflows (FluxCD / ArgoCD) as well as in designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines

  • Hands-on experience with modern observability stacks - metrics, logs and traces

  • Proficiency in scripting and automation with Python, Bash and Go

  • A solid grasp of security fundamentals (IAM, secrets management, hardening, compliance) and distributed systems concepts (CAP theorem, consensus, fault tolerance)

  • A clear bias toward automation over manual toil, a passion for continuous improvement and strict documentation discipline

  • You thrive in collaborative product teams, bring a strong ownership mentality, a blameless culture mindset and strong communication skills, and you adapt easily when things change

arbeitnow:mitarbeiter-im-kundenservice-c.description:
Einleitung

Wir suchen neue Kolleg:innen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Weg zur Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht und einem starken Team aus über 60 Kolleg:innen begleiten wir tausende Mandant:innen erfolgreich auf dem Weg zum deutschen Pass. Alle unsere Stellen sind Festanstellungen bei uns vor Ort in Cottbus.

Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich selbst einen Eindruck auf unserer Karriereseite. Denn wir können hier schreiben, was wir wollen, am Ende bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung.

Wir bieten Dir

Für viele Mandant:innen bist du der Mensch, der endlich Klarheit bringt. Damit du dich voll darauf konzentrieren kannst, bekommst du bei uns digitale Tools, ein Team ohne Ellenbogen und ein Umfeld ohne Callcenter-Druck.

  • Nur eingehende Anfragen
    Du rufst niemanden unaufgefordert an und verschickst keine ungefragten E-Mails. Du betreust ausschließlich Menschen, die sich selbst bei uns gemeldet haben und Hilfe suchen.
  • Kein Callcenter-Feeling
    Bei uns gibt es keine Fließbandgespräche, keine starren Skripte und kein anonymes Großraumbüro. Du arbeitest in einem überschaubaren Team mit eigenem Arbeitsplatz und kurzen Wegen, auch zur Geschäftsführung.
  • Digitale Tools statt Zettelwirtschaft
    Wir arbeiten digital und mit System, zum Beispiel mit HubSpot. Keine Excel-Listen und keine Zettel, sondern durchdachte Prozesse, die dir die Arbeit erleichtern.
  • Faires Gehalt & Sicherheit
    Wir schätzen deine Arbeit mit einer fairen, guten Bezahlung und geben dir mit einem unbefristeten Vertrag eine langfristige Perspektive.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Du unterstützt Menschen dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Am Ende des Tages weißt du, dass du vielen eine Sorge abgenommen hast.
  • Ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz
    Rückenfreundlicher Stuhl, höhenverstellbarer Tisch, zwei große Monitore, ein hochwertiges Headset und ein leistungsstarker Laptop, egal ob MacBook oder Windows.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit und flexible Teilzeit
    Keine Kernzeiten, keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster. Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell: Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Nach deiner Einarbeitung ist gelegentliches Homeoffice aber kein Problem, auch spontan.
  • Spontan frei, wenn das Leben dazwischenkommt
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend, kurzfristiger Arzttermin oder einfach mal eine Auszeit: Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Altbau-Büro im Herzen von Cottbus
    Zentrale Lage, sehr gute ÖPNV-Anbindung und Mitarbeiterparkplätze direkt um die Ecke. Dazu ein Innenhof für die Pause und ein eigener Fitnessraum im Haus, kostenlos und jederzeit zugänglich.
  • Team-Events und Feel-Good-Angebote
    Ellenbogenmentalität gibt es bei uns nicht, dafür echte Wertschätzung im Alltag und Events wie Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder Halloween-Sause. Zwischendurch sorgt unsere Feel-Good-Managerin mit Massagen und kleinen Auszeiten für Entspannung.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

Als Mitarbeiter im Kundenservice (w/m/d) bist du für viele Mandant:innen die erste Stimme von Migrando. Du beantwortest Fragen, gibst Orientierung und sorgst dafür, dass sich niemand mit seinem Anliegen allein gelassen fühlt.

  • Erste Anlaufstelle über alle Kanäle
    Ob Telefon, Ticketsystem oder Social Media: Du hilfst schnell und freundlich weiter, egal wo die Anfrage reinkommt.
  • Fragen rund um die Einbürgerung beantworten
    Du gibst Auskunft zu unseren Leistungen und erklärst, wie der Weg zum deutschen Pass bei uns abläuft.
  • Statusauskünfte zum Verfahren
    Du schaust im System nach, wo ein Vorgang gerade steht, und erklärst den nächsten Schritt so, dass ihn auch jemand ohne Fachwissen versteht.
  • Zuhören und verständlich erklären
    Viele unserer Mandant:innen lernen gerade erst Deutsch. Du hörst nicht nur, was gefragt wird, sondern erkennst, was dahintersteckt, findest Worte, die ankommen, und erklärst auch gern ein zweites Mal.
  • Termine und Rückrufe
    Du stimmst Rückrufe und Gesprächstermine ab und behältst im Blick, wer wann eine Rückmeldung erwartet.
  • Nachforderung fehlender Unterlagen
    Du erinnerst freundlich an offene Dokumente und erklärst, warum sie gebraucht werden.
  • Saubere Dokumentation
    Du hältst fest, was besprochen wurde, inklusive Rückmeldungen, Beschwerden und Lösungen. So haben alle Kolleg:innen den gleichen Stand.
  • Schnittstelle zur Sachbearbeitung und zum Anwaltsteam
    Wenn eine Frage tiefer geht, leitest du sie mit dem nötigen Kontext weiter und sorgst dafür, dass niemand zweimal dasselbe erzählen muss.
  • Umgang mit Beschwerden und Unmut

arbeitnow:digital-guest-service-customer.description:
We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.

Homaris widmet sich einer der drängendsten Herausforderungen moderner Städte: Menschen aus aller Welt brauchen Orte, an denen sie leben, arbeiten und sich zuhause fühlen können. Wir entwickeln und betreiben vollständig digitalisierte Serviced Apartments in den großen Städten Deutschlands. Unser nächster Schritt: Europa und darüber hinaus.

Mit dem nanopartment® verfolgen wir eine Produktvision, die modernes Wohnen auf Zeit neu denkt – auf kleinstmöglichem Raum.

Unser Umsatz verdreifacht sich innerhalb von zwei Jahren – organisch und aus eigener Kraft. Ohne Venture Capital. Ohne Exit-Strategie. Wir denken langfristig und bauen unser Unternehmen konsequent danach auf.

Außergewöhnliche Menschen machen diese Entwicklung möglich. Jetzt suchen wir eine weitere Person, die diesen Weg mit uns gestaltet.

Your Role

Du führst die operativen Fäden unserer digitalen Gästebetreuung. Aus dem Headoffice in Berlin arbeitest du mit dem Guest Service Supervisor Team und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere weltweiten Guest Service Agents. Du sorgst dafür, dass Gäste eine verlässliche Betreuung erleben, und hältst den Rücken frei für Teams, die täglich mit ihnen sprechen. Am Steuer unserer digitalen Rezeption schaffst du im Hintergrund den reibungslosen Ablauf jedes Aufenthalts.

What You'll Do

Betrieb. Du unterstützt das Guest Service Team im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Apartments aus dem Hintergrund reibungslos laufen.

Qualität. Du entwickelst neue Qualitätskonzepte, kontrollierst die Einhaltung unserer Standards in der Gästekommunikation und schulst die Agents fortlaufend.

Kommunikation. Du entwirfst Nachrichtenvorlagen, mit denen Gäste verlässlich, persönlich und im richtigen Ton erreicht werden.

Second Level. Du bist die Ansprechperson für Agents, wenn es komplex wird, und übernimmst die Lösung, wenn es darauf ankommt.

Onboarding. Du begleitest die Einarbeitung neuer Kolleg:innen und die Weiterbildung bestehender Teammitglieder.

Vertretung. Du vertrittst die Teamlead Guest Service bei Abwesenheit und behältst dann das gesamte Team im Blick.

Schnittstelle. Du stimmst dich eng mit internen Abteilungen und externen Dienstleistern ab, als verlässlicher Partner, der Lösungen zu Ende denkt.

What Makes You a Fit

Service mit Haltung. Du hast einen starken Dienstleistungsgedanken und dich stört es nicht, zu unterschiedlichen Tageszeiten sowie in geregelten Abständen am Wochenende im Dienst zu sein.

Erfahrung. Du bringst Berufserfahrung als Reservierungsmitarbeiter:in, Reservation Agent oder Manager:in, Call Center Agent, Rezeptionist:in oder aus einer anderen serviceorientierten Branche mit.

Organisation. Du organisierst und koordinierst souverän und denkst lösungsorientiert.

Kommunikationsstärke. Du findest schnell Zugang zu unterschiedlichen Persönlichkeiten und vermittelst Standpunkte, Ideen und Lösungen klar.

Digitale Werkzeuge. Du kommst mit Software und digitalen Lösungen im Alltag mühelos zurecht. Erfahrung mit Buchungsplattformen sowie den Property-Management-Systemen Apaleo oder Guesty ist ein Plus.

Sprachen. Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift (jeweils C1).

Digitale Neugier. Du erkennst Potenziale in neuen Tools und bist begeistert davon, wie KI deinen Arbeitsalltag effizienter macht.

The Environment

Homaris ist konsequent langfristig ausgerichtet. Wir investieren nicht in kurzfristiges Wachstum mit dem Ziel, schnell zu verkaufen. Wir bauen etwas Nachhaltiges und Substanzielles auf – und suchen Menschen, die diesen Weg gemeinsam mit uns gehen und langfristig Verantwortung übernehmen wollen.

Das Tempo ist hoch. Die Herausforderungen sind anspruchsvoll und unmittelbar. Unser Team ist bewusst klein gehalten, sodass jede Person einen spürbaren Beitrag leistet.

Wir nehmen uns nicht immer ausreichend Zeit, unsere Erfolge sichtbar zu machen und gemeinsam zu feiern. Daran arbeiten wir – und freuen uns, wenn du uns dabei unterstützt.

What We Offer

Wir definieren unsere Level nicht anhand von Jobtiteln oder Berufsjahren, sondern danach, welche Themen du eigenständig verantwortest und für welche Entscheidungen du einstehst.

Darüber hinaus haben wir uns intensiv damit auseinandergesetzt, was Menschen brauchen, um ihre beste Arbeit zu leisten und gleichzeitig gut zu leben. Daraus ist ein Leistungspaket entstanden, das genau das widerspiegelt: Gesundheit, Mobilität, persönliche Entwicklung, Flexibilität und einige besondere Vorteile, die das Arbeiten in der Reise- und Hospitality-Branche mit sich bringt. Vieles ist bereits dabei.

Die Details stellen wir dir gerne im persönlichen Gespräch vor.

Next Steps

Wenn dich diese Position anspricht, freuen wir uns darauf, mehr über deine Erfahrungen und deine Perspektive zu erfahren.

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf.

Du hast Fragen? Melde dich gerne bei Natalie unter oder +49 157 92465807.

Wir schätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Geschlechter, Kulturen und Hintergründe.

arbeitnow:engineering-lead-germany-berli.description:
At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.

Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning.

The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it!

The role

Context

Parallel uses AI to take administrative work off hospital teams, starting with inpatient coding. Our agents read the full patient record before billing, find what was documented but not coded, and coders validate every suggestion. We work with around 100 hospitals and clinics in France and are launching in Germany in 2027.

You will own our technical roadmap for Germany and be our first engineering leader in the country. You report to Chris Rydhal, CTO and co-founder, and work every day with our General Manager, Germany and our Head of Medical Coding, Germany. Berlin or Munich, hybrid, regular trips to pilot hospitals and to Paris.

Missions

  • Own the German technical roadmap: decide what we build for Germany and in what order, on top of the core engine we share with Paris.

  • Adapt our engine to German coding (ICD-10-GM, OPS, aG-DRG, DKR) with our Head of Medical Coding and AI engineers, and measure its accuracy.

  • Run our agents on German hospital information systems (Dedalus ORBIS first, then CGM, Nexus, Meierhofer, i.s.h.med, Avelios) through ScreenFlow, our computer-use technology, and handle German data (§21 KHEntgG, §301 SGB V, HL7, FHIR / ISiK).

  • Own the technical side of security and compliance: C5 attestation, hospital security reviews (B3S, NIS2), EU hosting and on-premise deployments when pilots need them.

  • Deploy our first German pilots with our Forward Deployed Engineer.

  • Build the German engineering team, as one team with Paris.

In your first months, you will get ScreenFlow running on Dedalus ORBIS at our first pilot hospital, ship the first version of our German engine with our Head of Medical Coding, drive the technical work for our C5 attestation, and hire our Forward Deployed Engineer.

Who you are

  • 8 to 12 years in software engineering, including at least 2 years leading a small team or as tech lead. Still hands-on.

  • You have shipped software into German hospitals or another regulated health environment.

  • You have built integrations with hospital information systems (HL7, FHIR, ideally ISiK) and worked with security certifications (C5, ISO 27001, B3S).

  • LLMs or ML in production are a plus. Experience at a KIS, Medizincontrolling or billing software vendor is a big plus.

  • A builder and an owner who keeps one product with Paris, not two.

  • Native German, fluent English.

Our values

  • Play to Win: we're not here to just take part, deliver something "good enough" or simply enjoy the startup ride. We want to win. That means caring about results, moving fast and bringing the right intensity when it matters.

  • High Trust, High Standards: trust is our starting point. If you join us, it's because we believe you can own your scope and make good decisions. We don't want a company built on approvals, control and micromanagement. But trust comes with accountability: the more freedom you have, the higher the bar.

  • Low Ego, Hands-On: at Parallel, no one is above the work. No title, seniority or past success exempts anyone from getting involved in the actual work. Leading means taking responsibility, not distancing yourself from execution.

  • Don't Take Yourself Too Seriously: we take our mission very seriously, not ourselves. Building a company is intense. We want Parallel to remain a place where people enjoy spending time together, laughing, celebrating and giving energy to others. High standards and a good atmosphere aren't opposites: we want both.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call (30 min).

  2. Technical deep dive with Chris (60 min): a system you built and the hard calls you made.

  3. Design session (90 min, in person or by video): design our first German pilot, end to end.

  4. Meet the team (General Manager and Head of Medical Coding, Germany), then references.

Why join us?

  • Build the German product and engineering team from day one, on a founding team.

  • A product already live in around 100 hospitals, an AI engine and computer-use technology built for hospitals that can't wait for long integration projects.

  • A competitive package

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.
If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

At Lexroom, we set the bar for legal AI—clear, fast, and built for trust. In just a few years, what began as an idea has become a reliable platform adopted by thousands of legal professionals across Europe.

Our mission is clear: make the law faster, clearer, and more reliable, giving lawyers, law firms, and companies the time and confidence to focus on what truly matters.

We're growing fast, backed by top-tier investors and a world-class team committed to rigor, clarity, and impact.

Today, Lexroom is a trusted partner, shaping the evolution of legal AI with the same rigor and precision that define our product.

Join us as Customer Success Manager to build Lexroom's German customer base from the ground up.

You will be the first dedicated CS hire for the German market, owning the full portfolio of German customers end to end. The product already won in Italy, with the numbers to prove it. Germany is next, and you own it.

Your key responsibilities

  • Own the full German customer portfolio from handover to renewal, with a clear goal: keep every customer (retention first) and grow each account through proactive upsell and uplift.

  • 2 to 4 years in Customer Success or account management, ideally at a SaaS, tech, or software company. Exposure to legal or professional-services customers is a plus.

How we work

Lexroom is building the platform where legal work gets done. Founded in Milan in 2023, we are the legal AI built data-first for civil-law Europe: a proprietary base of 7M+ verified legal sources, used today by 12,000+ law firms and in-house legal teams. We move fast and accurate, own outcomes, and say what we mean. Impact is defined by execution, not by title.

An Exceptional Team.

arbeitnow:senior-sales-manager-munich-30.description:
About Munich Electrification

Munich Electrification is an innovative company founded with the aim of accelerating the transition to electric and connected mobility. We develop innovative electronic control units for electric vehicles and stationary storage systems for our global customers. Our international team is composed of highly motivated and exceptional engineers. As a small and specialized team we are well-aware of the importance of each individual colleague and support and promote each employee according to their abilities and needs. Our office with adjacent prototype and testing lab is located in the heart of Munich at the Heimeranplatz.

This is what we stand for:

- Technological Leadership: We challenge norms, innovate quickly, and anticipate future needs. We take smart risks and learn from outcomes to stay ahead.

- Sustainability: We actively drive change for a sustainable future, aware of our impact and inspiring others to build a better world.

- Team Culture: We believe work should be enjoyable, fostering a spirit of inspiration, celebration, and teamwork across the globe.

- Entrepreneurial Spirit: We embrace change, think big, and push limits with passion.

Your role

As Senior Sales Manager, you will drive new business for our battery management systems and electronic control units in the automotive and energy storage markets. You take ownership of qualified leads from Business Development, develop them into concrete opportunities and guide each one through the RFI/RFQ phase and commercial negotiations to contract award. As the customer's primary commercial contact throughout the acquisition phase, you are responsible for pricing, lifetime volumes and contract terms. You work closely with Product Management, Engineering and senior management to develop compelling proposals and ensure a seamless handover to Key Account Management once the contract is signed. In this senior position, you independently lead complex, high-value opportunities and play an active role in shaping our sales organization.

Your future tasks at a glance

• Take ownership of qualified leads from Business Development and develop them into concrete opportunities, acting as the customer's primary commercial contact through to contract or PO signature

• Build trusted relationships with key decision makers and develop a thorough understanding of customer requirements, lifetime volumes, timelines and the competitive landscape

• Define win strategies and prepare go/no-go decisions for each opportunity

• Lead RFI/RFQ processes end to end, including NDAs, clarification of requirements and submission deadlines, and coordinate technical input, cost basis and timelines with Product Management, the CTO and the CCO

• Take full responsibility for the commercial part of offers, including pricing, lifetime volumes, NRE as well as payment and delivery terms, in line with margin targets

• Present proposals and lead negotiations on commercial and contractual terms, such as supply and development agreements, liability and warranty, up to executive level

• Ensure a structured handover of won customers to Key Account Management and incorporate contract learnings into future offers

• Provide Product Management with market insights, including customer requirements,

competitor activity and pricing feedback

• Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast (lifetime volume, revenue, margin, win probability, SOP) and report to management

• Mentor Sales Managers and contribute to the continuous improvement of our sales processes and offer standards.

Who you are and what you have

• Degree in business administration, engineering, industrial engineering or a related field

• At least 5 years of experience in B2B sales of technical products or electronics, ideally in the automotive, energy storage or battery management sector

• Proven track record of winning RFQs and closing multi-year supply or development agreements

• Strong commercial and analytical skills, including pricing, business case development and lifetime volume and margin calculations

• Excellent negotiation and presentation skills and the confidence to engage with buyers, commodity managers, engineering leads and executives

• Structured, self-driven way of working combined with an entrepreneurial mindset and a strong interest in technology

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with Product Management, Engineering and Operations

• Experience with CRM systems and SAP; advanced MS Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint

• Business-fluent German and English, both written and spoken

• Willingness to travel

Our Offer & Benefits

The chance to be part of a highly innovative, agile, and unique team with prestigious customers in the automotive and battery storage sector. You will gain a deeper knowledge around connected & electric vehicle batteries, battery management and electronics development and strive in an exciting work environment

Benefits (Full-time Employees):

- Trust-based working hours and hybrid work

- Adequate and competitive compensation

- Pension Plan/Bonus

- Free access to the fitness center right next to us or subsidized EGYM Wellpass

- Free snacks, coffee, drinks and lunch (freshly cooked by our chef) every day

- Public transport ticket

- Bike-Leasing via Business Bike

- Experience various inspiring and fun team events

- ME-branded clothing

- Option to "work from anywhere" (6 weeks/year)

arbeitnow:junior-engineer-typescript-pyt.description:

Berlin, On-site
Top-of-Market Compensation - Exceptional commitment deserves exceptional reward

Most junior engineers take years to earn full ownership. Here as all our engineers, you will have real impact from week one and be a part of a team shipping a product millions of people use every day. Your first 12 months compress what takes 3 years elsewhere.

You'll join a small team of engineers who have built and shipped at scale, with the support to learn fast. Show us you can own more, and we'll give you more.

We're looking for AI-native Junior Software Engineers who know how to build with AI tools, with different focus points, so you can pick your track:

  2. Python (Backend):

    • If you love building the systems behind the app.

    • You'll build the services that handle rewards, offers, and payments for millions of users.

    • You'll need: strong Python and SQL.

  3. DevOps:

    • If you love building the tools that help everyone else ship.

    • You'll build the CI/CD pipelines, deployments, and AI tooling our engineers use every day, and make them faster and safer.

    • You'll need: strong TypeScript, Python, or Rust; Kubernetes or GitHub Actions is a plus.

    • If you love building with LLMs and want to see them work in production.

    • If you love building the pipelines that turn raw data into decisions.

    • You'll build live pipelines from ingestion to storage, then help keep a warehouse of hundreds of terabytes fast and reliable.

    • You'll need: strong Python and SQL, plus hands-on experience with a database beyond the basics.

What You’ll Do

  • You'll own real problems from first idea to production.

  • You get going on a vague problem without waiting for a spec, and take it further

  • You use AI tools to move faster, and you still check the output.

  • You dig into bugs until you find the real cause.

What You'll Bring

  • Solid fundamentals with proof of depth: projects you shipped, open-source contributions, internships, or strong coursework.

  • Bonus: a live product with real users, a system you built and hardened yourself, or hackathon / competitive programming results.

Why Almedia

  • Grow at Almedia: profitable from launch, higher revenue per employee than Big Tech.

  • Sharp, small team: we keep it small on purpose, every hire raises the bar.

  • Equity: every Berlin employee gets a stake.

  • Top-of-market baseline. Deliver outlier impact, earn accordingly.

Small team, high bar. Growing at scale. If that sounds like home, apply.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

arbeitnow:growth-manager-business-expans.description:
Our bar is high, and this is the best place for ambitious builders.

Bootstrapped and profitable from day one, Almedia is Germany’s fastest-growing company (FT1000). Join us as we build the global leader in rewards, at a $1bn+ revenue run rate and climbing fast.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Growth Manager - Business Expansion (Berlin)

Salary Range: €50k-€65k

At a Glance

You'll win new advertisers and turn their first campaigns into growing, long-term partnerships with Almedia. You'll own the journey from prospecting and closing to campaign launch, optimization, and initial scale-up.

This is a hands-on sales role with clear revenue ownership. Closing the deal is the starting point: you'll learn Almedia’s products in depth, understand what drives campaign performance, and help advertisers build the confidence to commit larger budgets.

 

What You’ll Do 🎯

  • Win new business. Identify and engage advertisers, and publishers. Build your pipeline through targeted outreach, referrals, industry events, and your network.

  • Own the full sales cycle. Lead discovery, pitches, proposals, negotiations, and closing. Understand each advertiser’s goals, buying process, and performance expectations.

  • Learn the product deeply. Build a working understanding of Almedia’s platform, campaign setup, targeting, reward structures, reporting, and optimization tools. Use that knowledge to propose campaigns that can deliver.

  • Own the first campaigns. Coordinate setup and launch with advertisers and internal teams. Agree on test budgets, performance targets, measurement, and clear criteria for scaling.

  • Optimize and scale. Monitor early campaign performance, identify what limits delivery or returns, and take action. Use Almedia’s internal tools to adjust campaign settings and ROAS targets, working with Growth and algorithm teams to improve results.

  • Turn results into larger budgets. Translate campaign data into clear recommendations. Secure budget increases, expand into new geographies or operating systems, and move successful tests into sustained spending.

  • Solve problems early. Spot underdelivery, attribution discrepancies, or performance issues before they damage advertiser confidence. Coordinate resolution and keep the advertiser informed.

  • Deliver revenue targets. Take responsibility for new advertiser acquisition and the revenue generated as their initial campaigns scale. Prioritize opportunities with meaningful commercial potential.

  • Keep a reliable forecast. Maintain an accurate pipeline and a clear view of launch readiness, campaign progress, and expected budget growth.

What Your First 90 Days Look Like

  • Days 1–30: Learn Almedia’s products, sales process, and campaign optimization fundamentals. Shadow sales and campaign reviews, build your target-account list, and begin outreach.

  • Days 31–60: Own discovery calls, pitches, and proposals. Build a qualified pipeline and work alongside experienced Growth Managers on campaign setup, performance analysis, and optimization decisions.

  • Days 61–90: Close your first advertiser partnerships and own their initial campaign launches. Identify performance improvements, make optimization recommendations, and secure budget increases where results support scaling.

  • Beyond 90 days: Build a repeatable record of winning advertisers and growing their spend. Take on larger opportunities and contribute to Almedia’s commercial growth.

What You’ll Bring 💡

  • A record of winning business. You've acquired customers, negotiated agreements, and delivered measurable revenue results in sales, business development, or a commercially focused growth role.

  • The drive to create opportunities. You're comfortable opening doors, reaching decision-makers, and building a pipeline through your own initiative.

  • A consultative sales approach. You ask sharp questions, understand advertiser priorities, and connect your proposal to a clear business outcome.

  • Campaign optimization skills. You can read performance data, diagnose why a campaign is underperforming, and propose changes to improve delivery and returns. You're comfortable forming a hypothesis, running a test, and deciding whether to scale.

  • The ability to learn a technical product. You want to understand how Almedia works in practice. You can learn its tools and explain campaign mechanics clearly to advertisers.

  • Confidence with performance metrics. You understand ROAS, LTV, retention, ARPU, and cohort performance—and how they influence optimization decisions and advertiser budgets.

  • Commercial judgment. You know how to balance an advertiser’s performance goals with a sustainable commercial outcome for Almedia.

  • Ownership and discipline. You follow through, keep your forecast honest, and take responsibility for both closing deals and helping initial campaigns succeed.

     

Bonus Points If You

  • You speak Russian or Turkish on a native level, have ideally worked in this market before and understand the market specifics.

  • Have sold performance marketing, mobile advertising, adtech, or user acquisition solutions.

  • Have hands-on experience optimizing mobile gaming, app, or rewarded user acquisition campaigns.

  • Have relationships with studios, app publishers, agencies, or advertisers expanding internationally.

  • Have turned small campaign tests into significant, sustained advertiser spending.

 

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  • Own Everything: Get It Done. You stay involved from the first conversation through launch and initial scale-up. You bring the right people together and keep progress moving.

  • Take Initiative: Be Proactive. You find promising advertisers and spot opportunities to improve their campaigns before they ask.

  • Move Fast: Start Simple, Iterate Quickly. You launch focused tests, respect the time needed to evaluate results, and make timely decisions based on what you learn.

  • Focus on Impact: Deliver What Matters Most. You prioritize advertisers and campaign improvements with the greatest potential to generate sustainable revenue.

  • Raise the Bar: Have High Standards. You make credible commitments, understand the product you sell, and use each campaign to improve the next one.

 

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

At a Glance

You'll own a real book of business. This is a full 360 degree role with a sales and account management motion. Quota chasing is not the job but you'll have full top-line ownership and will not only shape the work but also execute it.


What You’ll Do 🎯

  • Own a book of 5–15 advertiser accounts end-to-end. You'll be the person behind the growth. The one advertisers ask when something breaks. The one our Director checks in with when an account spikes.

arbeitnow:legal-counsel-it-data-protecti.description:
Hi, we’re AMBOSS and we’re searching for a Legal Counsel to support our business in IT & Data Protection matters!

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we've grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique

Why can this position be exciting for you?

In this role, you will be the core link between regulatory requirements and day-to-day operations. By partnering in early stages with product and engineering teams, you turn complex privacy rules – including emerging AI frameworks – into straightforward, actionable guidance that keeps projects moving forward & safely. From streamlining vendor reviews and data subject requests to mapping risks across our systems, your work lead to practical processes, ensuring AMBOSS expands into new markets with scalable compliance already built in.

You will:

  • Be a trusted data protection advisor for our teams. You partner with product and engineering from concept to launch, including on [AI-based features / new markets]. You give clear, pragmatic recommendations.

  • Own data protection risk assessment across our systems and processes. You identify, assess and prioritise compliance risks and turn them into practical frameworks that teams can use.

  • Keep us ahead of international requirements. You track data protection and related regulation in our markets, including AI-related rules, and turn them into pragmatic solutions for AMBOSS.

  • Make vendors, tools and contracts easy to get right. You review and negotiate data processing agreements and assess new software and vendors, so the business gets fast, reliable answers.

  • Build and improve our data protection operations. You own our policies, the record of processing activities and the handling of data subject requests (access, rectification, erasure). You simplify, standardise and automate wherever possible.

  • Work as one team. You collaborate closely with our DPO, the General Counsel and the wider Legal team, and bring in external input when it makes sense.

You bring:

  • Legal qualification (Diploma; 1st state exam, LLM or international equivalent)

  • At least 4 years of experience in IT law and data protection at a law firm or in-house, with a clear track record of giving practical, decision-ready advice to a diverse range of stakeholders

  • Strong working knowledge of GDPR and how to apply it pragmatically in a product environment

  • Prior experience working alongside engineering, product, and technical teams to translate complex legal, regulatory, and compliance requirements into actionable product features, technical specifications, and workflows

  • Technical curiosity: you enjoy understanding how systems and data flows work

  • A pragmatic interest in AI and legal technology, and ideally experience using these tools to work faster and more effectively

You enjoy:

  • A diverse Legal Portfolio: Drive a fast-evolving mix of IT legal matters, data protection frameworks, and commercial advisory

  • Uncharted legal territory: High-stakes regulatory challenges and emerging tech questions where the playbook hasn't been written yet

  • High autonomy, real impact: Move past "no" to craft actionable, business-enabling solutions with complete ownership of your domain

  • Continuous Improvement: Disrupt outdated legal workflows and refine our operational baseline for scale

arbeitnow:fullstack-software-engineer-mu.title: Fullstack Software Engineer (m/f/d)
arbeitnow:fullstack-software-engineer-mu.description:
YOUR JOB

AI can write code now. It can't decide what's worth building, and it can't tell whether its own output is right. That part is yours. As a Fullstack Software Engineer in our customer-facing feature team, you'll take on real problems, often co-leading an initiative with a fellow engineer. You'll carry them from the first discovery conversation to production and beyond, working with Product, Design and engineers who would rather own an outcome than close a ticket. What you build lands with many companies working to keep their data, and the people behind it, safe.

WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Own what you build, end to end. Shape capabilities in discovery with your Product Owner and Designer, build them across frontend and backend, ship them to production, and make sure they work properly in customers' hands.

  • Help decide what gets built, not just how. Challenge assumptions, suggest alternatives, and help define requirements before anyone writes code.

  • Engineer with AI, responsibly. Use agentic workflows and AI tooling every day while you stay accountable for architecture, security and quality. You'll also help shape how our team builds with AI.

  • Build the new and improve the existing. Your time splits roughly evenly between new product capabilities and modernising an established codebase. Every area you touch should be better when you leave it.

  • Work beyond your team's walls. Spot dependencies with our other teams early, raise risks before they block delivery, and keep stakeholders informed.

  • Deliver as a team. Join four talented engineers who share ownership. You'll work in four-month terms with two-week sprints, keep rituals lean, and adjust scope when reality changes.

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

  • The freedom, trust, and tools to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company, committed to doing genuine good in the digital world

  • Enjoy a high degree of flexibility with tailored working hours, choice of work location, and benefits that support your lifestyle, health, and family needs

  • Join a secure, future-focused role in a dynamic scale-up positioned to make a major impact in the rapidly expanding Security & Compliance market

  • Grow along expert or leadership paths with support from employee accelerator programs, bi-annual feedback cycles, and a personal training budget

  • Work in an environment that values autonomy, rapid decision-making, a flat hierarchy, and collaborative, eye-level communication to keep things moving forward.

THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD

  • You think in problems, solutions and how to implement them properly to deliver value to customers, not tickets that should to be done.

  • You're a builder across the stack, with at least 3 years of professional software engineering experience. You've shipped features on both frontend and backend. Your backend are Java, Node.js using typescript or a similar typed languages, a knowledge in ruby is a plus. Your frontend is a modern SPA framework: Vue is ideal and React works too. You don't need deep expertise in both, but you can deliver on each without help.

  • You treat Product and Design as partners. You've worked closely with Product Managers and Designers. You've disagreed with one, and the result was a better idea.

  • Ambiguity doesn't stop you. You don't wait for a perfect ticket. You ask the right questions, make a call, write it down and move forward.

  • You use AI seriously, but not blindly. You've built real workflows with AI tools and you know how to verify what they produce through reviews, tests and asking "is this actually right?" You don't vibe-code your way to production.

  • You fix what's broken, deliberately. You won't ignore an issue just because it sits outside your ticket. You also know which ones to fix now, which to flag for later, and which rabbit holes to stay out of.

  • You explain things clearly. You can describe a technical decision in plain English to a customer, a colleague from Sales or Support, or a fellow engineer. You've worked in more than one company or product and you bring what you learned.

LAST BUT NOT LEAST. FROM THE BOTTOM OF OUR HEARTS:

No matter your origin, ethnicity, gender identity, religion or individual requirements; at DataGuard, all that counts is the person you are. As Guards and Guardettes, we are united not only by our dedication, but also by our shared belief in our purpose: Protect the people behind the data. Convince us with your personality and your skills – and together we will make great things happen. We are looking forward to meeting you!

#LI-DNI

Founded in 2025, Taxforce rethinks tax advisory from the ground up: AI-powered and highly automated, yet personal. We're starting with healthcare professionals, a complex and underserved segment, and we grow both organically and through M&A.

This is a €40B market in Germany alone, with processes that have barely changed in decades. AI now enables a fundamental shift, and there are no playbooks yet. We're writing them. We're a small, highly ambitious team in Berlin, backed by €5M from Tenet VC and founded by alumni of Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Bain & Company, Y Combinator and the former Klarna Head of Engineering.

The role

You work right in the middle of our tax work for doctors’ and dentists’ practices. You support our tax advisors on live mandates from day one. Because tech and tax work together at Taxforce, you also help turn manual steps into automation.

Tasks

  • Ongoing bookkeeping. Prepare financial accounting for our practices in DATEV: receipt capture, booking, account reconciliation.

  • Year-end and returns. Prepare annual financial statement packages and give draft-level input on tax returns, with feedback from our tax advisors.

  • Deadlines and documents. Support our digital mail and tax-assessment processing, deadline control and client master data.

  • Automation. Test our internal tools and help automate recurring steps such as document classification and data extraction.

Requirements

  • Relevant studies. You’re studying business, economics, law, tax or a related field, with a strong interest in tax and accounting.

  • First practical experience. You’ve worked in a tax firm, accounting or audit, as an intern, working student or trained Steuerfachangestellte/r.

  • Care & accuracy. You work carefully and precisely, because in tax every detail counts.

  • Structured & independent. You organise yourself well and get things done without everything spelled out.

  • Tech-savvy. You use AI tools comfortably and enjoy building small automations. DATEV experience is a plus.

  • German language skills. Our clients speak German, so we require fluent German (C2) and good English.

Benefits

  • Learn hands-on from tax advisors. Work side by side with experienced tax advisors on real mandates, with direct feedback and mentoring.

  • Ownership from day one. Take on real responsibility in live client work early on.

  • Front-row seat to AI in the real world. See how AI changes the daily work of a tax firm and help build it.

  • Healthcare insight. Understand how medical and dental practices work financially, a segment few tax firms truly know.

The details

Full-time internship for 3 to 6 months, start any time of the year, on-site in our Berlin office five days a week.

How to apply

Send us your CV and a few lines on why this role fits you. Our process has three steps: a 30-minute intro call, a short live case from our day-to-day work, and a conversation with the founders.

Maternity cover - 18-month contract duration

  • Hybrid working model: We love our brand new office in Prenzlauer Berg. But sometimes you need a little more flexibility. Zenjob’s flexible working model combines the best of both worlds, so you can work remotely up to 2 days / week (1 day, during the first 6 months, so we can guarantee you the best onboarding).

  • Dog-lover: If you have a dog, feel free to bring it with you. We don’t bite and always have a bowl of water in our range of drinks

arbeitnow:partnership-manager-german-spe.description:
About 8returns

Every online shop has returns. Most treat them as a cost. We help brands turn them into a better customer experience, more exchanges instead of refunds, and less work for their teams.

400+ brands run their returns on 8returns, including Tommy Hilfiger, Reebok, Fielmann and OACE. We’re a small team based in Berlin, with short decision paths, direct feedback and room to own your work end to end.

The role

You’ll build and grow the partner network that helps make 8returns a leading returns solution for e-commerce brands in DACH. You’ll work closely with our founders to decide where to focus, which partners to invest in and what to launch together.

You’ll take ownership of existing relationships and build new ones with agencies, logistics providers and e-commerce technology companies. You’ll be the main point of contact for key partners and work with sales and product to turn those relationships into merchant referrals, joint offers or integrations that solve real merchant problems.

What you’ll do

  • Own and grow a portfolio of key partners across DACH. Decide where to invest based on merchant needs, commercial potential and the long-term value for both sides.

  • Open new relationships and represent 8returns in conversations with agency founders, partner executives and commercial leads. Explain where 8returns fits and get the right people on both sides aligned.

  • Build and execute joint plans with partners. Agree on what to launch first, who owns each step, how you’ll measure success and when you’ll review progress together.

  • Onboard partners and give their teams the training, materials and referral process they need to introduce 8returns. Work with sales and product to launch and grow referrals, joint campaigns or integrations.

  • Track the results that matter for each partnership, such as qualified referrals, sales opportunities or merchant adoption. Use regular partner check-ins to resolve blockers and decide what to improve or expand.

  • Use AI to map the e-commerce ecosystem, research potential partners and prepare outreach.

What you bring

  • You’ve owned external relationships and can point to a concrete commercial result, such as qualified referrals, a joint launch or merchant adoption.

  • You’re comfortable starting relationships from scratch, leading conversations with senior decision-makers and getting both sides to agree on what happens next.

  • You can turn an agreement into a launch, with clear owners, deadlines and regular follow-up across teams and companies.

  • You’re comfortable tracking results and deciding where to focus your time.

  • You’re fluent in German and comfortable leading commercial conversations and writing follow-ups in German. You also communicate clearly in English.

  • Experience in partnerships, business development or a related commercial role is valuable. Familiarity with Shopify, logistics, e-commerce or B2B SaaS is a plus.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary

  • Fully remote, with regular team meetups

  • Responsibility from day one, with the chance to build and lead our partner network across DACH and even broader markets

Hiring process

  1. Intro call (15 min)

  2. Deep dive (60 min)

  3. Call with our founders (30 min)

  4. Paid trial day

arbeitnow:gtm-engineer-london-55076.title: GTM Engineer
arbeitnow:gtm-engineer-london-55076.description:
Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain that moves them from donation to resale is offline, manual and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We run a B2B marketplace where resellers and stores buy clothing in bulk, and we build the AI systems that digitise the supply chain behind it.

Our buyers sell on eBay, Vinted, Depop, Whatnot, eBay Live and TikTok Shop, or run vintage stores from Brick Lane to Paris to New York. They source graded stock from wholesalers and rag houses across many countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise an item from a single photo.

We are now going well beyond vintage. Live sellers can sell almost anything, and there is an opportunity for Fleek to be the backend for B2B resale. We've now started onboarding customers alongside supply from Japan, South Korea, the Philippines and Thailand.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill and tripled in size year on year. We've raised ~$50M from a16z, Y Combinator, HV Capital and others, and recently closed our Series B. Our advisors and private investors include operators behind Depop, Shopify and Postmates.

We're looking for people who want to build something that matters, and move fast doing it.

About the role

You'll join the GTM team as our GTM Engineer, reporting to our GTM lead and working day to day with the new business team. You'll own the system we use to find and win customers, on both sides of the marketplace.

On the demand side, that means online resellers, live sellers and physical stores in the UK, Europe and the US, buying vintage, deadstock, new with tags and luxury. On the supply side, it means the brands, brokers, wholesalers and rag houses who sell to them. As we add new categories and markets, the system has to find those customers too.

We already have pipelines that scrape marketplaces and load leads into our CRM. The next step is everything after that: putting the right leads first, reaching them well, and learning from every outcome. You'll own the engine end to end, from the first scrape to the revenue each new customer brings in.

This is not a typical B2B SaaS GTM engineering role. You won't spend your days wiring a CRM to a LinkedIn sequencer or building dashboards. Everyone on our commercial team builds their own tools with AI. You'll take on the problems they can't: systems that improve themselves, infrastructure that scales, and outreach that works within limits set by platforms like Meta.

The role is part engineer, part product manager and part commercial. You won't carry a closes target, but you'll own every metric that moves it.

The problem you'll solve

We want a system that finds the right customers, puts them in order, reaches out, and gets better every week. It runs as a loop:

  1. Find. Source leads across marketplaces and social platforms, for every segment and market we sell into.

  2. Prioritise. Score each lead on the signals that predict a good customer, not just a likely reply.

  3. Reach out. Contact them on Instagram, WhatsApp, email, phone or LinkedIn, personalised by AI and handed to a rep at the right moment.

  4. Learn. Feed every outcome back into scoring. If a store replied but wasn't a fit, similar leads drop down the list, so we stop spending tokens and rep time on them. Then back to step 1.

To make that loop work, you'll build a second brain for GTM: one layer that holds everything we know about a customer, with models and agents running on top. That includes the messages we sent and how they replied, how fast they replied and closed, what they sell and where, what they click and search for in our app, what they told our reps on calls, and how much they spend and how well they retain.

The same data powers our account management team, who look after customers once they've placed their first orders. Matching each buyer with the right supply is one of their next big problems, and you'll help solve it.

What you'll do

  • Own the acquisition engine. Learn how our current pipelines work and improve them. If a rebuild is the right call, make the case for it, and keep leads flowing to the reps while you build.

  • Source at scale in new segments. Find vintage stores, live sellers, deadstock and luxury buyers, and new suppliers, in every market we enter.

  • Build the scoring and feedback loop. Define what a good lead looks like for each segment, then keep refining it on what actually closes and what actually spends.

  • Engineer multi-channel outreach. Instagram, WhatsApp, email, calls and LinkedIn, personalised by AI and built around real limits like Instagram DM caps and Meta restrictions.

  • Own the funnel numbers. Leads sourced per day on each platform, reply rate, conversion rate and GMV per close by source. Use them to decide what to fix next.

  • Sit with the reps and talk to customers. Learn why a lead is good and how each segment wants to be sold to. Then automate the repetitive parts of the rep's day.

  • Turn repeat work into agents. Qualification, first messages, reply handling, dedupe and CRM hygiene should run without a person.

  • Keep it efficient. Every system you build should make sense on cost per lead and unit economics.

  • Connect acquisition to retention. Make sure new customers land cleanly with account management, and help build the buyer-to-supply matching they rely on.

What you bring

  • A strong technical background. You've built and run real systems, such as data pipelines, scrapers, models or production infrastructure. You've done more than configure tools.

  • An AI-first mindset, a step ahead. You build with Claude and other models every day and know where agents work and where they break. Our commercial team is very AI-literate, and you'll push them further.

  • Curiosity about the customer. You want to know why one lead closes and another doesn't, and how each segment wants to be sold to. You're happy on a call with a reseller.

  • Problem solving over playbooks. You take an ambiguous problem, form your own view and ship something that works. We'd rather hire someone who works it out than someone repeating what worked elsewhere.

  • Ownership. You challenge how things are done, bring your own recommendations and explain why.

  • Rigour with numbers. You track honest metrics, know where your funnel leaks and judge your systems on results.

  • Excitement about the space. You see how big the opportunity is and want to build it.

Nice to have

  • GTM, growth or RevOps experience, including outbound you've run yourself

  • Founder or early-startup experience where you owned growth end to end

  • Experience building ranking, scoring or recommendation models

  • Experience building for marketplaces, resellers, live selling or independent retail

  • Familiarity with secondhand, vintage, deadstock or luxury fashion

  • Running multi-channel outbound under platform limits (DM caps, deliverability, warm-up)

What good looks like

  • First 30 days: you know the current pipelines inside out, have sat with the reps and have shipped your first improvements, with leads still flowing. You've shared your plan to improve what's there or rebuild it, and why.

  • 3 months: one data layer joins outreach, replies, closes, app activity, call notes and spend. Scoring runs on it, and the loop from outcome back to scoring is live for at least one segment.

  • 6 months: the system improves itself. Each week it sources more leads, and better ones, across our segments and markets, and conversion and GMV per close are rising.

  • 12 months: the engine is the backbone of acquisition across vintage, deadstock and luxury, on both demand and supply. Agents run the repeat work, and you focus on what to build next.

What you'll get

  • Competitive salary plus a performance bonus tied to qualified pipeline

  • Generous equity: being on Fleek means you'll own a part of it

  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage

  • A collaborative team in a lovely office in the heart of East London

  • Access to founders. We're a small team and they're heavily involved (and good fun!)

  • Exclusive employee discounts to buy on Fleek

  • Access to borrow any item from our collection of vintage and reworks in the office

  • A disproportionate level of responsibility and the chance to drive massive impact

How we work

High ownership, non-hierarchical and fast-moving. We hire problem solvers, not order takers. If you have a better way to do something, and it moves the numbers at a sensible cost, go for it.

Our commercial team builds its own tools, so each new hire starts more effective than the last. People who deliver get more scope quickly. You'll work embedded with the GTM team, ship fast and see your work in the pipeline within days, not quarters.

The practicalities

  • Location: London HQ, E1, Spitalfields / Shoreditch

  • Work model: in person, with trust-based flexibility

  • Stage: post-Series B, hyper-growth

  • Team: a GTM team of 5 AEs in new business and 3 AMs in account management, within 100+ people across London, India and Pakistan

  • Process: an intro call, then an in-person case study in two parts: one on the business with our GTM lead, one technical with our engineers

Our values

Five values shape how we work at Fleek:

  • Dream Big and Disrupt Yourself: Push the most ambitious version of what you're building. Step out of your comfort zone. Nothing is out of reach.

  • Absolute Ownership: The buck stops with you. Drive initiatives to completion. Experiment, learn, persevere. The job isn't done until the job is done.

  • Curiosity Leads the Way: Don't accept anything at face value. Ask questions you don't know the answer to. That's how you innovate.

  • Talk to the Customer: Deeply understand their challenges, motivations and ambitions. Every decision starts with the customer at the centre.

  • Embrace Diversity: A global team building for a global supply chain. Bring your authentic self and embrace the diversity of everyone you encounter.

Ready to build the infrastructure for the world's fastest-growing fashion economy? If you want to work on genuinely hard problems, with a world-class team, at a company that's tripling annually, we'd love to hear from you.
