About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. Bret currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Open AI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs.

What you’ll do

You'll own the operational backbone that connects what we sell to what we bill: turning executed contracts and agent usage into accurate bookings and reports, and turning the data behind both into critical insights the business acts on. This role sits at the center of the company’s business model and works across Sales, Finance, Legal, Pricing, GTM Systems, and Agent Development.

Own order management across the customer lifecycle

  • Own the path from signature to booking: build, verify, and book quotes across the customer lifecycle, capturing all critical commercial terms

  • Collaborate across GTM Operations, Finance, and Sales Compensation to ensure bookings flow accurately into all downstream systems and reporting

  • Leverage and spearhead order management guides and best practices, influencing policies and processes as new terms and products emerge

Accelerate usage tracking and reporting

  • Partner with Agent Development to set up, verify, and maintain outcome-based usage tracking across agents

  • Run the monthly consumption reporting and billing cycle for our growing customer base, delivering key reports to the company and to the Customer

  • Serve as the owner for usage questions from customers, Sales, and Agent Development

Support our deal operations and velocity

  • Draft, review, and execute order forms, working with our Pricing team to align on commercial negotiation, deal forecast, and downstream operability

  • Partner with Sales, Legal, Pricing, and Finance across the deal lifecycle to execute deals cleanly and drive scalability over time

Build the operational machine with us

  • Continuously identify repetitive processes across the order management lifecycle and collaborate across the Go-to-Market Operations team to automate and scale them

  • Work with Revenue Operations and GTM systems to define billing processes and policies for new products and pricing models

  • Ramp from running standard processes to owning complex and ambiguous scenarios

What you’ll bring

  • 2–4 years in deal desk, order management, billing operations, or revenue operations at a B2B SaaS company

  • Experience owning an operational booking and/or billing queue end-to-end with high accuracy against monthly deadlines

  • Experience with CRMs (e.g., Salesforce) and a CPQ or billing system; comfortable reading a contract and translating terms into system fields

  • Strong attention to detail and clear written communication skills to collaborate with Sales, Finance, Legal, and customers

  • Ability to identify areas for improvement and build solutions using AI tooling

  • Based in San Francisco and able to work in-office with the team

Even Better…

  • Experience with usage-based billing (commitments, overages, credits, true-ups)

  • Familiarity with Quoting and Contract Lifecycle Management tools

  • SQL or spreadsheet modeling skills

  • Exposure to sales compensation, revenue recognition, or partner and reseller billing

  • Experience at a high-growth company where you helped stand up a process from scratch

Our values

  • Trust: We do the right thing, even when no one is looking, and even when it’s hard. When we screw up, we take accountability, fully and completely. We act in such a way that if all of our actions were completely visible to our customers, we would be proud.

  • Customer Obsession: Our entire business is designed to ensure every agent built on Sierra succeeds, and that we are accountable to our customers and their success. We do whatever it takes to make our customers successful, and we go the extra mile in how we show up as a partner with unreasonable hospitality.

  • Craftsmanship: A great company is the aggregation of thousands of things done well. As they say, “how you do anything is how you do everything”. Most important is craftsmanship in building agents that are so great that people thank them at the end of a call. That’s the standard.

  • Intensity: We operate with urgency, and we want to win. We are never complacent. We fight to win every deal, big or small, using the full force of the company. And when we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We work hard, and turn on the afterburners when needed. But we pick up our parents at the airport when they’re visiting from out of town. We go to our kids’ events. And we show up for one another, in moments of celebration and hardship.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized when working onsite

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region and employment type, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply through the link on this page even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description.

Sierra is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws, including veteran status and disability status. Hiring decisions are made by people, based on merit. If you need a reasonable accommodation for a disability, a religious practice, pregnancy or any related condition at any point in the application or interview process, contact us at ----- Requests are handled confidentially and do not affect your candidacy.

arbeitnow:sales-enablement-lead-london-2.title: Sales Enablement Lead
arbeitnow:sales-enablement-lead-london-2.description:
You make every rep and every manager on our commercial team better, every week, so we win more of the deals that matter.

WHAT WE ARE BUILDING AT CONVEO

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high-quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to hear from real people at scale and turn what they say into decisions.

#1 WHAT PROBLEM ARE WE SOLVING

In a year our commercial team has grown to 60+ client-facing people across New York, San Francisco, London and Antwerp, and we’re doubling again. Hiring great people is only half the job. The other half is making every one of them great, fast, and keeping them there. That’s this role.

#2 THE TEAM YOU WILL JOIN

You’ll report to our VP Sales and work hand in hand with Talent Development, who are building our enablement system: the knowledge hub, the competency framework and the skills data behind it. You make that system real on the ground: on calls, in deals and in 1:1s. You’ll work every day with our Sales Directors, Client Growth Managers, Research Impact Leads and the managers who lead them, and closely with Sales leadership, Product Marketing and GTM Ops.

#3 HOW WE OPERATE

  • Relentless ownership. See it. Own it. Don’t wait to be asked.

  • Low ego, radical candor. Say the hard thing because you care.

  • Think AI first. Start from the agent, not the spreadsheet.

  • Speed. We execute with the smallest possible team. We work hard and we have fun.

THE ROLE

As Sales Enablement Lead, you own how our reps and managers get better. You coach in the field, turn our skills and pipeline data into action, and hold reps and managers to the development plans they commit to.

This is not a role for building slide decks or running a learning platform. It’s for someone who has carried a number, knows exactly what good sounds like on a call, and wants to get a whole team performing at that level.

YOUR MISSION

1. Coach the field

  • Run weekly call reviews, deal clinics and live sessions across Sales, Client Growth and Research Impact.

  • Lift the skills that win complex deals: deep discovery, building the business case, multi-threading and closing with a clear next step.

  • Bring top performers into the room so what works spreads across the team, and design and run the enablement at our team off-sites.

Your bar: reps feel the difference on their next call, not next quarter.

2. Coach the coaches

  • Work with every sales manager on how they coach, not just on what their team does.

  • Prepare managers for 1:1s with each rep’s skills data, and agree development plans together.

Your bar: managers run sharper 1:1s because you’ve been in them.

3. Turn data into action

  • Read call-skills scores alongside pipeline, win rates and stage velocity, and spot the patterns by role, region and stage.

  • Decide where coaching goes next, then prove whether it moved the numbers.

  • Use AI agents and practice avatars to scale coaching beyond the hours in your day.

Your bar: every coaching decision has a number behind it.

4. Ramp people and hold the line

  • Run onboarding for each new cohort of Sales Directors and certify them before they go live.

  • Follow through on every development plan with reps and managers, and report progress to leadership every week.

Your bar: new reps ramp faster, and no development plan goes quiet.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • In 90 days: you know every rep, every manager and every deal that matters. A weekly coaching rhythm is live in every region, and every manager has a development plan for each person on their team.

  • In 6 months: the difference is measurable. Deeper discovery, sharper business cases, and deals that keep moving instead of stalling.

  • In 12 months: we have a world-class commercial team. New reps ramp in record time, every manager coaches with data, and the best sellers want to join Conveo because of how we develop people.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Must-haves

  • You’ve done the job. A consistent record of hitting quota as an AE or Sales Director in B2B SaaS, selling complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

  • You’ve made others better. As a team lead, player-coach or enablement lead, with results you can point to.

  • You coach managers as well as reps, and senior sellers take your feedback seriously.

  • You’re fluent with data. At home in HubSpot (or Salesforce), call-recording tools and dashboards, and you turn numbers into a coaching plan.

  • You hold people accountable, warmly and directly.

Mindset

  • A go-getter. You go and find the problem instead of waiting for it to land on your desk.

  • Energised by speed, ambiguity and a company that’s doubling in size.

  • AI-first. You already use AI to work faster, and you want to build with it.

Bonus

  • Tech sales experience; even better, market research, insights or consulting.

  • You’ve built or run onboarding in a hyper-growth scale-up.

  • Experience coaching teams across the US and Europe.

WHY JOIN US

  • Shape how a fast-growing AI company sells, from the ground up.

  • Work directly with our founders and sales leadership.

  • Join the cutting edge of how a business works: AI-first in everything we do, from how we sell to how we grow our people.

PLUS

  • Competitive compensation with meaningful equity upside.

  • Hybrid working, with offices in New York, San Francisco, London and Antwerp.

  • A culture built on taste, speed, ownership, and ambition.

arbeitnow:junior-it-support-analyst-edin.description:
Hybrid working with two/three days a week in our Edinburgh office, depending on ‘in-office’ support required that week.

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role

We’re looking for a Junior IT support analyst to join our TechOps team, reporting to the Senior IT support analyst. This role will help us deliver outstanding IT support to Seccl staff as we continue to scale.

Our TechOps team sits within Engineering and underpins Seccl’s modern workplace. It’s a fast moving, collaborative environment with plenty of variety, from supporting joiners, movers and leavers, to managing the Mac device lifecycle and SaaS admin. You’ll quickly build hands on experience with the latest tech.

What you’ll own

  • Act as the first point of contact for internal IT queries, owning triage and providing first contact resolution where possible

  • Meet first response SLAs and keep colleagues updated on ticket progress through clear, friendly communication

  • Support the joiner / mover / leaver process, from equipment provisioning and account setup to access changes and deactivation, maintaining an accurate IT asset register

  • Keep endpoints compliant with our security standards in a Mac first environment

  • Use our ticketing tools (e.g., Jira Service Management) and suggest pragmatic improvements to workflows and automation

  • Be a friendly face for TechOps, especially on busy office days - helping new starters settle in and resolving day-to-day issues quickly

This role’s for you if...

  • You’re proficient with Mac and comfortable supporting colleagues in a Mac based environment (essential)

  • You have a strong interest in technology, a problem solving mindset and clear, empathetic communication (essential)

  • You’re organised, proactive, friendly and confident engaging with people across the business (essential)

  • You’re happy to work 2–3 days a week from our Edinburgh office to support colleagues in person (essential)

  • You’ve had exposure to Microsoft 365 - Azure AD, Entra, Outlook, SharePoint, OneDrive (desirable)

  • You’ve used Jamf or other endpoint management (e.g., Intune) and understand the basics (desirable)

  • You’ve used Jira Service Management or similar ticketing systems and/or the Atlassian suite (desirable)

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You’re less comfortable in people-facing roles. As the first port of call for IT issues, and one of the first faces employees meet as they join Seccl, strong people skills are essential!

  • You’re not comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet

  • You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen

  • You don’t like change. You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 £27,000 - £30,000, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off and paid dependant leave

  • 💙 Two volunteering days each year

  • 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

  • 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

  • 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

  • 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

  • 👪 Enhanced parental leave

  • 💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

  • 📖 £750 annual learning budget

  • 🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

  • 🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

  • 🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

  • 🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too:

  • Screening call - 20 mins initial chat with one of our Talent team

  • First stage – 45 mins competencies-based interview with the hiring manager and IT support analyst

  • Second stage – one hour technical interview or assessment with the hiring manager and the Senior TechOps manager

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.

Everyone’s welcome

We want to build a diverse and inclusive company full of brilliant people with different skills, experiences and perspectives. All applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you.

arbeitnow:ai-solutions-engineer-rd-farri.title: AI Solutions Engineer - R&D
arbeitnow:ai-solutions-engineer-rd-farri.description:
AI Solutions Engineer - R&D

 

➡️ Do you understand how R&D and engineering teams work, from technical research and technology evaluation through to product development and innovation?

➡️ Have you gone beyond using AI to actually building solutions, integrating APIs, developing agents or automating complex workflows?

➡️ Can you combine hands-on technical capability with the confidence to engage enterprise customers, understand their challenges and design solutions that deliver real value?

 

If this sounds like your next move, we’d love to hear from you.

 

Role Summary:

We have an exciting new role as an AI Solutions Engineer to support our R&D customers.

You’ll work alongside Account Executives and Account Managers throughout the sales process, speaking directly with prospective customers to understand their R&D and data workflows, uncover what they’re trying to achieve, and design AI-powered solutions around those needs. This isn’t a role where you simply demo an existing product. You’ll be expected to build and tailor the solution for the customer — using Patsnap’s data, APIs, MCP capabilities and AI tools to create agents, workflows, prototypes and proof-of-concepts that bring their use case to life.

The brief is simple:

Understand the customer. Build the solution. Prove the value.

We’re looking for people who can bring together:

Domain knowledge + customer-facing experience + real AI build capability

A typical day could involve joining several customer calls, running technical discovery, building a prototype between meetings, demonstrating it live to a prospect, refining it based on feedback and, where needed, supporting deployment after signature.

We're looking for someone who brings together three core strengths:

  • R&D & Engineering Workflow Understanding: You understand how R&D, engineering and innovation teams operate, the challenges they face and where AI can deliver value.

  • Customer-Facing & Commercial Capability: You're confident engaging enterprise customers, leading technical discovery and translating requirements into compelling solutions.

  • Hands-On AI Development: You can independently build AI agents, integrations, automated workflows and technical prototypes, rather than simply demonstrating existing software.

You'll use Patsnap's proprietary R&D and innovation intelligence, APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) capabilities and AI technologies to design, build and demonstrate solutions tailored to customer needs.

That could involve developing an AI agent to accelerate technical research, integrating Patsnap's intelligence into existing enterprise systems, automating technology scouting processes or creating intelligent workflows to support engineering and product development decisions.

You'll take customer challenges from initial discovery through to working prototypes and proof-of-concepts, demonstrating how AI can deliver meaningful improvements to their R&D processes.

This is not a traditional software engineering role. You won’t be expected to build production software from scratch, but you will need to be technically confident, comfortable building independently and credible in front of enterprise customers.

Want to see the platform you'd be representing?
Check out this short overview:

This is a hybrid position in our London, UK office, working 1–2 days in the office and the rest from home.

 

Who are we?

Patsnap is a global, pre-IPO company that transforms the way organizations harness their Intellectual Property and Research and Development productivity. Our platform revolutionizes how IP and R&D teams collaborate across the entire innovation lifecycle, using domain-specific AI to accelerate the creation of market-ready products. With over 12,000 customers worldwide, including some of the biggest names in innovation, Patsnap is at the forefront of technological advancement. Our $300M Series E funding round brings our valuation to a $1 billion unicorn status, and we still have a remarkable amount of growth ahead. 

 

We have a vibrant and diverse team with offices in London, Toronto, Singapore, Shanghai and remote teams based in US. Our hyper-growth trajectory is powered by our people, and we are extremely proud of our company-wide vision, work ethic, and entrepreneurial spirit. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where talent thrives and ideas bloom.   

Why Join Patsnap?

  • Build with AI every day. Design and develop AI agents, technical workflows, integrations and prototypes that address real customer challenges.

  • Work at the forefront of R&D innovation. Help leading organisations transform how they approach research, technology discovery, engineering and product development.

  • Go beyond traditional pre-sales. You'll have the freedom to design and build tailored solutions rather than simply demonstrate existing software.

  • Make a tangible commercial impact. See your technical work directly influence customer decisions, accelerate opportunities and support enterprise adoption.

  • Help shape our AI capabilities. Work closely with Product and Engineering, bringing real customer requirements into the development of scalable solutions.

  • Join at an exciting stage of growth. Be part of Patsnap's continued investment in agentic AI, enterprise integrations and the evolution of our Solution Consulting function.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Partner with Account Executives and Account Managers to support complex enterprise opportunities across R&D, engineering, product development and innovation.

  • Lead technical discovery sessions with customers, understanding their existing research processes, engineering workflows, systems, data requirements and business challenges.

  • Design, build and demonstrate AI agents, intelligent workflows, integrations and proof-of-concepts using Patsnap's APIs, MCP capabilities, LLMs and other relevant technologies.

  • Translate real-world R&D use cases, such as technology scouting, technical literature analysis, engineering research, competitive intelligence and product innovation, into practical AI-powered solutions.

  • Integrate Patsnap's proprietary intelligence into customer workflows, internal systems and AI applications.

  • Deliver tailored technical demonstrations that clearly communicate how proposed solutions address customer challenges and deliver measurable business value.

  • Own proof-of-concept development from initial requirements and solution design through to testing, iteration and customer presentation.

  • Support technical implementation and deployment following signature, collaborating with Product, Engineering and Customer Success where required.

  • Identify opportunities to develop reusable workflows, templates and solution frameworks that can be applied across customers.

  • Share customer insights and technical feedback to help shape Patsnap's future AI capabilities.

  • You won't carry an individual sales quota, but your contribution will be measured through the commercial opportunities you help progress and close.


What We'd Love From You:

There are three equally important parts to this role:

1) R&D & Engineering Workflow Understanding

  • Strong understanding of R&D and engineering workflows, including how organisations approach technical research, technology scouting, product development, innovation and technical decision-making.

  • Experience working within or supporting engineering, industrial R&D, manufacturing, technology development or other research-intensive environments.

  • Ability to understand the challenges faced by R&D and engineering teams, including fragmented data, complex research processes, information discovery and opportunities for workflow automation.

  • Confidence engaging with technical stakeholders, understanding their requirements and translating these into practical AI-powered solutions.

  • A background in engineering, technical consulting, industrial technology, scientific software or a related discipline would be advantageous.

2) Customer-Facing Experience

  • Experience working directly with customers or prospects in areas such as pre-sales, solutions consulting, product, implementation, consulting or technical delivery.

  • Confidence leading discovery and requirements conversations.

  • Able to explain complex scientific and technical concepts clearly.

  • Comfortable presenting and demonstrating solutions live.

  • Good commercial judgement: you know when to go deeper technically and when to focus on business value.

3) Hands-On AI Experience

You must already have experience building with AI, not simply using LLMs for everyday productivity.

We care less about whether something reached production and more about whether you have personally built, tested and iterated something that solved a real problem.

That might include:

  • AI agents or agentic workflows

  • LLM-powered applications

  • APIs and integrations

  • MCP

  • RAG or data-driven AI applications

  • Workflow automation

  • Prompt-based systems

  • Rapid prototypes or proof-of-concepts

Comfort with APIs, no-code/low-code tools, data and light scripting such as Python is a strong plus.

Backgrounds That Could Fit

You might currently work as a:

  • Solutions Engineer / Solution Consultant

  • Technical Pre-Sales Consultant

  • Product Manager / Product Owner

  • Technical or Implementation Consultant

  • Business or Product Analyst

  • Scientific Software Consultant

  • Life Sciences Technology Consultant

We’re typically looking for around 3–4 years of relevant professional experience, although the quality and relevance of your experience matters more than an exact number.

Benefits & Perks:

A culture we’re genuinely proud of. High-performing but low ego, collaborative, social and dynamic. It’s a team that supports each other, shares knowledge, raises standards and celebrates wins properly together. You’ll have plenty of ownership, work with smart people across the business and be encouraged to keep learning and experimenting. Alongside a great product, it’s one of the best parts of working here.

Additional benefits

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Two paid volunteering days

  • Private healthcare with AXA

  • Pension with Scottish Widows

  • Enhanced parental leave policies

  • Work from home stipend

  • Cycle to Work scheme

  • Life assurance

  • Payroll giving options

  • Eyecare vouchers

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, citizenship, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, or marital, veteran/military, or disability status, or any other protected status in accordance with federal, provincial/state or local laws.

arbeitnow:director-commercial-partnershi.description:
Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.

About us

Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable. 

Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices.  With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search. 

We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on.

arbeitnow:meridial-senior-research-softw.description:
About Meridial

Meridial is a Focused Research Organisation (FRO) with a mission to bring connectomics into the living brain. We are building a platform for longitudinal, synapse-resolution mapping of functional neural circuitry in preclinical models. Our aim is to deploy this platform for translational projects and improve drug development outcomes for disorders of the central nervous system.

Meridial is a new not-for-profit FRO in the Convergent Research Ecosystem and funded by the Advanced Research and Invention Agency (ARIA).

The technical challenge

Our imaging platform records the activity of neurons and synapses in the living brain. The scientific value of these recordings depends on converting raw images into reliable, quantitative data.

This is a demanding image processing problem. Fluorescence signals are faint, noisy and spatially overlapping; residual tissue motion and other imaging artefacts must be corrected; in addition to conventional planar frames, data may be acquired from arbitrarily shaped 3D regions or several depths at once; properties vary between signal types and experimental configurations; and the same cells and synapses must be reliably matched across imaging sessions spanning weeks. You will build a software package that addresses these challenges in two modes: real-time processing and visualisation, with latencies of tens to hundreds of milliseconds, that inform experimental decisions at the microscope, and offline pipelines that deliver maximum accuracy for scientific analysis and serve as the benchmark for the real-time methods.

The impact of this work is direct and visible: your software will be used at the microscope as experiments unfold, and your pipelines will generate the data underpinning new insights into how neural circuits function and how they change in disease.


Key responsibilities

You will own Meridial’s image processing software end to end, starting from the interface with microscope control and acquisition all the way to processed results prepared for biological analysis. This is a role with a high degree of autonomy: you will make the main design and technology decisions, set priorities with the people who use the software, and work out what to build as requirements emerge.

Who you will work with

  • Experimental team. The neuroscientists running experiments are the main users of the real-time tools. You will work with them at the microscope, understand their problems and turn joint solutions into reliable tools.
  • Senior Software Engineer. Develops the microscope control and image acquisition software, mostly in Rust. Your real-time code exchanges data with that software but need not be part of it. Together, you will decide how the two systems connect.
  • Neuroscience Data Scientist. Owns Meridial’s database and the downstream scientific analysis. You will ensure processed results reach the database with a full record of how they were produced.
  • Reporting line. You will join the Computational Team and report to its Head once appointed, and to the Director of Experimental Research until then.

    • What you will do

  • Build robust pipelines for motion and artefact correction, segmentation of cells and synapses, separation of overlapping signals and extraction of activity over time, adapted to different signal types.
  • Register data from flexible 3D imaging modes to reference volumes, and build tools that find the same field of view and match cells and synapses across sessions, both live at the microscope and offline at high resolution.
  • Develop real-time versions of these methods that keep up with streaming data, including fast identification of cells as stimulation targets.
  • Build live visualisations and summary measures, such as rolling averages, response histograms and noise metrics, that help scientists steer experiments.
  • Define, with the Senior Software Engineer, the interface between acquisition and processing, with a focus on throughput and low latency.
  • Evaluate and adapt existing open-source tools, develop new methods where needed, and validate them against ground truth, using offline results as the benchmark for the real-time processing.
  • Optimise for speed and scale, using multi-threading, GPUs or compiled languages where needed, so that processing keeps up with large and growing datasets.
  • Write clean, tested and documented code, and set up version control, continuous integration and documentation practices for the codebase.
  • Use AI coding assistants to work efficiently, while keeping code correct and maintainable.
  • Plan and track work in Jira or another project management system, in short iterations with the experimental team.
  • Turn prototypes into reproducible tools that scientists can use and that can be released as open source.

    • The person we are looking for

    You are an experienced software engineer with a background in image analysis or computer vision. You enjoy hard technical problems and set high standards for correctness, performance and code quality. You like working directly with the people who use your software: understanding their problems, trying out ideas with them and turning the best into reliable tools.

    You enjoy building from scratch and are comfortable with the ambiguity of an early-stage organisation. As the main developer of our image processing software, you will work independently and shape how it evolves.

    Experience in any of these areas would help you hit the ground running, but none is required: real-time or streaming data processing, microscopy or scientific image analysis, statistics, or machine learning for image analysis. A background in biology, biophysics or neuroscience would also help.


    Essential experience
  • Experience with image analysis or computer vision, such as segmentation, motion correction, registration or denoising, including image quality measures like signal-to-noise ratio.
  • 5+ years of software development experience, in industry or research (for example, PhD or postdoctoral work where software was a main output).
  • Strong proficiency in Python, with good engineering practice: Git, automated testing and well-documented code.
  • Experience with performance optimisation, such as multi-threading or GPU programming, and with a compiled language such as C/C++ or Rust (if not Rust, a willingness to learn it).
  • Experience building interactive, high-performance data visualisations.
  • Experience building data-intensive pipelines for large datasets, from requirements through to deployment.
  • Experience working directly with end users who are not developers, gathering requirements and turning feedback into improvements.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants in your day-to-day development.

    • Physical demands
  • Fine motor skills for operating computers and office/lab equipment
  • Ability to move light-to-moderately heavy items (typical lab supplies/equipment); may include occasional lifting/carrying with appropriate equipment (e.g., carts/dollies)

    • Position type / schedule
  • Start date: February 2027 or later.
  • Full-time.
  • Based in London, with an on-site presence of four days per week.

arbeitnow:clinical-ai-research-lead-lond.title: Clinical AI Research Lead
arbeitnow:clinical-ai-research-lead-lond.description:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

Heidi is building AI that works at the frontier of clinical practice. As we pursue medical device registration and expand our clinical trial portfolio and product portfolio, we need someone who can hold the full arc from regulatory strategy to research protocol to working prototypes and translate across all of them.

This role is designed for a rare profile: clinically trained, technically capable, and research-rigorous. You will own the innovation pipeline from problem identification through validated prototype, coordinate the company's clinical research programme, and serve as the internal bridge between product, regulation, and evidence. You will operate as a senior individual contributor with a small specialist team and broad cross-functional mandate.

 

What you’ll do

Research & Evidence Programme

  • Lead and support clinical trials and pilots adjacent to product development and regulation from protocol through analysis and dissemination

  • Design evaluations with research/publication-grade rigour: statistical power, confounder control, reproducible methodology

  • Provide analytical support company-wide - elevating ad hoc analysis to defensible evidence

Regulatory & Compliance Intelligence

  • Translate evolving UK and international medical device regulation into actionable product and development constraints

  • Generate and maintain technical documentation, clinical evaluation reports, and post-market surveillance artefacts - directly analytically supporting the regulatory team.

  • Partner with compliance to ensure regulatory soundness is built in, not bolted on, a strategic moat, not a checklist

  • Serve as the accessible regulatory resource for product, engineering, models and commercial teams: making regulation legible, usable and deeply embedded into all engineering practices.

  • This role is strategic support, and ownership of all product and regulatory adjacent research activities with a strong supporting team to drive progress and delivery.

Cross-functional AI & Research Support

  • Act as a senior research partner to product squads, commercial teams, and leadership, providing evidence, framing decisions, and raising analytical standards

  • Supporting commercial requests with tender applications etc…

 

What you'll need

Clinical

  • Qualified clinician with active understanding of clinical workflow, risk, and patient safety

  • Experience in medical device or clinical AI evaluation, including familiarity with MHRA, UKCA, and/or EU MDR frameworks

Research

  • Postgraduate research training in a relevant field (clinical informatics, AI/ML, health data science, or similar)

  • Demonstrated ability to design, execute, and disseminate clinical or applied research independently

  • Fluency in quantitative methods: statistical modelling, NLP evaluation, speech analytics, and performance benchmarking

  • Skills in implementation science and translational projects involving new technologies

Leadership & Communication

  • Strong written communication, capable of producing high-quality documentation for clinical, regulatory, and commercial audiences

  • Collaborative operator in a fast-moving environment; able to work across seniority levels and functions

  • Experience managing small teams or contractors; structured, outcome-oriented

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

 

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We offer 25 days of paid time off per year, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a €100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a €500 home office budget, a €700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to €7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

Heidi’s commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Heidi is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are proud to welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.

arbeitnow:site-reliability-engineer-44-f.title: Site Reliability Engineer
arbeitnow:site-reliability-engineer-44-f.description:
At Signal AI, we use cutting-edge AI technology to offer clarity on decisions that shape businesses and society. We value restless curiosity, creative thinking, and diverse perspectives as we strive to become AI-native. We believe that AI is a collaborator, not just a tool, and we invite passionate individuals to join us on our journey as we continue to learn, experiment, and grow together.

We're hiring a Senior SRE to help us run and evolve the infrastructure behind Signal AI's decision intelligence platform.

You'd be joining a small, collaborative Infrastructure team at a moment when the work is genuinely changing shape. Over the last year, we've hardened the platform, reduced cost, and built serious observability into our highest-volume systems. The next year is about scaling that work, absorbing infrastructure from a recent acquisition, and being thoughtful about how AI shows up in operational work: not as a gimmick, but as a tool we trust ourselves to use well.

We're looking for someone who wants to shape the team's direction; someone people can rely on for tricky or urgent problems; someone who brings curiosity and care to the work; and someone who wants to leave things meaningfully better than they found them.

What we've shipped recently

  • Cut ~$50k/year off our Elasticsearch bill by migrating compute to more efficient chips. (Apr 2026)

  • Built the foundation for our MCP server platform: leveraging and contributing to open-source tooling to give the whole company extensible, production-grade AI integrations. (2025–2026)

  • Rebuilt production from scratch in a full DR game day. End-to-end restore validated across our multi-account AWS setup. (Jan 2026)

What we're working on next

  • AI-augmented operations: Claude Enterprise is deployed across Signal. We want this team to help define what good looks like for SRE: incident triage, runbook generation, capacity planning, cost analysis. This is a strategic investment, not a side project, and we'd love someone genuinely curious about what these tools can and can't do.

  • Security in the age of AI: The threat landscape has shifted. Supply chain security is more at threat than ever, and powerful models are emerging that promise to change how the industry thinks about security. We're looking for someone interested in thinking seriously about what actually matters to protect now.

  • Acquisition integration: Bringing a recently acquired product's infrastructure under our reliability, security, and operational standards. A substantial, multi-quarter piece of work with real technical and organisational complexity, and plenty of room to make your mark.

  • Batch workload consolidation: Moving disparate batch jobs onto EKS for unified scheduling, cost visibility, and operational tooling.

Your first six months

We want to set you up to thrive. Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Month 1: You're onboarded across our AWS estate, Terraform, and observability stack. You've completed your first on-call shift with team support, landed your first PR in the DevOps repo, and started working Claude Enterprise into your daily flow.

  • Month 3: You're owning a workstream end-to-end. You've led the SRE response to at least one production incident and hosted your first post-mortem. You've surfaced a real opportunity and pushed it to a measurable result.

  • Month 6: You're driving a multi-quarter workstream with clear direction, coaching less experienced teammates along the way, and contributing insights to our AI-in-operations playbook: including where Claude adds real leverage and where it doesn't.

What we're looking for

You have solid AWS and Terraform experience, and you're comfortable writing Python or Go to solve operational problems. You think in distributed systems: failure modes, observability, blast radius: and you take problems end-to-end rather than stopping at the edges of your own work.

When a problem is complex, you can lay out a few ways to solve it, weigh the trade-offs, and recommend the one that meets our needs now without sacrificing tomorrow. You take personal ownership of customer-impacting issues in the systems you look after.

You communicate openly and you're comfortable pushing back when you think something could be better. You give clear, actionable feedback and you enjoy helping others level up.

You're pragmatic about AI tooling. Not evangelical, not dismissive. You can tell us when you'd reach for an LLM and when you wouldn't, and you'd have a clear reason either way.

We know not every strong candidate will have every skill on this list. If you're excited about the work and you're close on the experience, we'd encourage you to apply.

Nice to haves

  • Networking depth. You're comfortable below the load balancer: TCP/IP fundamentals, DNS, VPC design, and what actually happens when a service can't reach another one.

  • Operational security instincts. You follow the threat landscape with genuine interest: not just CVEs, but shifts in how attacks happen and how the industry is responding. You have a point of view on what actually matters right now.

  • Linux internals comfort. When something behaves strangely under load, you know where to look.

  • Elasticsearch at scale. Sharding, index lifecycle management, node failures and JVM tuning.

  • Communication across technical levels. You can collaborate with your infrastructure teammates and explain the same concepts clearly to a product manager.

Not sure you meet every requirement? Studies show that women and other underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they check every box. At Signal AI, diverse perspectives strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and lead to better performance. So even if your background doesn’t align perfectly with each qualification, we encourage you to apply if you’re passionate about this role.

We're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every Signaller feels welcomed, valued, and heard—a place where you can truly thrive as yourself.

Compensation: £75K – £95K

arbeitnow:assistant-general-counsel-prod.title: Assistant General Counsel – Product and Regulatory Legal (EU)
arbeitnow:assistant-general-counsel-prod.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Join our Product and Regulatory Legal team, embedded with Kraken's Product, Design and Engineering teams to ship novel products and experiences that accelerate the global adoption of crypto. We are a tight, experienced group of lawyers from a diverse range of tradfi, fintech and crypto backgrounds who move fast, stay curious and take pride in the commercial accountability of our advice, partnering directly with Product, senior leadership and Compliance to chart clear, defensible paths to launch and to keep our licensed entities running smoothly.

This is a senior product-facing legal role for the European Union. You will be the lawyer the business trusts on questions that cut across several regimes at once: for example, a single product such as a tokenised equity, a card, or an institutional custody and prime brokerage service can touch the Markets in Financial Instruments Directive ("MiFID II"), the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation ("MiCA"), the Payment Services Directive ("PSD2"), the Electronic Money Directive ("EMD2") and banking rules at the same time. You will bring clarity on which regime applies, what it requires, and how to launch within it.

 

The opportunity

Reporting to the Head of Product Legal, you will act as a senior legal adviser to European leadership on new products, licensing structure and regulatory strategy.

  • Own cross-functional product counselling for European Union launches from discovery to design, launch and iteration, giving Product, Engineering, Compliance and leadership decision-ready advice with clear options and risk trade-offs

  • Advise on the regulatory perimeter and classification of new offerings across MiFID II and the Markets in Financial Instruments Regulation ("MiFIR"), MiCA, the European Market Infrastructure Regulation ("EMIR"), payment services and electronic money rules, and banking regulation, including where an instrument or service falls between regimes (for example tokenised securities, crypto-asset derivatives, margin and financing, and stablecoin-linked products)

  • Advise on payments and electronic money offerings, including the Krak card and account propositions, safeguarding, open banking and account-access obligations, and the developing Payment Services Directive 3 and Payment Services Regulation framework

  • Advise on banking-related questions that arise in the European Union, including bank partnerships and sponsor-bank arrangements, deposit-taking and lending perimeter questions, the Capital Requirements Regulation and Directive, and the interaction of these rules with our custody, prime brokerage and financing products

  • Monitor and interpret European Union legislative and supervisory developments, take part in consultations and industry association work where appropriate, and translate their significance for the business proactively

  • Draft and negotiate client-facing terms and conditions, taking clear, business-aligned positions

  • Act as gatekeeper for European Union outside counsel engagements: scope the work, estimate and manage cost, and sign off before matters go externally

  • Mentor and develop more junior lawyers in the team, set quality standards for plain-English, risk-based advice, and act as a senior sounding board for colleagues across the Regulatory Legal team

  • Use AI-assisted tools (for example Enterprise GPTs) to speed up regulatory analysis, first drafts and matter tracking, and to build self-service tools that let stakeholders answer commoditised legal and regulatory questions themselves

  • Advise on anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing requirements affecting products, including the Transfer of Funds Regulation ("Travel Rule") and the new European Union anti-money laundering package, and on market abuse, conduct, outsourcing and operational resilience obligations, including the Digital Operational Resilience Act ("DORA")

  • Lead or oversee licensing, authorisation and variation workstreams in the European Union, including scoping requirements, mapping pathways, supervising outside counsel, preparing application materials and managing regulator interactions

 
 

What you bring

  • Qualified lawyer admitted in Ireland, England and Wales, or another European Union Member State

  • 15 or more years' post-qualification experience ("PQE") in financial services regulatory law, gained at a regulated financial services institution (for example a bank, payment institution, broker-dealer, exchange, central counterparty or crypto services provider) or at a leading law firm supporting such clients, ideally with in-house or direct product counselling experience

  • Deep, current knowledge of several of the following, with real depth in at least two: MiFID II and MiFIR (investment services, market structure, derivatives and conduct), MiCA (crypto-asset services, custody, trading platforms and stablecoins), European Union payment services and electronic money regulation, and European Union banking regulation

  • Demonstrated ability to analyse novel products against overlapping regimes and give a clear view on classification and perimeter, including in areas where the rules are unsettled or supervisors have not yet spoken

  • Direct experience managing senior regulator relationships, including notifications, information requests, supervisory correspondence and examinations

  • Working knowledge of anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing, outsourcing and operational resilience obligations, including DORA

  • Proven ability to instruct, supervise and manage the cost of outside counsel across multiple jurisdictions

  • Outstanding analytical, drafting and organisational skills, with crisp, plain-English writing

  • Ability to distill complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, actionable guidance for non-lawyer stakeholders and for senior leadership

  • A pragmatic, commercially accountable approach to legal and regulatory risk that gives stakeholders a useful range of options and a clear recommendation

  • Experience mentoring or managing lawyers, and the judgement to know when to escalate

  • Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy in a fast-moving, remote environment

  • Familiarity with using AI tools such as Enterprise GPTs to increase the efficiency of legal services

 
 

Nice to haves

  • Experience advising on tokenised securities and the European Union Distributed Ledger Technology Pilot Regime

  • Experience with EMIR, including the clearing obligation, margin for non-centrally cleared derivatives and transaction reporting

  • Experience with prime brokerage, securities financing, margin lending or institutional custody

  • Experience advising on the United Kingdom cryptoasset regime or other non-European Union frameworks that intersect with European Union operations

  • Experience supporting regulatory aspects of corporate transactions, such as change-of-control notifications and entity migrations

  • Experience with European Union data protection and consumer protection rules as they apply to financial products

  • Fluency in a second European language

  • An authentic interest in crypto and digital assets, and familiarity with Payward's and competitors' products

 
 
 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

 

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Who We Are:
Omaze lets people in the UK and Germany win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes while raising money for the causes they love. Our community has raised over £150 million for UK charities in five years, including Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity.

🔑 About The Job

We are hiring a Senior People Partner to help our managers lead well. You will focus on leadership capability, how teams run, and programmes that measurably improve culture and performance. Within a year, our managers should set clearer expectations, handle underperformance earlier and need you less for what they can now do themselves.

You will partner with our managers and senior managers and report to our VP People. We’re a small team, so you will own your work from diagnosis through to adoption.

💪 What you will have done in 12 months

  • Manager capability you can see in the numbers. Managers set expectations, give feedback and address underperformance with confidence, and you can show the before and after.

  • A real team problem fixed. You diagnosed an issue in structure, accountability or decision-making with the leader who owned it, and measured whether the fix worked.

  • A change landed well. Leaders had a clear plan, people understood what was happening and why, and those affected had real support.

  • A programme taken through to adoption. You owned it from diagnosis to rollout, and you reported honestly on whether it made a difference.

🫵 What you will do

  • Coach and challenge managers. Build their confidence and capability in setting expectations, giving feedback, developing talent and addressing underperformance.

  • Improve how teams work. Partner with leaders on team structure, capability, accountability and decision-making.

  • Deliver people programmes. Diagnose the business need, propose practical solutions and own delivery through to adoption.

  • Lead people change. Help leaders plan and implement organisational change, with clear communication and support for the people affected.

  • Give sound advice on sensitive people matters. Bring empathy, commercial judgement and the confidence to challenge.

  • Use AI well. Apply it in your own work and help managers do the same, with sound judgement on confidentiality and accuracy.

🎯 Who this is for

Experienced people partners who coach, diagnose and finish what they start. You have worked in an organisation of 300 or more people, or helped a smaller one grow through that size, so you know what good looks like at scale and when not to apply it.

  • You have designed and delivered a people programme yourself and can show what changed, for example in manager effectiveness, engagement, regretted attrition or time to productivity.

  • You coach managers well, and you can give examples of managers who became more effective and more independent because of you.

  • You connect people issues to business priorities. You use data and employee insight to find causes, and you check whether your fix worked.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity, you prioritise hard, and you carry work through to completion in a lean team.

  • You use AI in your daily work and can describe exactly how it has changed what you do. You also help others raise their own use, with good judgement on confidentiality and accuracy.

  • You can tell us what you do differently now compared with 18 months ago, and why.

😢 Who this is not for

If your strength is policy administration, process ownership or running People Operations, this is not the right fit, because that work is covered elsewhere. If you want a large HR team to deliver through, you should also know this is a lean team and you will do much of the work yourself.

Useful but not required

CIPD qualification. Experience in a growing business.

🙌 What’s In It For You

  • Generous stock options scheme

  • 25 days annual leave PLUS Bank Holidays

  • Private medical and dental insurance

  • 9% employer pension contributions, when you contribute at least 2%

  • A generous personal learning and development budget each year to use on training courses, conferences and professional memberships

  • Enhanced family leave policies

  • Life assurance of 4x your salary

DEI Statement

arbeitnow:regulatory-lead-united-kingdom.description:
Regulatory Lead

Remote, with occasional travel as required | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 60+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The role

We are looking for a Regulatory Lead to take day-to-day ownership of our regulatory framework, and of our relationship with our external compliance provider, as the business grows.

This is a broad, hands-on role covering regulatory change, compliance processes, governance and risk across the UK and US. The successful candidate will work closely with the CEO, our Compliance Officer and MLRO, the senior leadership team, external legal and regulatory advisers, and sophisticated institutional clients and counterparties.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take day-to-day ownership of the firm’s regulatory framework across the UK and US, prioritising work through a central plan and dashboard.

  • Monitor regulatory developments affecting the business, assess their impact and lead the implementation of any changes required.

  • Work with our external compliance provider to keep compliance policies, procedures and controls up to date and applied in practice, including marketing and financial promotions approvals, client categorisation and onboarding, employee compliance (such as personal account dealing, conflicts of interest and gifts and hospitality) and compliance records.

  • Oversee the compliance monitoring carried out by our external provider, act on its findings, and keep records and evidence ready for regulatory and client due-diligence review.

  • Support the MLRO and our external provider in running the firm’s financial crime framework, including anti-money laundering, sanctions and client due diligence.

  • Assess the regulatory implications of new products, jurisdictions and business initiatives, and coordinate specialist advice where needed.

  • Act as a point of contact for regulators and for clients’ and counterparties’ compliance and regulatory teams, including responding to due-diligence questionnaires.

  • Coordinate compliance training with our external provider and promote a strong compliance culture across the business.

  • Prepare regulatory and compliance reporting for the Board and senior leadership, and support corporate governance processes.

  • Manage external legal and regulatory advisers, instructions and budgets, including on contractual, data protection and other matters requiring legal input.

  • Identify opportunities to improve compliance processes through templates, automation and technology.

About you

You will have substantial experience in a regulatory or compliance role, whether gained at a fintech, crypto or digital-asset business, a trading firm, bank or broker, a regulator, an advisory or consultancy firm, or a combination of these. A legal qualification is welcome but not required.

Experience in trading, markets, payments or digital assets is desirable. A strong working knowledge of UK regulatory frameworks, sound regulatory judgement and the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical business processes will be essential. Exposure to US regulation would be an advantage.

You should have:

  • Experience of compliance frameworks, policies and monitoring, including working with or overseeing outsourced compliance providers.

  • Experience managing regulatory change and assessing the regulatory impact of new products or business activities.

  • Excellent written communication skills, including drafting clear policies, procedures and reports.

  • The confidence to work independently and exercise sound judgement.

  • The ability to recognise when specialist legal advice is needed, and to work effectively with external counsel.

  • A practical, solutions-focused approach, with the ability to explain regulatory requirements clearly to colleagues across the business.

  • The ability to engage confidently with regulators, sophisticated clients, counterparties and their compliance or regulatory teams.

  • Experience managing external advisers and coordinating work across multiple jurisdictions.

  • An interest in financial markets, trading technology and regulatory developments.

The role would suit someone who wants meaningful responsibility in a growing business and enjoys building a well-organised, effective regulatory function rather than simply responding to individual queries.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.
