arbeitnow:ai-data-engineer-united-kingdo.description:
AI & Data Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 60+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a polyglot engineer who is comfortable across the data stack. This is someone who can build AI-powered tools and data infrastructure that make our platform smarter, our people more effective, and our operations more scalable.

This is not a research role. You'll build real systems that people use every day — Slack bots that investigate production incidents, data pipelines that surface anomalies before clients notice them, and AI agents that turn hours of manual trawling into seconds of guided investigation. You'll work across the full stack: Python and TypeScript for AI tooling and integrations, Go for backend services, and SQL for data analysis and pipeline work.

The person we're looking for ships working software, cares about making people's lives easier, and is energised by the pace of the AI landscape. You don't need to have built LLM applications before — but you should be curious, practical, and comfortable learning fast.

You'll work closely with our TechOps, Connectivity, and Data teams to understand their workflows, pain points, and knowledge gaps — then build the tools and infrastructure that solve them. This is a high-leverage role: the systems you build will multiply the effectiveness of every engineer and operator in the company.

What You'll Work On

  • AI-powered investigation tools — Slack-based bots and agents that automatically analyse support tickets, query production logs, and surface relevant context for incident response

  • MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers — authenticated access to ClickHouse, Kubernetes, Atlassian, and GitHub, enabling AI agents to interact with real systems safely

  • Data infrastructure — ClickHouse analytics pipelines, real-time anomaly detection, and platform health monitoring (our "Radar" initiative)

  • AI agent development — constrained, repeatable diagnosis agents that follow investigation playbooks, produce structured outputs, and operate with appropriate guardrails

  • Knowledge engineering — building and curating the corpus that makes our AI tools accurate: documentation, training material, structured metadata, and feedback loops

  • Internal tooling — full-stack applications that bridge the gap between data, AI, and the people who need answers

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong Python — your primary language for AI tooling, data pipelines, and backend services

  • Systems design – you have extensive experience building data-intensive systems. You can consider tradeoffs and manage system complexity

  • TypeScript / JavaScript — for Slack integrations, web interfaces, and full-stack tooling

  • Go experience is a bonus — we use Go extensively for backend services and CLI tooling

  • SQL — comfortable writing analytical queries against large datasets (ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, or similar)

  • Familiarity with LLM APIs and tooling — Claude, OpenAI, or similar; prompt engineering, function calling, tool use

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS — your tools will run in production infrastructure

  • Git and Linux fundamentals

  • Experience in financial services is a plus but not essential — domain knowledge can be learned; engineering instinct cannot

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate quickly, you get things in front of users, you improve based on feedback

  • You bridge domains. You're comfortable moving between AI, data, infrastructure, and product. You don't wait for someone else to define the interface — you go and understand the problem yourself

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You monitor it, you fix it, you make it better

  • You write things down. Documentation is how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. Good documentation also makes our AI tools better — every well-written page becomes training material

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication is essential

  • You embrace AI as a tool. You use AI to amplify your own productivity — and you build tools that do the same for others

What You Get

  • Growth — this role sits at the intersection of AI, data, and platform engineering. As the company scales, so does the opportunity. This is a new pod with an exciting remit

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Greenfield AI work — you're not maintaining legacy systems; you're building the next generation of intelligent tooling for a trading platform

  • Real impact — the tools you build will be used daily by engineers, operators, and eventually clients. This is not a side project

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our people

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition
Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Technical Interview with a member of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session. ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Leadership Conversation with our CTO
Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

The opportunity

As a Sr. MarTech Specialist for Attribution and Performance, you will support attribution and performance measurement at Payward by owning the data and processes that keep it accurate, and by acting as the bridge between our engineers and our performance marketing team. You will form part of a wider MarTech team and partner closely with finance and compliance so that measurement stays accurate and follows our safety and compliance practices. You will also use AI as a core part of how you work, moving quickly and sharing what you learn with the team. Key responsibilities include:

  • Attribution:

    • Drive attribution across web and app, covering conversion definitions, touchpoint credit and journeys stitched together across 3rd party vendors and our inhouse data platforms.

    • Reconcile ad platform, MMP, analytics and internal numbers, and explain the gaps in plain language.

    • Investigate discrepancies caused by vendor configuration, attribution methodology, fraud or bugs in our own apps.

    • Use AI as part of your everyday workflow to speed up investigation, SQL, specs and reporting, share what works with the team and contribute to team Agent.

    • Contribute to the roadmap for the next level of attribution, such as incrementality testing, LTV-based optimisation and marketing mix modelling.

    Engineering partnership:

    • Turn performance marketing needs into clear specs and tickets for engineering, covering event design, deep links, SDK changes and server-side tracking, and review what ships.

    • Work with engineers and data owners to keep the signals ad platforms optimise on (Meta, Google and TikTok conversion APIs and postbacks) complete, deduplicated and consent-compliant.

    • Audit and standardise event naming, properties and volume, with monitoring in place to catch breakages early.

    Performance and cross-functional support:

    • Run a regular rhythm with performance marketing on attribution health, discrepancies and test readouts.

    • Put a measurement plan in place before spend goes live on new channels, launches and tests, and own the readout afterwards.

    • Support weekly and monthly reporting cycles, maintain the attribution dashboards the performance team relies on, and support spend and invoice reconciliation with finance.

    • Work directly with MMP and ad platform reps and vendor support, escalating with evidence.

    • Work with compliance to keep tracking, conversion signals and reporting aligned with Payward's safety and compliance practices, including consent, privacy (GDPR, CCPA) and financial promotion rules.

    • Set up monitoring and alerts for tracking breakages, fraud and volatility-driven spikes in traffic and conversions, such as sharp market moves, and escalate per policy.

    • Participate in cross-functional discussions with product, compliance, finance, design, data and performance marketing, and prioritise requests openly.

 

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in MarTech, performance marketing technology, growth analytics or a related digital marketing field.

  • Hands-on experience with web and mobile attribution, including MMPs (such as AppsFlyer or Branch), SKAN, deep linking and web-to-app journeys.

  • Understanding of why ad platforms credit conversions differently, and experience with conversion APIs and server-side tracking for Meta, Google Ads and TikTok.

  • Comfortable working with data: SQL and a data warehouse, able to read an event schema and trace a discrepancy back to its source.

  • An AI-native way of working: you already use AI assistants and agents day to day for analysis, SQL, scripting, documentation and automation, move fast with them, check their output before relying on it, and follow our data privacy and security rules when doing so.

  • Experience working within safety and compliance practices in a regulated environment, such as consent and financial promotion rules, and monitoring data and alerts through volatile periods when traffic and conversions swing quickly.

  • Strong stakeholder management and written communication skills, with experience aligning performance marketers, engineers, data, finance and compliance around a number they might not align on.

  • Able to write a clear spec, work with engineers to deliver it and review the result.

  • Detail-oriented and process-driven, able to manage multiple workstreams and prioritise the problems that move spend decisions.

  • Genuine interest in the crypto or fintech industry.

 

Nice to haves

  • Exposure to incrementality testing or marketing mix modelling.

  • Experience building AI-assisted workflows or lightweight automations, for example with LLM APIs, scripts or agents, for reporting, QA or monitoring.

  • Familiarity with affiliate platforms (Impact.com or similar), CRM platforms, tag management and consent tooling.

  • Fintech or crypto experience.

XYZ Reality created the world’s first engineering-grade augmented reality for construction. Our site-safe hardhat, The Atom, overlays the design model onto the live build, so our engineers can verify work as it goes in on some of the most complex mission-critical projects in the world.

Backed by Series B investment and growing fast across the US, UK and Europe, we’re a driven, passionate team changing how the industry builds.

If you want your work to shape how the world gets built, we’d like to hear from you.

 

Help shape the future of construction project delivery with XYZ Reality.

 

Our Customer Operations team is at the heart of project delivery, bringing XYZ Reality's technology to life on site and supporting our clients from initial mobilisation through to successful project handover.

 

THE ROLE

We're looking for an experienced planning professional to take the lead on programme planning and controls across a portfolio of complex construction projects.

This is an opportunity to combine your expertise in project planning and scheduling with innovative technology, including 4D planning and augmented reality, to bring greater visibility, accuracy and confidence to project delivery.

As our client-facing planning lead, you'll work closely with project teams and stakeholders across multiple locations, identifying risks, challenging assumptions and keeping programmes on track. You'll also collaborate with our Engineering, Production and Sales teams.

Based in Aberdeen, Scotland, you'll report to the Head of Project Controls Analytics.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and maintain project programmes integrated with 3D design models, sequencing the build within the BIM environment in accordance with client requirements.

  • Integrate MEP (Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing) programmes into the overall project schedule to coordinate multi-disciplinary workstreams.

  • Embed the 4D scheduling workflow, linking time-sequenced programme data to the 3D model to enable real-time progress tracking, into project delivery.

  • Lead external planning teams, directing their use of Primavera P6, Asta Powerproject, and 4D integration tools.

  • Identify schedule risks and coordination issues across multi-disciplinary workstreams, driving structured resolution with the relevant stakeholders.

  • Produce regular progress reports at both customer and company level, using Microsoft Power BI, Power Apps, and Excel to generate clear, actionable project data.

  • Monitor productivity and completion deadlines, maintaining up-to-date programme status for all active portfolios.

  • Act as the primary planning contact for clients across active project portfolios, managing relationships proactively throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Support the Sales Team on client calls, demonstrating strong schedule knowledge and the capability of our planning approach

  • Coach and challenge both management and non-specialist audiences on programme matters, operating effectively across technical and non-technical settings

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum 4-6 years of scheduling or programme controls experience in a complex, multi-disciplinary project environment (construction, Oil and Gas, Energy, Infrastructure, Manufacturing, or similar), with demonstrable progression in client-facing or leadership responsibilities

  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 or equivalent enterprise scheduling platform

  • Senior stakeholder communication and progress reporting

KEY EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

  • Self-directed and comfortable managing ambiguity, able to build planning frameworks rather than simply follow established ones.

arbeitnow:solutions-consultant-emea-lond.title: Solutions Consultant - EMEA
arbeitnow:solutions-consultant-emea-lond.description:
About SugarAI UK Limited


SugarAI is redefining CRM for the age of AI.

We’re delivering on the original promise of CRM—turning fragmented customer and revenue signals into clear, prioritized action. Instead of more dashboards or surface-level insights, we help teams focus on what matters most and know exactly what to do next.

More than two decades after our founding, we’re entering a new chapter with clarity and momentum—building intelligent, intuitive solutions that work within the flow of how teams actually sell and serve. We’re focused on solving complex, real-world challenges where relationships, context, and precision make all the difference.

Our global team is united by a shared commitment to impact, ownership, and continuous growth. We create an environment where thoughtful ideas move quickly, where people are trusted to lead, and where flexibility supports how great work gets done.

If you’re excited to help shape what’s next in AI-driven CRM—and build technology that drives real outcomes—we’d love to meet you.

 

Where You Fit In:  

SugarAI is looking for a customer-facing, hands-on technologist to join our Solution Consulting team in EMEA. Drawing on deep CRM/CX market knowledge and an in-depth understanding of SugarAI’s platform architecture and capabilities, you’ll uncover customer business objectives, scope and present the product vision, and own the solution/technical side of the sales cycle – showing how SugarAI drives real business outcomes. 

You’ll be the resident SugarAI expert for both our internal and extended (reseller/partner) sales teams. Success in this role calls for strong customer interaction and presentation skills, a solid grasp of enterprise software solutions and how they integrate, and the ability to work closely with sales and professional services teams. 

**This role operates on a hybrid model, with a mix of remote work and in-office collaboration at our London location, specifically, working in-office a minimum of 2 days per week.**

Impact You'll Make

  • Act as a strategic technical and commercial partner to Sales, Customer Success, and Partners – shaping deal strategy and translating customer challenges into compelling solution outcomes. 

  • Own the pre-sales cycle end-to-end: discovery, qualification, value-based demonstrations, technical validation, solution design, RFP/Tender responses, and handoff to delivery teams. 

  • Show customers how AI, customer data, and intelligent workflows can transform sales execution, productivity, and decision-making – connecting SugarAI capabilities directly to their business priorities. 

  • Proactively identify technical and commercial risks within opportunities and work cross-functionally to remove barriers to a successful close. 

  • Enable EMEA direct and reseller/channel partners to confidently position, demonstrate, and sell SugarAI, including hands-on sales and demo training alongside the Training team. 

  • Serve as the go-to SugarAI product expert, providing ongoing application support to inside, channel, and direct sales teams. 

  • Champion CRM best practices and SugarAI’s extensibility, translating business requirements into a compelling platform vision. 

  • Track emerging AI and enterprise technology trends, bringing fresh ideas into customer conversations and the wider EMEA organization. 

  • Represent SugarAI externally – speaking at trade conferences and supporting product marketing and promotion. 

  • Partner with Marketing and Sales to keep demo toolkits and sales collateral current, and maintain key partner relationships. 

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years in pre-sales or a similar customer facing technical role, with a proven track record engaging C-level stakeholders. 

  • SaaS solution sales/configuration experience and a solid understanding of technical systems architecture, stacks, and platforms. 

  • Strong commercial acumen and is able to connect technical capabilities to measurable business outcomes, not just demonstrate product functionality. 

  • A consultative mindset and the confidence to engage stakeholders from end users through to C-level executives. 

  • Solid knowledge of enterprise business applications (CRM, ERP, APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, data architecture) and RFP/Tender best practices. 

  • Practical understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, conversational AI, and AI-assisted/agentic workflows, with the curiosity to keep experimenting with emerging technology. 

  • Excellent communication, listening, presentation, and objection-handling skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts through storytelling and demonstration. 

  • Strong teamwork, integrity, self-motivation, and a positive attitude. 

  • Outstanding planning and time management, with the ability to juggle competing priorities across direct sales, expansion, and partner-led opportunities. 

  • Comfortable working across local and remote teams and time zones, with willingness to travel up to 40%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Marketing Automation experience 

  • Business Analytics exposure

arbeitnow:applied-ai-member-of-technical.description:
About Us

We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity.

Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next.

The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve.

Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost.

Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor.

In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence.

We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Applied AI Research at Callosum discovers the methods that make real AI workloads faster, cheaper and better, and turns them into systems that run in production. You will study how agentic workflows, retrieval pipelines and code intelligence stacks actually behave, then invent ways to optimise them at a systems level.

A single optimisation can touch agent and workflow design, context and prompting, model choice, the serving stack and the silicon underneath. So we don't hire specialists in one layer. We hire researchers who can reason across the whole system, from agentic design down to the specifics of the model, and who have a feel for how inference and hardware shape what is possible.

The role is research-led and engineering-heavy. You will need first-principles judgment to see what kind of system a problem needs, the rigour to prove that it works, and the engineering skill to build it yourself.

You will sit across our research and platform functions. What you discover becomes product capability, and what you see in real workloads sets the research agenda. We run a flat Member of Technical Staff structure. Responsibility and scope grow with what you demonstrate, including leadership of the Applied AI Research function as the team scales.

What You'll Work On

Our research tries to construct optimal inference systems from the silicon layer all the way up to the harness: the system will learn from the actual deployment profile and tasks it is used on and optimise itself. Open problems you will own include:

•⁠ ⁠Reverse-engineering agentic systems. Infer the structure of agentic systems from minimal data, and find where it spends compute it doesn't need to.

•⁠ ⁠Routing. Build robust routers that send each request to the cheapest or fastest path that strictly matches or beats the incumbent model on quality.

•⁠ ⁠Proving there is no regression. Design layered proxy evaluations, that bound quality ever more tightly, from coarse checks down to a granular understanding of the system.

•⁠ ⁠New optimisation surface area. Extend the same automatic, detection to new optimisation techniques, and help decide which ones we pursue next.

•⁠ ⁠Research that ships. Run rigorous experiments, write up what you learn, and work with our platform team to turn what works into general product capability.

•⁠ ⁠Shared research infrastructure. Build the evaluation harnesses, benchmarks and experiment tooling the team runs on.

How We Work

•⁠ ⁠Generalists by design. Our cadence is fast and our priorities move as we learn. You will move between projects as the problem demands, so breadth and the speed at which you learn matter more than depth in one niche.

•⁠ ⁠Research judged by production. A result counts when it holds on real workloads. Ideas move quickly from hypothesis to experiment to a deployed system.

•⁠ ⁠Close to real workloads. You work from real production systems and pipelines. Customer contact is scoped: team members who show an aptitude for it can take on more customer-facing technical work, but it is not the core of the role.

•⁠ ⁠A mix of experience. We hire across seniority levels. Experienced researchers bring proven practice from large-scale AI development, earlier-career members bring speed and fresh eyes, and each learns from the other.

What You Bring

•⁠ ⁠Broad, foundational knowledge across the modern AI stack: agent and workflow design, LLMs and how they work inside, and inference and serving. You can reason about how a change in one layer affects the others.

•⁠ ⁠Exceptional technical depth, demonstrated through any of: research that shipped, production AI systems at scale, or an early or founding role where you owned the system end to end.

•⁠ ⁠Rigour in experimental design, evaluation and benchmarking. You can tell a real improvement from noise, and you design the measurement before you trust the result.

•⁠ ⁠A very fast learner who goes to first principles when the map runs out.

•⁠ ⁠Strong engineering skills: you build the systems you research.

•⁠ ⁠A bias for action, comfort with ambiguity and a strong sense of ownership.

What Sets You Apart

•⁠ ⁠An early or founding role at an AI-first, deep-tech company, where you made key technical decisions from first principles.

•⁠ ⁠You have designed and built multi-agent or agentic systems from the ground up, and you also have depth lower in the stack.

•⁠ ⁠Low-level systems or performance engineering: kernels, serving engines or latency-critical systems.

•⁠ ⁠Experience of large-scale AI development at a frontier lab or big tech company, and the engineering practices that come with it.

•⁠ ⁠Research in inference optimisation, model internals, evaluation, routing or distillation.

•⁠ ⁠Publications, open-source work or public write-ups that show how you think.

•⁠ ⁠Familiarity with novel accelerator platforms.

•⁠ ⁠Experience working directly with external engineering teams.


What We Offer

•⁠ ⁠Competitive Salary, determined by skills and experience

•⁠ ⁠Equity & Ownership

•⁠ ⁠Private healthcare

•⁠ ⁠We offer Visa sponsorship and relocation benefits to hire the best in the world

•⁠ ⁠We work in person at our London office. You'll have the tools, space and setup to do your best work, and if you have specific needs, just tell us

We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

About the Role:

As a Senior Software Engineer at Radiant, you’ll be a hands-on technical contributor, driving the design and development of our most critical systems, including our GPU orchestration layer, inference-serving infrastructure, and core platform APIs.

You’ll set the standard for engineering excellence across the team, working closely with other principal engineers to align on strategy and drive technical leadership. While you won’t have direct reports, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping engineering direction, design decisions, and cross-team collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build systems for your team's part of the platform, from provisioning and cluster management to telemetry, ML training and serving, networking, storage, and security.

  • Implement secure, reliable APIs (gRPC/REST) and backend systems

  • Design and develop Kubernetes Operators to manage compute and networking resources

  • Improve performance, resilience, and efficiency, including how workloads use GPUs, storage, and networks.

  • Translate customer and product requirements into clear technical designs.

  • Own the reliability of the services you build

  • Work with Product Managers to understand how our customers run AI workloads on our platform.

  • Contribute to design and code review across the team.

Your Profile

  • Solid experience building and running production software, ideally distributed systems.

  • Strong hands-on engineering skills in Go or similar.

  • Depth in at least one of our team areas: infrastructure and cluster management, observability, ML training or serving, networking, storage, or security.

  • Understanding of GPU infrastructure and multi-tenant cloud platforms, and how they behave at scale.

  • Comfortable working in Linux and with Kubernetes and containers.

  • Clear communicator who takes ownership of their work.

What You Bring

  • Engineering quality: Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and review others' work with care.

  • Ownership: Take features from design through production, and stay accountable for how they run.

  • Pragmatism: Ship what matters, simply, and improve it from real-world feedback.

  • Collaboration: Work openly with product, infrastructure, SRE and customers, and share what you learn.

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

About Us 

Avenir Collective. Building the future of beauty, personal care and lifestyle brands. 

We acquire and scale high-potential consumer brands, bringing together the capital, people and operating expertise to turn strong brands into enduring businesses. Our difference is that we are operators, actively managing our brands and providing the capabilities, infrastructure and expertise they need to scale, while preserving the product, purpose and consumer connection that make each brand special. 

We’re building a connected house of brands where great people, brands and ideas come together. If you’re excited by building businesses, solving problems and working with a collaborative, entrepreneurial team, we’d love to hear from you. 


Your role at a Glance

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, commercially grounded Senior Global Brand Manager to take ownership of two of our most exciting growth opportunities: a male grooming brand and a skin health brand. Both have built strong foundations as digital-first, Amazon-led businesses, with proven products and loyal customers. The next chapter is about turning them into true omnichannel brands, with clear positioning, distinctive identities and sustainable growth across key markets.

Reporting to our Chief Brand Officer, you will be the senior brand lead across both categories, setting direction and rolling up your sleeves in equal measure.

Initially you will work largely hands-on, partnering closely with product, creative, digital commerce and commercial colleagues to land key priorities. As you prove the model and build the case for further investment, you will have the opportunity to shape and grow a team around you. This is a role for someone who loves building: someone who takes ownership, moves at pace, brings people with them and gets things done.

The Mission

Both brands are at an inflection point. They have earned their place online through great products and performance-led growth, but their brand foundations have not yet caught up with their ambition. Positioning, identity and the wider brand ecosystem now need to evolve so that each brand can travel beyond a single marketplace, win in new channels and with retail partners, and stand for something clear in the mind of the consumer.

The task at hand:

  • In male grooming, evolve and sharpen the brand so it builds on a strong core proposition and grows into a broader, more relevant grooming brand for today’s man.

  • In skin health, build credibility and trust in a category where efficacy and reassurance matter most, creating a brand that consumers and retail partners can believe in.

  • Across both, translate brand strategy into omnichannel go-to-market plans that land in market, across retail, direct-to-consumers and marketplaces beyond Amazon.

  • Deliver early, visible wins that demonstrate commercial impact and build the business case for future investment in the brands and the team. 

Location and Flexibility 

  • Full-time role based at our modern office in Runway East, London  

  • 40 hours per week, 9 am to 6 pm with a one-hour lunch  

  • This position is hybrid, with the expectation to go to the office 2 days per week  

Key Responsibilities

Brand Strategy & Portfolio Leadership

  • Own the global brand strategy, positioning and identity for both the male grooming and skin health brands, ensuring each is clear, distinctive and relevant across markets.

  • Lead brand evolution work, from consumer insight and positioning through to visual identity, packaging and tone of voice, moving the brands from marketplace-led to brand-led.

  • Build annual brand plans with clear growth targets, KPIs and investment cases, and take accountability for delivery against them.

  • Put the consumer at the heart of every decision, using insight, data and real-world understanding to shape messaging, product experience and activation.

  • Track category trends, competitor activity and emerging opportunities in grooming and skin health and turn them into action.

  • Develop brand guidelines, playbooks and toolkits that make it easy for teams, partners and markets to bring the brands to life consistently.

 

Brand Activation & Commercial Delivery

  • Partner with product, creative, digital commerce and marketplace commercial teams to develop and land go-to-market plans at pace.

  • Lead omnichannel campaigns across e-commerce, retail, social media, PR, influencer and community platforms.

  • Bring a “glocal” mindset: consistent global brands, with room for smart local adaptation.

  • Work hand in hand with the commercial team on retailer sell-in, providing compelling brand stories, decks and assets, and joining key customer conversations where needed.

  • Manage and get the best from external agency partners across creative, PR, social and digital, within agreed budgets.

  • Measure performance rigorously, connecting brand activity to commercial outcomes and adjusting course quickly. 

 

Leadership, Collaboration & Building for the Future

  • Build strong, trusted relationships across the business and with external partners, bringing people with you through influence rather than authority.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on brand opportunities, risks and growth priorities.

  • Build the case for future investment in the brands and in brand capability, using results and insight to show what is possible.

 

Experience & Capabilities

  • Significant brand management experience, with a track record at senior manager level or equivalent, in male grooming, skin health, personal care, beauty or adjacent consumer health categories.

  • Proven experience building, repositioning or evolving brands, including positioning, identity, packaging and messaging.

  • Experience taking brands beyond a single channel, ideally from digital or marketplace-led into retail and wider omnichannel.

  • Strong commercial grounding: confident with P&Ls, retailer dynamics, pricing and business cases, and able to link brand investment to commercial returns.

  • Experience leading campaigns and brand activation across multiple markets.

  • Strong creative judgement and a good understanding of digital, social and content trends.

  • Excellent agency management and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, or scale-up environment is highly desirable.

 

Benefits

  • Salary: £60,000 - £70,000

  • 30 days holiday + 8 UK bank holidays

  • Pension contribution Scheme – 5% from you, 3% from us.

  • Private Medical Insurance – Includes travel, vision & dental (Vitality)

  • Work from Abroad – One month per year, anywhere in the world

  • Bonus Scheme – Discretionary bonus, based on individual and company performance

  • Mental Health Support – Free, confidential therapy via Spill

  • Flexi-Fridays – Finish early one Friday per month

  • Avenir Events – Quarterly meetups, celebrations & socials

  • Vibrant Office – Runway East, Bloomsbury

This is a rare opportunity to take two beauty and personal care opportunities to the next level, driving momentum and shaping their future while laying the foundations for a team and a truly brand-led business. You will have genuine ownership, senior visibility and the autonomy to make a tangible impact from day one.

About Us

Condukt is the next-generation compliance platform for financial services, offering an agentic solution powered by real-time data for business identity.

Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance.

We were founded by former operators and builders with deep experience in banking, payments, and lending. Today, our team spans across London and Porto, bringing together engineers, product owners, and operators from companies like Revolut, Meta, Block (Square), SumUp, American Express, Yandex, and OakNorth.

arbeitnow:software-engineer-drivers-virt.description:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago is an AI and computer hardware company whose mission is to drive the course of history forward. We do so by accelerating breakthroughs at the intersection of AI and semiconductors.

Founded in 2024 by AI researchers and physicists with deep expertise in photonics, electronics, software, mathematics, and machine learning, Arago brings together a lean team of engineers and scientists from the world’s top companies and research labs.

Composed of nine nationalities and operating from hubs in France, North America, and Israel, we believe in great science and fast achievements. Our work is guided by these core principles:

  1. Do great things: we deliver work we’re proud to sign our name to.

  2. High velocity: speed matters. We move quickly, one step at a time.

  3. One unit: we’re all in this together, with relationships grounded in trust, respect, and camaraderie.

Arago is backed by executives from Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Hugging Face, as well as prominent US and European deeptech venture firms and exited founders.

What you’ll do

As a Drivers & Virtualization Engineer, you will own the host-facing software boundary of Arago’s accelerator. Your mission is to ensure our hardware is accessible, secure, and performant across diverse environments—ranging from bare-metal deployments to complex virtualized and multi-device cloud infrastructures. You will focus on building robust kernel-level interfaces where correctness, isolation, and long-term operational safety are paramount.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • Deep knowledge of OS internals, particularly kernel memory management and I/O paths.

  • Strong understanding of memory safety requirements in kernel space.

  • Proven hands-on experience in Linux kernel driver development and kernel modules.

  • Solid understanding of virtualization fundamentals (KVM, hypervisors).

  • Practical experience with emulation frameworks, specifically QEMU internals or custom device models.

  • Familiarity with hardware-level protocols: PCIe, DMA, MMIO, and IOMMU.

  • Language: English at a proficient level. French is a plus.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain high-performance Linux kernel drivers for Arago’s proprietary accelerator.

  • Implement communication protocols and virtual device interfaces to bridge hardware and software.

  • Manage low-level hardware interactions including PCIe, DMA, MMIO, and interrupt handling.

  • Enable seamless virtualized access to accelerators using QEMU and KVM.

  • Design and implement robust device sharing, passthrough, and isolation mechanisms.

  • Ensure the security of accelerator operations through strict memory protection and resource isolation.

  • Debug complex failures that span the entire stack: from hardware and kernel to hypervisor and guest OS.

  • Support the scaling of our architecture from single-device setups to large-scale multi-device deployments.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered at the earliest stage of the company (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Relocation bonus and coverage of moving expenses for relocation within 20 minutes of the company’s location.

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

  • Reimbursement of 50% of the public transport subscription fee.

  • A high-paced, multicultural (with 10 nationalities), and engineering-led environment.

Our Hiring Process: Your Journey to Arago

  • Screening Call : Get to know you beyond your CV.

  • Technical meeting : Deep dive into your past projects and technical achievements.

  • CEO Interview : Assess the fit with the team’s culture and long-term vision.

  • Reference Calls: Mandatory calls with your former managers to validate strengths, weaknesses, and work style.

  • Technical Assessment: Take-home technical assignment crafted to the role you’re applying for.

  • Final Interview : Discuss your technical assignment and address any remaining questions with team members.

arbeitnow:tech-lead-ml-engineering-paris.description:
Join us as Tech Lead, ML Engineering to lead the Document Intelligence stream that teaches Qonto to read new kinds of documents, and to understand the existing ones better.

Every day, 750,000 businesses drop supplier invoices, client invoices and expense receipts into Qonto. Document Intelligence, part of our AI Engines team, reads them, understands them and connects them to the right transaction, with in-house trained models and fine-tuned LLMs. Our North Star is the share of documents handled end to end, with no human touch. You will report to Benjamin Wolter, Head of AI Engines.


➡️ What you'll do

  • Lead and grow your team: you start with 2 ML engineers and build to 5 in 2027. You run the 1:1s and growth plans, set the hiring bar, hire and onboard.

  • Own your stream end to end: new document types, fields and internal flows for internal domains around banking, accounting, cash-flow management, plus performance improvement of the flows customers already rely on.

  • Stay hands-on: you design, train and deploy models into production yourself, next to your team. Frontier LLM, fine-tuned model or purpose-built extractor? You benchmark them per document type and per field on real production data, and ship what gives customers the best accuracy at the latency they need.

  • Plan with your stakeholders: you build the stream's plan with your Product Manager and align with backend and data engineers across product teams.

  • Own production and guide technical decisions: when a model drifts or breaks, your team knows first and fixes it. Architecture, standards and the roadmap are decided as a team with our Staff MLEs, and you help steer them.


➡️ What we're looking for

  • People management: 2+ years with at least 2 direct reports. You have hired, coached and managed performance, from growing strong performers to closing gaps.

  • Technical mastery: 6+ years as an ML engineer, with model architectures you designed and shipped yourself. You have kept models healthy in production: monitoring, retraining, rollback.

  • Delivery in a large, living system: you have delivered complex ML projects with many stakeholders, not only on greenfield projects.

  • Hands-on by choice: leading doesn't mean you stop building. You write Python you would be proud to see in production.

  • A sense for the right tool: you have worked with generative AI and with classical ML, and you know when each one wins. Nice to have: fine-tuning transformer models, document understanding (OCR, layout, extraction), fintech or accounting.


➡️ What we can offer you

  • A team you build: from 2 to 5 engineers in 2027, with your own hiring bar, onboarding and rituals.

  • One of Qonto's core AI platforms: AI Engines gathers 16 ML and data engineers who build shared engines that every product team plugs into, held to the reliability a bank needs. Your scope widens from invoices and receipts to bank and financial statements and legal documents.

  • A real stack: Python, FastAPI, AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock), MLflow, Airflow, Kafka, Kubernetes, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, Prometheus, ArgoCD, GitHub, Cursor, Claude Code. You can test any tool that helps us reach the target.

  • Strong peers: you work next to our Staff MLEs, and technical decisions are taken as a team.

  • Room to grow and visible impact: your scope and your team grow from day one, on the management track of our ML career framework. Our north star, automation rate, is felt by customers every day and reported to Product and Tech leadership.


➡️ Your future manager

Your Future Manager will be Benjamin, Head of AI Products.

His background?

After earning his PhD in Physics and leading ML Engineering and Data Science teams in established tech companies across last-mile logistics and digital marketing, Benjamin joined Qonto to lead our AI Products team!

What does he bring to the team?

With deep technical expertise in machine learning and data science, he brings practical experience in building scalable ML systems and guiding teams through complex technical challenges. Benjamin is committed to creating an environment of ownership and autonomy, supporting team members in their growth and development.

Our interview process

We welcome everyone

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

arbeitnow:tritium-process-engineers-hybr.description:
About Tritium Fuel Cycle (TFC)

GFG is designing a first-of-a-kind (FOAK) fusion power plant (FPP) to deliver 1 GW of electrical power in the 2040s. The “GIGA” plant will be based on a stellarator magnetic confinement fusion device, operating continuously on a deuterium-tritium (D-T) fuel cycle.  Prior to this, the smaller “Gauss Industrial Demonstrator (GID-170)” will be deployed in the mid-2030s.

While deuterium can be extracted from seawater, tritium is a tightly controlled radioactive isotope with an extremely limited global supply. Therefore, both GID-170 and GIGA must utilise closed tritium fuel cycle infrastructure, to ensure that unburnt tritium is fully recycled back to the stellarator and not released to the environment. Meanwhile, the tritium consumed by the fusion reaction must be replenished using tritium breeding blankets (TBB).

A first-of-a-kind dedicated tritium fuel cycle (TFC) facility, suitable for continuously supporting a stellarator device, must be designed, built and commissioned. It will adopt a multi-loop process architecture, each loop comprising many deeply integrated subsystems. Developing such a facility presents unique engineering challenges: the supply chain is still emerging, commercial process simulation tools lack dedicated TFC libraries, suitable off-the-shelf equipment is not always available, and some technologies have relatively low technology readiness levels (TRLs). 

A conceptual design is currently under development, with the project then progressing into pre-front-end engineering design (pre-FEED) in 2028, followed by front-end engineering design (FEED) and design for manufacturing phases. Completion of the overall design phase (for GID-170) must be achieved by 2032.


About the role

GFG is looking for several Tritium Process Engineers to join the TFC department and develop the GID-170 and GIGA TFC facilities. The roles will contribute to the continued development and optimisation of the overall fuel cycle architecture and its subsystems. Activities will include managing design requirements; developing process flow diagrams (PFDs), piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), heat and mass balances (HMBs) and the Basis of Design (BoD); selecting technologies; sizing and arranging equipment; and contributing to safety-related design. The roles may also involve supporting equipment prototype development and testing with technology developers and research partners.
We welcome candidates with complementary strengths in process design and process modelling and simulation, with systems engineering experience also desirable. These specialisations sit within the same engineering function, and candidates are not expected to have equal expertise across all areas. The number of appointments and balance of responsibilities will reflect the successful candidates’ experience and technical strengths. Drawing on their specialist expertise, successful candidates will work collaboratively on design development, modelling, analysis and optimisation to assess design alternatives and inform robust, well-documented design decisions.
The TFC comprises a wide range of technologies and subsystems, requiring the department to manage multiple sub-projects and work packages in parallel. Each engineer will contribute across several activities and will be expected to take ownership of specific tasks or subsystems, or lead work packages, depending on their experience. The roles will involve close collaboration with engineers from the same and other disciplines at national and international partner organisations, research institutions and suppliers, as well as with colleagues across disciplines and departments within GFG. Given the specific challenges associated with tritium, close collaboration with Nuclear Safety and Export Control specialists will also be essential.
During conceptual design, successful candidates will work closely with the Head of Tritium Fuel Cycle to address the strong interdependencies between subsystems and develop a coherent, integrated design. As the project moves into pre-FEED, they will be expected to take greater day-to-day ownership of their assigned areas and drive design development through pre-FEED and FEED, while maintaining close coordination across subsystem interfaces. As the project progresses, the roles will evolve to support design for manufacture, procurement and commissioning of the GID-170 TFC systems, followed by further development and refinement of the TFC design for GIGA.


Main responsibilities

  • Process definition and systems engineering
    1. Identify, define and manage system requirements and interfaces across TFC subsystems and the overall plant architecture.
    2. Develop and optimise the fuel cycle architecture, assessing alternative subsystem technologies, their respective advantages and disadvantages, technology readiness levels (TRLs), and potential system configurations.
    3. Develop process flow diagrams (PFDs) for individual TFC subsystem blocks and the overall plant architecture.
    4. Participate in the development of piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), identification and sizing of key components, and equipment layout.
    5. Develop and maintain representative heat and mass balances to support process definition, system integration and design decisions.
  • Process modelling and simulation
    1. Develop, apply and improve process simulation models for individual TFC subsystem blocks and the overall plant architecture, using tools such as Aspen Plus, Aspen Custom Modeler, Python and dedicated proprietary software, as appropriate.
    2. Support the development and integration of custom models and, where appropriate, contribute to the development of dedicated simulation tools.
    3. Use modelling and simulation to assess system performance, compare technology options and operating configurations, support component sizing, and inform process optimisation and design decisions.
    4. Documentation of assumptions, uncertainty and applicability limits, and perform model validation when suitable data becomes available.
    5. Work collaboratively with internal and external modelling specialists to ensure consistency between simulation results, engineering requirements and the evolving plant design.
  • Cost, safety and risk management
    1. Identify and manage design risks, developing effective risk-reduction strategies and action plans.
    2. Identify applicable standards, regulations and codes, and ensure that these are considered throughout the design process. 
    3. Participate in hazard, safety and accident analyses, including hazard identification (HAZID) and hazard and operability (HAZOP) studies, and contribute to the definition of safety functions and development of the safety case.
    4. Contribute to capital and operational expenditure (CAPEX/OPEX) estimates.
  • Design development and delivery
    1. Develop design documentation and specifications, including contributions to the Basis of Design and design philosophies.
    2. Document design studies, verification and assessment activities, engineering assumptions and design decisions.
    3. Support the design development, procurement and testing of prototypes for key components, in collaboration with technology developers, suppliers and research partners.
    4. Provide engineering support for R&D activities conducted in-house and with external partners and collaborators.
  • Project coordination and collaboration
    1. Lead specific technical tasks or work packages assigned by the Head of TFC, in line with experience and expertise.
    2. Take ownership of specific subsystems throughout the pre-FEED and FEED studies, as assigned by the Head of TFC, in line with experience and expertise.
    3. Participate in technical meetings with partners, suppliers, research institutions and other collaborators.
    4. Collaborate closely with other engineering disciplines and contribute to the integration of TFC systems within the wider fusion plant.
    5. As required, undertake other relevant duties in support of project objectives.
  • GID-170 delivery (in the 2030s)
    1. Support the procurement and installation activities of the GID-170 TFC facilities.
    2. Develop commissioning plans and operating instructions.
The balance between process design, systems engineering, and process modelling and simulation will depend on each candidate’s background and area of expertise. All engineers are expected to work collaboratively across these areas, ensuring that modelling activities inform engineering decisions and that process design is supported by robust analysis.


Qualification and educational requirements

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in chemical engineering, process engineering, nuclear engineering, or a closely related discipline*. 

*In the case of a closely related discipline, the degree should be supported by relevant chemical engineering experience.

  • A minimum of 3 years design experience working as a Process Engineer in an industrial environment.

    Additional desirable qualifications relevant to process modelling and simulation:
  • A PhD or EngD in Chemical or Process Engineering or a closely related field.


Competences and preferred skills

1. Common skills

Essential

All applicants should demonstrate:

  • In-depth knowledge of chemical engineering principles, including thermodynamics, heat and mass transfer, process dynamics, and relevant transport phenomena.
  • Experience in the development of industrial-scale process engineering installations in complex environments requiring regulatory approval (ideally nuclear projects or similar).
  • Experience in the development of processes involving different fluids and conditions (cryogenic, vacuum, atmospheric pressure gas, high-pressure gas (up to 100 bara), liquid, etc.).
  • Experience in the design and development of integrated treatment unit operations (purification, separation, conditioning, etc.), ideally in the gas phase, and in the hydrogen or nuclear sectors.
  • Proficiency in at least one established process simulation tool, such as Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS, UniSim, gPROMS, ProMax, CHEMCAD or equivalent.
  • Experience in requirements capture, documentation and management.
  • Experience working alongside multiple other engineering disciplines, such as mechanical, electrical, control, thermal and nuclear engineers.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively within interdisciplinary teams of engineers, technologists and physicists.
  • A proactive and self-motivated approach, with strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills.
  • Professional working proficiency in English. 

Desirable

All applicants would benefit from demonstrating:

  • Knowledge of tritium fuel cycle technologies and/or hydrogen isotope separation. Hands-on experience working with tritium would be an advantage.
  • Experience with the design or analysis of pumping technologies, heat exchangers or other key process equipment.
  • Familiarity with magnetic fusion systems and/or nuclear power plant systems.
  • Familiarity with environmental, nuclear safety and other relevant regulatory requirements. 
  • Knowledge of systems engineering and an understanding of configuration management and risk management.
  • Understanding of equipment qualification, manufacture, testing, inspection and pragmatic usability.
  • Knowledge of German or other European languages.

2. Specialist Skills

Candidates are expected to demonstrate strengths in one or more of the following areas, depending on their background and specialisation.

Process design and systems engineering

  • Experience in developing process architectures, heat and mass balances, PFDs and P&IDs, and in supporting equipment selection, sizing and integration.
  • Experience in developing Basis of Design (BoD) documentation, design philosophies, specifications, design descriptions and justifications.
  • Ability to assess alternative process technologies and configurations, considering performance, safety, technical maturity and operational requirements.
  • Experience in translating system requirements and process analysis into engineering specifications and design decisions.
  • Familiarity with process safety codes, standards and regulations, as well as safety-by-design principles, including the ALARA (As Low As Reasonably Achievable) approach.
  • Experience in engaging with potential technology suppliers and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs).

Process modelling and simulation

  • Proficiency in process modelling tools such as Aspen Custom Modeler, gPROMS custom modelling or equivalent.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming or scientific computing language, such as Python, Julia, MATLAB, Octave or C++.
  • Strong understanding of numerical methods applied to chemical engineering, including ordinary and partial differential equations (ODEs and PDEs), differential-algebraic equations (DAEs), discretisation techniques and numerical convergence.
  • Knowledge of numerical optimisation methods and their implementation, with the ability to apply them to process analysis and design optimisation.
  • Experience developing custom process models, integrating subsystem models or analysing dynamic process behaviour, along with model automation and analysis, to assess system performance, compare design options and support process optimisation is an advantage.


We are recruiting engineers with complementary technical strengths. Applicants who meet the common essential criteria and have relevant capability in one specialist profile are encouraged to apply; experience in every technology or software package listed is not expected.


The balance of responsibilities and the level of technical ownership will be agreed according to each successful candidate’s experience and the needs of the programme, with opportunities for candidates to grow and develop into greater technical ownership.

Customer Success Partner, Enterprise

As a Customer Success Partner at CreatorIQ, you will serve as a strategic advisor to a portfolio of high-level enterprise customers, helping them achieve meaningful business outcomes through their creator marketing programs. You’ll work closely with customers to understand their goals and align them with CreatorIQ’s platform capabilities, driving long-term adoption, value realization, and program success.

This role will support some of our largest and most sophisticated European customers, with significant representation across beauty, fashion, and luxury. We’re looking for someone who brings a strong understanding of the creator and influencer marketing ecosystem and can confidently advise customers on how to evolve and scale their programs.

You’ll build trusted, multi-threaded relationships with key stakeholders, both virtually and in person, and serve as a proactive partner throughout the customer lifecycle. Customer Success Partners are experts in the CreatorIQ platform, fluent in creator and influencer marketing strategy, and passionate about delivering measurable business impact.

You will own the health and retention of your portfolio and will be measured on outcomes including gross retention, platform adoption, customer health, and value realization. As a Paris-based member of a broader European team, you’ll also need to be highly self-directed, comfortable operating with autonomy, and able to build strong internal and customer relationships across locations.

What you’ll do:

  • Serve as the primary strategic partner for a portfolio of complex enterprise customers, aligning CreatorIQ’s capabilities to their business goals and driving measurable value.

  • Bring creator and influencer marketing expertise to customer conversations, helping customers evolve their strategies, solve challenges, and build sophisticated, scalable creator programs.

  • Build trusted, multi-threaded relationships across customer organizations, from day-to-day users to senior and executive stakeholders.

  • Drive platform adoption and customer success by understanding each customer’s strategy, analyzing engagement, and identifying opportunities to increase value.

  • Lead strategic engagements including success planning, business reviews, roadmap discussions, and in-person meetings as appropriate.

  • Own customer health and retention across your portfolio, proactively identifying risk and coordinating action plans to support long-term success.

  • Maintain strategic account plans that capture customer goals, key stakeholders, adoption opportunities, risks, and growth opportunities.

  • Identify opportunities to deepen customer adoption and expand the value of CreatorIQ across their organizations.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Implementation, Services, Support, and Product to deliver a cohesive customer experience and resolve needs effectively.

  • Act as the voice of the customer internally while staying current on CreatorIQ capabilities and creator marketing trends, strategies, and best practices to bring relevant insights to customers.

  • Collaborate effectively with colleagues across Europe and globally while operating with a high degree of ownership and independence from Paris.

  • Travel within Europe for customer and company meetings as needed, including regular travel to London and occasional travel to other European markets.

Who you are and what you’ll need for this position:

  • Deep knowledge of creator and influencer marketing, with professional experience working directly with creator programs, platforms, campaigns, or strategies.

  • 3+ years of experience in a strategic, enterprise customer-facing role within creator/influencer marketing, marketing technology, a relevant brand, agency, or SaaS environment.

  • Experience supporting complex enterprise brands and accounts, with the ability to navigate large customer organizations and multiple stakeholders.

  • Beauty, cosmetics, skincare, fashion, or luxury experience strongly preferred, particularly experience working directly with enterprise brands in these industries.

  • Proven ability to manage toward business KPIs, retention goals, customer health, and customer advocacy metrics.

  • Experience identifying customer risk and contributing to retention, renewal, and growth strategies.

  • Skilled at building credibility and relationships across multiple levels, from daily platform users to Director, VP, and executive stakeholders.

  • Confident independently leading strategic customer conversations, including success planning, business reviews, executive conversations, and roadmap discussions.

  • Comfortable translating customer goals into actionable creator marketing and platform strategies with measurable outcomes.

  • Able to use customer, adoption, and performance data to identify risk, uncover opportunities, and tell compelling stories.

  • Strong strategic thinker who can also manage the day-to-day execution and follow-through required to move customer initiatives forward.

  • Highly organized, proactive, and self-directed, with the ability to effectively manage a portfolio of complex enterprise customers while working independently.

  • A can-do, solutions-oriented mindset and comfort navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Collaborative and experienced working cross-functionally with teams such as Implementation, Support, Product, Services, Insights, and Sales.

  • Fluent French required, with strong professional English communication skills. Additional European languages are a plus.

  • Based in Paris or within reasonable commuting distance and comfortable working independently as part of a distributed European team.

  • Willing and able to travel regularly within Europe, particularly to London, as customer and business needs require.

  • Comfortable with customer success and productivity tools such as Salesforce, Google Workspace, Zoom, Slack, Notion, Jira, or similar platforms.

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Have 50% of the criteria? Excited about this opportunity? Interested about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply!

arbeitnow:quality-control-engineer-produ.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 160 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

About the Role

We are looking for a Production Quality Control Engineer to ensure product conformity, reliability and quality throughout the manufacturing process.

You will work closely with manufacturing, engineering, and supply chain teams to implement robust quality controls across mechanical, electronic, and electromechanical assemblies.

This is a hands-on role, combining shop-floor presence, inspection activities, and continuous improvement in a fast-growing industrial environment.


Role & Missions


Production Quality Control

  • Define and implement incoming, in-process and final inspection procedures.

  • Establish inspection plans, checklists and acceptance criteria.

  • Perform and supervise inspections, measurements and functional tests.

  • Ensure compliance with engineering drawings, BOMs and technical specifications.

  • Apply relevant IPC standards, particularly IPC-A-610 and IPC/WHMA-A-620.

  • Manage production non-conformities, rework and corrective actions.

  • Validate product conformity before production release and shipment.

Process Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and improve manufacturing quality control processes.

  • Conduct root cause analysis (8D, 5 Why, Ishikawa, FMEA).

  • Monitor quality KPIs, defects, rework and production yield.

  • Work with Engineering and Manufacturing to prevent recurring issues.

  • Support industrialisation and production ramp-up.

Documentation & Supplier Interface

  • Maintain inspection records, quality documentation and product traceability.

  • Define incoming inspection requirements for critical components.

  • Coordinate with Supplier Quality and Supply Chain on supplier-related issues.

  • Contribute to the development of the Quality Management System and compliance with ISO 9001 / EN 9100 requirements.


Candidate Profile

Requirements

  • Engineering degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Electronics or Manufacturing Engineering, or equivalent experience.

  • 3+ years of experience in Production Quality, Manufacturing Quality or Quality Engineering.

  • Strong knowledge of inspection methods and manufacturing quality processes.

  • Good understanding of electronic assemblies, PCB integration and wiring harnesses.

  • Knowledge of IPC-A-610 and IPC-A-620 standards.

  • Ability to read engineering drawings, BOMs and technical specifications.

  • Familiarity with problem-solving methodologies (8D, 5 Why, FMEA).

  • Hands-on mindset, strong analytical skills and attention to detail.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in aerospace, defence, automotive or other high-reliability industries.

  • IPC certification (CIS/CIT).

  • Experience with mechanical and electronic assembly inspection.

  • Knowledge of ISO 9001 / EN 9100.

  • Experience supporting industrialisation and production ramp-up.
