arbeitnow:community-lead-talent-acquisit.company_name: How We Work & What We Value - Ashby
arbeitnow:community-lead-talent-acquisit.description:
Hi, I’m Kayla :) I lead global community activation within Partnerships at Ashby. Before joining a year ago, I spent 15 years in TA and was an Ashby customer. I made the move out of TA into this role, and nothing I’d learned has gone to waste. If anything, I’ve learnt even more from the community. It’s genuinely one of the most rewarding and fun roles I’ve had, and as I step into a leadership role, I’m on the hunt for someone to take over the work in EMEA and evolve it further.

We’re hiring an experienced TA Expert & Community Lead to grow one of our most successful GTM experiments: a high-touch, customer-led approach to growth. The model is already working in EMEA, built on curated events, product education and early community activation. You’ll own it across our target markets (UK&I, France, Nordics and Benelux), from customer breakfasts and curated experiences to enablement sessions and product demos.

This role suits someone who has worked with Ashby All-in-One, has a solid background in TA, and cares about tools, process, hospitality and community building. It also works well for TA people who still love the work but want to use what they know somewhere new. You’ll work closely with Sales, CS and Product Marketing, own a region end-to-end, and see how community connects to pipeline and retention.

A quick summary on travel, since it’s usually the first question and we know it means time away from home: you’ll have events in London regularly, plus one trip to another EMEA city a month, usually for around four days. Busier periods can mean two trips abroad in a month. There is flex, though. I’m a mum of three, and in this role, I’ve been able to stay home and take meaningful time off during every school holiday. We plan the calendar well in advance, so you’ll know what’s coming and can sort things at home with plenty of notice.

It’s also one of the best parts of the job. I’ve met some amazing people and had some really cool experiences along the way, from hosting a dinner cruise on the Seine and a TA leader workshop with a partner at the Shangri-La Paris, to spending time in customers’ offices in Stockholm, our company offsite in Playa Del Carmen, and hosting the mainstage at our first Ashby One London.

What you’ll do

  • Lead EMEA Community Events

    • Run community events across target EMEA markets. Event types might include:

      • Customer learning breakfasts

      • A mixed ecosystem event for customers and prospects

      • Partner cocktail events or roundtables co-hosted with local ecosystem players

    • Build and nurture relationships with TA leaders

    • Partner with Event Ops on venue selection, invites, and post-event recaps

    • Drive improvement and reimagine how we can show up in a very meaningful way for the community

  • Drive Customer Education

    • Become an Expert in Ashby + TA leader needs to curate relevant content

    • Design and lead live sessions that help customers activate key Ashby features and keep customers ahead on key TA trends and topics

    • Partner with CS and Product Marketing teams on the Ashby Hidden Gems program

    • Develop and distribute product tips, dashboards, and templates to increase customer sophistication

  • Expand EMEA Community and Customer Advocacy

    • Help Ashby deepen its brand and trust by showing up consistently and thoughtfully

    • Participate in and help advise on content for ACE (Ashby Customer Expert) events when we bring the program to EMEA

    • Partner with GTM teams on prospect and customer onsite visits

    • Moderate panels, attend events, and build a presence at industry gatherings

Who you’ll work with

You’ll report directly to me, but work closely with myself and Willem, who has pioneered what community growth looks like at Ashby. Within partnerships, you’ll also work closely with Katie to scale trusted community partner relationships and Louise to bring Owned Community experiences, like Ashby Cafe, to life. You’ll also partner day to day with our EMEA Sales and CS teams, who know our customers and prospects best and help shape who we bring into the room.

About You

We think the ideal person for this role will have experience and skills that look something like this:

  • You’ve been an Ashby power user or at least very familiar with Ashby and seen its benefits first-hand—someone who knows the product and Ashby community, champions good recruiting practices, and isn’t afraid to dive into dashboards, workflows, or templates

  • You’ve built a reputation inside organizations as the go-to expert on TA process and tooling

  • You’re a strong communicator—whether facilitating a breakfast, writing a post-event summary, or helping a customer understand how to build a dashboard

  • You love curating and connecting people and ideas. You get energy from hosting, matchmaking, and finding smart formats to share what works

  • You’re excited about being on the road ~2x/month and tapping into your existing network (and growing it!) in the TA space

  • You have strong business acumen. You understand how community supports the wider business and work well with Sales and CS to make sure our programs are reaching the right people

  • You’re entrepreneurial and experimental in nature. You’re not looking for rigid playbooks; you want room to try new formats and evolve what ‘great’ looks like. You come prepared with AI tools / automations that help us execute faster while maintaining quality.

  • You believe in unreasonable hospitality—the idea that going above and beyond for a customer doesn’t just build goodwill, it builds momentum.

This Role Probably Isn't Right If ...

  • You’re not excited about hosting or don’t enjoy the details of curating small, thoughtful gatherings

  • You hate writing and have difficulty building a cohesive brief (this is a very important skill at Ashby)

  • You don’t enjoy travelling and building new connections while you’re at it

  • You’ve never had hands-on TA experience

  • You’ve never used Ashby and aren’t familiar with modern TA systems and practices

  • You prefer working from a very established playbook and are uncomfortable with ambiguity or iteration

  • You’re uncomfortable with moderating discussions or being a speaker

  • You’d rather focus purely on the community side and aren’t keen to understand how it connects to the wider business

  • You only have an ‘events background’. For this role, we need folks with deep knowledge of the TA ecosystem and a proven network in major city hubs such as London, Paris, Berlin, Stockholm and Amsterdam.

Interview Plan

  • Recruiter Screen with Kayla/Willem - 30 minutes

  • Hiring Manager Interview with Kayla - 45 minutes

  • Cross-functional Panel - 1 hour

  • Assignment (written) - 2 hours

    • Followed by Assignment Review with Kayla - 30 Minutes

  • Final Round - 1-1.5 hours

Benefits

  • Compelling benefits offerings, location dependent

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

 

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped.

At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our London office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners.

You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind.


This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem.


What You'll Do

  • Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations.

  • Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners.

  • Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in the UK and the integrations team in Stockholm.

  • Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.

  • Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform.

  • Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity.

  • Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery.

  • Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly.

  • Support our sales organisation in answering technical questions from our customers.

     

What You Bring

  • Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment.

  • Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum.

  • Ability to anticipate, assess, and manage risk in projects, from scoping through to delivery.

  • Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction.

  • A product mindset - you care about building the right thing, not just delivering on time.

  • Native level english speaking.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in tech sales, enterprise sales, or enterprise software delivery

  • Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments

  • Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards

  • Experience working with platform or API products

  • Some hands-on technical experience (e.g. scripting, debugging, light coding)

  • Experience scaling integration processes or working with multiple external partners

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based in our London office, where you will work primarily on-site with the local team, while collaborating closely with colleagues at our HQ in London.

 

How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

  • Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  • Technical interview with some of our Engineering team

  • Follow-up interview with one of our Team Leads

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

arbeitnow:senior-software-engineer-full-.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack - EMEA Pricing and Affordability

You'll join EMEA Pricing & Affordability, the team that owns how an order is priced for consumers across EMEA: service and delivery fees, distance-based pricing and surcharges, fee discounts and the benefits that subscribers get. Our work sits right at the cart and checkout, on the new Pedregal platform shared across Deliveroo and Wolt.

Price is the most visible part of every order. Getting it right means customers can see what they'll pay and trust it, and can afford to order again. That drives conversion, order frequency and retention, and it is one of the biggest levers on both consumer growth and marketplace economics. Our roadmap covers subscriber pricing, service fee optimisation, distance-based pricing, long distance surcharges and priority delivery, so the work reaches millions of orders in many markets.

As a full stack engineer on this team you'll take pricing features from idea to production: designing fee and discount logic on the backend, building the checkout and basket experience that shows it, and measuring the result through experiments. You'll be expected to be comfortable with Go and React, with correctness and testing for money-critical code, and with working closely with Product, Data and the teams across Pedregal. Your changes will be seen by consumers within weeks of shipping, and you'll help decide what we build next.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer - Full Stack to join our London team. In this role, you'll help us build and scale seamless, high-performance features that span our entire stack, ensuring a world-class experience for our customers, partners, and riders.

Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You'll Be Doing

This role is based in our London office with a hybrid setup, typically 3 days in the office.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Drive Technical Excellence: Improve code structure and architecture across your team's remit, developing, releasing and running large-scale web applications whilst transitioning our monolithic codebase to a microservice-based architecture

  • Lead Project Planning: Foresee dependencies and risks, partnering closely with Product and Design to ensure smooth delivery of complex features, whilst defining the backend architecture and tech stack for a product area

  • Optimise Operations:Improve performance, reliability, scalability and security for our backend systems

  • Collaborate & Influence: Build relationships across global engineering teams to identify collaboration opportunities and influence the wider technical roadmap.

  • Mentor & Hire: Support the personal growth of your colleagues through technical guidance and take an active role in conducting engineering interviews to scale our team.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) in the full software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring and releasing software 
  •  
  • Strong Engineering Principles: Deep pride in writing readable, well-designed, and well-tested software.

Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find, fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by IT Ops/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers & operators, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools and false positives, resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn-it-alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will serve as a key technical resource for our enterprise customers, diagnosing and resolving complex issues related to cloud infrastructure, networking, and security. This position requires a proactive self-learner who thrives in fast-paced enterprise environments and can handle escalated support tickets with minimal supervision.

About Dataro

Dataro is a fast-growing tech company with a bold mission: set a new standard in charity fundraising. Our AI-driven SaaS tools help nonprofits raise more funds and make a bigger impact in the world. We work with more than 250 organisations across 20+ countries - including UNICEF, Greenpeace, Amnesty International and Save the Children - and we’re looking for someone to help us reach many more of them across the UK and Europe.

We closed a Series A funding round in February 2026, led by Blueprint Equity, and are investing that backing into growing the UK and European business.

About the Role

As our Sales Development Representative for the UK and Europe, you’ll be the first point of contact between Dataro and the fundraising leaders at large charities across the region. You’ll find the organisations with a problem worth solving, work out who inside them owns it, and open the conversations that let our Account Executives take things forward.

This is an outbound role and it sits at the front of everything we do commercially in the region. You’ll report directly to our Head of Region, UK & Europe, and work day to day alongside two Account Executives. You’ll own your own patch of target accounts across the UK and continental Europe.

This role is ideal for someone a few years into their sales career who wants a real patch rather than a script, and who is ready to move quickly.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research and prioritise target charities across the UK and Europe, using our ideal customer criteria and live buying signals rather than working an undifferentiated list.

  • Run multi-channel outbound - email, LinkedIn and phone - leading with a relevant insight about the prospect’s fundraising programme, not a product pitch.

  • Map the buying group, identifying the fundraising managers, data leads and individual giving specialists who feel the problem day to day, and understanding how decisions actually get made inside each organisation.

  • Qualify hard and disqualify quickly. A fast no is more useful than a long maybe, for us and for the prospect.

  • Book and hand over qualified meetings, with enough context that the Account Executive walks in properly prepared.

  • Work across European markets, adapting your approach to local fundraising practice - the sector looks quite different in the Nordics, the Netherlands and the UK.

  • Keep HubSpot accurate - accounts, contacts, sequences, activity and notes.

  • Act as the voice of the market internally, feeding what you hear back to Sales, Marketing and Product. You’ll be closer to prospective customers than almost anyone else in the business.

Qualifications & Key Skills

  • 1–3 years’ experience in an outbound SDR or BDR role, ideally B2B SaaS.

  • Demonstrable track record of meeting and exceeding outbound activity and meeting targets.

  • AI Native - foundational understanding of AI-based efficiency tools (e.g. Claude), and a habit of using them.

  • Clear, plain written English. Most of your first impressions will be made in writing, and charity audiences respond badly to hype.

  • Comfortable with structure and discipline: sequences, activity cadence, CRM hygiene.

  • Interest in the nonprofit sector and a genuine curiosity about how charities raise money — direct mail, regular giving, digital, major gifts.

  • Familiarity with nonprofit CRM platforms (e.g. Raiser’s Edge, Salesforce NPSP, Blackbaud, Microsoft Dynamics) is useful but not required.

  • Experience with HubSpot and LinkedIn Sales Navigator is a plus.

Soft Skills & Qualities that make a great candidate

  • High Agency - you don’t wait to be told what to do. You see broken things and fix them.

  • Hustle - you stay in the fight when things get hard.

  • AI-First mindset - you use every tool at your disposal to move faster and think bigger.

  • Cares about the Mission - you genuinely care about helping nonprofits raise more money to change the world.


Contract Details

Contract type:

Permanent, full-time. Employed by Dataro Limited (UK).

Start date:

1 November 2026.

Location:

United Kingdom. The role is remote, with occasional travel to London for team meetings and to in-person client or sector events as needed.

Salary Range:

£37,000-£40,000 base salary based on location and experience, plus commission

This is a highly entrepreneurial role suited for someone who enjoys building new business lines, navigating ambiguity, and operating with high ownership in a fast-moving environment.

🤩What makes this role special?

  • Own both acquisition and growth: You’ll drive the full partnership lifecycle, from outbound prospecting and commercial negotiations to account management and long-term growth.

🎯 You are a great fit if

  • You’ve closed consultative deals end to end: You bring 5-8 years of experience across enterprise partnerships, strategic business development, or enterprise sales. You have a strong track record of owning the full commercial cycle, from first touch to signature.

  • You’ve worked with public-sector institutions: You have experience selling to or building partnerships with government agencies, tourism bodies, public institutions, or other complex public-sector organizations. 

  • You’ve built from zero: You’ve sold something new, launched a product, opened a market, or created demand where none existed. You know how to build pipelines, playbooks, and processes without waiting for someone to hand them to you.

About Agon

Agon is building Europe’s defence AI lab. We develop the sovereign infrastructure and AI foundation models to train, test and evolve autonomous defence systems, in Europe and for Europe. At the heart of it is a synthetic battlefield: a virtual testing ground where drones, vessels and other autonomous systems face adaptive adversaries at scale, and where their failure modes are exposed before they ever deploy. We work as a neutral partner to defence manufacturers and governments.

Founded in London in January 2026, we’ve raised $100M to date. Our $70M Series A, at a $450M valuation, was led by Northzone alongside Lakestar, Lux Capital and XYZ, with backing from former Sequoia Capital head Roelof Botha. It was also the first joint investment by the UK Government’s Sovereign AI Fund and the National Security Strategic Investment Fund.

Between them, our founders have helped build one of the defining defence-tech companies of the last decade, and started an aerospace company from scratch. Around them is a founding team hand-picked from Europe’s best engineers, each at the top of their field, and brought together to build this. We’re scaling fast across our offices in London and Berlin.

The role

We’re hiring our first Head of Legal: a hands-on commercial lawyer who will build Agon’s legal function and be a trusted partner to our leadership team. You’ll lead on the contracts and partnerships that shape our growth, cover corporate and employment matters with confidence, and represent Agon with partners and customers.

This role is based in London, with work across our UK and German entities.

  • Lead commercial contracting: negotiate and draft defence contracts, sales agreements, teaming and partnership agreements, and joint ventures with industry partners and government customers.

  • Protect our IP: shape how we own, license and protect our technology and data in commercial deals.

  • Navigate defence regulation: own the legal view on export controls and related regimes, and manage specialist external counsel where needed.

  • Cover corporate and employment law: support governance, fundraising and transactions, and handle employment matters across the UK and Germany.

  • Be a partner to the business: work closely with our founders, commercial and product teams, and help them move quickly with sound judgement.

  • Build partnerships: represent Agon at industry events and with partners and customers, helping to open and shape strategic relationships.

  • Build the function: set up the processes, templates, training and external counsel relationships a scaling defence company needs.

What you’ll bring

  • Commercial depth: substantial hands-on experience negotiating complex commercial agreements, such as sales agreements, JVs and IP.

  • Defence context: familiarity with the defence or government sector, including export controls. You don’t need to be a specialist, but you should know the risks and when to bring in expert counsel.

  • Breadth: confidence handling corporate and employment law as well as commercial work.

  • Big law and beyond: training or experience at a leading law firm, followed by time in another setting, such as in-house, a scale-up, or military or government service.

  • An outward-facing style: you enjoy building relationships, attending events and talking to partners and customers.

  • Judgement and pace: you give clear, pragmatic advice and are comfortable doing the work yourself.

Nice to have

  • In-house experience at a defence, aerospace or deep-tech company

  • Experience with government contracting or procurement

  • Knowledge of German law or experience working with German entities

  • Experience supporting a venture-backed fundraising

What we offer

We pay at the top of the market we compete in, and everyone is an owner.

  • Pay: salary at the 90th percentile of the companies we compete with, benchmarked by role, level and location.

  • Equity: every permanent employee holds options. New hires receive options worth their base salary, vesting over four years with a one-year cliff.

  • Cash and equity choice: trade some salary for more options, or some options for more cash.

  • Pension: 5% employer and 5% employee contributions on full base salary.

  • Ownership from day one: you’ll build Agon’s legal function directly with our founders.

How we work

Our values shape how we work: All as One Company, Take Extreme Ownership, Low Ego, Be Bold, and Remember Who We Serve. We prefer clear written thinking to polished slides, and we hold a high bar.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you’re excited by this role but don’t meet every requirement, we’d still like to hear from you.

At the heart of it is a synthetic battlefield: a virtual testing ground where drones, vessels and other autonomous systems face adaptive adversaries at scale, and where their failure modes are exposed before they ever deploy. Founded in London in January 2026, we’ve raised $100M to date.   • Model the real world: work with domain experts to bring aircraft, sensors and other systems into the arena at the right fidelity.

  • Raise the bar: set engineering standards, review code and shape the architecture of a platform built to last.

You’re comfortable working in code, particularly on the web, and aren’t afraid to roll up your sleeves, dive into the codebase and make changes yourself. We’re looking for someone whose centre of gravity is design, who can work directly with engineers and use code as another design tool.

You enjoy ambiguity, experimentation and exploring ideas that may or may not become products.

You’ll work across tldraw’s products and experiments, including tldraw.com, tldraw offline, our SDK and new product bets.

You’ll work closely with product engineers and the wider product team to explore ideas, prototype them quickly, develop the interaction model, and carry the best ones through to something we can ship.

  • Take ambiguous product ideas from rough concepts through prototypes, interaction design and polished experiences

  • Build high-fidelity prototypes in code when that is the fastest or best way to explore an idea

  • Work directly with engineers to turn designs into exceptional production experiences

  • Sweat the details across interaction, motion, typography, layout, responsiveness and overall product feel

  • Contribute to the evolution and consistency of our design language across products

  • Explore unconventional interfaces and interaction patterns, particularly around canvas, creative tools and AI

  • Make experimental things: demos, prototypes, side projects and ideas that help us discover what tldraw should build next

You should have

  • A strong track record in product, interaction or digital design

  • A strong portfolio showing exceptional product craft and substantial personal contribution to shipped products

  • Experience working on sophisticated interactive software, not only marketing websites or static interfaces

  • Excellent visual, interaction and product design judgement

  • Experience prototyping ideas and iterating rapidly based on what you learn

  • Enough frontend development experience to work directly in modern web technologies and turn designs into functioning experiences

About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Design Delivery to own and lead the delivery of coordinated, multidisciplinary designs for Volta’s AI factory projects in EMEA.

You will be accountable for project design delivery throughout the design stage and remain closely engaged with the Delivery team through procurement, construction, commissioning and handover. You will manage the design scope and associated programme, interfaces and deliverables, ensuring the right information and decisions are available when needed to support successful project delivery.

Working closely with the Volta Product, Technology, Corporate Development, Engineering, Operations and Delivery teams, you will translate requirements into a clear project design brief and lead external design partners in applying Volta’s Reference Design to each site. You will move easily between technical detail and the wider project picture, balancing performance, reliability, cost, speed of delivery and operability. The role will also involve liaising with customer teams to incorporate their requirements into the project design brief.

What You Will Do

› Own the delivery of the project design from initial brief through to detailed design, ensuring design deliverables meet the agreed scope, quality, budget and programme requirements.

› Provide ongoing design support through procurement, construction, commissioning and handover, assisting the Delivery team during these stages.

› Establish and maintain the project design brief with customers, Product, Engineering, Operations and Delivery, capturing requirements, scope boundaries, acceptance criteria and responsibilities.

› Develop and manage the design delivery programme, aligning design packages, reviews, approvals and information release with key project milestones.

› Coordinate design inputs to planning, permitting and statutory approvals with local design partners and the relevant Volta teams, ensuring requirements and approval conditions are incorporated into the design and delivery programme.

› Lead and coordinate external design partners across all disciplines, setting clear scopes, deliverables and accountabilities and managing performance against agreed quality, programme and budget expectations.

› Manage the application of Volta’s Reference Design and engineering standards to each project, coordinating site-specific adaptations and securing approval from the relevant technical authorities for departures.

› Lead multidisciplinary design coordination reviews, resolving interfaces between civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, controls and GPU compute infrastructure to ensure the overall design works as one integrated AI factory.

› Act as the principal point of coordination for project design matters, working closely with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve requirements, secure timely decisions and maintain alignment as the design develops.

› Plan and lead design reviews and stage gates, ensuring deliverables are complete, coordinated and appropriately reviewed, with comments, actions and approvals tracked to closure.

› Work with the Project Controls, Delivery and Procurement teams to define design package boundaries and release priorities, support technical tender evaluations and incorporate supplier and contractor design information into the coordinated project design.

› Embed construction sequencing, prefabrication, modular delivery, access, logistics and maintainability into the design, working with the teams that will build and operate the facility.

› Manage design changes through a clear change control process, assessing their impact on scope, cost, programme, capacity and performance and securing the required approvals before implementation.

› Remain closely engaged during construction, coordinating responses to technical queries, design clarifications, submittals and proposed changes with designers and engineering, so site teams receive timely, approved information.

› Work with Operations and commissioning teams to incorporate testing, commissioning, maintenance and handover requirements into the design, including the information needed for safe and effective operation.

› Champion best practice health and safety throughout design delivery, leading multidisciplinary reviews to eliminate foreseeable hazards and reduce H&S risks through design.

› Maintain clear visibility of design risks, assumptions, interfaces and outstanding decisions, escalating issues early and reporting design delivery status to project leadership

What You Will Bring

› A degree in engineering, architecture, construction or equivalent relevant experience.

› Significant experience managing multidisciplinary design delivery for large scale data centres, AI factories or similarly complex infrastructure.

› A track record of taking projects from concept through detailed design and supporting procurement, construction, commissioning and handover.

› Strong understanding of the interfaces between building infrastructure, power, cooling, controls and compute, including the requirements of high-density AI and GPU facilities.

› Experience translating customer, product and operational requirements into clear design briefs and coordinated project deliverables.

› Proven ability to lead external consultants and coordinate internal technical specialists, suppliers and contractors around a common delivery programme.

› Experience managing design programmes, consultant scopes and fees, stage gate reviews, design changes and technical information release.

› An understanding of how reference designs are adapted to site conditions, local requirements and project-specific needs while maintaining consistency across a portfolio.

› Strong commercial judgement, balancing design quality, capex, schedule, constructability, reliability and operability.

› Familiarity with BIM coordination, common data environments and document control processes that support effective multidisciplinary design delivery.

› Experience integrating offsite manufacturing, prefabrication and DFMA into coordinated project designs and delivery programmes.

› Confident communication, able to explain design issues, trade-offs and decisions clearly to customers, technical teams and senior stakeholders.

› A collaborative and accountable approach, with the ability to resolve competing priorities, challenge incomplete information and drive decisions through to closure.

› Willingness to travel to project sites periodically, customer meetings and design partner locations across EMEA.

What We Offer

At Volta, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to grow. We're building a company where you can make an impact, keep a healthy balance between work and life, and build a career you're proud of.
As a global team, we do our best to provide great benefits wherever you're based. While some benefits vary by country due to local regulations, we believe looking after our people is simply the right thing to do.

Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Are our Product Principles aligned with your vision?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In almost 7 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €225 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1300+ happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1M+ small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 4,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

Autopilot is Pennylane’s AI add-on for accounting firms, designed to automate bookkeeping and move accountants from execution to supervision—with a clear ambition: a 1-click VAT return.

The challenge is no longer only to build a powerful product, but to activate it at scale, prove its value and turn adoption into revenue.

As the first PM of the new Bookkeeping / Autopilot Growth squad, you will play a central role in making that happen. You will help hundreds of thousands of companies adopt Autopilot, connect firms to the value it already delivers and shape Pennylane’s AI monetization strategy.

HOW you will contribute to the company as a Product Manager

As a Senior Product Manager, you will join a 100+ person Product organization, working with 300+ engineers to make Autopilot the default way firms run their bookkeeping.

You will:

  • Understand what drives adoption. Talk to firm owners and accountants, analyse product data with SQL, Amplitude and Metabase, and identify where firms hesitate to activate Autopilot.

  • Turn insights into measurable growth. Define clear hypotheses, metrics and stop criteria, then run B2B experiments through holdouts, cohort analysis and staged rollouts.

  • Own the growth strategy. Set your OKRs, shape the roadmap and focus the squad on the initiatives that drive activation, trust, usage and revenue.

  • Build with a cross-functional squad. Partner closely with a Product Designer, Engineering Manager and product-focused engineers, starting with MVPs and iterating based on what you learn.

  • Work across the ecosystem. Collaborate with the squads building Bookkeeping and Autopilot, as well as Data, Product Marketing, Pricing, Sales, Customer Success and Account Management.

  • Scale adoption beyond the product. Design in-product and lifecycle experiences that help firms self-serve, while providing commercial teams with the signals they need to support adoption.

  • Build for France and Germany from day one. Design configurable solutions rather than simple translations, and work with the German team to make what works in France scalable internationally.

  • Help define a new way of building product. Work agentic-first, design for supervision and stay relentlessly user-obsessed—using AI tools and agents every day to explore data, prototype and move faster.

WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane

Within one month

  • You'll learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week

  • You'll familiarize yourself with the product, the accounting industry and the accountant channel (you will have access to a lot of documentation and will attend trainings organized by your peers)

  • You'll understand how Autopilot works: what it automates, how confident it is, and where it still needs a human

  • You'll have mapped the Autopilot adoption funnel, at company and firm level: eligible, enabled, expanded, paying

Within 3 months

  • You'll have set the adoption baseline and targets with your manager

  • You'll have shipped and read your first experiments on activation, hand in hand with your Product Designer and Engineers

  • You'll have impacted positively at least one OKR

  • You will have set up your continuous discovery routine with firms and be ready to build your roadmap

Within 6 months

  • You'll be autonomous at defining your OKRs and your roadmap

  • You'll have shipped at least one step change in how firms activate Autopilot

  • You'll have made the time Autopilot saves visible to firm owners

  • You'll have prepared the switch to paid with Pricing, Product Marketing and Sales

  • You'll have equipped Account Managers and CSMs with an adoption playbook they actually use

  • You'll share your learnings and playbooks with the other Autopilot squads and with Germany

What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🏢 You'll be able to work remotely from anywhere in Europe, as long as your contract allows you to;

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us;

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it;

⛹️Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness;

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French;

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment;

🎉 You’ll be part of a vibrant social community : we do lots of sports together (Foot, running, climbing...), we love to hang out and have a drink together (thursday afterwork drinks on our rooftop is a usual thing. Twice-a-year we do company seminars, last time we went on a trip to the French Alps and it was fabulous !).

 

And.. If you're based in 🇫🇷 :

 

🏢 You’ll be able to work fully from your home or any co-working space in France, or from our wonderful office in the center of Paris

🏝You’ll get 10 additional days off (to the 25 standard ones) to rest and do what you love each year

🍜 You’ll have lunch credits (Swile card) to buy your favorite food every day

🏥 You’ll have a great healthcare cover (Alan Blue) to take care of yourself and your family

 

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

What does the recruitment process look like?

  • You will first have a general chat with Charlène, Talent Acquisition Manager (45 min)

  • You'll then have a discussion with one member of our Product team to assess the fit and the Product culture (45 min)

  • You'll then pass a live case study on an Autopilot adoption problem with 2 Product Managers from our team (1h15)

  • You'll have a final round with Tancrède (our CPO) and a Group PM or a Head of Product (60 min)

We make sure we move fast; you can expect the recruitment process with us to last between 15 and 25 days in total.

Language

For this specific role, a full fluent level in French 🇫🇷 is required.

What you’ll bring

  • Proven experience driving growth, adoption or monetization, ideally in B2B SaaS or a scaled B2C product, with measurable results;

  • Strong data fluency and hands-on analytical skills: you can go from SQL query to dashboard to actionable decision, using Amplitude or equivalent tools—even when the data is imperfect;

  • Rigour in experimentation: you know when sample sizes are too small for A/B testing and can design robust holdouts, cohorts and staged rollouts instead;

  • A strong understanding of AI-powered products: you can assess automation quality across confidence, accuracy, coverage and evaluation—and know what it takes to build user trust;

  • Excellent product sense and user research skills: you can uncover what makes professional users comfortable delegating critical work to a machine;

  • Strong cross-functional leadership: you influence and align multiple squads and commercial teams without relying on formal authority;

  • Clear, structured communication skills, with fluency in French and professional proficiency in English;

  • Previous Product Management experience in a scale-up or large technology company.

Experience in accounting is not required, but curiosity for the domain and comfort with complexity are essential. Experience with pricing and packaging, free-to-paid transitions, paid add-ons, lifecycle/CRM or sales-assisted PLG would be a strong plus.

arbeitnow:compliance-officer-paris-24777.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Compliance Officer, you will be the dedicated owner of third-party due diligence and the broader integrity compliance agenda at Harmattan AI. You will protect our ability to operate and win contracts with demanding customers and partners as we scale across Europe, the US, the Middle East and Africa. You will build this function from the ground up, with real ownership and direct access to management.

Responsibilities

  • Own the third-party due diligence process end to end, covering partners, intermediaries, suppliers, prospects and investors.

  • Screen incoming requests, assess the risk and issue clear go / no-go / go-with-safeguards recommendations.

  • Define the risk-tiering methodology, screening tools and approval workflow that every due diligence file runs through.

  • Build and maintain the group compliance risk map and a multi-year compliance roadmap.

  • Draft, update and roll out group policies on anti-corruption, gifts and hospitality, conflicts of interest and whistleblowing.

  • Design and deliver compliance training and awareness for employees and managers.

  • Partner with Sales, Procurement and Legal on live files and contract clauses, escalating sensitive cases to management.

  • Support the trade compliance function on end-use checks, and prepare evidence for audits, customer questionnaires and investor due diligence.

  • Monitor anti-corruption and sanctions developments and turn them into practical guidance for the business.

Candidate Requirements

  • 2 to 5 years of experience in third-party due diligence, compliance or corporate investigations, ideally involving high-risk jurisdictions.

  • Background in compliance, law or ethics, or in economic intelligence, risk advisory or corporate investigations.

  • Strong research and investigation skills: OSINT, corporate registries, UBO identification, sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening, network mapping.

  • Ability to write clear, decision-oriented due diligence reports.

  • Working knowledge of Sapin II, FCPA, the UK Bribery Act and EU, UN, OFAC and UK sanctions regimes.

  • Degree in law, political science or business, or a specialized master's in economic intelligence, geopolitics or risk; demonstrated rigor matters more than field of study.

  • Curious, methodical and comfortable with ambiguity, with the pragmatism to turn findings into a clear risk position.

  • Ability to challenge commercial opportunities while preserving the relationship with business teams.

  • Motivated to move from advising clients to owning decisions and building a function in-house.

  • Fluency in English and French.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

The Material Flow Engineer designs, builds, and optimizes the end-to-end physical movement and presentation of hardware from receiving docks through warehousing, kitting, and lineside delivery, to support high-rate production schedules and rapid manufacturing scale. This role owns the physical-to-digital operating mechanisms that translate factory layouts and inventory data into executable material handling workflows, including Plan for Every Part (PFEP) management, facility layout engineering, and custom material handling hardware design.

You will serve as the connective tissue between Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering, and Production, driving inventory accuracy, eliminating lineside bottlenecks, and deploying low-CAPEX, high-impact floor solutions before scaling to automation. In addition to daily floor execution, you will partner closely with Design Engineering, Program Management, Quality, and Facilities to support New Product Introduction (NPI) line readiness, factory expansions, and continuous lean process improvements.

  • Own observability and reliability of our GPU services: metrics, dashboards and alerts for latency, throughput, queue depth and GPU utilization, and incident investigation when those numbers move.

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France.

About the role

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach in France.

At the core of our market expansion plans is market analysis. To maximise future revenue, we spend a lot of time understanding the value of flexibility in power markets around the world.

We are looking for a technical individual (data scientist, analyst or engineer) with strong knowledge of the French electricity markets and an instinct for commercial value.

You will become Axle’s internal expert on French power markets: understanding the market rules, modelling the value, and building relationships with system operators and regulators. We’re scrappy about method and rigorous about conclusions.

You will speak fluent French and English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Developing a deep understanding of French energy markets and grid dynamics to understand how trading, compensation, penalties and cash flow work

  • Jumping on the phone with grid operators, regulators and market stakeholders to validate hypotheses and make sense of data

  • Building and optimising models of wholesale/NEBCO, capacity, balancing, ancillary services and local flexibility markets in France to forecast what different assets can earn

  • Sizing the revenue opportunity across markets and products to shape where we expand next

  • Building and evaluating different strategies for cycling a battery or load-shifting an EV charger

  • Monitoring and shaping energy regulation to accelerate the growth of flexibility.

This is an opportunity to gain unique domain expertise and build the quantitative case for first-of-a-kind projects across the world.

What we think you need to be successful

  • Deep quantitative and modelling ability (Python, SQL)

  • Exceptional communication and the ability to turn data into actionable commercial insights

  • Comfort moving fast and making decisions in an evolving environment

  • Deep knowledge of French electricity markets (NEBCO, Mécanisme de Capacité, Mécanisme d’Ajustement, ancillary services…)

  • Relationships with regulators, grid operators and other stakeholders (CRE, DGEC, RTE, Enedis, etc.) are a plus

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract (CDD). Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in France. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Take-home exercise

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

  • Monitor and explain our performance towards our business objectives

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

arbeitnow:customer-support-specialist-pa.description:
About us

Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed.
Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity.
K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners.

Position is based in our Paris office or remotely in France, UK or Germany.

Please submit your CV in English

About the role:

Owkin is looking for a Customer Support Specialist to own first-level support for K-Pro, Owkin's AI research platform for biopharma R&D, used by AstraZeneca, Sanofi, Servier and Boehringer Ingelheim.

Our clients have made major investments to access K-Pro, and their contracts come with strict response and resolution SLAs. You will be their first point of contact during business hours: the person who understands their problem quickly, keeps them informed, and gets the right engineering, product or customer success people moving. You will also help shape how support works at Owkin, including where AI and agentisation make it better.

 

In particular, you will:

Own the support flow

  • Own incoming tickets during business hours as the first line of support for all K-Pro clients

  • Triage every ticket: set priority (P1 to P4) and the impacted service, and route it to the right team

  • Keep SLAs on track: follow up on open tickets, escalate early when a deadline is at risk

  • Communicate clear, timely updates to users and CSMs throughout the ticket lifecycled 

 Go deep on the product

  • Diagnose issues directly with users: reproduce bugs, check data and configurations, and give engineers a clean, actionable report

  • Learn K-Pro in depth (its features, the datasets clients use, how login, API access, exports and permissions work, and the research questions clients bring to it) so you can resolve most issues without escalating

  • Recognise when a result looks scientifically wrong and when it's a usage question

Turn support into insight

  • Act as the Customer Success team's eyes on support: flag critical tickets, recurring issues, and signs that a client is becoming dissatisfied, so CSMs can act early

  • Spot patterns across tickets and turn them into product feedback, doc updates or process fixes

  • Track and report on support metrics (response time, SLA compliance, first contact resolution, volume) and give actionable insights to the team.

Own the knowledge base

  • Own the K-Pro help center: write, update and remove articles as new issues are resolved

  • Turn one-off fixes into reusable answers for clients and for the support team

Improve support with AI

  • Identify where automation and AI tools (triage, routing, response drafting, knowledge retrieval) would save time or improve quality

  • Work with R&Tech Operations to build, test and improve these workflows

 

About you

Required qualifications / experience:

  • Proven technical support or customer support for B2B software, ideally SaaS, with enterprise clients

  • A track record handling SLA-bound support with demanding customers, and staying calm under pressure

  • Strong technical curiosity: comfortable with APIs, logs, data and configurations; basic SQL or scripting is a plus

  • Hands-on experience with AI tooling and building or improving agentic support workflows (AI-assisted triage, automated routing, LLM-powered drafting), and the judgment to know when automation fits

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, able to explain technical issues to scientists and to engineers alike

  • Experience with support tooling such as Zendesk, Linear and PagerDuty, or equivalent

  • Able to follow runbooks and escalation paths, and to know when to deviate from them

  • A habit of turning fixes into documentation and patterns into insights

Preferred qualifications/bonus:

  • Experience in life sciences, biopharma or another regulated industry is a strong plus

What success looks like in your first 6 months

  • You handle the full ticket flow for all K-Pro clients with SLAs met

  • CSMs rely on your signals to anticipate account risks

  • The help center covers the most frequent ticket types

  • You have shipped at least one automation that measurably improves support 

#LI-HB1

 

What we offer

  • Flexible work organization

  • Friendly and informal working environment

  • Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds

Recruitment Process & Security

  • Please complete the form and submit your CV.

  • Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability.

  • Owkin is a great place to work. As a coveted workplace we are, unfortunately, vulnerable to recruitment phishing scams. We urge all job seekers and candidates to be wary of potential scams. Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information:

  • Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn.

  • Communication is always through an official Owkin email address (from the @owkin.com domain), over the phone or through our applicant tracking system (Ashby).

  • The Owkin talent team do use platforms such as LinkedIn, however if you have any concern or doubt about this contact, please ask for them to send an email from @Owkin.com.

  • The Owkin talent team will not solicit personal data from candidates during the application phase including, but not limited to, date of birth, social security numbers, or bank account information;

  • Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger

  • Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format.

If you think that you have been a victim of fraud,

  • Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn

  • Check our senior team on our website https://owkin.com/team/

  • Check the existence of the position on our website: https://www.owkin.com/careers#current-opportunities

  • Notify Owkin's recruitment unit at this address contact the following authorities:

    • [FR] https://internet-signalement.gouv.fr/

    • [UK] https://www.actionfraud.police.uk/reporting-fraud-and-cyber-crime

    • [US] https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/

Après le grade Confirmé vient le grade Senior, avec des contextes plus exigeants et des PM plus juniors à accompagner. La plupart de nos managers et leads ont commencé consultants chez nous, donc ton prochain poste peut très bien être en interne.

  • On fait du Product et de l’IA depuis 2016, et rien d’autre. Autour de toi, tout le monde parle produit

  • Tu interviens chez Dior, Decathlon, Leroy Merlin, France TV…

  • Tu as au moins 3 ans d’expérience comme PM sur des produits digitaux dans des environnements grands comptes

  • Tu as déjà fait de la discovery avec de vrais utilisateurs, et tu as envie d’en faire plus

  • Backlog, priorisation, roadmap : tu connais, et tu as envie de pratiquer dans d’autres contextes

  • Tu aimes convaincre, et défendre une décision face à un client ne te fait pas peur

  1. Un premier échange avec l’équipe RH

  2. Un cas pratique en live avec un Manager (1h30)

  3. Un entretien avec un VP ou un des cofondateurs (1h30)

  4. Un appel RH de 15 minutes pour la proposition

Quelle que soit l’issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum.

arbeitnow:product-manager-f-h-paris-3154.description:
Aujourd'hui, une IA sait remplir un backlog.

Rédiger des user stories, synthétiser des entretiens, proposer une priorisation : la production devient une commodité. Ce qui ne l'est pas : décider de ce qui mérite d'être construit, puis fédérer une organisation autour de cette décision.

C'est ce métier que tu exerces chez Hubvisory. Tu interviens auprès de grands comptes comme Club Med, SNCF, TF1 ou Saint-Gobain, sur des produits où les arbitrages sont structurants. Tu n'exécutes pas un brief : tu le challenges.

  • Identifier ce qui crée de la valeur. Entretiens utilisateurs, JTBD, story mapping. Tu pars d'hypothèses et tu construis des preuves.

  • Arbitrer. Roadmap, OKR, priorisation : tu tranches entre enjeux business, usages et contraintes tech, et tu assumes tes choix face à des interlocuteurs exigeants.

  • Piloter le delivery. Backlog, rituels, environnement agile. Tu tiens le rôle de PM en autonomie et tu challenges les pratiques de la squad.

  • Mesurer ton impact et défendre tes décisions. Tu définis les indicateurs, tu suis les résultats de tes choix et tu les portes devant les parties prenantes.

  • Faire de l'IA un levier. Tu l'utilises pour gagner en efficacité, en gardant la maîtrise de ton jugement.

Notre objectif : faire de toi un PM reconnu pour sa capacité à décider en contexte d'incertitude. Selon ton appétence, ton évolution se construit vers Senior, Product Leader, Manager ou Principal.

Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory

  • Une rémunération lisible. De 46 à 58 K€ selon ton expérience, une part variable et l'intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits, redistribué de façon égalitaire.

  • Un rôle sur le quoi, pas seulement sur le comment. Notre positionnement Product & IA nous place là où se crée la valeur.

  • Une progression alignée sur ton impact. Revalorisations salariales bi-annuelles, passages de grade fondés sur la performance et non sur l'ancienneté.

  • Un onboarding structuré. Un parcours collectif et individuel, avec un plan de formation et une montée en charge progressive. Tu es accompagné par un buddy et un mentor dédiés, et tu as accès à 1000h de contenu à la carte.

  • 3 à 5 ans d'expérience comme PM / PO sur des produits digitaux. Une expérience en conseil ou en grand groupe est un vrai plus.

  • Indispensables : maîtrise de la Discovery et du Delivery, capacité à avancer sans cadrage parfait, culture de la mesure d'impact.

  • Atouts : usage concret de l'IA dans ta pratique produit, culture SAFe ou agilité à l'échelle.

  • Savoir-être : autonomie, posture client solide, engagement dans le collectif (chez Hubvisory, tu t’impliques à la fois chez client et au sein du cabinet).

  1. Échange avec un RH : ton projet, notre modèle, tes attentes (45 min)

arbeitnow:head-of-marketing-strasbourg-2.description:
At Goodweek, we help businesses make the most of AI. Our platform brings leading AI models, such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Mistral, together in one place, allowing employees to use the right AI tools for their tasks while keeping everything secure, controlled, and connected to the software they already use. By helping businesses manage AI more effectively, we enable them to save time, reduce costs, and improve productivity.

We work through our partners, including Distributors and Managed Service Providers (MSPs), who bring Goodweek’s platform to their own customers.

Our international team is based across France, Spain, and the United States, and our vision is backed by six international investment funds.

The role

We're looking for a hands-on Head of Marketing to own our marketing strategy end to end and build the team that delivers it. Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, you'll shape how the market sees us, fill the pipeline, and give Sales and our partners the tools to win.

This is a builder role. You'll start with a team of 3 direct reports, then hire, train and grow a team across brand, demand generation, communications, product marketing, sales and partner enablement.

What you'll do

1. Brand Awareness and Storytelling

  • Define and own the company narrative, positioning, and messaging across all channels.

  • Build a compelling brand story that sets us apart in our market.

  • Create and maintain company brand assets: guidelines, website, decks, visual identity, and templates.

2. Demand Generation

  • Design and run integrated inbound and outbound campaigns that build qualified pipeline.

  • Own the marketing funnel, budget, and attribution, with clear targets shared with Revenue Team.

  • Lead our presence at industry events and trade shows, define KPIs and keep Revenue team accountable for driving leads conversions. Support post-event outreach campaigns and follow-up communication.

3. Communications and PR

  • Build media and analyst relationships, and secure coverage that strengthens our credibility.

  • Manage press releases, announcements, executive thought leadership, and social media.

  • Ensure consistent internal and external communication.

4. Product Marketing

  • Turn product capabilities into clear customer value, working closely with Product.

  • Produce product digests, launch plans, and release communications.

  • Build competitive intelligence and battlecards.

  • Run customer and prospect webinars, and deliver product trainings for internal teams.

5. Sales Enablement and Partner Marketing

  • Equip Sales with the content, playbooks, and tools they need to win.

  • Design and run MIP (Managed Intelligent Partner) workshops.

  • Build partner marketing programs, including co-marketing campaigns and co-funding (MDF) management.

  • Own partner newsletters and sign up subscriptions.

  • Develop partners and end-customers success stories (one sheeters, testimonials, use cases, videos).

6. Building the team

  • Assess current marketing capabilities, gaps, and agency or freelance support

  • Design the target marketing organization and a phased hiring plan aligned with business growth

  • Recruit, onboard, and develop a high-performing team (for example, demand gen, product marketing, content and comms, partner marketing)

  • Set clear goals, processes, and KPIs, and build a collaborative, accountable culture

  • Work as a true partner to Sales, Customer Success, Product, and leadership

Requirements

  • 10+ years of B2B marketing experience (ideally in Tech, SaaS, or Agencies), including 3+ years leading marketing teams.

  • Proven track record across brand, demand generation, and product marketing.

  • Experience with channel or partner marketing, including co-marketing and MDF programs.

  • Strong storyteller and writer, comfortable with media and on stage.

  • Data-driven, with hands-on knowledge of marketing automation, CRM, and attribution.

  • Builder mindset: comfortable rolling up your sleeves in a scaling environment.

  • Collaborative leader and great team player who earns trust across Sales, Product, and partners.

  • Excellent communication skills in English (additional languages a plus).

Benefits

  • Meal vouchers and transportation cost reimbursement (50%)

  • Flexible working hours

  • Hybrid remote work
