Senior Data Protection Engineer (Backup & Cyber Resilience)

Location: Windsor, UK

Introduction

We’re hiring a Senior Data Protection Engineer to join a global hosting and managed services team. The team runs business-critical, highly regulated systems for organisations around the world, many of them in healthcare, where losing data or failing to recover it is not an option.

This is a senior role with real influence. You’ll own the enterprise backup and recovery platform across all regions. You’ll set the standards for how data is protected, retained and restored, and you’ll show, with evidence, that recovery targets are met. You’ll also help shape where data protection services go next, at a time when cyber resilience matters more than ever.

Responsibilities & Tasks

  • Run the platform globally. Lead the engineering, administration and continuous improvement of an enterprise Rubrik environment. This covers configuration, upgrades, capacity planning, health monitoring, security hardening and lifecycle management.

  • Set the rules. Design and enforce global protection policies, including SLA tiers, retention, archiving, replication, immutability, encryption and access controls.

  • Turn requirements into protection. Convert business, regulatory, contractual and risk needs into clear protection tiers, RPO and RTO targets, and practical operating procedures.

  • Keep coverage complete. Bring new workloads into the service and keep protection accurate across on-premises, cloud, virtualised, database and application environments.

  • Keep operations healthy. Monitor backup, replication, archiving and restore activity. Fix failed jobs, capacity pressure, performance issues and policy exceptions before they become risks.

  • Prove that recovery works. Plan and run restore tests, disaster recovery exercises and readiness reviews, and keep the evidence that recovery targets and controls are met.

  • Strengthen cyber resilience. Work with security and incident response teams on ransomware readiness, anomaly investigations, clean-recovery planning and privileged-access controls.

  • Build strong governance. Write the runbooks, standards and procedures that define good practice, and help regions and technology teams adopt them consistently.

  • Lead when it counts. Take technical ownership during incidents and service disruptions, and drive root cause analysis and lasting corrective actions.

  • Automate. Use APIs, scripting and orchestration tools to automate routine operations, compliance checks, reporting and workflows.

  • Report clearly. Give regular insight into protection coverage, recoverability, compliance, capacity, platform risk and operational performance.

  • Work across teams. Partner closely with infrastructure, cloud, database, application, security, risk and business continuity colleagues, and take part in a shared on-call rota for critical production services.

Requirements & Qualifications

Essential:

  • A solid track record of engineering and running enterprise-scale backup, recovery and data protection services

  • Extensive hands-on production experience with Rubrik

  • A current Rubrik Certified System Administrator (RCSA) certification

  • Experience designing and rolling out data protection policies, standards and operating models across multiple regions

  • A strong grasp of retention, immutability, encryption, access control, RPO and RTO, and recovery validation

  • Hands-on involvement in disaster recovery, cyber recovery or ransomware-resilience initiatives

  • Strong troubleshooting skills, and familiarity with incident, change and problem management processes

  • Experience supporting production services in a 24x7 or on-call environment

Benefits & Culture

  • Global reach and visible impact: Your work will directly protect critical services, including healthcare systems that clinicians and care providers rely on every day.

  • Real ownership: You’ll have a strong voice in policy design, retention strategy, cyber resilience, automation and the long-term direction of the service.

  • Collaborative environment: You’ll join experienced engineers and architects who value shared ownership, operational excellence and openly sharing knowledge.

  • Growth and development: You’ll keep developing your skills on an enterprise-grade platform, with support for certifications and continuous learning.

  • Competitive rewards: The package includes market-aligned pay and comprehensive benefits that reflect a senior technical role.

If you want to make data protection dependable at a global scale, we’d love to hear from you.

  • 100M+ conversations per month

  • 150+ brand clients

  • a $100B market structuring at high speed

Context

You'll join a tight-knit team with high product standards and direct access to production deployment: our models are tested in real-world conditions, with several million users each month, with very short cycles between prototyping, integration and deployment.

In this context, you'll work on the next generation of agentic and recommendation systems: building the pipelines, agents, and models that sit at the core of our product.

Your Mission

Your goal is to build and scale the agentic infrastructure that powers Lemrock's commerce intelligence: turning raw signals into automated, self-improving systems at production scale.

Concretely, you will:

  • Analyze large-scale conversational interaction datasets (100M+ events/month) to uncover behavioral patterns, intent signals, and performance drivers.

  • Design and deploy agentic pipelines end-to-end, from data ingestion and enrichment to model orchestration, monitoring, and continuous improvement, integrated into systems exposed to millions of requests daily.

  • Build autonomous agents that keep our knowledge infrastructure accurate and current.

  • Translate insights into iteration loops in production, by updating, fine-tuning, and improving our existing recommendation and ranking algorithms with tight constraints on latency, robustness, and business outcomes.

  • Design and train new recommendation models from scratch when needed, with a focus on scalability, evaluation rigor, and deployability in real-world traffic.

Candidate Profile

  • Strong academic background (MVA, ENS, X, Central…)

  • 2+ years of experience in AI, Agentic Systems, ML / Deep Learning, statistics or NLP

  • Experience prototyping and deploying AI models into production

  • Experience with production systems (APIs, monitoring, optimization)

  • Strong interest in LLMs, recommendation and conversational systems: building agentic pipelines, agent orchestration, fine-tuning

  • Comfortable with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor)

  • Thrives in ambiguity and 0-to-1 environments

  • Fluent in English; French is a plus

Tech Stack

ML/AI (required)

  • Agentic frameworks (e.g., Langchain) and/or native SDKs like OpenAI/Anthropic

  • Observability and evaluation for LLM/agent workflows

  • Vector search, scoring, prompting, LLM orchestration

  • Hybrid recommender systems, causal inference, probabilistic models

Bonus (appreciated but not required)

  • TypeScript

  • Engineering: Docker, GCP, PostgreSQL, Redis, Vector DBs, PostHog

Why Join Us

  • Join a company in early breakout mode, already generating revenue, with a clear technological edge and strong financial backing to fuel its growth

Competitive salary disclosed during the interview process.

From generating General Meeting reports to leveraging AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our teams in our 8 offices across France, the US, Mexico, MEA, Germany, Spain, Italy, and Canada are the driving force behind our global success. We also care about how you think about AI: whether you approach it as a design question as much as an engineering one, and whether you bring genuine curiosity and opinions into product conversations.

arbeitnow:senior-data-engineer-financial.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

About the Role

As a Senior Data Engineer on the Financial Flows team, you will take full technical ownership of the end-to-end data pipelines, predictive models, and cloud infrastructure powering Kpler’s commodity finance analytics. You will lead the modernization of our data foundation, spearheading the migration of production services to AWS and re-architecting legacy calculation engines into clean, performant Python services. Operating at the crossroads of quantitative research and cloud infrastructure, your work will directly ensure that market participants receive real-time, mission-critical insights across global commodities markets.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate resilient batch and real-time streaming data ingestion pipelines connecting to external financial market data providers via APIs and WebSockets.

  • Lead the architectural migration of legacy backend infrastructure to modern cloud-native environments on AWS, establishing high standards for system reliability and scalability.

  • Drive the refactoring and rewrite of the CTA positioning indicator calculation blocks from PHP to Python, ensuring strict mathematical output parity, comprehensive test coverage, and optimized latency.

  • Ingest and model complex financial datasets—including futures pricing, open interest, and trading volumes—across time-series stores and search engines like QuestDB and Elasticsearch.

  • Implement automated data validation, proactive alerting, and system monitoring to ensure market data feeds remain accurate, continuous, and fault-tolerant.

  • Deploy, maintain, and scale containerized services across Docker and Kubernetes environments using automated CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows.

  • Partner closely with quantitative researchers, commodity analysts, and product managers to translate complex trading models into high-performance production pipelines.

  • Provide technical mentorship to peer engineers, raising team-wide engineering rigor through thoughtful code reviews, system design guidance, and architectural documentation.


    • Experience & Background

    What you'll need (Must-haves)

  • 5+ years of professional experience building, operating, and scaling production-grade data pipelines and backend infrastructure.

  • Advanced expertise in Python, with a strong background refactoring and rewriting production-critical code for performance and testability.

  • Proven hands-on experience building and maintaining real-time or streaming API ingestion pipelines (REST, WebSockets) handling time-series datasets.

  • Solid production experience deploying and managing containerized applications on AWS using Docker, Kubernetes, and modern CI/CD practices.

  • Strong database fundamentals in SQL and experience working with distributed search or time-series databases (e.g., Elasticsearch, QuestDB, ClickHouse).

  • Deep experience establishing automated data quality frameworks, observability (monitoring/alerting), and root-cause troubleshooting for production systems.

    • Nice-to-haves

  • Domain knowledge of financial market structures, futures contracts, open interest, and commodities trading symbology.

  • Experience integrating data from major financial market vendors (e.g., Bloomberg, LSEG, Enverus, Trading Technologies).

  • Familiarity with legacy PHP codebase migration or reading PHP algorithms to translate into Python.

  • Practical familiarity with GitOps frameworks and infrastructure-as-code tooling.

About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 40 million active members to share rides across 41 countries each year. Its technology matches drivers with empty seats with passengers heading the same way, so they can share the cost of the trip.

BlaBlaCar’s mission is to be the go-to marketplace for shared travel, bringing carpooling, buses, and trains together in one place. Globally, the BlaBlaCar Group also includes Obilet, the leading online bus ticketing platform in Turkey. By partnering with over 20,000 operators, the Group offers a wide choice of affordable and sustainable transport solutions.

In 2025, the BlaBlaCar community connected 2.7 million meeting points worldwide and enabled 138 million connections between travelers. Drivers saved 568 million euros by carpooling, and all of the BlaBlaCar Group’s mobility services contributed to avoiding 4 million tonnes of CO2 emissions.


Your Mission

We are looking for a confirmed Backend Engineer to join the Booking team at BlaBlaCar. Their mission is to optimize our multimodal (Carpool, Bus, and Train supplies) booking and checkout experience for passengers, by integrating and unifying multiple heterogeneous inventory sources from external partners.

As confirmed Backend Engineer, your role will be to work on technical challenges and product feature developments from early-stage  conception, to development, testing strategy, deployment in production and monitoring. You will be working with a full-stack team of 10 developers.

  • Lead the development of our new impactful features, from the early technical design to the actual rollout

  • You have good communication skills, you’re humble and you're a team player

L’histoire de Theodo et son succès
Depuis 2009, Theodo accompagne des entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux (plateforme TF1+, applications LCL Pro et France Identité Numérique) en alliant excellence technologique et approche Lean.
 
Le Groupe fédère aujourd’hui 750 Theodoers répartis dans 3 bureaux (Paris, Londres et Rabat). En forte croissance, il a généré 100 millions d’euros de chiffre d’affaires en 2025.
 
Dans ce contexte, notre dernière enquête interne a clairement fait émerger le besoin d’une communication interne plus lisible, plus régulière et mieux organisée. Pour y répondre, nous avons mené au deuxième semestre 2026 un audit de la communication interne et formulé des orientations pour la professionnaliser : une architecture, des porte-paroles, des standards pour les rituels et les annonces, une cascade d’information, de nouveaux formats et une feuille de route pour 2027. Vous prendrez le relais de ce travail. Votre rôle sera de vous approprier ces recommandations et de les mettre en œuvre avec les dirigeants, les partners et les équipes.
 
Pour fluidifier la communication au sein de l’organisation au bénéfice de la performance Groupe, la direction générale de Theodo crée un poste de Responsable / Directeur de la communication interne.
 
Votre rôle
En tant que Responsable de la communication interne, vous êtes le concepteur et le garant du système de communication interne de Theodo : ses règles, ses outils, ses rituels, son calendrier. Vous œuvrez pour que chaque décision stratégique soit communiquée selon les modalités les plus adaptées (par qui, quand, comment). Vous accompagnez de manière transverse l’ensemble des porte-paroles Groupe pour porter les bons messages aux bons publics.
 
Homme / Femme de lien, à l’écoute des signaux faibles et apporteur d’idées pour fluidifier la communication Groupe, vous travaillez au quotidien avec le CEO Office, les fondateurs et les membres du COMEX.

  • Prise de poste : janvier 2027
  • Rattachement : Directrice de cabinet (Chief of Staff) du Directeur général (CEO Office)

  • Soutenir l’animation des rituels internes et temps forts de communication récurrents (réunions hebdomadaires et mensuelles, keynote, etc.)
  • Promouvoir les dispositifs existants et accompagner les collaborateurs à l’adoption des bonnes pratiques de communication
  • Mesurer l’efficacité des dispositifs mis en place (KPIs et évaluation)

  • Produire les documents utiles (kits, roll-out, éléments de langage, Q&A, etc.)
  • Contribuer à la cellule de crise

    • 3. Éditeur
  • Définir la ligne éditoriale et piloter le calendrier annuel de la communication interne
  • Produire les formats récurrents, superviser la production des contenus de communication interne
  • Appuyer les porte-paroles dans la préparation de leurs prises de parole

    • Profil recherché
  • Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en communication interne dans une organisation, en cabinet de conseil ou en agence
  • Aisance rédactionnelle et finesse dans l’analyse des situations
  • Méthode, rigueur et autonomie
  • Sens politique pour travailler avec différents dirigeants

Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.
 
Chez Theodo GovTech, nous accompagnons nos clients - ministères, collectivités territoriales et grands opérateurs publics - dans la conception, le développement et la maintenance de produits numériques accessibles, durables et utiles pour la société.
Rejoindre notre aventure, c'est partager une ambition commune : utiliser le numérique pour augmenter l’efficacité de l'action publique et améliorer le quotidien des agents et des usagers.

L’équipe que tu rejoins :
Sur chaque projet, tu seras intégré(e) au sein d’une équipe projet avec 1 Tech lead Developpeur, 1 à 2 Dévelopeur, 1 Associate Product Manager et 1 Lead Product Manager.
Tu seras managé(e) par Matthieu, notre CTO qui a plus de 14 ans d’expérience dans la tech.
Tu travailleras aussi avec Maxime, notre CEO, expert du secteur public.
 
Tes missions principales sont :
- Concevoir des architectures d’infrastructure adaptées à des contextes contraints (sécurité, souveraineté, performance)
- Builder et déployer des infrastructures from scratch ou en refonte
- Diffuser l’approche DevOps au cœur de l’équipe agile (rituels, cadrage, documentation)
- Challenger les choix techniques pour optimiser coûts, performance et maintenabilité
- Analyser les défauts et incidents pour renforcer la robustesse du système
- Expliquer, documenter et rendre lisibles des décisions techniques complexes
- Former l’équipe “en situation de travail” aux bonnes pratiques DevOps
 
Profil recherché
Hard skills
- 5 ans minimum d’expérience en SRE sur des environnements on-premise ou cloud privé, ou cloud souverain.
- Excellente maîtrise des concepts DevOps et web complexes
- Très bonnes bases en conteneurisation et orchestration
- Solides compétences en réseaux et systèmes Linux
- Capacité à concevoir et expliquer une architecture claire
- Exigence forte sur la qualité, la lisibilité et la maintenabilité
 
Soft skills
- Pragmatisme : créer un maximum de valeur avec les contraintes existantes
- Esprit d’équipe : la réussite collective avant l’ego
- Curiosité et envie de progresser (et de faire progresser les autres)
- Humilité : savoir demander de l’aide et challenger avec bienveillance
 
Process de recrutement
L’entretien se déroule en 5 étapes sous une dizaine de jours :
Un call de qualification (30 min)
Un entretien de culture fit (1 heure)
Un entretien théorique de connaissance infra et archi (1 heure)
Un entretien technique (1 heure)
Un final (1 heure)
Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo GovTech ?
L’environnement:

At Illuin Technology, we don't just "sell" software; we architect the AI future of the world’s largest organizations.   • Account Orchestration: Take full ownership of a targeted portfolio. You will define the strategy to expand our footprint exclusively within the Telecommunications sector.

  • Full-Cycle Execution: From cold-start qualification (MEDDIC/BANT) to complex negotiations and closing. You’ll be expertly managing all stages of the sales process.

Ingénieur DATA sénior / Senior DATA Engineer (H/F)

CDI

Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe !

Qui sommes-nous ?

EXPLORE, filiale d’INTESCIA GROUP, est un acteur leader dans le développement de solutions de data intelligence BtoB. Nous produisons des données à forte valeur ajoutée pour accompagner le développement commercial des entreprises, faciliter leurs analyses de marchés et optimiser leur connaissance clients. Nous comptons aujourd’hui plus de 1 500 clients et près de 35 000 utilisateurs dans les univers de l’Immobilier, la Construction, l’Énergie, l’Environnement et des Services à l’entreprise.

Nos atouts ?

  • Un groupe en pleine expansion, reconnu pour son expertise et ses solutions à forte valeur ajoutée.

  • Une culture d’innovation, où la créativité et l’amélioration continue sont au cœur de notre ADN.

  • Des équipes passionnées et engagées, évoluant dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif.

Votre mission :

Vous intégrerez l'équipe Data Engineer qui joue un rôle central chez Intescia : ingérer, structurer, fiabiliser et valoriser la donnée vendue aux clients. Vous intégrerez une entreprise en pleine transformation data : migration de la donnée dans Databricks.

En tant que Senior Data Engineer vous aurez un rôle clé dans la mise en place de cette transformation : conception et développement des pipelines de données, mise en place et diffusion des bonnes pratiques de développement et optimisation des performances.

Un des axes majeurs de la donnée traitée par Intescia est l’axe géographique. Vous prenez le relais de notre géomaticien qui évolue vers une autre équipe : vous avez de l’appétence et de l’expérience dans le traitement de la donnée géographique.

Vos activités :

Construire et industrialiser les pipelines de données

·         Concevoir, développer et maintenir les pipelines d'ingestion et de transformation de données.

·         Garantir la fiabilité, la fraîcheur, la qualité et la traçabilité des données produites.

·         Mettre en place le monitoring, les tests, l'alerting et la documentation associée.

Porter la migration vers Databricks

·         Contribuer activement à la conception de la cible : organisation du DataLakehouse, Unity Catalog, gouvernance, modèle de données.

·         Migrer les traitements existants et poser les standards (structuration des jobs, CI/CD, conventions, revue de code).

·         Diffuser les bonnes pratiques Spark / Delta au sein de l'équipe et accompagner sa montée en compétences.

Prendre en charge la dimension géographique

·         Industrialiser les traitements géospatiaux : géocodage, appariement d'adresses, jointures spatiales, agrégations par mailles administratives, gestion des projections et des référentiels.

·         Être le point de contact de l'équipe sur les référentiels géographiques et leurs évolutions.

Assumer un rôle de leadership technique

·         Être garant·e de la cohérence technique des solutions produites par l'équipe.

·         Animer les choix d'architecture, arbitrer et documenter les décisions.

·         Accompagner et faire monter en compétences les autres membres de l'équipe (revues de code, pair programming).

Stack technique

·         Environnement : Databricks

·         Langages : Python, SQL

·         Framework : Spark

·         Databases : ElasticSearch, Postgres

·         DevOps : Github Action (CI/CD), Docker

·         Monitoring : Grafana, Prometheus

  • La rémunération annuelle fixe sur ce poste sera entre 55K€ et 60K€ en fonction du profil que nous recruterons.

Le profil que nous recherchons :

Vos compétences :

  • L’usage de DATABRICKS sera un critère fortement apprécié

  • Capacité à porter techniquement un sujet de bout en bout et à embarquer les autres.

  • Clarté et transparence dans la communication

  • Leadership, référent au sein d'une équipe.

Expérience :

  • 5 ans et plus d'expérience en data engineering, sur des pipelines en production.

  • Très bonne maîtrise de Python et de SQL.

  • Très bonne maitrise du traitement de données distribué : Spark (PySpark).

  • Solide expérience de développement de pipelines de données sur Databricks

  • Pratique des standards d'ingénierie logicielle : Git, CI/CD, tests automatisés, revue de code, performance.

  • Expérience de l'orchestration (Airflow, Databricks Workflows ou équivalent).

  • Appétence réelle pour la donnée géographique : vous en avez déjà manipulé.

  • Compréhension des systèmes de projection (WGS84, Lambert 93) et des formats géospatiaux (GeoJSON, Shapefile, WFS etc).

  • Connaissance de PostGis (SQL Spatial) et QGIS.

Ce que nous vous offrons :

  • Situé à Carquefou, proche de Nantes, dans le cadre paisible et verdoyant du quartier de la Fleuriaye, à quelques pas de l’Erdre (Port-Jean), vous profiterez d’un cadre idéal pour allier productivité et bien-être.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Sujet de stage

Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Dans ce contexte, l’application permet aux utilisateurs d’uploader de nombreux types de fichiers (PDF, Word, images, etc) à partir de nombreuses sources.

L’objectif du stage est d’améliorer les outils présents dans l’application pour visualiser et manipuler ces documents. Ceci peut inclure :

  • Visualiser les PDF mais également d’autres types de documents (Word, images, etc) directement dans le navigateur, d’une manière scalable et sécurisée,
  • Ajouter plus d’options pour configurer la visualisation (zoom, recherche, orientation, etc),
  • Superposer le texte issu de l’OCR au document original afin de permettre à l’utilisateur de sélectionner et copier le texte,
  • Ajouter des fonctionnalités de découpage, fusion, et de changement d’ordre des pages,
  • Et d’autres fonctionnalités !

Ces fonctionnalités sont disponibles à travers toute l’expérience de Doctrine autour des documents privés, y compris dans l’Assistant, les dossiers collaboratifs, et les outils spécialisés tels Flow Litigate et Flow Counsel.

Le ou la stagiaire devra participer à la compréhension du besoin utilisateur autour de ces outils (en collaboration avec les équipes produit) et à la définition des solutions techniques (en collaboration avec les équipes techniques). Il ou elle rejoindra l’équipe Productivity, et participera également au chapter web (regroupement de tous les développeurs fullstack de l’entreprise).


Les à-côtés du poste 👁️
Le ou la stagiaire participera comme tous les ingénieurs à son chapter (réuni 2 fois par mois) dont le but est de :
  • Partager des connaissances entre ses membres (amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques)
  • Proposer des améliorations (nouveaux outils et processus)
  • Aider ses membres en fonction de leurs besoins

    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

     

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
    • Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
    • Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.

arbeitnow:data-analyst-maternity-cover-t.description:
Vestiaire Collective is the leading global online marketplace for desirable pre-loved fashion connecting millions of buyers and sellers across the world. Our mission is to transform the fashion industry for a more sustainable future by empowering our community to promote the circular fashion movement. Vestiaire was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Paris with offices in London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, Ho Chi Minh and warehouses in Tourcoing (France), Crawley (UK), Hong Kong and Brooklyn, we combine the desirability of luxury with the trust and rigour that make buying pre-loved effortless and safe.

We currently have a diverse global team of 600 employees representing more than 50 nationalities. Our values are Activism, Transparency, Dedication and Greatness and Collective.


Data Analyst - Operations

Full-time Temporary position based in Paris.

Timeline: From December 1st 2026 until June or July 2027.

About the Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst as part of the Product Team and reporting to the Data Product Lead, and working closely with the Customer Experience & Operations Products & Tech teams.

We are seeking for someone with exceptional skills in SQL and a strong emphasis on impact assessment.

You will be defining KPIs, creating dashboards and analyzing data to generate hypotheses, targets and follow up on the impact we generate for our customers and the company.

You will advocate for data driven culture, as well objective analysis over the impact of our work.

This is a full-time, Temporary role based in our Ho Chi Minh City office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure the proper definition and monitoring of the team KPIs & OKRs

  • Support Customer Experience & Operations Product managers with data analysis for specific business cases.

  • Define key user actions to be tracked to ensure we are able to analyse their behaviour and make sound decisions to improve the User Experience.

  • Conduct data querying and analysis, supporting the team in providing actionable data insights that lead to measurable impact.

  • Create reports & dashboards for communicating insights with stakeholders.

  • Work on A/B test setup and analysis to validate core hypotheses and assess the impact of product changes.

  • Manage stakeholder relationships and facilitate data-driven decision-making.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics/Business (with a data focus), Engineering, or related field.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in data & product analytics, preferably in e-commerce and operations, you adapt quickly in fast-paced environments.

  • Proficient in SQL. (Experience in Python is a plus)

  • You’re curious about AI and how it can improve your work, and keen to explore practical ways to use it in your day-to-day activities. 

  • Experienced in statistical methods and experimentation.

  • Skilled in data visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker).

  • Strong communication skills in English. 

  • A team player who is structured, detail-oriented, and thrives in a startup environment.

  • Passionate about the fashion/luxury industry.

What we offer

  • A rare chance to own two of the most important, unsolved problems at the world's leading pre-loved luxury platform — trust and desirability.

  • Proximity to our Engineering team in HCMC — ship fast, learn fast, build together.

  • The chance to shape how AI transforms authentication, fraud prevention and product imagery.

  • An international, fast-paced, mission-driven team transforming fashion toward circularity.

  • Competitive salary and bonus.

  • A meaningful job with an impact on the way people consume fashion and promote sustainability

  • Two days to help Project - reinforcing your activist journey and volunteer for an association

  • Significant investment in your learning and growth

 
 
Research indicates that people from underrepresented backgrounds—including women, people with disabilities, and other marginalized communities—often hesitate to apply for roles unless they meet every single requirement.
 
At Vestiaire Collective, we believe that talent comes in many forms, and we're committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Your unique perspective could be exactly what our team needs, so we encourage you to apply even if you don't tick every box.
 
Vestiaire Collective is an equal opportunities employer

Founded in 2005, Diabolocom is a leading European provider of AI-first, cloud-based contact centre (CCaaS) and customer experience (CX) solutions. We combine proprietary AI technology, native telecom infrastructure, and deep CRM integrations to help businesses deliver smarter, more seamless customer experiences.

Trusted by over 400 clients, we are entering a new phase of growth, scaling our technology and accelerating our international expansion, with offices in the United States, Canada, Brazil, and the United Arab Emirates.

Our ambition is to become a global technology leader by combining engineering excellence, continuous innovation, and long-term vision. At Diabolocom, you'll contribute to impactful products in a growing international company that remains agile enough for your ideas and contributions to make a real difference.

About the Role

As part of our Cross Functional Projects team, you will work on a variety of technical and business-driven projects with a direct impact on Diabolocom's operations and growth.

You'll join a hands-on team tackling important business challenges, where pragmatism, autonomy, and fast execution are key. From developing applications and internal tools to contributing to cross-functional initiatives, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, explore different technical challenges, and see your solutions make a tangible difference.

If you enjoy building high-quality software, taking initiative, and working in a dynamic environment where you can have a real impact, this role is for you.

Your Responsibilities

Software Development

Strategic Projects

Tooling & Infrastructure

About You

Your Experience & Technical Skills

Here is what you'll enjoy at Diabolocom:

arbeitnow:database-engineer-stateful-ser.title: Database Engineer (Stateful Services)
arbeitnow:database-engineer-stateful-ser.description:
Build the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI-powered customer communications.

Diabolocom is building an AI-first communication platform where AI and human agents, business workflows and communication channels work together seamlessly.
As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Database Engineer (Stateful Services) to help build and operate the infrastructure foundation behind the platform.
This is a unique opportunity to work on an infrastructure environment combining carrier-grade voice systems, on-premise data centers, distributed systems and AI workloads, while helping us build the reliability and operational maturity required to support 3x growth.
You will report to the newly forming Stateful Services Lead and work closely with Engineering, SRE and Infrastructure teams to improve the reliability, scalability and evolution of our stateful systems.

Your mission

Your goal is to build, operate and improve Diabolocom’s stateful services, with a strong focus on databases and data stores.
You will help ensure that our databases and stateful systems remain highly available, reliable and performant, while evolving our infrastructure so that maintenance, upgrades and scaling can be performed safely and with minimal to no downtime.
Working closely with the Stateful Services Lead, you will take ownership of specific technical projects and contribute to the evolution of our stateful infrastructure.

You will:

  • Operate and maintain our stateful services, including PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, RabbitMQ and Kafka/Redpanda.
  • Contribute to the design, evolution and scaling of our database infrastructure, with 50+ PostgreSQL clusters and increasingly complex data workloads.
  • Work on projects aimed at making database maintenance, upgrades and migrations safer and less disruptive to our services.
  • Improve high availability, replication, failover, backup/restore and disaster recovery across our stateful systems.
  • Contribute to rebuilding our PostgreSQL clusters to support automatic failover between data centers and reduce the impact of maintenance operations.
  • Help improving our queueing infrastructure, including projects such as quorum-based RabbitMQ.
  • Help building and maintaining stable Redis infrastructure and improve the reliability of our stateful services.
  • Investigate and solve complex performance, scalability and reliability issues across databases and distributed systems.
  • Work closely with development teams to understand their needs, support their use of databases and help them build reliable solutions.
  • Collaborate with SRE, networking and infrastructure teams to ensure that our stateful services operate reliably within our broader infrastructure.
  • Contribute to monitoring, automation and operational practices that make our infrastructure easier and safer to operate.
  • Participate in our on-call and incident management rotation, helping diagnose and resolve production issues when needed.
  • Stay hands-on and close to the technology: you will be expected to understand how our systems work, how they fail and how to improve them.

Who we are looking for

We’re looking for a technically strong and hands-on Database Engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems and taking ownership of production systems where reliability really matters.
You have experience operating databases or stateful services in production and understand that running these systems is about much more than simply maintaining them. You know how to troubleshoot them, how they behave under load, how they fail, and how to make them more reliable as they scale.
You’ll work on specific technical projects defined with the Stateful Services Lead, while having the autonomy to investigate problems, propose solutions and contribute to technical decisions.
We care more about your technical depth, curiosity and ability to take ownership than the exact number of years of experience you have.

Must Have

  • Strong hands-on experience as a DBA, Database Engineer, SRE or similar, with solid experience in PostgreSQL.
  • Experience operating and maintaining production databases, including upgrades, migrations, replication, backups, recovery, monitoring and performance troubleshooting.
  • Good understanding of high availability and reliability for stateful systems: failover, redundancy, replication, disaster recovery and minimising downtime during maintenance.
  • Good understanding of distributed systems, including replication, consistency, fault tolerance and the challenges of operating stateful services at scale.
  • Experience working with on-premise infrastructure or a willingness and ability to quickly adapt to an on-premise/bare-metal environment.
  • Good system design skills and the ability to reason about scalability, reliability and performance.
  • Experience collaborating closely with software development teams, understanding their requirements and helping them build reliable solutions around databases and stateful services.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex production issues.
  • Strong hands-on mindset: you enjoy getting into the technical details and solving problems yourself.
  • Comfortable participating in on-call and incident management.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. French or other languages are a plus.

Nice to Have

Experience with some of the following:
  • ClickHouse or another complex database/data platform.
  • Kafka or Redpanda and event-streaming infrastructure.
  • RabbitMQ, particularly quorum-based configurations.
  • Redis and distributed caching.
  • Other database technologies such as Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, MySQL, Cassandra or MongoDB.
  • Advanced Linux systems administration, including processes, storage, networking and troubleshooting.
  • Bare-metal infrastructure and data-center environments.
  • Observability and monitoring of stateful systems.
  • Capacity planning, performance analysis and load testing.
  • Infrastructure automation and configuration management.
  • Incident management, root-cause analysis and post-mortem practices.

About You

  • You take ownership. When you see a reliability or scalability problem, you investigate it and work towards a solution.
  • You are genuinely technical. You like understanding how things work under the hood and are comfortable diving deep when something breaks.
  • You think in systems. You understand that databases don't operate in isolation and enjoy working across infrastructure, networking, SRE and development teams.
  • You care about reliability. You want systems that can be maintained, upgraded and scaled without putting the business at risk.
  • You are pragmatic. You can make sensible technical trade-offs in complex environments.
  • You are curious and self-driven. You learn by doing, investigate unfamiliar technologies and are comfortable figuring things out independently.
  • You enjoy solving complex problems. You like working on systems where there isn't always an obvious answer.
  • You communicate clearly. You can explain technical topics and work effectively with the teams relying on your services.
  • You are comfortable taking responsibility. You don't need to be a manager to have an impact or take the lead on a technical problem.

Why join us

  • Own critical infrastructure: your work will directly impact the reliability and scalability of Diabolocom’s platform.
  • Solve complex technical challenges: work with large-scale databases and stateful services, including PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, Redis and RabbitMQ.
  • Work on real infrastructure challenges: help improve PostgreSQL clusters, cross-data-center failover, RabbitMQ and Redis reliability.
  • Stay hands-on: spend your time solving challenging technical problems rather than managing people.
  • Learn and grow: work across databases, distributed systems, messaging and infrastructure in a diverse technical environment.
  • Work across teams: collaborate closely with Engineering, SRE and Infrastructure to build reliable systems at scale.

Recruitment Process

  1. Introductory call with Talent Acquisition (1h)
  2. Interview with Sergey, our CTO (1h)
  3. On-site System Design interview with Sergey (1h)
    Work through a technical case study and explore your system design approach.
  4. Cultural fit interview with the Team (1h)

Logistics

📍 Paris, rue de la Paix, 75002
🏢 Hybrid model: 3 days onsite / 2 days remote
💻 Equipment: choose your preferred setup (Mac/Linux + monitors)
🍽  Lunch vouchers
🚇 Navigo: 50% of the monthly pass reimbursed

One More Thing

We are not necessarily looking for someone who has already worked in this exact role or with every technology in our stack.
The strongest candidates are often engineers who have built and operated complex infrastructure, taken ownership of production systems and learned new technologies along the way.
If you enjoy solving difficult technical problems, want to work close to the infrastructure and are excited by the challenge of making stateful systems more reliable and scalable — we would love to talk.

As part of our hiring process, please note that any employment offer or service provider offer will be subject to a background check, including verification of your identity, educational credentials, and previous employment history.

arbeitnow:architecte-logiciel-senior-kub.description:
La mission en bref

  • Durée — 6 mois.

  • Démarrage — Dès que possible.

  • Localisation — Saint-Denis ou Cesson-Sévigné.

  • Présence sur site — Au moins 3 jours par semaine.

Contexte de la mission

Pour le compte d’un opérateur télécom, ImaginePartners recherche un architecte logiciel senior pour intervenir sur un programme de cloud souverain. Vous définirez l’architecture logicielle commune aux équipes qui automatisent le déploiement et l’exploitation des services réseau, bare metal et stockage de la plateforme.

Vos missions

  • Définir l’architecture de référence des opérateurs Kubernetes. Concevoir les API déclaratives, les ressources personnalisées (CRD), les contrôleurs et les boucles de réconciliation qui automatisent le cycle de vie des composants d’infrastructure.

  • Harmoniser les pratiques de développement Go. Définir les conventions de code, la stratégie de tests automatisés et les pratiques de revue de code. Identifier les composants que plusieurs équipes peuvent réutiliser.

  • Concevoir l’architecture cible du réseau Kubernetes. Étudier l’intégration de solutions CNI telles que Cilium, Calico ou OVN-Kubernetes, définir les politiques réseau et assurer la cohérence entre le réseau des clusters et l’infrastructure sous-jacente.

  • Accompagner les équipes dans leurs choix d’architecture. Animer les revues techniques, évaluer les options et formaliser les décisions communes. Suivre leur mise en œuvre et les actions de réduction de la dette technique.

Livrables attendus

  • Architecture de référence des opérateurs Kubernetes et catalogue des modèles de conception communs.

  • Dossiers d’architecture et spécifications d’ingénierie, notamment les contrats d’API, les schémas de CRD et les interfaces entre équipes.

  • Guide de développement Go couvrant les tests, la sécurité du code et les revues.

  • Architecture cible d’intégration des CNI, modèles de politiques réseau et registre des décisions d’architecture.

Profil recherché

Vous avez au moins 10 ans d’expérience en ingénierie logicielle ou DevOps cloud-native, une formation d’ingénieur ou un Bac+5 en informatique, et une expérience d’architecte transverse ou de référent technique auprès de plusieurs équipes.

  • Opérateurs Kubernetes — Expérience démontrable de la conception et du développement d’opérateurs, de la modélisation des CRD à la gestion de la réconciliation. Pratique de Kubebuilder, Operator SDK ou controller-runtime.

  • Go appliqué à l’infrastructure — Expérience du développement de composants système ou d’automatisation en Go, avec une pratique des tests automatisés, de la revue de code et de la CI/CD.

  • Réseau cloud-native — Expérience de l’intégration de CNI et de la mise en œuvre de politiques réseau Kubernetes. Solides bases en routage, notamment BGP, en segmentation et en architectures overlay/underlay.

Le français est la langue de travail et l’anglais courant est attendu. Une expérience chez un opérateur télécom ou un fournisseur cloud, des contributions open source, la pratique de Crossplane ou de GitOps et la connaissance de SecNumCloud ou de NIS2 sont des atouts.

Candidature

Merci de nous transmettre les éléments suivants :

  • Votre CV.

  • Votre date de disponibilité.

  • Votre TJM HT.

  • Votre statut (société, portage salarial, etc.).

  • Le ou les sites sur lesquels vous pouvez intervenir (Saint-Denis ou Cesson-Sévigné).

  • Un exemple de réalisation sur des opérateurs Kubernetes en Go, en précisant votre rôle.

  • Un exemple de projet d’intégration réseau Kubernetes, en précisant votre rôle.

Tu travailles directement avec le fondateur, sur trois chantiers :

1) Les dossiers d'investissement : analyse, préparation du comité, suivi jusqu'à la signature chez le notaire.

2) L'IA en production : tu fais évoluer nos agents et automatisations (n8n, Claude, Zoho).

Profil : Bac+4/5 en école de commerce, d'ingénieur ou à l'université. Rigoureux, à l'aise avec l'IA. Maîtrise parfaite du français : tu échanges chaque jour au téléphone avec des propriétaires de toute la France.

Stage conventionné de 6 mois, début dès décembre 2026 ou en janvier 2027, gratification de 1 000 à 1 500 € par mois selon profil, possibilité d'embauche à l'issue, sur site à Neuilly-sur-Seine.

arbeitnow:account-development-representa.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

Hi there! We're hiring a French-speaking ADR I to join our Account Development team at Camunda.

We're a tight-knit, energetic team that takes outbound seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. We run structured prospecting motions, share what's working in real time, celebrate the wins together, and still allow for flexibility in the way we operate because booking a good meeting takes real work and progressing an opportunity puts ADRs at the forefront of a great GTM motion.

This is a strong entry point into tech sales for someone who wants to learn and refine the fundamentals of prospecting, discovery, and pipeline generation inside an enterprise software motion. You'll work directly with Account Executives but will also be responsible for prospecting into your own patch. We ask that all of our ADRs have a remote environment that is conducive to consistent weekly motions and to be able to travel 4-6 times per year, usually a week or less at a time.

As an ADR I, you'll run long-term outbound and timely inbound prospecting motions to generate qualified pipeline for our sales team. Working emails, sales cadences, social outreach and most importantly calls to get in front of the right people at the right accounts at the right time. This role exists because a sustainable pipeline is built through persistence, consistency, a growth mindset and an ability to diagnose challenges and bring solutions within your own prospecting motion.

What you will do:

  • Generate qualified pipeline by running outbound prospecting across email, phone, event outreach and attendance and LinkedIn into target accounts.

  • Qualify inbound interest through ADR-led scheduled calls and convert into booked meetings for Account Executives.

  • Research accounts, personas and signals to tailor and leverage AI for high touch low impact motions.

  • Partner with Account Executives to understand what constitutes a quality meeting, contact and account, and adjust your approach based on feedback.

  • Exhibit excellent operational hygiene by tracking activity and pipeline health in Salesforce and other sales tools to monitor your own inputs and performance.

  • Learn Camunda's product and value propositions and the process orchestration space well enough to have credible, useful conversations with prospects in specific verticals.

What you bring:

  • Fluency in French

  • Some experience with outbound prospecting or customer-facing communication is preferred. This doesn't have to be in sales. Internships, retail, hospitality, or customer support all count if you know how to build rapport with people, manage expectations and handle rejection.

  • Comfort with strict time management and prioritization of requests. You'll be conducting a lot of calls and emails, and you're motivated by the math of it. You will also be given regular enablement and will be responsible for monitoring multiple sources of leads.

  • Curiosity about technology and a willingness to learn a technical product. You don't need an engineering background, but you need to be genuinely interested in understanding what Camunda does and why it matters to the people you're calling. You share successes.

  • Resilience and self-awareness. You know how to keep going without getting discouraged, and you can tell the difference between a bad day and a bad approach.

  • Coachability. You take feedback from your manager and AEs seriously and change your approach in a timely and meaningful way based on it.

  • Cross-functional relationships. You have a curiosity as to how things work and which individuals you can support and thus that can support you. You ask questions and challenge the status quo if you’ve experienced a better solution.

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

This role is an existing vacancy

#LI-JS1 #LI-Remote #France

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • United States: $91,000.00 to $181,700.00

  • United Kingdom: £57,200.00 to £116,400.00

  • Singapore: S$113,100.00 to S$209,900.00

  • France: €58,800.00 to €120,500

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. arbeitnow:managing-director-france-paris.description:
Location: France

Type: Full-time | Hybrid-flexible | Based near one of our portfolio company locations

Note: This is an ongoing opportunity for future Managing Directors across the Everfield ecosystem. As we continue to grow our portfolio, we are proactively engaging with candidates who have the leadership experience and operational expertise to step into Managing Director roles within our vertical market software companies.

About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe’s software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices while focusing on what they do best, building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics.

Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 10 countries, and growing.

The Role

As Managing Director (MD), you will lead one of Everfield’s portfolio companies and assume full ownership of its strategy, execution, and performance. This role is designed for operationally strong leaders with deep experience in software businesses who are ready to take end-to-end responsibility for a growing company.

You will work closely with Everfield’s central teams but operate independently, with the autonomy to shape the future of the business. This role is especially suited to individuals with prior experience running software companies in a standalone or platform model, particularly in the €2M–€10M recurring revenue range.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Vision & Growth

  • Define and execute long-term strategy, aligned with scalable growth

  • Identify new market opportunities, product innovations, and partnerships

  • Monitor competitive trends to position the business effectively

Leadership & Influence

  • Lead, develop, and retain high-performing cross-functional teams

  • Inspire cultural alignment and ownership across the organization

  • Champion team effectiveness and collaboration while serving as a coach and decision-maker

Financial Acumen

  • Lead financial planning, forecasting, and reporting

  • Manage full P&L and own key performance metrics (EBITDA, ARR, MRR)

  • Drive revenue growth and cost optimization to achieve financial targets

Commercial Execution

  • Shape the go-to-market model, including sales, marketing, and pricing

  • Establish clear KPIs and performance systems to track revenue and funnel efficiency

  • Drive customer retention and recurring revenue growth

Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Represent the company externally and internally with investors, partners, and customers

  • Report to Everfield’s central team with strategic and financial updates

  • Serve as the face of the business while cultivating lasting external relationships

Operational Excellence

  • Continuously improve internal operations, product delivery, and support

  • Implement systems and processes for scalable growth

  • Drive a culture of operational discipline and innovation

Candidate Profile

We are especially interested in individuals with:

  • Prior experience as a Managing Director, General Manager, or CEO in a B2B software or SaaS environment

  • Proven success leading a business with €2M–€10M in recurring revenue

  • Full accountability for business performance, including P&L, headcount, and strategy

  • Familiarity with multi-site or multi-entity software company structures

  • Experience operating within decentralised models or working with shared-service or platform support functions

  • A hands-on leadership style, grounded in operational excellence, clear communication, and cultural stewardship

  • Must be fully proficient (C1-C2) in English and French, both written and oral.

Who Should Apply

We welcome interest from experienced software leaders who understand the dynamics of buy-and-hold environments and portfolio-driven growth—particularly those who have thrived in aggregator, accumulator, or roll-up software organizations.

While we review each application carefully, we are currently focused on candidates who bring:

  • First-hand experience scaling vertical or niche software businesses

  • Familiarity with decentralized ownership and platform-based acquisition models

  • A desire to take full accountability for a business and build for the long term

If this context resonates and your experience aligns, we’d love to hear from you.

What We Offer

  • Impact: Lead and grow a business with full strategic and operational ownership

  • Support: Access to Everfield’s network of functional experts and peers

  • Growth: Potential to take on broader leadership within Everfield over time

  • Community: Be part of a long-term, values-driven ecosystem of software entrepreneurs

  • Flexibility: Hybrid working across key European markets with in-person collaboration

Note on Timing

While we may not have an immediate opening in your geography or vertical, we maintain a high-touch pipeline of senior candidates aligned with our investment roadmap.

Candidates with the experience outlined above will be contacted for follow-up discussions.

We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision are made on the basis of skills, qualifications and experiences.

arbeitnow:propulsion-data-modeling-engin.title: Propulsion Data & Modeling Engineer
arbeitnow:propulsion-data-modeling-engin.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

The heart of a spacecraft lies in its propulsion system, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours.

We want you as a talented Propulsion Functional Systems Engineer to contribute to the development, testing, analysis, prediction and refinement of the functional architecture for Nyx Earth Propulsion System Development Models.

In order to derisk and gain confidence on the flight propulsion system, different development models are being built in order to run a multitude of tests spanning from functional tests, cold flows to system level hot fires. This testing will allow for the verification and validation of all the propulsion subsystems. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between design and hardware testing for the Nyx spacecraft propulsion system. As such, you will work closely with both the design and testing teams to ensure seamless integration and validation of propulsion subsystems.

You will report to the Propulsion Development Models Principal Engineer.

Key responsibilities:

In your capacity as a Propulsion Functional Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for the development of analysis, post processing, and prediction tools that can support testing and design activities linked to the propulsion sub-systems.

Your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day responsibilities will include:

During the Design Phase:

  • Work closely with the pressure and feed system engineers to define the best configuration of the test setups, ensuring a high level of representativeness and testability to conduct all fluid modelling and analyses to verify repeatability of the test rigs with the flight systems and to perform test predictions.

  • Support on the creation of test plans for propulsion subsystems (from a modeling perspective), including data acquisition, analysis, and reporting to ensure the performance of the system can be assessed.

  • Design and develop propulsion analysis and post processing tools, to support testing activities and design maturation

  • Work in close collaboration with the pressure and feed system engineers to ensure the anchoring of the different fluidic models and assess against test data

During testing phase:

  • Provide on-site support during propulsion test campaigns, working closely with the test operator and test conductor.

  • Perform test campaigns, analysing in real-time, through different test parameters and ensure test results with timely resolution of any anomaly arising during testing.

  • Conduct pre-test and post-test reviews and elaborate the test reports.

  • Update and correlate the fluidic models based on test results.

  • Provide actionable insights to identify key performance indicators and potential critical scenarios

What we would love to see from you:

  • A minimum of a bachelor's degree in a related Engineering discipline.

  • +3 years of related experience in complex fluid systems, fluidic modeling, data analysis and data post processing.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals in thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, and combustion principles.

  • Familiarity with test facilities, or storable propulsion systems is an asset

  • Experience in propulsion systems storable or cryogenic fluidic systems is a plus.

  • Proficiency in python for fluid analyses, data post processing and model anchoring.

  • Experience in EcosimPro (or similar software) for the high fidelity analysis of numerical twins.

  • Proficiency in conducting fluid analyses using classical hand calculations

  • Excellent collaboration skills for working effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

  • Fluency in English.

Skills and Behaviours:

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.

  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks.

  • Strong team player with a proactive mindset.

  • Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done.

  • Ability to communicate at all levels of the business.

  • Demonstrates behaviours consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork.

  • Space enthusiast, ready to change the European space industry.

  • Nice to have, Ecosim experience

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

arbeitnow:propulsion-gse-team-leader-bor.title: Propulsion GSE Team Leader
arbeitnow:propulsion-gse-team-leader-bor.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.


We are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We are seeking an experienced and talented Propulsion Ground Support Equipment Team Leader, to lead the development, commissioning and operation of our engine test benches that we use to test our cryogenic engines and storable thrusters.

This is a key leadership role that requires technical expertise in liquid-propellant propulsion systems, a strong track record in managing complex engineering projects, and proven experience in leading and mentoring technical teams. The GSE Team Leader role for Liquid Propulsion Testing drives the end-to-end lifecycle – from initial concept and fluid/structural design to fabrication, commissioning, and operation – of critical ground infrastructure supporting liquid propellant rocket engine test campaigns.

As the GSE Team Leader, you will oversee the design, development and building of propulsion test facility. The primary objective is to develop and maintain robust, high-reliability test bench GSE that meets ambitious program cadences while ensuring absolute safety in hazardous operating environments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the engineering development of new test facility GSE, including high-pressure gas distribution systems, propellant feed systems, electrical network, control and data acquisition system, mechanical structures, etc.

  • Translate test matrix requirements into hardware specifications, master P&IDs, and fluid system architectures

  • Manage a cross-functional team of mechanical, fluid, and instrumentation engineers and technicians

  • Direct resource allocation across multiple test benches, manage development schedules, and ensure alignment between propulsion design teams and facility operations

  • Oversee the structural fabrication, tube bending, welding, and mechanical assembly of GSE lines, panels, and thrust measurement structures

  • Lead high-pressure proof testing, leak checks, and system commissioning/decommissioning phases

  • Establish protocols for handling hazardous fluids (both cryogenic and storable propellants)

  • Enforce strict compliance with oxygen compatibility, system passivation, and precision cleanliness levels

  • Manage data acquisition and control systems (DAQ/DCS) engineers and technicians to integrate sensors (pressure transducers, thermocouples, flow meters) and remote-actuated valves into the GSE infrastructure for automated test sequences and redline monitoring

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary

We are looking for an Anti-Corruption & Trade Compliance Legal Counsel to play a central role in the building, development and operation of Mistral AI's corporate compliance framework, with a particular focus on anti-corruption, economic sanctions and export controls.

Reporting to the Lead Anti-Corruption & Trade Compliance, the position offers genuine build-from-scratch ownership of core policies, processes and tools. It combines programme development, day-to-day compliance operations and cross-functional advisory work.

The role involves close collaboration with Legal, Finance, Procurement, Sales, Security, and Product and Engineering to translate legal requirements into clear, proportionate and auditable processes.

Key responsibilities

Anti-corruption/Sapin II

  • Coordinate Sapin II Action Plan deployment of relevant policies, controls, training and third-party procedure.

  • Lead the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of risk-based due diligence from integrity screening through enhanced diligence and periodic review;

  • Support the implementation and periodic review of the code of conduct, related policies, whistleblowing framework and training programme,

  • Administer the gifts, hospitality and conflicts-of-interest processes, including reviewing requests and declarations, maintaining the relevant records and registers, and providing practical guidance to business teams.

  • Work with Finance and Internal Control to define and monitor risk-based anti-corruption accounting controls.

  • Contribute to the monitoring and periodic assessment of the anti-corruption programme, including programme records, metrics and reporting; monitor relevant regulatory and enforcement developments; and support anti-corruption incidents, internal reviews and investigations.

Economic sanctions and export controls

  • Manage screening for new and existing counterparties as part of third-party due diligence and transaction-review processes.

  • Support the Lead Anti-Corruption and Trade Compliance in export control classification of AI models, software, technology, compute infrastructure and hardware.

  • Work with Procurement, Operations, Product and Engineering to embed screening and access-control requirements into onboarding, contracting and deployment processes, and maintain clear, auditable records and internal guidance.

  • Develop and maintain standard sanctions and export-control contractual positions and clauses, and support their review and negotiation in customer, supplier, partner and reseller agreements.

  • Monitor relevant regulatory and enforcement developments; coordinate external counsel and advisers; contribute to programme reporting for Legal leadership.

Qualifications and skills

  • Legal Master degree (Master’s in Business Law, Corporate Law, Compliance, or equivalent). Compliance certifications are also an asset.

  • A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in a company, law firm, consulting firm or regulatory authority.

  • Substantive exposure to at least two of the following areas: anti-corruption and Sapin II, economic sanctions, and export controls.

  • Experience in the technology or AI sector is a plus (understanding of data, semiconductors, or dual-use goods), as well as knowledge and understanding of artificial intelligence.

  • Analytical and problem solving skills: Candidates should be able to analyze complex topics and have strong problem-solving skills, and be able to dig into internal systems.

  • Pedagogy: Excellent written and verbal communication; strong ability to communicate legal advice to clients and colleagues, and presenting complex legal concepts in a clear and understandable manner.

  • International mindset: International experience is a plus.

  • Adaptability: Given the rapidly evolving nature of AI technologies and compute topics, and the legal landscape surrounding them, candidates should be adaptable and willing to continuously learn and update their skills and knowledge.

  • Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.

  • Ethical Awareness: Ability to promote an ethical and responsible culture.
