Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Payroll Analyst to join our Global Payroll team and play a key role in the delivery and continuous improvement of payroll across our international markets.

This is a senior operational role with responsibility for overseeing payroll activity across multiple countries. You will bring strong payroll expertise, sound judgement and a proactive approach to ensure employees are paid accurately, on time and in compliance with local legislation.

Working closely with the Payroll Team, internal HR and People teams, Finance, Tax and external payroll providers, you will take ownership of complex payroll activities, provide subject-matter expertise and act as a key escalation point for payroll issues.

The role will also provide opportunities to support international payroll projects, process improvements, system implementations and automation, helping Deliveroo build a scalable and efficient global payroll operation.

What you'll be doing

  • Take ownership of the end-to-end payroll delivery for assigned international entities.
  • Partner with local HR, People Operations, Finance and Tax teams to ensure payroll inputs are complete, accurate and delivered within agreed timelines.
  • Review, validate and approve payroll inputs and outputs, identifying discrepancies, trends and potential risks before payroll is finalised.
  • Apply a strong understanding of legislation across multiple jurisdictions, statutory requirements and payroll practices, ensuring processes remain compliant and appropriately controlled.
  • Work closely with external payroll providers, holding them accountable for accuracy, timeliness, compliance and service delivery.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for complex employee and stakeholder payroll queries, providing clear guidance and appropriate resolutions.
  • Perform and oversee payroll reconciliations, payment validation and statutory submissions, ensuring appropriate controls are completed and documented.
  • Analyse payroll data and reporting to identify anomalies, control weaknesses, recurring issues and opportunities for improvement.
  • Maintain strong payroll governance and documentation, ensuring processes, controls and procedures are consistently followed.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate payroll processes, reducing manual intervention and operational risk.
  • Support and lead payroll-related projects, including system implementations, payroll migrations, integrations, process changes and new entity onboarding.
  • Partner with Technology and payroll vendors to troubleshoot system and integration issues and support effective resolution.
  • Contribute to the development of payroll policies, procedures, controls and best practices across international markets.
  • Share knowledge and provide guidance to Payroll Analysts and other team members, helping to build capability and consistency across the wider team.
  • Stay up to date with changes to payroll legislation and communicate relevant impacts to internal stakeholders and payroll providers.
  • Support the Payroll Lead with wider global payroll initiatives and deputise where required.

What you'll bring

  • Significant experience working in a payroll analyst or senior payroll position, ideally within a complex, international organisation.
  • Strong hands-on experience of international payroll, with experience of Italy and/or France payroll highly desirable.
  • Good working knowledge of Italian and/or French payroll legislation, statutory requirements and payroll processes is preferable.

About ExTrac

ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.

Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai.


The Role

Location: Hybrid (in-office in London, 2-3 days per week)

This is ExTrac's first Talent Enablement hire and as a founding member of the Talent Function you will run full-cycle recruiting across Engineering, Growth and Research & Analysis, but the deeper brief is to build the systems, tools and hiring-manager capability that let ExTrac scale with a lean talent team. Reporting to the Director of People & Talent, you will own Ashby, the data behind our hiring decisions, and the sourcing and assessment tools hiring managers use, while coaching those hiring managers to run strong searches with less of your direct involvement over time. We're looking for someone who wants to build something that outlasts their own day-to-day effort, not just fill requisitions.


What the job involves

Talent Acquisition, Hiring manager enablement and sourcing strategy

  • Run full-cycle, generalist recruiting across Engineering, Growth and Research & Analysis (and other functions as needed).

  • Design and roll out sourcing strategies that hiring teams can run themselves, rather than owning sourcing for every role personally.

  • Coach and upskill hiring managers and interviewers so strong hiring practice lives in the teams doing the hiring, not solely with you.

  • Act as the trusted business partner hiring managers bring hard calls to: who to hire, how to structure a search, when a role isn't working as scoped.

Systems, AI-augmented infrastructure and data driven decision-making

  • Own and continuously improve ExTrac's use of Ashby, reducing friction in the hiring process for candidates, hiring managers and interviewers.

  • Use AI to analyse and calibrate hiring data into insights that drive a recruitment project roadmap grounded in evidence, backed by a clear hypothesis of what needs to change, while keeping hiring decisions with the humans making them, never handed to AI.

  • Build internal talent products, such as process design tools, assessment tools, and hiring manager and interviewer training, so quality hiring practice doesn't need to be rebuilt from scratch for every open role.

  • Build the clean, consistent data foundations that make hiring decisions and reporting trustworthy.

  • Use data to identify where the hiring process is working, where it isn't, and what to fix next.

Assessment design

  • Design assessment strategies that get at candidates' real capability, not just what they can produce with AI assistance, refreshing methods as the ways candidates use AI evolve.

Talent Partnership and Operations

  • Support and constructively challenge hiring managers on workforce planning, org design and capability mapping decisions.

  • When active recruitment isn't at peak, shift into longer-term work: capability mapping, org design support, and building future talent pools and long-term candidate relationships.

  • Flex into adjacent People Operations work when the business needs it, including onboarding support and administering equity paperwork and employment contracts.

You should apply if

  • You have a proven track record as a business partner or stakeholder manager, not just a candidate-pipeline builder: you've built trust with hiring managers and driven outcomes by working through them, not around them.

  • You're a generalist by inclination as well as necessity: you're equally comfortable partnering on a technical engineering search, a commercial hire and a research or analyst role, rather than being deep in one domain and shallow in the rest.

  • You've genuinely used AI to build agents, automations or workflows, whether in a professional recruiting context or in your own life, and you're energised by using it to change how hiring works here, not just to speed up admin.

  • You are comfortable working in a lean team at all levels of scope - from partnering with executives through to basic recruitment coordination.

  • A background as a sourcer is genuinely welcome here; this role is as much about what you can build and who you can influence, as the specific lived experience.

  • You're based in or able to commute into our London office 2-3 days a week to build the in-person relationships this role depends on.

Where this role can take you

  • Gain experience driving significant change management around how we market and assess candidates in the new AI influenced shift towards assessing competency not just technical skills.

  • This role presents an opportunity to grow into a Lead Talent Partner: fuller ownership of the AI-driven recruiting infrastructure and the recruitment roadmap, with recognised authority as the systems owner behind ExTrac's hiring.

  • Partner with colleagues across the business on workforce planning, org design and global geo location strategies.

  • Shape how AI is used in hiring and assessment across ExTrac, on a topic most companies are still improvising on.

Requirements

  • A proven track record of business partnering or stakeholder management in a recruiting, talent or adjacent context, with specific examples of driving outcomes by influencing hiring managers and interviewers rather than owning delivery alone.

  • Full-cycle recruiting experience across more than one function or domain (for example technical, commercial, research or analytical), reflecting genuine generalist range rather than single-domain depth.

  • Experience designing candidate assessments, particularly ones built to withstand AI-assisted candidate output.

  • Hands-on experience administering and improving an ATS (Ashby or a comparable platform), including reducing process friction for candidates and hiring teams.

  • Demonstrated, genuine use of AI tools to build workflows, agents or automations, in a professional or personal capacity, with a clear point of view on how AI should and shouldn't be used in hiring decisions.

  • Based in or able to commute to ExTrac's London office 2-3 days per week.

Desirable

  • Experience across both UK and US talent markets.

  • Prior experience as a sourcer.

  • Experience in a small or lean People or Talent team where the role required covering adjacent work such as onboarding, equity administration or contracts.

  • Experience working in a security-conscious environment serving government, defence and intelligence-adjacent clients.

Interview Process

  • Initial screening interview with Director of People & Talent – 30 minutes

  • Business-partnering scenario & Competency based interviews – 2 x 45 minutes

  • Final Leadership Interview – 30-45 minutes

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on skills and experience.

  • A benefits package, including Private Medical Health Insurance and enhanced pension contributions.

  • Enhanced parental leave and a workplace nursery scheme.

  • £500/year education budget with additional items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

  • 33 days of leave across the year inclusive of bank holidays.

  • Flexible working, hybrid: 2-3 days per week in our central London office.

About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

As Senior Finance Business Analyst/Senior Accountant, you will be a strategic member of our Controllership team based in Barcelona. This role sits under the Finance Department and you will be able to apply both your accounting and analysis skills. You will be part of the Trade Team, with whom you will be responsible for reconciling sales and purchases between backend data and the ERP, calculating and verifying the commissions and fees, and reconciling and invoicing supplier monthly data, among other adhoc projects. This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment and enjoys turning data into strategy.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Perform monthly reconciliations between the operational back-end systems and the accounting ERP (NetSuite) to ensure completeness and accuracy of revenue and COGS.

  • Prepare, review and post monthly journal entries, including revenue and COGS accruals, reclassifications and other accounting adjustments, ensuring accuracy, completeness and compliance with applicable accounting policies.

  • Perform monthly flux analysis across revenue, COGS and relevant balance sheet accounts, investigating significant movements against prior periods, identifying underlying business drivers and providing clear explanations for variances.

  • Investigate discrepancies and coordinate with relevant stakeholders (Strategic Finance, Supplier Relationship, Product) to ensure timely resolution.

  • Calculate and review the commissions received from the assigned verticals, and dispute differences if any.

  • Ensure that suppliers within assigned verticals are properly reconciled in NetSuite and that their aging reports are clean and accurate, analyzing open items and clearing accounts and proposing the right treatment for each.

  • Calculate and review the commissions received from the assigned verticals, and dispute differences if any, working with Supplier Relationship on the conversation with the supplier.

  • Read and interpret supplier and partner contracts to understand how commission and fee terms work, including variable elements, and check that they are reflected correctly in the calculations and data.

  • Support external audits, including preparing workpapers and responding to inquiries.

  • Turn recurring findings into insight and recommendations for Strategic Finance, Supplier Relationship and Product.

  • Identify automation and systems optimization opportunities in the order-to-cash and procure-to-pay cycles, replacing manual reconciliation steps with repeatable checks.

  • Participate in process improvement and optimization projects across the accounting function.

 
 

What We’re Looking For

  • Extensive experience in Financial Business Analytics (Audit, Accounting, Controllership).

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (Master’s or CPA/ACCA a plus).

  • Solid understanding of revenue recognition principles and financial accounting, preferably under US GAAP or IFRS.

  • Proven experience analysing revenue, COGS and gross margin performance, identifying trends and investigating variances between financial and operational data.

  • Ability to interpret commercial agreements and supplier contracts, understanding their financial and accounting implications.

  • Comfortable working in fast-paced startup or scale-up environments, with the ability to adapt quickly and prioritize effectively.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills—you can explain complex ideas in simple terms to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • High business acumen and strategic thinking—you're not just delivering data, you're driving decisions.

  • Experience with ERP systems - NetSuite is a plus.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets skills.

  • Proactive, hands-on attitude with the ability to work independently.

  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Tech awareness - active interest in technology and automation. We constantly strive to improve and automate our policies so that we operate world class processes.

  • Excellent team player


What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk.

  • Rest and recharge with our generous allocation of vacation days plus public holidays.

  • Take control of your physical health with your choice of private healthcare or a gym allowance.

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen.

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party.

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Make your money go further with our flexible compensation plan.

  • Focus on your family with 17 weeks’ paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes.

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year.

  • Nurture your language skills with real-life English, Spanish, and Catalan lessons.

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support.

Interview Process

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

Location: Any MSF office*

*By default, the successful candidate will be offered a contract in the MSF office, able to issue a contract, of their country of residence at the time of application. If no MSF office exists in their country of residence, the successful candidate will be expected to relocate to a country where an MSF office can issue a contract, provided the local legislation allows for that.

At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. The successful candidate will be expected to comply with the organisation’s safeguarding policies and standards of professional behaviour.

We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process.

MSF International

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 26 sections, 28 associations and 16 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested.

I. CONTEXT

MSF consists of 6 Operational Centres (OCs) and 3 European Supply Centres (ESCs). In the supply domain there is a joint Supply Tansformational Topics Roadmap composed by several inter-OC and inter-ESC projects, and their number is growing due to the need to increase cooperation between MSF entities while improving the quality of MSF's supply chain. The capacity to measure performance and analyse data across different entities is therefore essential and is contributing to MSF ambitions on interoperability and climate.

The role of the International Office is to foster cooperation and coordination between MSF entities. The Supply Data Analyst will therefore act as a facilitator between the OCs and ESCs: bringing their representatives together, helping them build shared approaches on supply data and performance, and turning these agreements into concrete deliverables.

The Global Supply Data & Analytics (GSDA) team (previously SCPM) has been actively working to build the analytical and data foundations needed to support a global approach to supply chain performance management, and to contribute to the governance of supply data across entities. The team is led by the Supply Chain Analytics Manager and includes one Data Analysts and one data governance specialist; the Supply Data Analyst will join it as an additional analyst.

Reporting hierarchically and functionally to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager, the Supply Data Analyst will: collaborate closely with the supply chain professionals responsible for BI and performance management within the 6 OCs and 3 ESCs; work in close link with the ShARP (Shared Analytics and Reporting Project) team in SITS (Shared IT Services); on the existing UniField intersection reports; work alongside the GSDA team and the IO Supply team on projects related to supply chain data analytics; and interact with stakeholders across MSF, including finance, IT, medical, pharmacy, logistics and operations teams.

II. PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The Supply Data Analyst supports supply chain performance analysis and decision making across MSF by delivering reliable data, KPIs, reports and actionable recommendations. The position also fosters cooperation between the OCs and ESCs around shared supply data, turning agreements into concrete deliverables.

Within GSDA, the Supply Data Analyst will support the growing need for data management, reporting and analytics from the supply chain teams, including the monitoring of KPIs and the analysis of data coming from MSF information systems (such as UniField, Isystock or Akiba).

III. ACCOUNTABILITIES

The Supply Data Analyst is accountable for the following expected results and the activities deployed to achieve them.

1. UniField intersection reports are reliable, relevant and meet the needs of the OCs

a. Take over the existing UniField intersection reports in close link with the ShARP team and improve them (reliability, relevance, usability) based on users' feedback and identified gaps

b. Collect the reporting needs of each OC and consolidate them into a clear, prioritised set of requirements

c. Design and deliver new intersection reports in coordination with the ShARP team, with validation from the OC representatives

2. Supply data is available and of reliable quality for analysis

a. Extract, clean and consolidate supply data from UniField and other information systems

b. Check data consistency and quality, and report anomalies to the relevant teams

c. Document data sources, definitions and calculation methods

3. KPIs and reporting solutions support decision making

a. Calculate and update a set of KPIs on a regular basis, in coordination with the teams concerned

b. Build and maintain ad hoc data reporting solutions (Power BI) providing visuals that accurately summarise supply chain activities while providing actionable insights

c. Support the teams in the definition of additional KPIs as needs arise

4. Stakeholders receive relevant data analysis and actionable recommendations

a. Support stakeholders on supply data analysis

b. Respond to ad hoc data and analysis requests using supply data from different stakeholders (supply, finance, medical…)

c. Present analysis results and recommendations in a clear way to non-technical audiences

5. Cooperation between the OCs and ESCs on supply data produces concrete deliverables

a. Convene and facilitate working groups and meetings with representatives of each OC and ESC, from preparation (agenda, pre-alignment of positions) to follow-up (minutes, actions, deadlines)

b. Lead discussions between entities with different needs and practices, and build compromises and consensus on shared definitions, KPIs and ways of working

c. Turn agreements into concrete deliverables (e.g., shared KPI definitions, dashboards, documentation) and follow their delivery

6. Data-related tools and processes improve continuously and stakeholders are kept informed

a. Contribute to the improvement of data-related tools and processes within the team

b. Proactively identify data needs, risks and improvement opportunities, and propose solutions autonomously

c. Manage stakeholders and expectations: identify their needs, keep them informed, and escalate blockers to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager when needed

IV. AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY

Challenges and decisions that the job faces to achieve the accountabilities:

  • Autonomy to think and act: works with limited supervision; takes initiative, prioritises and drives work to completion, proactively identifies data needs, risks and improvement opportunities, and escalates blockers to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager when needed.

  • Complexity of the environment: works across 6 OCs and 3 ESCs with different needs, practices and information systems (UniField, Isystock, Akiba); builds compromises on shared definitions and KPIs, handles multiple priorities at once, and interacts with technical and non-technical stakeholders (finance, IT, medical, pharmacy, logistics, operations) in a cross-cultural and cross-functional environment.

SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE

The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others.


Education

  • Bachelor's level or above in data analytics, statistics, business management, supply chain or a related field, or a combination of relevant education and professional experience (essential)

Experience

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience as Data Analyst (essential)

  • Direct work experience involving significant data management (essential)

  • Experience in facilitating meetings or working groups involving multiple stakeholders and in delivering concrete outputs from them (essential)

  • Supply chain, logistics and Finance experience in NGO's operational settings (desirable)

  • Previous work experience with UniField, MSF's main ERP software (desirable)

Skills

  • Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills: ability to bring together representatives of different entities, lead effective meetings, negotiate compromises and deliver concrete outcomes

  • Strong analytical skills

  • Good organisational skills, ability to handle multiple priorities at one time

  • Autonomous and proactive: ability to take initiative, prioritise and drive work to completion with limited supervision

  • Good level skills in Excel, Power BI and database management

  • Ability to work in a cross-cultural and cross-functional environment

  • Drive for change, improvement and innovation

Languages

This is an Atlantic porfolio company.

The opportunity

Demand for AI compute is outrunning the infrastructure to deliver it, and the environmental bill is growing with it: more fossil power, more freshwater, more land. New capacity on land also means waiting years for power, sites and permits.

We take a different route: we bring compute to the power. Far offshore, the wind blows stronger and steadier than anywhere on land, and no grid will ever reach it. Using it lets AI scale without adding carbon or competing with communities and nature for water and land.

We're building fleets of autonomous ships that turn that wind into AI compute at sea. Each ship carries its own wind turbines and computing on board, and navigates on its own across the open ocean, following the strongest and steadiest winds. No mooring, no cables to shore: the fleet goes where the energy is. It's AI infrastructure built from the ground up for the open ocean, from power systems and autonomy to high-density computing, engineered to run in one of the harshest environments on Earth. No grid queue. No freshwater. No land. Zero-carbon compute that scales with the fleet.

  • Firm, low-carbon power at a target cost of ~€50/MWh, one of the biggest costs in running AI compute

  • 70%+ capacity factor: offshore wind that behaves like baseload

  • First demonstrator at sea in late 2027

Founded in 2025 by repeat entrepreneurs and industrial leaders. Backed by major international investors.

The mandate

You'll work directly with the CEO and the board and own the company's business strategy as we go from first demonstrator to fleet.

Our platform opens several paths to value across compute and infrastructure, from capacity to hardware to the services around them. You'll decide which to pursue first, build them into the core of the company, and open new ones as the fleet grows.

What you'll own

  • Business model & strategy. Shape the business model and evolve it as we scale: products, markets, pricing and unit economics. Turn a breakthrough technology into a bankable one.

  • Strategic partnerships. Decide which partners and customers we build the company with, from AI labs and cloud providers to chipmakers and sovereign compute programmes, and secure the relationships that shape our first fleet.

  • Capital strategy. Work with the CEO on how the business case underpins project finance and fundraising, and own that story with investors and the board.

  • Product direction. Make sure what we build at sea is shaped by where the market is going, working hand in hand with our marine, power and systems engineers.

  • Ecosystem & alliances. Build the partnerships a new infrastructure class needs: chip and systems vendors, cloud platforms, data center operators, ports and financiers.

Why this role

arbeitnow:offre-de-stage-de-recherche-ma.description:
Dates : 6 mois à partir de février ou mars 2027

Contexte du projet :

L’allègement des structures automobiles reste un levier majeur pour réduire la consommation et les émissions des véhicules, tout en répondant à des exigences croissantes de rigidité et de tenue au crash. Les pièces de caisse en blanc sont en grande majorité réalisées à partir de tôles d’acier mises en forme, dont la conception repose encore largement sur l’expertise et sur des itérations successives entre calcul et dessin.

L’optimisation topologique permet de déterminer la meilleure répartition de matière dans un domaine de conception donné. Appliquée à un domaine volumique 3D, elle conduit cependant à des structures massives ou de type treillis, difficilement transposables en pièces embouties d’épaisseur quasi constante. Le défi scientifique consiste à formuler une méthode capable de faire émerger, à partir d’un domaine volumique, des géométries représentatives de tôles (structures à parois minces), en maîtrisant l’épaisseur et la fabricabilité, sous chargements statiques puis dynamiques.

Ce stage s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une collaboration de recherche entre le LTDS et ArcelorMittal Global R&D. Il a vocation à se poursuivre par une thèse CIFRE en cas de résultats concluants.

L’objectif du stage sera de développer et d’évaluer une première méthodologie d’optimisation topologique 3D aboutissant à une solution en tôle d’acier, en s’appuyant sur une structure automobile.

Les missions pourront comprendre :

•Un état de l’art des méthodes d’optimisation topologique conduisant à des structures minces de type coque (contrôle d’épaisseur par filtrage et projection, contraintes de longueur caractéristique, approches par composants explicites ou level-set).

•Le développement d’un algorithme d’optimisation 3D appliqué à une pièce automobile soumise à des chargements statiques.

•L’extension de la méthode à des solutions plus avancées proposées par ArcelorMittal.

Les missions pourront être adaptées en fonction du profil du candidat et de l’avancement du projet.


Profil recherché : étudiant(e) en Master 2 ou équivalent (stage ingénieur) dans le domaine de la mécanique numérique, du calcul des structures ou des mathématiques appliquées.

Compétences souhaitées : méthode des éléments finis, optimisation numérique, programmation scientifique (Python, MATLAB ou C++). Des connaissances en optimisation topologique ou en dynamique rapide (LS-DYNA, Radioss) seront appréciées.

Encadrement : Frédéric Gillot (LTDS, École Centrale de Lyon) ; Daoming Yu, Alexandre Blaise et Cristian Alvarez (ArcelorMittal Global R&D).

L’accueil au laboratoire est soumis à une autorisation préalable (procédure FSD, 2 à 3 mois de délai) : les candidatures (CV, lettre de motivation, relevés de notes) sont à adresser dès que possible.

arbeitnow:chief-of-staff-tech-engineerin.title: Chief of Staff Tech - Engineering
arbeitnow:chief-of-staff-tech-engineerin.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

 

In 2024, we implemented an organizational structure built around business 'tracks'. This approach integrates key stakeholders across marketing, sales, product, and customer care into unified teams focused on specific product lines or client segments. Each track operates as a mini-business, empowered with dedicated resources (e.g., product marketing, data analytics, and operational support) and direct accountability for performance.

 
 

Why this role matters at Pennylane

 

As Chief of Staff to the CTO, you operate as a senior leader in the Tech organisation. Your leverage does not come from managing teams but from owning the hardest problems that sit between them, and from being technical enough to earn the trust of the other engineering leaders.

You are the person the CTO trusts with ambiguous, org-wide problems. You turn that ambiguity into a clear framing, a decision, an owner and a measurable outcome.

This is not a coordination role. You are expected to have opinions on engineering strategy, staffing choices and technical trade-offs, and to defend them in front of the Tech leadership team.

 

Team and Context

Pennylane's Tech organisation is 70+ squads, each led by an Engineering Manager working with a PM and a Product Designer. We serve 1.5m+ customers and we want to scale in Europe. At that size, the hard problems are no longer inside a squad: how the organisation plans, how it decides, how it measures itself, how it invests in foundations without stalling product delivery. That is your perimeter.

You report directly to Quentin, Co-founder & CTO. Your influence comes from the scope of what you own and from credibility with senior engineering leaders, which is why we ask for a technical background. As the organisation grows, this role can evolve towards a management position.

Key missions

Engineering strategy and transversal initiatives

  • Own the strategic, cross-organization initiatives that no single squad can carry: platform or architecture programmes, reliability and quality step-changes, engineering productivity, technical debt paydown

  • Frame the problem, build the technical and business case, secure alignment across Engineering, Product and Security to drive execution

  • Lead the Tech side of company-level programmes (e.g. European expansion, major compliance or infrastructure shifts) alongside the rest of the Tech leadership

Planning & Performance tracking

  • Own the Tech planning cycle: collect the inputs, surface the trade-offs (capacity vs. platform, run vs. new bets), and drive the arbitration with Tech leadership

  • Drive the definition and calibration of Tech OKRs, and hold the organisation accountable

  • Define what "good" looks like for a 70+ squad engineering organization and build the metrics that measure it (delivery cadence, reliability, quality, staffing and attrition, engineering satisfaction)

Decision-making and leadership cadence

  • Own the Tech leadership operating system: staff meetings, QBRs, roadmap and architecture reviews. You design them, set the agenda, write or commission the pre-reads, frame the decisions to be made, and make sure decisions land

  • Maintain the CTO's decision log: what was decided, by whom, with what trade-off, and what happened next

  • Raise the quality of decision-making across the Tech leadership team

Communication

  • Lead internal and operational communications across the engineering organization, building clear messaging systems from board decks down to team-wide updates

Who you’ll work with?

  • CTO and Tech leadership (Head of Engineering / Head of Data / Senior Engineering Managers)

  • Rest of the leadership (CPO, VP Strategic Initiatives)

  • Other relevant teams (e.g. Security, Finance, People)

Who we’re looking for

Must-have

  • An engineering degree (engineering, computer science or equivalent scientific curriculum)

  • Technical fluency: you can read a design doc, follow an architecture discussion, challenge an estimate or a trade-off, and be taken seriously by senior engineers

  • 7-10 years of experience, including significant time inside a tech organisation at scale (multiple squads, platform teams), where you have lived the problems of scaling engineering

  • A track record of owning complex, cross-organisational initiatives from framing to measurable outcome with senior stakeholders

  • Outstanding written communication: this role produces documents that senior people act on

  • Fluency in English

Nice-to-have

  • A hands-on engineering past: software engineer, engineering manager, Technical Program Manager, architect or equivalent

  • Experience as a Chief of Staff, VP/Director of Engineering Operations, or in a strategy & operations function inside a product-led tech company

What you can expect?

Within one month

  • You'll complete the company and Tech onboarding, including our application, accounting domain and engineering practices

  • You'll have met the Tech leadership team and formed your own view of where the organisation loses time, quality or alignment

  • You'll have taken ownership of the leadership cadence and the next planning milestone

Within 3-6 months

  • You'll be leading selected org-wide strategic initiatives end-to-end, with a measurable target

  • The Tech organisation will have a metrics picture it trusts and uses to make decisions

  • You'll be a recognised voice in the senior tech community at Pennylane, consulted on decisions rather than just informed of them

  • You'll be shaping the engineering narrative that the rest of the company and the board hear

Recruitment Process

- Screening interview with Barbara - Senior Recruiter (30 mins)

- An interview with Eric - VP Strategic Initiatives (45 mins)

- An interview with Quentin - CTO (1h)

- A Business Case to prepare at home and to present (1h)

- A final interview with Nathan - Head of Product Strat&Ops (45 mins)

What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains ----- or ----- style="min-height:1.5em">We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

 

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

About the Role

As our GNC, ML, Embedded Software, and Validation teams scale, they rely increasingly on simulation to develop and test our autonomous defense systems. The value of that simulation depends directly on how faithfully it reproduces the real behavior of our drones.

Joining the Tooling team, you will be responsible for bringing the physical models of our drones into the simulator—including aerodynamics, propulsion, electronics, sensors, and electromechanical systems. Designed by expert domain teams, these models require your expertise to translate user needs, integrate models into the simulator software stack, and validate expected behavior. Because not every use case requires the same level of realism, you will help establish the appropriate fidelity targets across applications.

This role offers high ownership and the opportunity to work at the intersection of physics, software engineering, and AI robotics with direct mission impact.

Responsibilities

  • Coordination with Domain Experts: Work with the teams in charge of aerodynamics, propulsion, electronics, sensors, and electromechanical systems to understand their models, their assumptions, and their inputs and outputs, and to agree on how they are delivered to the simulator.

  • Model Integration: Integrate these models into the simulator software stack in a clean, performant, and maintainable way, with clear interfaces and configurable parameters.

  • Validation: Define and run tests that check the integrated models against the reference data given by the expert teams (flight logs, bench tests, manufacturer data), and report discrepancies back to the model owners.

  • User Needs & Fidelity Targets: Work with the simulator users (GNC, Embedded, Validation) to understand their use cases, and translate them into a realism target for each model. Pick the right balance between fidelity, performance, and integration effort, and prioritise the model integration work to match.

  • Documentation & Standards: Document the integrated models, their parameters, validity domains, and validation results, and help standardise the model integration and validation process.

Candidate requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in software engineering, simulation, or a related engineering field.

  • Physics Understanding: Good understanding of flight dynamics and enough physics background to discuss models with experts in aerodynamics, propulsion, electronics, sensors, and electromechanical systems, and to turn their models into working code.

  • Integration & Validation: Experience integrating third-party models or components into a larger software system, and validating them against experimental data with a rigorous approach.

  • Technical Proficiency: Comfortable with C++ and Python, with a good knowledge of Linux environments.

  • Educational Background: MSc or BSc in Aerospace Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, Applied Physics, or a similar technical field; equivalent professional experience is equally valued.

Plus (nice to have)

  • Experience with drones or robotic systems, ideally with open-source autopilots like PX4 or ArduPilot.

  • Hands-on experience with flight testing, test benches, or log analysis.

  • French language skills.

Mindset

  • Rigor: Empirical and disciplined about validation, grounded in real test data, and skeptical of a result that only exists in simulation.

  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication, comfortable working with several specialized teams, asking the right questions, and sharing validation results with them.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

arbeitnow:stage-2027-ia-ml-engineer-50-r.description:
Ekimetrics est un leader mondial de l'efficacité marketing et commerciale et des solutions d'IA à l'échelle. Depuis 2006, nous aidons les entreprises à optimiser leur marketing et leurs opérations en combinant IA avec expertise business et technologique dans 4 domaines : Marketing & commercial effectiveness, Customer analytics, Operational excellence, ESG & sustainability.  
 
Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous concevons des solutions sur mesure qui transforment les données en impact positif concret, grâce à une combinaison unique de technologie et de services.
 
Notre force est de déployer une IA à impact, à grande échelle. Notre mission : mobiliser cette puissance pour répondre aux défis les plus urgents de notre temps. Nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un impact constant à grande échelle, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN.  

Contexte

Les modèles marketing sont mis à jour à mesure que de nouvelles données arrivent : ventes hebdomadaires, résultats de campagnes, comportement des clients. Ils comprennent les marketing mix models (MMM), qui estiment le retour sur investissement de chaque canal média, ainsi que les modèles de demande et de promotion et les modèles de réponse client. Chaque mise à jour fait bouger les estimations, et la première question des métiers est : pourquoi ont-elles bougé ?

Notre équipe a développé une méthode qui y répond de façon exacte pour les modèles bayésiens. Elle répartit le déplacement de toute quantité a posteriori entre des groupes d'observations : semaines, campagnes, régions, segments de clients ou expériences. La méthode est en cours d'évaluation par les pairs. Un premier prototype sur le MMM suit déjà une estimation semaine après semaine et lève une alerte quand une mise à jour la déplace plus que prévu.

Sujet : pourquoi l'estimation a-t-elle bougé ? Attribution bayésienne en ligne pour les modèles marketing.

Volet recherche (environ 3 mois)

• Étendre l'attribution à l'apprentissage bayésien en ligne : mises à jour séquentielles, effets variables dans le temps (modèles linéaires dynamiques, filtre de Kalman), oubli des données anciennes.

• Distinguer les trois causes d'un déplacement à chaque mise à jour : les nouvelles données, un vrai changement du marché et une erreur dans un flux de données.

• Calibrer l'alerte de mise à jour : taux de fausses alertes et délai de détection, sur des données simulées dont la vérité est connue et sur des données publiques, pour le MMM et pour au moins un autre modèle marketing.

• Rédiger un article destiné à un public de statistique ou de marketing science.

Volet produit (environ 3 mois)

• Transformer la méthode en un module Python testé, compatible avec nos outils de modélisation bayésienne (le MMM en premier).

• Construire les sorties destinées aux métiers : une vue « ce qui a fait bouger l'estimation » et une alerte de mise à jour.

• Les valider avec des consultants sur des cas réels, puis les documenter et les transmettre à l'équipe produit.

Livrables attendus

• Un article soumis à une revue ou une conférence à comité de lecture.

• Un module Python testé et documenté, intégré à nos outils de modélisation.

• Un guide court pour les consultants : comment lire et expliquer une attribution.

Profil

• Étudiant ou étudiante en dernière année de master ou d'école d'ingénieurs, en statistique, science des données ou probabilités.

• Statistique bayésienne (prior, posterior, MCMC), et idéalement séries temporelles ou modèles à espace d'états.

• Bonne maîtrise de Python (NumPy, une librairie de programmation probabiliste comme PyMC ou NumPyro), Git, tests unitaires.

• Intérêt pour l'application de la statistique au marketing et pour l'explication des résultats à des non-spécialistes. Aucune connaissance préalable en marketing n'est requise. Rédaction claire en anglais.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
 
Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent — à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif. 
 
Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu, que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte.
 
Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même.
 
En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations.
 
Nous sommes également certifiés Great Place to Work© en France, au Royaume-Uni et aux Etats-Unis, et notre bureau de Hong Kong a reçu le prix Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2023©.
 
Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 !Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux.  
 
Vous aurez accès :
 
·       Au catalogue de formation Eki.Academy qui contient des programmes qui vous feront monter en compétences sur nos solutions et nos métiers, des parcours apprenants sur notre plateforme digitale ainsi que des programmes dédiés à nos enjeux prioritaires, dont la sensibilisation aux sujets environnementaux avec la Climate School.
·       A une vie sportive, artistique, musicale, ludique, caritative et engagée : de notre salle de sport privatisée à nos expositions d’art, en passant par des jeux vidéo et des concerts, ou encore les défis RSE sur la plateforme Vendredi. Toutes ces initiatives sont portées par nos Eki.People ;

arbeitnow:intern-ai-researcher-anomaly-d.title: Intern AI Researcher: Anomaly Detection for Predictive Maintenance in Distributed Storage
arbeitnow:intern-ai-researcher-anomaly-d.description:
About Scality

Scality builds data infrastructure software for enterprise AI, cyber resilience, and sovereign control at multi-petabyte to exabyte scale. Its AI Data Infrastructure platform reduces operational burden through AI-powered autonomous operations while aligning the right storage media, performance, and protection to each workload through human-approved lifecycle policies.
 
Built on CORE5 cyber resilience and open-code principles, Scality software delivers extreme performance, operational simplicity, and sustainable economics. 
 
The world's most demanding enterprises and government organizations depend on Scality to power AI initiatives, defend critical data, and build infrastructure that lasts for decades. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality is where AI remembers, learns, and thinks. F
 
Follow us on LinkedIn. Visit www.scality.com and our blog.

Context & Motivation
A distributed storage cluster continuously emits telemetry at every level, from the platform and S3 service down to each server and disk. A failing disk, server or storage node leaves traces in these multivariate time series, from subtle shifts in a few metrics to system-wide disruption. Detecting and diagnosing these anomalies early is critical for:
  • Predictive maintenance: isolating or replacing a component before it impacts service
  • Faster diagnosis: pointing support engineers to the root cause, not just to an alert
  • Higher availability and durability of customer data
    • This internship is part of a joint research project between Scality and an INRIA research team. The project released SHAD (Scality High-dimensional Anomaly Detection), an open benchmark published at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations & Datasets Track). It contains 215 real 171-dimensional time series from Scality RING clusters, annotated for injected disk, server and storage-node failures. SHAD's baselines show the problem is far from solved. No detector handles every failure type, per-dimension attributions find root causes no better than chance, and off-the-shelf LLMs cannot interpret the anomalies. This internship builds on SHAD to close these gaps.

    More details on the project: scality.github.io/shad

    Your Mission
    As part of our R&D team and in close collaboration with INRIA researchers, you will develop AI models that detect, explain and interpret anomalies in storage-cluster telemetry. Your work will include: 
     
    1. State of the Art
    Review the literature and open-source projects on multivariate time series anomaly detection, root-cause attribution and LLM-based interpretation of time series. Also survey recent work on AI agents that automate research and experimentation. Starting points include SHAD and the TSB-AD benchmark. 
     
    2. Anomaly Detection & Diagnosis Models
    Design, train and benchmark models that improve on SHAD's baselines at each stage of the pipeline:
  • Detection that stays accurate across disk, server and storage-node failures (e.g., ensembles, hybrid models, time series foundation models)
  • Explanation: attributing each anomaly to the dimensions that actually cause it
  • Interpretation: turning detections into actionable diagnoses (failure type, criticality, affected component) 
  • Early detection of progressive degradations, the core of predictive maintenance
    •  
    3. Fleets of AI Agents for Research
    Set up and manage fleets of AI agents that run your studies at scale:
  • Design agent workflows that launch experiments, run benchmarks and compare methods
  • Orchestrate and monitor many agents working in parallel
  • Build safeguards for rigor: experiment tracking, reproducibility, independent verification of results
  • Assess what agent-driven research changes in practice: speed, coverage, failure modes
    •  
    4. Evaluation & Validation
    Evaluate every model with rigorous, reproducible protocols. Use them to:
  • Measure each stage with SHAD's metrics (VUS-PR for detection, NDCG for explanation, a questionnaire for interpretation)
    Quantify performance per failure family and scenario
  • Identify which approaches are ready to transfer to production monitoring

    • Expected Outcomes & Valorization
    Depending on results, the work may be valorized through:
     
  • A scientific publication with the Scality and INRIA researchers
  • New methods and baselines contributed to the open-source SHAD benchmark
  • Reusable agent-based research workflows for the R&D team

    • Technical Stack
  • Python (primary language for modeling, experimentation and analysis)
  • PyTorch and scikit-learn (deep learning and classical models)
  • SHAD benchmark (github.com/scality/shad) and TSB-AD (github.com/TheDatumOrg/TSB-AD) for data, detectors and evaluation
  • LLM-based AI agents and their orchestration tooling

    • Candidate Profile
  • Final-year student in a Master's program or Engineering school (Bac+5), in machine learning, data science or computer science
  • Solid foundations in machine learning; experience with time series or anomaly detection is a strong plus
  • Strong interest in LLMs and AI agents, and curiosity for new ways of doing research
  • Good Python skills and hands-on experience with a deep learning framework such as PyTorch
  • Rigorous and critical with experimental results, especially when agents produce them
  • Autonomous and curious, able to communicate results clearly in written and spoken English
  • Interest in distributed systems or storage is a plus, not a prerequisite

    • Work Environment
    You will join a fast-paced, lean AI R&D team. French and English is our primary working language. You will benefit from:
     
  • Mentorship from R&D engineers
  • Close collaboration with INRIA researchers working on time series anomaly detection
  • Access to real telemetry from Scality RING clusters and to the AI agent tooling the team uses for its studies
  • A high-trust environment where your findings will directly influence engineering decisions

    • Why Join Scality?
  • Work on a concrete research problem with real-world industrial impact
  • Build on a benchmark published at NeurIPS and contribute to open research
  • Practice a new way of doing research, with fleets of AI agents as research assistants
  • Be part of a team building infrastructure trusted by Fortune 500 companies
  • Potential to publish research or continue as a full-time engineer after the internship

Who we are

Yubo is the instantly social, social app: the leading real-time social discovery platform where you can meet new people for friendship, crushes and community. Our mission is to help young adults find community - whoever they are, wherever they are and whenever they feel social. That's why we’re building a more spontaneous and human social world, one based on interaction, exploration and possibility.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow. Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission.

As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

We also work closely with the broader technology industry to share our knowledge and NGOs create industry-leading child protection standards.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role


At Yubo, Product Managers have real ownership. They work in strong partnership with Product Designers and Engineering, shaping strategy and decisions from problem definition all the way to delivery, with direct and visible impact on both the product and the business.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to form that partnership with a Product Designer: a duo jointly responsible for the end-to-end experiences you ship together. You'll take ownership of a strategic product area, identify the biggest opportunities, and turn them into clear product bets on a product used by millions of people.

We're moving away from small, isolated feature launches toward bigger, end-to-end experiences tested at scale. You'll combine user understanding, data and strong product convictions to frame problems, shape solutions with Design and Engineering, and decide what to scale, iterate, or stop.

You'll also work closely with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing and Trust & Safety on challenges ranging from recommendation and discovery to retention, safety, monetization and AI.

This role is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and who wants their decisions to have a visible impact on both user experience and business outcomes.

To make this dream duo work, we’re basing this role in Paris and looking for someone willing to come to the office once or twice a week.


Your responsibilities

  • Define product strategy and translate company objectives into clear priorities and measurable outcomes

  • Partner closely with Product Design and Engineering to shape end-to-end experiences rather than isolated features

  • Use data, research, user feedback, market insights, and product intuition to identify the problems worth solving

  • Turn opportunities into bold product bets, measure their impact, and decide whether to scale, iterate, or stop

  • Collaborate with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, Trust & Safety, and Legal to make informed product decisions

  • Balance user value, business impact, safety, and technical constraints when making trade-offs

  • Create alignment across stakeholders through clear problem framing, strong product conviction, and structured decision-making

  • Figma

  • Notion

  • Slack

  • Enterpret

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex, Dust

Who you are

  • You have 4+ years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally within consumer mobile products and a startup or scale-up environment

  • You are comfortable owning a product area from problem definition through launch and iteration

  • You combine strong product intuition with analytical rigor

  • You know how to use data, research, user feedback, and experimentation to guide decisions

  • You start with the user problem rather than jumping straight to a feature or solution

  • You have the conviction to form a strong product point of view, make bold calls, and defend them

  • You enjoy working closely with Design and Engineering and leading through influence rather than hierarchy

  • You are comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and changing direction when the evidence tells you to

  • You know how to balance user experience with growth, engagement, monetization, safety, and long-term product health

  • Experience with social, community, social discovery, gaming, recommendation, or consumer subscription products is a plus

Within a month, you will

  • Get familiar with Yubo's product, users, business model, and product principles

  • Build relationships with your Product Designer and key stakeholders across Engineering, Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, and Trust & Safety

  • Understand current product priorities, ongoing experiments, major user journeys, and the metrics behind them

  • Start contributing to discovery and product discussions

Within 3 months, you will

  • Take ownership of a defined product area and its key user and business problems

  • Establish a trusted way of working with your Product Designer and Engineering counterparts

  • Lead your first discovery work and turn your findings into clear product opportunities

  • Launch and analyze your first experiments, using their results to inform your next decisions

Within 6 months, you will

  • Own the strategy and key initiatives for your product area end to end

  • Lead ambitious product bets that rethink meaningful parts of the user experience rather than isolated features

  • Drive measurable progress on outcomes such as retention, engagement, recommendation quality, monetization, or trust

  • Use data, user insight, and experimentation to decide what to scale, iterate, stop, or explore next

  • Raise the bar on product thinking, experimentation, and decision-making across Yubo

The recruitment process

  • Phone screen with Anita, Talent Acquisition

  • First interview with Sacha, our CEO

  • Product case study and debrief with Product Managers

  • Cultural fit assessments

  • And if everything went well, an offer!

What we offer

  • A highly competitive salary range as well as equity in the company

  • A hybrid work policy with up to two days of on-site presence per week at an amazing office and monthly team events to enjoy.

  • We also cover fees for external professional events and meetups (Android Makers, etc…)

  • Great health insurance coverage for both you and your family by Alan, fully paid for by Yubo !

  • Numerous benefits for parents: additional parental leave, easy access to nurseries and daycare facilities in France.

Our approach to privacy & safety

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

Here’s how we live our mission every day:

You own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter

Unconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better

Be Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward

One team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins

 

Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you.

 

Enjoy Top-notch Benefits

Culture is central at Yubo, hence the numerous benefits:

Cool Workplace: enjoy our amazing Parisian office and our many hybrid work options

Family-Friendly: we support parents with childcare options and family-friendly policies

Wellness Programs: benefit from comprehensive health insurance, wellness programs, sports classes, and mental well-being initiatives

Position description

Sonar is becoming an AI-first company. Strategy Enablement turns Sonar's strategic ideas into real, lasting results: company-critical initiatives, business transformations, acquisition integrations and new market expansion. As Sr. Project Manager, Strategic Initiatives, you will lead some of these initiatives from fuzzy intent to measurable outcome with pace and focus, as a trusted thought partner to leadership. Everything we do ultimately serves our internal and external customers, and you will keep them at the center of the solutions you design. You will reinvent both how projects are run and what they deliver: you use AI agents every day in your own work, and you design solutions AI-first, ambitious yet practical. Your first focus will be the AI transformation of our Go-To-Market organization, with our Business Technology team (including SALT, its AI team) and the Data & Insights team. Over time, you will lead initiatives across the company, in domains you may not know yet.

What you will do

  • Frame ambiguous strategic intents into clear problems, objectives and business cases, starting from the impact on our customers and the business.

  • Bring the customer voice into every initiative: use customer feedback and data to shape solutions, and make sure internal changes improve how customers buy, use and renew with Sonar.

  • Ground decisions in data: establish baselines, size opportunities, define success metrics up front and measure impact after go-live.

  • Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives end to end, driving pace and keeping the focus on customer and business outcomes.

  • Re-plan quickly when priorities or context change, and recommend stopping work that no longer pays off.

  • Redesign processes AI-first, from the outcome back: decide what AI agents do, where humans and AI work together and where human judgment stays essential, with guardrails proportional to business risk.

  • Build working prototypes (skills, agents, lightweight apps, automations) to test ideas early with users, then partner with Business Technology to industrialize what works.

  • Use AI agents systematically in your own business analysis and project management work, and share reusable skills and workflows to raise the AI bar around you.

  • Bridge leadership and operational teams: engage stakeholders early, manage competing priorities and keep sponsors and teams aligned.

  • Stay agile and pragmatic: run initiatives with simple, effective tools and communication rather than heavy process and admin, pick the approach that drives the behaviors and actions needed, re-plan quickly when context changes, and recommend stopping work that no longer pays off.

  • Master business analysis and project management foundations, and apply them pragmatically: just enough process, simple tools and clear communication, never process for its own sake.

  • Own change management as part of delivery (communication, training, champions, reinforcement) until new ways of working stick, with particular care for the human side of AI-driven change.

Experience and qualifications

The ideal candidate will:

  • Have 10+ years of experience leading complex, cross-functional, international transformation or strategic initiatives, ideally combining strategy or transformation consulting with in-house experience in a fast-growing tech or SaaS company.

  • Bring a proven track record of measurable outcomes (revenue, cost, efficiency, adoption, customer experience), not just projects delivered.

Shape the service around static and agentic workflows, with support for additional analysis types guided by validated customer needs.

The domain covers issue-processing pipelines, durable storage, and supporting APIs and events. You will agree the scope and ownership of shared execution orchestration and other expanded capabilities with engine, infrastructure, and consuming-product teams. Engine teams retain detection logic; consuming teams retain their product workflows and acceptance criteria; workflow and Quality Gate owners retain publication, policy, and merge decisions.

Your direct customers are the technical teams building analysis engines, agent services, guidance capabilities, and other products on this service. Success is the value these teams deliver to developers and enterprises, not the number of shared capabilities shipped.

Agree contracts for issue identity and state changes with engine and workflow owners, keeping processing separate from publication and policy decisions.

arbeitnow:senior-mechanical-design-engin.title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (Power Electronics)
arbeitnow:senior-mechanical-design-engin.description:
Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness.

As a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer, you will turn our power electronic modules into a robust, compact and safe product. You will design how the SiC-based power modules, magnetics, busbars and cooling come together into one unit, working closely with our power electronics, magnetics and thermal engineers.

Instead of handing your designs over for someone else to build, you take them all the way: you calculate them, build and assemble the prototypes yourself in our workshop, and take the design from first prototype to a product ready for series production.

This role is for you if…

you've designed the mechanical integration of power electronics or other electronic systems and know your way around creepage, clearance and insulating plastics. You back your designs with solid calculations, and you're as comfortable with a screwdriver in the workshop as with CAD at your desk.

This role isn't for you if…

your experience is in classic mechanical design only, such as gears, gearboxes or pumps, or you prefer to stay at your desk while someone else builds your prototypes. It's also not a fit if you need technicians for assembly or established processes before you can start.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design the mechanical integration of power electronic modules into the SST: enclosures, holders, fixtures and jigs, and interfaces to the busbar system, with a modular design approach.

  • Model and design electro-mechanical parts and assemblies, including plastics, sheet metal, insulation systems, magnetic components and cooling system interfaces.

  • Ensure electrical safety through the design on both the medium-voltage and low-voltage side: creepage and clearance distances, CTI and material selection, electrical isolation and sealing.

  • Design for manufacturing, assembly and test from the first concept, working with suppliers on processes such as injection molding, sheet metal and machining.

  • Own the DFMEA for your designs and drive the resulting actions into the design.

  • Validate designs with structural FEA, including static, modal, shock and vibration analysis, before they are released for production, and correlate the results with test data.

  • Build and assemble prototypes and test assemblies hands-on in our workshop, together with the engineering team, using additive manufacturing where it speeds things up.

  • Collaborate with other engineers to take designs from concept through prototype to series production.

  • Share your expertise and support other engineers on best practices in mechanical engineering.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical engineering or a related field.

  • 4+ years of full-time industry experience in mechanical design, with a focus on the mechanical integration of power electronics or other electronic systems.

  • Proven experience applying DFM and DFA to your own designs, with parts and assemblies that made it into production.

  • Hands-on experience leading or actively contributing to DFMEAs.

  • Strong experience with structural FEA (e.g. ANSYS), including static, modal, shock and vibration analysis. You set up the models yourself and use the results to drive design decisions.

  • Solid knowledge of creepage, clearance, CTI, insulation coordination and electrical safety (e.g. IEC 60664-1, IEC 62477-1), ideally up to medium voltage.

  • Solid experience designing with polymers/plastics, ideally for electronics integration.
