arbeitnow:head-of-sales-fund-administrat.description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

As Head of Sales at bunch, you will strengthen, lead and scale our sales team across key European markets — UK, Luxembourg and Germany. Reporting directly to the Co-Founder, you will turn our high-touch executive commercial motion into a structured, repeatable sales engine across our key European markets.

You will lead Account Executives and Commercial Associates selling to sophisticated decision-makers across VC, PE, and alternative asset managers (GPs, CFOs, COOs, and Fund Ops teams). Because our business model combines scalable SaaS capabilities with high-touch fund services, sales cycles are relationship-driven, multi-stakeholder, and often long. This role demands a leader who can combine structured organisation and process building, relentless deal execution and strong coaching with domain adaptability.

You will:

  • Lead, coach, and develop Account Executives across UK, Luxembourg and Germany.

  • Set a high bar for sales quality, customer understanding, pipeline discipline, commercial judgment, and performance

  • Define and execute market-by-market sales plans in close partnership with the leadership team

  • Build a predictable sales operating cadence across pipeline reviews, forecasting, deal inspection, CRM discipline, and conversion tracking

  • Set up scalable sales processes across the full funnel — from lead routing, qualification, discovery, mutual action plans, pricing, proposal creation, negotiation, handover, and post-sale feedback loops

  • Own the commercial operating system: CRM hygiene, reporting, dashboarding, pipeline definitions, stage exit criteria, forecasting methodology, activity tracking, and tooling adoption

  • Create and maintain sales handbooks, enablement materials, talk tracks, qualification guides, objection-handling resources, market playbooks, and deal review templates so the team has a clear source of truth

  • Coach the team on complex enterprise sales: discovery, qualification, stakeholder mapping, business-case building, negotiation, pricing, executive communication, and multi-threading

  • Build a regular coaching rhythm through call reviews, deal reviews, pipeline inspection, 1:1s, performance feedback, and structured development plans

  • Stay close to strategic deals where customer trust, market context, executive engagement, or commercial judgment are critical

  • Partner closely with other teams, including Marketing, Customer Success, Product Development, Operations, Legal & Finance, and our Co-Founders to advance commercial outcomes

  • Bring structured market feedback into company planning, including customer needs, competitor patterns, pricing insights, product gaps, and operational blockers

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition to hire, onboard, ramp, and manage performance as the sales team expands

About you

  • You have proven experience navigating commercial models that blend scalable software/SaaS with high-touch services, implementation, or customer operations, understanding how to price, position, and transition complex deals without eroding margins.

  • Extensive B2B commercial experience with proven success closing complex, consultative enterprise software or tech-enabled service deals.

  • Direct experience selling into venture capital, private equity, asset management, or fund services is a strong plus, but your ability to build a high-performing tech sales motion comes first.

  • You have a track record of driving sales motions for high-ticket solutions where deal sizes are consistently in the hundreds of thousands, focusing on relationship-driven, consultative outcomes.

  • You have 3+ years of experience directly managing, coaching, and scaling Account Executives teams, with a clear track record of raising team performance, enforcing pipeline discipline, and driving revenue growth.

  • You have coached team members through long-cycle, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals

  • You have successfully built and scaled sales motions across multiple markets, driving high performance through rigorous CRM discipline, RevOps tooling, and predictable forecasting routines.

  • You excel at creating practical sales handbooks, enablement resources, playbooks, and coaching frameworks that teams rely on to drive complex, long-cycle enterprise deals.

  • You are a seasoned people leader who sets a high bar for excellence, fostering talent through direct feedback, clear performance management, and structured coaching.

  • You combine strong commercial judgment—knowing when to push or qualify out—with the executive presence to build trust and credibility with senior stakeholders.

  • You have a builder mentality and are comfortable creating structure in an environment that is still scaling

  • You communicate excellently in English

Existing understanding of VC / PE fund operations, GP / LP structures, fund administration, investor onboarding, transfer agency, or Luxembourg fund structures is a strong plus.

What success looks like

In your first months, you will build a clear understanding of bunch’s commercial motion, ICP, product, implementation model, pricing, and market dynamics. You will establish trust with the existing sales team, founders, and key cross-functional partners, while introducing a clear cadence for pipeline reviews, deal coaching, forecasting, and performance visibility.

Over time, you will strengthen the team’s execution across priority markets, improve pipeline quality and forecast accuracy, standardise the sales playbook, support hiring and onboarding, and build stronger cross-functional routines with Marketing, Solutions, Operations, Customer Success, Product, and RevOps. You will also establish the core sales infrastructure the team needs to scale: clear funnel processes, reliable CRM workflows, useful dashboards, practical handbooks, repeatable coaching routines, and a shared source of truth for how we sell.

Ultimately, you will help build a high-performing and scalable sales organisation across UK, Luxembourg and Germany, improving predictable revenue generation and constantly raising the quality bar for complex private-markets selling.

Workplace & Benefits

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Hybrid setup (3 days/week in office)

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  1. People Team Interview (30 min) – Meet us & check initial fit

  2. Founder’s Interview (60 min) – Role deep dive, sales leadership, and commercial scope

  3. Sales Leadership Case (60 min) – Coaching, pipeline discipline, and complex deal execution

  4. Final Round (3 x 45 min) – Meet our leadership team (Tech, Ops, CS).

  5. In-person Meet & Greet with team members.

  6. Reference checks

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

ÜBER UNSERE COMPANY

freiheit.com wurde 1999 in Hamburg gegründet und entwickelt seitdem custom large-scale Softwareprodukte. Unsere Mission ist: “Ship great software”.

In mehr als zwei Jahrzehnten haben wir immer das ausgeliefert, was wir versprochen haben – “always on time, on budget, on target and on quality”.

85% unserer Members sind Software Engineers mit Abschlüssen in Informatik, Physik oder Mathematik, viele auch mit fundierten Kenntnissen in Maschinellem Lernen und Künstlicher Intelligenz. 

Seit über einem Vierteljahrhundert arbeiten wir für das „Who’s Who“ der deutschen und europäischen Industrie- und Handelsunternehmen.
Retail, Automotive, E-Commerce, Healthcare und mehr.

Unsere large-scale Softwareprodukte werden täglich von Millionen von Benutzern verwendet und sind entscheidend für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg unserer Kunden. Jedes Produkt ist somit geschäftskritisch und ist von strategischer Relevanz. 

Gemeinsam machen wir “mission impossible possible”. 

Unser Team besteht aus 300+ Members aus der ganzen Welt. In unseren Büros in Hamburg und Lissabon bauen wir gemeinsam Produkte, die noch nie jemand zuvor entwickelt hat.

Unsere Teams arbeiten datengetrieben, um ihre eigene Produktivität ständig zu optimieren. Jedes Teammitglied übernimmt die “end-to-end” Verantwortung für seine Arbeit. Um erfolgreich zu sein, muss man produktiv sein. Um produktiv zu sein, muss man effizient und effektiv sein.

Technology never rests. Neither do we.


ÜBER DEINEN JOB

Als “Senior Recruiter” im Team Recruiting von freiheit.com sind dies Deine Verantwortungsbereiche:

  • Active Sourcing auf Top-Niveau: Du verlässt dich nicht auf eingehende Bewerbungen, sondern spürst per Active Sourcing die besten Talente auf. Du findest genau die Menschen, die das Mindset, den Willen und die Disziplin mitbringen, um mit uns „Mission Impossible“-Projekte Wirklichkeit werden zu lassen.

  • Klasse statt Masse: Dein Ziel ist es nicht, Bewerberzahlen künstlich aufzublähen, sondern von vornherein die richtigen Leute über die passenden Kanäle anzusprechen. Du steuerst deine Sourcing-Pipelines datengetrieben, misst Response- sowie Conversion-Rates und optimierst jeden Schritt für ein stetiges, nachhaltiges Wachstum unserer Community.

  • Engineers recruit Engineers: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Engineering-Teams und dem Management zusammen. Dabei hast du die Koordination des Bewerbermanagements fest im Griff, schaffst klare Strukturen und sicherst die Prozessqualität durch dokumentierte Standards.

  • Volle Ownership & KPI-Transparenz: Du sprichst die Sprache deiner Stakeholder und übernimmst End-to-End-Verantwortung für eure Recruiting-Ergebnisse. Zu jedem Zeitpunkt kannst du alle Fragen zu deinen Pipelines, Sourcing-Erfolgen und KPIs präzise beantworten.

  • Langfristige Netzwerke aufbauen: Mit deiner offenen, direkten Art knüpfst und pflegst du nachhaltige Verbindungen zu Universitäten, Studentengruppen und spezialisierten Partnern, um unseren Talent-Pool kontinuierlich zu stärken.

  • High-Speed als Normalzustand: Ein hochdynamisches, schnelllebiges Umfeld spornt dich an. Du bist ehrgeizig, willst selbst jeden Tag besser werden und suchst ständig nach der nächsten Herausforderung. 


    • ÜBER DICH

  • Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im Recruiting– idealerweise in einem technologie- oder softwaregetriebenen Umfeld.

  • Du bist ein Profi im Active Sourcing: Du beherrschst moderne Suchstrategien, schreibst individuelle Nachrichten mit hoher Antwortquote und weißt, wie man passive Top-Talente überzeugt.
  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium bevorzugt in (Sport) Psychologie oder in der Fachrichtung Personalwesen, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaften.

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (mind. C1) und verhandlungssicheres Englisch. 

  • Du hast Spaß daran, selbständig zu arbeiten, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und an neuen Herausforderungen zu wachsen.

  • Du bist gut im Networking und hast Freude daran, dauerhafte Arbeitsbeziehungen aufzubauen.

  • Du hast Durchhaltevermögen und “Situational Awareness” mit absolutem Willen zum Erfolg.

  • Du bist offen, empathisch, klar in der Kommunikation und hast Freude daran, gemeinsam mit einem starken Team etwas zu bewegen.

  • Du bist mitreißend, charmant und selbstbewusst.

  • Du suchst nicht einfach nur irgendeinen Job: Du möchtest lernen und deine Ideen und Fähigkeiten einsetzen, um einen bleibenden Beitrag für unsere Community zu leisten.

    • ÜBER UNSERE COMMUNITY

    Auf die Frage, warum jemand hier arbeitet, lautet die Antwort oft: „wegen der Menschen“ und „weil ich in meinem Leben noch nie so viel gelernt habe“.

    Wir glauben, dass produktive Menschen glückliche Menschen sind. 

    In unseren Engineering Hubs in Hamburg und Lissabon triffst du auf Menschen aus der ganzen Welt. 

    Hier hast du die Möglichkeit, mit intelligenten Menschen an spannenden Aufgaben zu arbeiten und Projekte von der Idee bis zur Auslieferung umzusetzen – end-to-end. 

    Ein wahrer Experte in seinem Fachgebiet wird man nicht über Nacht – dazu braucht es Jahre harter Arbeit und kontinuierliches Lernen. Als ein Member unserer Community wird viel von dir verlangt, und niemand kann die Arbeit für dich übernehmen.

    Unser Unternehmen ist ein Ort, an dem du die beste Version deiner selbst werden kannst. 

    ***Wir bieten keine reinen Remote-Stellen an. Wir arbeiten fünf Tage pro Woche im Büro.

arbeitnow:senior-account-executive-germa.description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role?

As a Senior Account Executive at Cohere you will have ownership of the full sales cycle - from identifying leads to closing deals, with Defense, Federal Civilian and Local Government Agencies in Germany.

In this role you will be focussed on business development activity across all PUBSEC Government Agencies and Departments in Germany.

We’re looking for an approachable and compelling communicator who loves working with public sector customers to uncover their needs and feels comfortable developing tailored value propositions around how Cohere’s platform can help them drive better mission and citizen outcomes. You’ll lay the foundation for Cohere’s growth by owning your territory and collaborating with teammates across Customer Success, Sales Development, Marketing, and Sales Engineering. You’ll be the voice of the field and help our Product and Engineering teams prioritize the Cohere roadmap with customer-centric care. In this highly self-directed role, you will thrive in a quickly evolving environment.

As a Senior Account Executive, you will:

  • Drive net-new customer acquisition through targeted outbound activity, senior leader engagement, and relationship building in Germany.

  • Develop and execute a sales plan for Germany, prioritizing accounts and opportunities through collaboration with Cohere leadership.

  • Act as a trusted advisor and thought partner to public sector customers and prospects by understanding their goals and shaping AI solutions that deliver measurable value

  • Work closely with channel and regional partners, as well as major system integrators to scale outreach, accelerate adoption, and maximize customer success

  • Leverage senior-level relationships with executives and government decision-makers to drive strategic opportunities and long-term partnerships

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams on strategic efforts to deliver enterprise and public-sector solutions

  • Partner with SDRs and Marketing to drive top-of-funnel activity and overall territory growth

  • Own the full sales cycle; including discovery, technical and business validation, proof-of-concept, procurement, and deal close within a team-selling environment

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 10+ years of direct public sector sales experience in Germany, with a proven track record of closing $3M+ annual quotas.

  • Deep knowledge of PUBSEC procurement and budget cycles, decision-making processes, and how to work with regional partners and resellers.

  • Established network in Germany, including federal agencies, prime contractors, and industry associations.

  • Experience selling SaaS, AI/ML, or enterprise software solutions to government clients.

  • High tolerance for ambiguity, you are both a strategist and a hands-on operator capable of building a market from the ground up

  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple internal and external stakeholders across fast-moving deals

  • Creativity and strong technical acumen to structure unique, mutually beneficial partnerships

  • Excellent communication skills, you listen deeply, understand what matters to senior decision-makers, and confidently present to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • English and German language proficiency essential.

  • Must be based in Germany with willingness to travel (25-35%).

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. arbeitnow:account-executive-dach-ai-supp.title: Account Executive (DACH) | AI Supply Chain SaaS AE (d/f/m)
arbeitnow:account-executive-dach-ai-supp.description:
About the role

Electronics is a trillion-dollar industry that still runs on spreadsheets, email threads and part-search tabs. Luminovo is the AI platform that replaces them, and DACH is our home market, with 400+ customers worldwide.

We're adding an Account Executive to our German-speaking team. You will sell our procurement intelligence platform to OEMs, from automotive suppliers to industrial equipment and medical device makers: procurement, supply chain and engineering leaders who want to cut component costs and see supply risk before it stops production. Our buyers rarely arrive knowing they have a problem worth solving, so you win through deep discovery, a sharp business case and trust built across several stakeholders.

You will write the playbook with us. Our OEM motion in DACH is still being built, and you will shape how we sell to it, with a founder and a VP of Sales next to you.

 

Your performance objectives

Generate pipeline

  • Create qualified pipeline of roughly €420k–€500k ARR per quarter at Level 2 and €570k–€680k at Level 3, through your own outbound, events and the meetings our BDRs book, qualified with SPICED (Situation, Pain, Impact, Critical event, Decision criteria).

  • Build your network: connect with 50+ relevant decision-makers at electronics manufacturers per quarter and represent Luminovo at 2–3 industry fairs a year.

  • Ramp with clear targets: in your first 3 months, complete the discovery and demo certifications and all Lumiversity courses, and create 4 qualified opportunities at Level 2 or 6 at Level 3 (6 and 9 with BDR support). In your second quarter you work toward 50% of full quota, and from there toward full quota.

Close opportunities

  • Run demos tailored to each customer's pain and prove value with domain experts in workshops that quantify ROI: savings against market prices, risk exposure uncovered, disruptions avoided.

  • Guide prospects through complex buyer journeys: map stakeholders, handle procurement and legal, close about €105k–€125k of new ARR per quarter at Level 2 or €143k–€169k at Level 3, and hand over smoothly to Customer Success.

Build your OEM playbook

  • Within 6 months, document what works in the DACH OEM segment (messaging, discovery questions, objections) and contribute it to our sales playbook.

  • Feed customer and market insight to Product every month, with at least one concrete product input that lands on the roadmap.

Lead by example

  • Own your metrics (pipeline health, conversion, deal velocity) and use them to hit your quarterly targets.

  • Mentor our BDRs through call reviews and shared discovery, and ask for coaching after every major customer interaction.

 

Your potential growth path

  • Months 1–6: master the product, close your first 5–10 deals, build your DACH network.

  • Months 6–18: take on larger deals and complex stakeholder setups, mentor BDRs.

  • 18+ months: move into Enterprise AE (€100k+ deals), own strategic accounts, mentor junior AEs.

 

Your territory and work setup

German-speaking market (DACH) plus some English-speaking territories. Discovery, demos and negotiations happen in German and the company works in English, so you need both at a professional level. Hybrid at our Munich HQ or Berlin hub, with the sales team in the office three days a week. Occasional travel for retreats and industry events, costs covered.

 

Whom you'll be working with

  • Clifton Lobo, VP Global Sales, your manager, who coaches you on deal strategy and career progression

  • Sebastian Schaal, co-founder, for positioning and pricing

  • Inga Schwarz, Team Lead and pioneer AE for OEM, your partner in building the OEM playbook

  • Dasha and our BDR team, who feed you qualified meetings

  • Max Hungenbach and RevOps for CRM, dashboards and enablement

  • Marketing and Customer Success

 

Why Luminovo

  • Measurable product impact: our procurement intelligence shows OEMs where they pay above market and which parts put production at risk, so your business case starts from the customer's own BOMs

  • An open field: you shape the DACH OEM playbook with a founder and our VP Global Sales next to you

  • AI is part of how we work, from our MCP integrations to the agents our own teams build

  • Psychological safety, honest feedback, an international and remote-first team

 

Just so you know – we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care just about your CV. If you're interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles – see here.

 

⚡️ About Luminovo

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

To date, over 400 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

Our core principles: putting people first & building great things

About the role

Electronics is a trillion-dollar industry that still runs on spreadsheets, email threads and part-search tabs. Luminovo is the AI platform that replaces them, and DACH is our home market, with 400+ customers worldwide.

As a BDR in our DACH team you are the engine behind our new pipeline. You find the procurement, supply chain and engineering leaders at electronics manufacturers who overpay for components or carry hidden supply risk, start the conversation, and hand our Account Executives meetings worth taking. We want you to build the outbound machine with us, not only run it.

This is the first step of a defined path: consistent target achievement gets you considered for promotion to a full-cycle Account Executive role.

Your performance objectives

Generate pipeline

  • Build and keep current a target list of OEM accounts in DACH (automotive suppliers, industrial equipment, medical devices), and map the decision-makers per account in engineering, procurement and supply chain, using Sales Navigator, Apollo and Clay.

  • Run multichannel outbound (email, phone, LinkedIn, events) that books discovery calls for our AEs: 4 in month 1, 8 in month 2 and 12 per month from month 3 (16 per month at Level 3). Source your first qualified opportunities from month 2 and reach 6 per month by month 4 (8 at Level 3).

Qualify with precision

  • Run cold calls and discovery conversations in German that find the pain behind the title: the current process, the cost of delay, who decides. Hand over each meeting with clean notes so the AE never starts from zero.

  • Complete the discovery and demo certifications in your first weeks and all Lumiversity courses by the end of month 3, so every meeting you hand over meets our qualified-opportunity bar.

  • Tell us fast which segments and messages convert.

Build an AI-powered outbound engine

  • Within your first 90 days, design and ship one automation or agent that improves your own outbound (account research, personalized first lines, lead scoring), and show the result: reply rate, hours saved or meetings booked.

  • Share what works with the team, so the next BDR starts with your playbook.

Grow toward Account Executive

  • Learn the product and the electronics supply chain well enough to start co-running discovery calls with an AE.

  • Own your numbers every week (activity, reply rate, meetings, acceptance) and bring market insights to sales, marketing and product.

Your potential growth path

  • Months 1–3: master the product and our ICP, launch your first sequences, book your first qualified meetings.

  • Months 4–9: hit your meeting target consistently, ship your own automation, start co-running discovery with AEs.

  • After the ramp: consistent target achievement gets you considered for promotion to full-cycle Account Executive, following our sales progression framework.

Your territory and work setup

DACH market. Discovery calls and outreach happen in German and the company works in English, so you need both at a professional level. Hybrid in Munich or Berlin, with three office days per week. Occasional travel for team retreats and industry events, costs covered.

Whom you'll be working with

  • Dasha, our BDR Lead, who coaches you day to day

  • Seba, one of our founders, supporting the OEM go-to-market team

Why Luminovo

  • A clear, written path from BDR to Account Executive

  • AI is part of how we work, from our MCP integrations to the agents our own teams build

  • Psychological safety, honest feedback, an international and remote-first team

Just so you know – we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care just about your CV. Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

arbeitnow:senior-controllerin-berlin-179.description:
HALLO

wir suchen eine:n Senior Controller:in (m/w/d), um bei Yazio einzusteigen und im Zuge unseres weiteren Wachstums die volle Verantwortung für unser Controlling zu übernehmen. Du bringst Struktur, Sorgfalt und fundiertes Fachwissen in unseren Monatsabschluss, die Buchhaltungsprozesse und die internen Kontrollen ein und setzt damit den Maßstab dafür, wie Controlling bei Yazio funktioniert. Mit rund 150 Mitarbeitenden wirken sich deine Entscheidungen zum Aufbau des Monatsabschlusses und zur Gestaltung der Buchhaltung langfristig aus. Diese bestimmen mit, wie das Finance-Team in den kommenden Jahren arbeitet.

Du bist dafür verantwortlich, unsere zentralen Buchhaltungs- und Controlling-Prozesse kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und zu verbessern. Du sorgst für korrekte und fristgerechte Finanzberichterstattung und bist die interne Anlaufstelle für fachliche Bilanzierungs- und Rechnungslegungsthemen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit FP&A, Legal, Operations und externen Partnern unterstützt du sowohl die operative Umsetzung im Tagesgeschäft als auch komplexe Bilanzierungsfragen zu neuen Produkten und Transaktionen.

Diese Stelle ist zu 100 % remote und steht Bewerber:innen mit Wohnsitz in Deutschland, Spanien, Portugal oder dem Vereinigten Königreich offen.

 

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Den Monatsabschluss von Anfang bis Ende aufbauen, verantworten und vorantreiben und gemeinsam mit Accounting und zentralen Stakeholdern eine schnelle, präzise und gut koordinierte Finanzberichterstattung sicherstellen

  • Prüfung und Freigabe von Rückstellungen, Stichtagsbuchungen, Abstimmungen und Berichtspaketen für die Geschäftsleitung und den Bereich FP&A

  • Als zentrale Anlaufstelle für Fragen zur Rechnungslegung fungieren und neue Geschäftsmodelle, Verträge sowie komplexe Bilanzierungssachverhalte unterstützen

  • Technische Rechnungslegungsdokumentation und Positionspapiere entwickeln und pflegen (z. B. Umsatzrealisierung, Aktivierung, Leasingverhältnisse und andere komplexe Themen)

  • Externe Partner wie Buchhalter:innen, Steuerberater:innen und Wirtschaftsprüfer:innen steuern und koordinieren und dabei für eine hohe Qualität der Dokumentation und eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit sorgen

  • Interne Kontrollen kontinuierlich stärken, indem du Auffälligkeiten erkennst, offene Punkte nachverfolgst und die Wirksamkeit der Kontrollen langfristig verbesserst

  • Prozess- und Systemverbesserungen vorantreiben, um manuellen Aufwand zu reduzieren, die Effizienz im Abschlussprozess zu steigern und skalierbare, gut dokumentierte Workflows aufzubauen

  • KI-Werkzeuge für Analysen, Abweichungserklärungen, Audit-Vorbereitung und Recherchen in der Rechnungslegung einsetzen und dabei die kritische Prüfung sowie die Verantwortung für die Ergebnisse übernehmen

  • Eine moderne, skalierbare Finanzfunktion durch Automatisierung, Standardisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung aufbauen

 

DEIN PROFIL

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in Buchhaltung, Controlling oder Finanzberichterstattung, idealerweise in schnell wachsenden Unternehmen mit zunehmender Komplexität

  • Vorerfahrung in der Leitung oder Koordination eines kleinen Buchhaltungsteams ist von Vorteil

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse des deutschen HGB; IFRS-Erfahrung ist von Vorteil

  • Nachweisliche Verantwortung für den gesamten Monatsabschluss, mit Blick auf Richtigkeit, Vollständigkeit und eine hohe Qualität der Berichterstattung

  • Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für interne Kontrollen sowie die Fähigkeit, Risiken proaktiv zu erkennen, Kontrollen zu konzipieren und Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern

  • Fortgeschrittene DATEV-Kenntnisse und sicherer Umgang mit Buchhaltungssystemen und Finanzdaten

  • Sicher im Umgang mit KI-Werkzeugen zur Steigerung der Produktivität (z. B. für Recherche, Dokumentation, Anomalieerkennung und Unterstützung bei der Berichterstattung), verbunden mit ausgeprägtem kritischen Urteilsvermögen bei der Bewertung der Ergebnisse

  • Strukturierte, dokumentationsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit einem klaren Fokus auf Prüfbarkeit und Transparenz

  • Ausgeprägter Wille zur Prozessverbesserung und ein gutes Gespür für Ineffizienzen und skalierbare Lösungen

  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung im Umgang mit Stakeholdern und in der Zusammenarbeit mit externen Buchhalter:innen, Steuerberater:innen und Wirtschaftsprüfer:innen

  • Wachstumsorientiertes Mindset und die Bereitschaft, sich laufend über Änderungen in Rechnungslegung und Steuerrecht zu informieren (z. B. HGB, Umsatzsteuer und IFRS)

 

WARUM WIR?

  • Ein spannendes Produkt mit Millionen von Nutzer:innen in über 150 Ländern, angetrieben von unserer Mission, die Welt durch gesunde Ernährung zu verändern

  • Ein Remote-First-Ansatz: Du arbeitest zu 100 % von zu Hause, nutzt einen Coworking-Space oder arbeitest für mehrere Wochen pro Jahr aus dem Ausland

  • 30 Urlaubstage zum Entspannen und neue Energie tanken sowie 5 Kinderkrankentage, wenn dein Kind dich braucht

  • Eine fokussierte Kultur, in der Effizienz wichtiger ist als lange Arbeitstage – keine Überstunden, und wenn doch, bekommst du die Zeit zurück!

  • Ein Umfeld mit großer Wirkung, in dem deine Arbeit echte Veränderungen bewirkt – mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und ohne Mikromanagement

  • Eine Teamkultur, in der Ehrgeiz und Balance Hand in Hand gehen, getragen von starker Verbundenheit – vom komplett bezahlten Unternehmens-Retreat bis hin zu Teamtreffen und virtuellen Kaffeepausen

  • Tools und Support, damit du deine beste Arbeit leisten kannst: MacBook, Monitor und ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.000 €, plus regelmäßiges Feedback und Unterstützung bei deiner Karriereentwicklung

  • Ein wirklich internationales Team mit Englisch als Unternehmenssprache und einem gemeinsamen Engagement für Wachstum und Wohlbefinden – unterstützt von Sunday Supplements und Nilo Health

 

Vielfalt und Inklusion

Bei YAZIO sind wir überzeugt, dass Vielfalt Innovation antreibt. Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld ein, in dem sich alle wertgeschätzt und gestärkt fühlen, unabhängig von Geschlechtsidentität, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung oder Behinderung. Wir schätzen unterschiedliche Perspektiven und ermutigen Menschen mit ganz verschiedenen Lebenswegen aktiv, sich bei uns zu bewerben.

 

DU WILLST BEI UNS EINSTEIGEN?

Du möchtest YAZIO aufs nächste Level bringen und Menschen weltweit zu einem gesünderen Leben verhelfen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, von dir zu hören! Bitte sende uns:

  • Deinen Lebenslauf auf Englisch

  • Ein paar Zeilen (oder ein kurzes Video, falls dir das lieber ist) darüber, wer du bist und warum du bei YAZIO arbeiten möchtest

  • Weitere Unterlagen, die deine Arbeit zeigen (z. B. dein LinkedIn-Profil, Portfolio)

arbeitnow:senior-product-designer-berlin.title: Senior Product Designer (m/f/d)
arbeitnow:senior-product-designer-berlin.description:
The team at Klim is building the operating system for regenerative agriculture. We help farms restore their soil - and turn that into real, measurable business value for the food companies, banks and insurers who depend on it.

We’re a Berlin-based agritech startup backed by $22M in Series A funding, partnering with global food leaders such as Nestlé and ADM to build supply chain resilience through regenerative agriculture. Since 2020, we’ve supported +4,000 farmers managing over 900,000 hectares.

Join our incredible team of 80+ dedicated people across Germany, the UK, Poland and Czechia to help build a more sustainable, resilient food system and drive real climate impact.

Your mission:

Own the design experience of Klim end to end, and build the AI-augmented design process that lets a small design team and product managers ship coherent, high-quality work at scale. You'll do the hardest design work yourself and raise the level of everyone who designs around you. This means it is a player/coach role with 60% hands-on design and 40% building the system and process around you.


What you'll do

Product experience:

  • Own the end-to-end experience across farmer and partner journeys, from onboarding through assessment, planning and improvement, verification and reporting and paymnet, shaping journeys and value moments with product managers, not only interfaces.

  • Design the most complex and brand-critical work, from wireframes and flows to polished, high-fidelity interaction and visual design.

  • Cut farmer effort, with a focus on "enter once, used everywhere" data capture, simpler onboarding and self-serve help.

  • Run continuous research, usability testing and A/B tests with farmers and partners, and track experience metrics (activation, task completion, time-to-value, satisfaction) with product and analytics.

AI-augmented design process:

  • Own and deliver Klim's AI-augmented design model maintaining highest quality while enabling others to deliver simpler design needs under your guidance

  • Own the canonical design system with engineering: components and page templates, with code as the source of truth and Figma kept in sync.

  • Define the handoff contract and the automated and human coherence checks, using AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code, Claude Design, Figma, Storybook) and rules AI tools can follow.

  • Measure and improve the process: self-serve share, first-pass coherence, review time, engineering rework and ticket-to-design lead time.

Engineering efficiency and quality:

  • Partner with engineering leads to simplify and standardise how UI is built, so new features reuse proven patterns instead of starting from scratch.

  • Reduce design-related rework by making requirements, states and edge cases explicit before build.

  • Govern the intake of new patterns and log any exceptions, so the system grows deliberately rather than drifting.

Coach:

  • Enable product managers to design simpler elements well within the system through templates, patterns, content rules and review.

  • Build design rituals (critique, design reviews, a shared quality bar) and make the case for design decisions with evidence across product, engineering and commercial teams.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years in product design, including senior or lead roles owning complex B2B or data-heavy products end to end.

  • Exceptional interaction and visual design craft, with mastery of Figma. You'll personally deliver the most complex and brand-critical work.

  • A portfolio that shows product-level impact (engagement, adoption, satisfaction), not only interface quality.

  • Proven ability to improve engagement and strong plus for experience running A/B tests and product experiments and strong research skills.

  • Proven experience building and running a design system with engineering, ideally in React and Storybook, with tokens and components treated as code.

  • Hands-on use of AI tools in design and delivery (e.g. Claude, Figma AI or similar), and a clear view of where they help and where they don't.

  • A track record of designing processes others adopt, coaching designers and enabling non-designers, while still doing strong hands-on work.

  • Clear communication with farmers, engineers and executives alike.

  • Fluent English.

Nice to have:

  • German, to speak directly with farmers.

  • Experience in agriculture, climate, sustainability or other multi-sided platforms.

  • Experience with multi-language products and content design.

Why join Klim

  • Opportunity: Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company.

  • Impact: Your work helps farmers move to regenerative practice and helps companies cut supply-chain emissions.

  • Ownership: you'll set how design works at Klim, with direct access to leadership and a clear influence on the product roadmap.

  • Competitive package: competitive salary and participation in our VSIP program.

  • Flexible work: At Klim, we foster a flexible, hybrid work approach and facilitate temporary remote work (within the EU). It is advantageous for this role if you live in Berlin or can be present in our office regularly.

  • Additional benefits: We offer a subsidy for a membership in Urban Sports Club or the Deutschlandticket (if based in Germany), a company pension scheme, plus team lunches and regular team events.

At Klim, we believe that a thriving workplace is built on the diverse backgrounds, talents, and perspectives of our team. We grow stronger together by embracing and building on each individual’s unique strengths.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. All hiring and personnel decisions are made solely based on qualifications, performance, and the needs of the company - ensuring fairness and equal opportunity for all.

arbeitnow:strategy-operations-3-6-yoe-lo.description:
Strategy & Operations (3-6 YoE)

London, 5x days per week in-office

 

Vega is looking for multi-disciplinary A players who have what it takes to build a business from the ground up. We hire people who are already high-performers in MBB or finance/investing, but still have the itch to do more. This role will sit in the CEO Office, reporting to the Head of Strategy & Growth, working across the highest strategic priorities in the business.

 

About Vega

Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.

 

Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.

 

Who we are

We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.

 

How we do it

Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:

  1. We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.

  2. We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

  3. We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

  4. We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.

  5. We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.

We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.

 

Who succeeds in this role

We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.

 

In this role, you will:

  • Context-switch across strategy, go-to-market, operations, client delivery, external comms, special projects, and investor relations

  • Take on client-facing engagement responsibilities as needed, owning the day-to-day relationship and delivery coordination for enterprise customers.

  • Be able to own projects from Day 1, including representing Vega externally

  • Sit in the CEO Office, reporting directly to the Head of Strategy & Growth

  • Work closely with the Product & Growth and Engineering teams - strategy is not a silo at Vega

 

What we look for:

  • Required: 3-6 years of experience in MBB or finance/investing at a Tier 1 institution, with a clear spike in strategic thinking.

  • Whilst stellar training is essential, this is not all that we look for and not everyone with a background in MBB/investing will do well. This role is for people who have high standards of excellence for themselves, along with the risk tolerance and ambition to go beyond the comfort zone and structure of a larger institution.

  • Low ego, and a willingness to get stuck in; this role will allow you to do career-accelerating things that you might otherwise wait decades to do - but there will also be gruntwork. Everyone at Vega, including leadership, handles both.

  • Exceptional analytical and communication skills. You will need to think and explain complex concepts and communicate them to a range of stakeholders (e.g., enterprise customers, business, tech, and ops teams) with different audiences.

  • Confidence and judgement, with the ability to decide when and how to challenge requests, and an awareness of scalability and trade-offs when making those judgement calls.

 

Why join us?

  • Get a first-hand view, and real ownership of, everything that it takes to operate a fast-growing business

Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:

  2. We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

  3. We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.

 

Who succeeds in this role

We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive Vega’s ISO 27001 certification programme, building out and running the information security management system (ISMS) behind it, with policies that reflect how Vega works. Maintain our SOC 2 attestation with no exceptions.

  • Scope and manage external security testing, set up automated external scanning, challenge the findings and drive remediation to closure.

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in security with a substantial compliance/GRC share, including hands-on experience of ISO 27001 and SOC 2 audits. Ideally you’ve been part of a team that took an organisation through ISO 27001 certification.

The Mission: Why We Exist

Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer healthier lives, using the power of genomics.

Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores – giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time.

A Day in the Life

At Genomics, we tackle major scientific challenges in harnessing genomic data to improve human health.

This role is part of the Life Sciences team, working on a range of challenges spanning the therapeutic development cycle, with a particular focus on developing patient stratification strategies, advancing disease understanding using ‘omic data, and identifying novel biomarkers. The Scientist is an early-career member of the team, who will thrive in a highly collaborative team environment. With the team’s support, you will develop and execute innovative and rigorous scientific approaches, and will effectively communicate findings to both internal and external stakeholders.

For example, a Scientist may:

  • Apply and optimise risk tools for patient stratification that combine genetic information, through polygenic risk scores, with conventional risk factors, to find the individuals most at risk of disease onset or progression and those most likely to benefit from therapies.

  • Cluster genetic variants by their effects on disease-relevant traits to reveal distinct biological mechanisms, and use partitioned polygenic scores to define patient subgroups that share underlying causal biology.

  • Discover and validate novel biomarkers from clinical or ‘omic data, and apply them to stratify patient populations in large biobanks or clinical trials.

To be successful in this role, you will: bring a strong foundation in the application of statistical and computational techniques in biomedical science that you can apply in innovative ways, thrive on analysing vast and diverse sources of ‘omic data using leading statistical or AI/ML approaches to make meaningful insights into complex problems, and take pride in effectively sharing your findings with others.

Who You Are

Essential:

  • Solid foundations in statistics (e.g., modelling, regression), genetics and molecular biology, and statistical programming (e.g., Python or R).

  • Experience using at least one of the following statistical genetics approaches: GWAS, colocalization, fine-mapping, Mendelian randomization, polygenic risk scores.

Preferred:

  • Experience defining phenotypes from electronic health records.

  • Knowledge of Bayesian inference, high dimensional statistics, causal inference.

  • Experience with software engineering practices (version control [Git & GitHub], testing, documentation, agentic coding)

  • Experience building and running reproducible pipelines, e.g., using WDL, Snakemake, or NextFlow.

  • Experience using cloud computing and trusted research environments, e.g., DNAnexus or Verily Workbench.

  • Experience with methods development within statistical genetics.

arbeitnow:senior-engineer-platform-tooli.description:
Who is Atominvest

Atominvest is the operating system for modern private markets asset managers. Our modular, flexible SaaS technology underpins key investor- and portfolio-management workflows.

Our customers are sophisticated private equity, growth equity, and private credit firms managing billions in assets globally. We aim to deliver ongoing high-quality outcomes for them through a long-term partnership mindset.

At Atominvest, you’ll be working on something very exciting: the future of work, investments and sustainability/ ethical investing for the world’s best investors and delivering a positive impact through this. Based on the growth we are experiencing, we think we’re on to something big.

It won’t be easy. Joining a scale up business is an amazing and rewarding challenge, pushing well beyond the boundaries of natural growth cycles. You’ll move quicker than feels comfortable and be brilliant at continually re-prioritizing what must get done to keep Atominvest growing year over year at the pace of the best SaaS companies on the planet.

We’ve gone from zero to ten, now we’re looking to go from ten to one hundred!

About the role

Hi, I'm Thomas, VP Engineering at Atominvest. This is the hire I'm most excited about, so I wanted to tell you about it myself.

You'll own the platform our clients run on and build the AI development harness our engineers work in day to day. That work runs from infrastructure to application code, so we're looking for an experienced engineer with breadth across both, and depth in at least one. Together, it's what lets a small, lean team, working alongside AI agents, ship like a much bigger one.

 

By platform, we mean everything our product and our engineers stand on: infrastructure, security, test automation, developer experience, and the agent pipelines that run through all of them. It's a broad, hands-on role. You'll write infrastructure as code for a new service one day and address network vulnerabilities the next, then enhance our AI development harness and release a new feature, all within the same month.

 

You might be a platform engineer who loves shipping product, or a full-stack engineer who has run serious production infrastructure. Either works.

As deployments grow more complex, the team needs your depth in infrastructure and distributed systems. You'll strengthen the architecture and make the design decisions the platform will rest on for years. Those decisions should leave room to grow, because future products may bring much larger volumes of data than we handle today.

It has to stay dependable while we do it. Our software needs to be available around the clock, every day of the year, and data integrity is critical. Our clients use Atominvest to report to their own investors, so a wrong number matters as much as an outage. Security, reliability and audit-readiness matter too. If you enjoy getting those right without slowing everything else down, you'll find plenty of fun things to work on.

The machine that builds the product

We're becoming AI-native. Agents do more and more of the mechanical work of writing code, and engineers build the machine that builds the product: the architecture, the specs, the limits agents work within, and the evals that tell us whether their output is right.

I think that moves an engineer's leverage upstream. When code is cheap, the scarce things are judgement and understanding. Which problem is worth solving? What does good look like for the person using it? Is the output actually right? Did what we shipped help? The best engineers I've worked with always solved the end problem, with code as the medium. Now that's most of the job.

That's why product and user understanding sit at the centre of how we work. An engineer who knows our clients' workflows can point agents at the right problem and spot when the result is subtly wrong. Without that, agents just build the wrong thing faster.

Your part is the AI development harness that makes this safe. That means sandboxed environments with synthetic data, scoped and audited access to logs and alerts, and evals and validation gates in CI. It also means firm lines, enforced by tooling, that keep production deploys and secrets in human hands, and client data out of reach of development agents.

You'll also build the agent orchestration pipelines that run in three places: in how we build software, in AI workflows inside the product our clients use, and in the internal tools our implementation team uses to onboard and configure clients.

What you'll do

Build the machine that builds the product

Most of your time goes here.

  • Build our AI development harness. Self-service infrastructure, a reproducible development environment, and the sandboxes, guardrails and evals that let agents take on more of the work safely, with results we can measure.

  • Automate quality. Build the QA automation pipeline: automated tests, validation gates and release checks that give us confidence in every change, including the ones agents write.

  • Orchestrate agents across the business. Build pipelines that run agents reliably and safely in our product workflows and our internal implementation tools, not just in engineering.

Own the platform

  • Own our infrastructure. We're migrating to ECS. You'll strengthen our ECS architecture, see the move through in safe, reversible stages, bring every resource under infrastructure as code, and retire the old deployment model.

  • Build security into the platform. Tenant-scoped credentials, per-tenant secrets, least-privilege access, and the audit trail that SOC 2 and our clients' security teams expect.

  • Make production observable. Set up the monitoring, alerting and tracing we rely on, and build playbooks for on-call and incident response which is shared amongst the team.

Work across the stack

  • Make the application changes the harness needs, such as synthetic data, test hooks and the specs agents work from.

  • Ship product. Pick up application work in TypeScript and React alongside the team. Over time, you'll learn the codebase as well as the platform it runs on.

  • Grow the team around you. Write the design notes and runbooks, pair with and review the work of other engineers, and mentor those who want to grow into infrastructure, so the platform never depends on one person.

Your first six months

  • Get the first parts of "the machine" running, and show that they make the team faster without lowering quality.

  • At the moment all of our end to end testing is done manually by our Product team. That's a massive manual overhead that bottlenecks our product development. You'll help build our AI-powered QA automation pipeline, so every change, whether a person or an agent wrote it, is tested automatically before it reaches clients.

  • Strengthen the ECS architecture and complete the move with no disruption to clients.

  • Get the platform fully into code, with tenant isolation and least privilege designed in.

  • Put in place the monitoring and on-call foundations the team will build on.

How you'll work

You'll own this area rather than work through a ticket queue. You'll decide what to build and when it's good enough, write your decisions down so others can challenge them, and tell us when something isn't worth doing. You'll work closely with Product from the start of significant work, because the platform exists to serve clients and the engineers building for them.

You and I will work together every day. We'll shape the technical direction together and think through the hard calls, and you'll have a direct line to every decision that affects your work. I'll back your judgement, and I'll expect you to push back when you think I'm wrong.

This is an individual contributor role, but we expect you to multiply the team: leading different areas at different times, and delivering through others as well as through your own work.

You'll probably enjoy this if

  • You'd rather build a platform properly than keep patching one.

  • You're product-minded. You've probably worked at a startup or scale-up, or even founded something yourself. Seeing your work out in the world, solving real problems, is what motivates you. You ask who a change is for before you ask how to build it.

  • You already work this way. Agents write much of your code, and your time goes on design, specs and judging the output. You've built AI tooling for yourself, and probably for others on your team.

  • You get satisfaction from making other engineers faster.

  • You're comfortable writing Terraform, an API endpoint and an answer to a client's security questionnaire in the same week.

  • You've been the person others come to with hard problems, and you've changed your mind publicly when the evidence said so.

This probably isn't for you if

  • You want a pure DevOps or SRE role.

  • You want to manage people right now. These opportunities might exist in the future, but for now we're small, lean and as flat as possible.

What you'll bring

Very few people match every line. If most of this describes you, we'd like to hear from you.

  • Deep, hands-on AWS. Several years running production workloads on ECS or EKS, with a solid grasp of IAM, networking and Lambda.

  • Infrastructure as code as a habit, with Terraform or CloudFormation, including bringing existing hand-built resources under code.

  • Scaling distributed systems. You've taken systems through real growth in load and data, and can teach others what you learnt.

  • Single-tenant SaaS experience. You know the isolation trade-offs and how to keep one client's data and credentials away from another's.

  • Security and compliance as part of engineering: least privilege, secrets management, and evidence for SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

arbeitnow:staff-data-engineer-ai-data-pl.description:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

The Staff Data Engineer (AI Data Platform) will design, build and operate the data platform that makes UFORCE’s operational data usable for AI model training and validation.

You will connect diverse data sources—from high-frequency telemetry and time series to imagery, video, documents and structured records—and make the resulting data discoverable, governed and reproducible. You will work hands-on across architecture, pipelines, data quality and platform operations, while helping other engineers and partner teams make sound technical decisions.

This is a staff-level individual contributor role for someone who combines strong engineering judgment with a practical approach to delivery. You will partner with ML, product, engineering, field and security teams to build a platform that works for real use cases and operating constraints. Model research and model performance decisions remain with the accountable ML and product owners.

What you’ll do

  • Design and deliver a data platform for ingesting, storing, discovering and preparing heterogeneous data for approved analytics and ML workflows.

  • Build reliable batch and streaming pipelines for priority data sources, with validation, schema evolution, retries, backfills, replay and appropriate handling of failed data.

  • Preserve the context needed to understand and trace data, including timestamps, source identity, format versions and provenance where available.

  • Establish data contracts, metadata, interfaces and ownership boundaries that make data easier to find, understand and use across teams.

  • Enable reproducible training and evaluation datasets, including source and transformation versions, labels, filters and split definitions.

  • Build data-quality checks for issues such as missing data, corruption, duplication and temporal misalignment. Work with ML partners to surface coverage, sampling and leakage risks.

  • Make data rights, classification, retention, permitted use and access restrictions visible and actionable.

  • Design for the environments the work requires, which may include cloud, on-premises, sovereign or disconnected deployments.

  • Instrument and operate data workflows with clear visibility into health, freshness, quality, throughput and cost. Document failure handling, recovery and operational ownership.

  • Apply appropriate access controls, encryption, auditability and data-handling practices in partnership with security and other stakeholders.

  • Lead technical decisions across teams, communicate trade-offs and risks, mentor engineers, and deliver reusable components in small, reviewable increments.

What success looks like

  • A coherent platform architecture and incremental roadmap support priority AI and product use cases, with clear interfaces and ownership.

  • Priority data sources are ingested reliably and traceably, with agreed measures for completeness, freshness, quality and recovery.

  • Approved datasets are discoverable, governed and reproducible from source data through transformations to training and evaluation outputs.

  • ML teams can assess data quality, provenance and known limitations before using a dataset, and issues can be traced back and corrected.

  • Platform workflows have actionable monitoring, documented recovery procedures and clear operational ownership.

  • Security, deployment and cost constraints are understood and incorporated into platform decisions.

  • Partner teams can use the platform effectively, and engineers are unblocked through clear designs, reusable tools and mentoring.

Success measures and numerical targets will be established with the hiring manager and partner teams once baselines and operating constraints are understood.

Required qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering or a related field.

  • Data platform experience — designed, built and operated production data platforms or data-intensive systems end to end.

  • Staff-level technical leadership — led architectural decisions and cross-team delivery, mentored engineers and communicated clearly with stakeholders.

  • Hands-on engineering — strong Python and SQL skills, or equivalent, with experience in testing, code review and production-quality software.

  • Data pipelines — built reliable batch and streaming pipelines, including validation, schema evolution, retries, backfills and replay.

  • Data modalities — worked with structured or semi-structured data and at least one relevant modality, such as telemetry, time series, imagery, video or documents; understands provenance and temporal alignment.

  • ML data foundations — experience with storage, cataloguing, lineage, quality controls and reproducible datasets, including versioning, splits and leakage or sampling risks.

  • Platform operations — experience with observability, incident response, recovery, reliability and cost management.

  • Security and governance — practical knowledge of access controls, encryption, auditability, retention and sensitive-data handling.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with robotics, connected-device fleets or other operational systems that produce high-frequency or multimodal data.

  • Experience designing data systems for constrained connectivity, offline, air-gapped or sovereign environments.

  • Experience supporting defence, regulated or other security-sensitive customers.

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

Are You?

arbeitnow:sustainability-data-advisor-fi.description:
About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

Leading financial institutions like Carlyle Group, KKR, Ares, and BBVA use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive portfolio decarbonization.

We are looking for a customer-focused and analytically minded individual to join our Sustainability Data Advisory team in London, with a focus on financial institutions. You'll join a small team that operates like a startup within a startup at Watershed, working with some of the world's leading asset managers, private equity firms, banks, and insurers to accelerate their sustainability strategies.

You'll work directly with customers as a trusted advisor, leading measurement sessions and delivering advisory services that unlock the full value of our platform. You'll help customers measure financed emissions and use insights from their footprint to inform reporting and decision-making.

You will:

  • Advise teams at the world's largest financial institutions. Work directly with customers to measure financed emissions and strengthen their sustainable finance programs, supporting portfolio decarbonization and reporting across frameworks including TCFD, SFDR, CSRD, and LP reporting.

  • Deliver services that accelerate customer success. Lead measurement sessions and provide specialized advisory to help customers set up measurements, improve data quality, and unlock value from Watershed's platform. Support customers through emissions verification when needed.

  • Collaborate with science, engineering, and product teams to apply innovative measurement solutions, interpret the Partnership for Carbon Accounting Financials (PCAF) standards, and help customers make informed choices about how to measure emissions across asset classes.

You might be a fit if you:

  • Have 4–6 years of experience in consulting, solutions engineering, another customer-facing role in sustainability. You are excited to work directly with customers to help them build world-class sustainability programs.

  • Have an understanding of PCAF methodology and experience applying it to financed emissions measurement.

  • Have experience working with financial institutions and understand how they use emissions to inform internal decision-making and sustainability strategies.

  • Are an excellent verbal and written communicator. You can communicate complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Learn quickly and operate well in ambiguity. You are organized, systematic, and efficient, and you thrive in a high-volume environment.

  • Think clearly about complex problems and are comfortable using and speaking to data. You are meticulous and detail-obsessed.

  • Are passionate about solving climate change and excited to contribute to doing so at a fast-paced startup.

Fluency in multiple languages—English, French, German, or Spanish—is a nice to have.

This position requires working in person in our London office four days per week.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.
