arbeitnow:junior-business-controller-dat.title: Junior Business Controller (Data specialist)
arbeitnow:junior-business-controller-dat.description:
Do you enjoy working with numbers, analysing data and finding out what is really happening behind the figures? As Junior Business Controller at HG, you will support our Controllers and Group Financial Controller with financial analyses, reporting and increasingly data-driven insights.

At HG, you will work in a compact organisation with an international reach. You will get the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, take responsibility early and turn financial and business data into insights that help us make better decisions. We value people who are curious, take initiative and have the energy to turn ideas into action.

About the role

As Junior Business Controller, you will support our Controllers and gradually build your own areas of responsibility. The role combines financial activities with a strong focus on data, analysis and improving management information.

You will:

  • support the Business Controllers with financial analyses, reporting and recurring control activities;

  • own and maintain the data model

  • analyse financial and business data and translate it into useful insights;

  • investigate differences, trends and developments and help explain what is happening behind the numbers;

  • build, review and improve data models used for reporting and analysis;

  • use various tools including Excel and Power BI to make information clearer and easier to use;

  • investigate how data flows from source to report and identify opportunities to improve data quality and reporting;

  • help reduce manual work by finding smarter and more reliable ways of working;

  • contribute to improvements in management information and financial processes;

  • translate questions from colleagues into practical analyses and insights.

An important part of the role is conceptual thinking about data. You understand how information should be structured, see connections between different data points and can think about how a data model can be improved to provide better business insights.

Your development in data

Next to your finance responsibilities, you will grow step by step into the data side of the role, coached by our current Data Specialist. You do not need to master these areas from day one: together we will set up a development path in which you learn to:

  • contribute to HG's Business Intelligence and data strategy, making sure data supports our company goals;

  • design and maintain data models (such as star schemas) and database/Lakehouse structures, so that data is accurate, reliable and accessible;

  • integrate data from different sources and systems in a medallion model (Bronze for raw data, Silver for engineering, Gold for consumption);

  • manage the HG Data Dictionary, data repositories and the underlying data architecture;

  • apply data governance and data quality practices, including audit trails, data privacy requirements and best-practice frameworks such as DAMA;

  • map business processes (BPMN 2.0) and translate business requirements into practical data solutions;

  • work with tools such as SQL, Python (pandas), Power Query, Power Automate and Microsoft Fabric, and over time explore AI techniques;

  • document data models and data processes, and monitor data systems for performance and reliability.

This gives you a strong combination of finance and data expertise, which is becoming increasingly valuable in modern Business Control.

Collaboration & positioning

You will be part of the Finance team and work closely with our Business Controllers. This gives you the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues while contributing your own analytical and data-driven perspective.

Because HG is a relatively compact organisation, you will have direct contact with colleagues across different disciplines. This means you can quickly see how your analyses and improvements are being used in the business. At the same time, you will work within an international organisation, with colleagues and markets across Europe.

The role is based at our head office in Almere.

HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected.


What you bring

We are looking for someone who is analytical, energetic and curious. You enjoy getting to the bottom of a question rather than simply producing a report. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do and how the underlying data can provide better insights.

You bring:

  • willingness to learn

  • around 3–5 years of relevant work experience, for example as a big 4 auditor, Finance Analyst, Data Analyst or Junior Business Controller;

  • solid knowledge of finance and accounting, preferably gained through an education in Accountancy, Finance & Control, Business Information Management, Data Analytics);

  • experience with or a strong interest in Power BI;

  • strong analytical skills;

  • the ability to think conceptually about data, reporting and data models;

  • a curious and proactive approach to solving problems;

  • the confidence to ask questions and challenge existing ways of working;

  • an energetic mindset and the drive to learn and improve;

  • a genuine eagerness to learn and to keep developing yourself, both in finance and in data;

  • fluent English; knowledge of Dutch is desirable.

  • experience with AI tools, such as Copilot.

    Please note that we do not offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this position. You must therefore hold a valid EU work permit

What we offer

This is a role where you can build a strong foundation in modern Business Control while developing further in data and analytics. You will not only work with existing reports and figures, but also have the opportunity to improve how information is structured, analysed and used.

You can expect:

  • a monthly salary between €4.000 and €5.200 (excluding holiday allowance), depending on your experience.

  • an annual on-target bonus of 10% of your gross annual salary; 

  • full-time employment with 30 days of annual leave; 

  • a pension scheme; 

  • a commuting allowance; 

  • a dynamic and ambitious working environment where initiative and ownership are valued;

  • the opportunity to grow towards a broader Business Controller role as your knowledge, experience and responsibilities develop;

  • structured coaching by our Data Specialist to develop your data skills alongside your finance role;

  • a friendly, welcoming team, with a free shared lunch every Monday and monthly social drinks.

We are HG

HG is a leading European brand in specialist cleaning and maintenance products.

We believe a home should be a place where people can live carefree, with confidence in the products they use to care for the spaces and belongings around them. Our products are developed to do exactly what they promise: deliver effective, reliable and specialist cleaning solutions that help consumers solve real household problems.

HG’s mission is to help people enjoy their homes without worrying about what might go wrong. We do this through high-quality products, specialist expertise, clear advice and a relentless focus on performance.

We are dedicated to delivering superiority, innovation, quality and customer satisfaction. With a strong presence across Europe and beyond, we are continuously investing to make an even bigger impact.

HG does what it promises.


Do you have any questions?

Our colleague Ilse de Groot, Corporate Recruiter, will be happy to answer any questions. You can contact her at

Would you like to apply for the junior business controller position at HG? You can apply directly by uploading your CV. We aim to respond within 5 working days.

Acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated.

arbeitnow:hr-stagiaire-almelo-111104.description:
Als HR‑Stagiair(e) draai je bij ons mee in het HR‑team en krijg je de kans om veel te leren, met een duidelijke focus op Learning & Development. Je werkt mee aan verschillende HR- en L&D‑activiteiten en krijgt daarnaast de ruimte om je stage zelf vorm te geven en te ontdekken welke andere HR‑onderwerpen jou aanspreken. Zo doe je brede praktijkervaring op in een omgeving waar veel gebeurt en waar je actief kunt bijdragen.


Jouw stage:

Je werkt mee in ons team van 10 HR‑professionals met expertise in o.a. onboarding, L&D, verzuim, recruitment, employer branding en HR‑advies. Je krijgt veel vrijheid én goede begeleiding om jezelf te ontwikkelen.

Waar draag je aan bij?

  • Het versterken van vaardigheden en ontwikkeling binnen de organisatie door mee te werken aan L&D‑projecten.

  • Het soepel laten verlopen van soft skills trainingen, door ondersteuning bij voorbereiding, communicatie en coördinatie.

  • De verbetering van HR‑processen door het initiëren en uitvoeren van eigen HR‑projecten (bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van onboarding, recruitment of procesoptimalisatie).

  • Events rondom arbeidsmarktcommunicatie, workshops rond duurzame inzetbaarheid en onboardingsactiviteiten.

  • Een correcte en overzichtelijke HR‑administratie, zoals het opstellen van contracten, brieven en personele mutaties.

  • Continue verbetering binnen HR door actieve deelname aan HR‑overleggen en het meedenken over verbeteringen.

Onze organisatie beweegt snel: er gebeurt veel en geen week is hetzelfde. Dat biedt enorm veel leerkansen, maar vraagt ook dat jij zelf richting geeft aan je stage en je weg vindt in een dynamische omgeving. Je krijgt van ons goede begeleiding, maar het is aan jou om kansen te zien en initiatief te tonen.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken een stagiair(e) die:

  • Een hbo‑opleiding HRM volgt (3e of 4e jaar) en stage wil lopen vanaf februari 2027.

  • Beschikbaar is voor 4 of 5 dagen per week.

  • Geïnteresseerd is in Learning & Development.

  • Sterk is in Nederlands en goed overweg kan met Engels.

  • Nauwkeurig werkt, durft te vragen en zelfstandig durft te handelen.

  • Het leuk vindt om in een dynamische omgeving te werken waar veel gebeurt.

Wij bieden:

  • Stageplek per september 2026 voor 32-40 uur per week.

  • Begeleiding van ervaren HR-professionals.

  • Stagevergoeding van € 650,- per maand op basis van 40 uur.

  • Meedoen met ons Be-Fit programma; wekelijks sporten met collega’s.

  • Ook gewoon een superleuke tijd!

Over Benchmark

Benchmark in Almelo maakt onderdeel uit van de multinational Benchmark Electronics Inc., een beursgenoteerde onderneming op het gebied van het vervaardigen van elektronica en het leveren van diensten richting original equipment manufacturers (OEM’s).

Bij Benchmark werk je voor bedrijven die impact maken met hun innovaties. Zo ontwikkelen we nieuwe producten die de veiligheid of gezondheid verbeteren of juist het gemak vergroten. Deze producten worden geleverd vanaf het productontwerp tot en met productie en soms ook rechtstreeks aan de eindgebruiker. Dit gehele proces wordt geheel in Almelo uitgevoerd.

Wereldwijd heeft Benchmark Electronics Inc. momenteel 23 vestigingen. Op onze vestiging in Almelo werken we samen met zo’n 675 collega’s.

Interesse?

arbeitnow:android-engineer-amsterdam-442.title: Android Engineer
arbeitnow:android-engineer-amsterdam-442.description:
Who are we?

We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging.
Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive.

As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in.

Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we’re proud of. We’re committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow.

About the role

Aquablu's products run Android in more places than your pocket. Our dispensing systems ship with Android-powered on-device software that hundreds of thousands of people touch every day, and our mobile apps put hydration in users' hands. As our Android Engineer, you work across that whole surface.

Your main arena is on-device: the software running on the hardware itself, where Android meets the physical world. Screens people tap on a machine, software that talks to firmware, updates that roll out to hundreds of deployed systems in the field. Alongside that, you contribute to our mobile development where the products need it. Few Android roles give you this range.

This is a hands-on engineering role in a small, fast team. You own features end to end and deliver them reliably, reaching out to your manager when support is needed to unblock you. You build with AI agents as your default collaborator, you work cross-functionally with hardware, firmware, and product, proactively identifying and reaching out to key players that can help filling any gaps.

This role reports into our Head of Digital Product, and is part of Aquablu’s Software & Intelligence Engineering team.


What You'll Build & Own

  • On-device Android software: Features on the user-facing software running on our dispensing systems — UI, device behaviour, and the integration layer where software meets hardware. You own your features end to end.

  • Fleet-ready releases: Contribute to releases that update reliably across hundreds of deployed devices in the field, where a broken release means a technician visit. The riskiest releases get a second pair of senior eyes — and you learn what makes them safe.

  • Hardware & firmware integration: Work with embedded and firmware engineers to define and implement serial APIs (UART), that expose device state and trigger mechanical actions.

  • Mobile contribution: Support Android development on our consumer app where the roadmap needs it.

  • AI-native development: Build with AI agents every day and keep pushing what that lets you ship.

What You Bring

  • Solid Android engineering experience: A minimum of 3-5 years building and shipping Android apps in Kotlin, with a solid grasp of the platform (lifecycle, concurrency). You should be able to judge which Android patterns fit a non-standard system, and to design features that contribute to a scalable, reliable system.

  • Curiosity for Android beyond the traditional mobile world: kiosk, embedded, or AOSP work is a strong plus. Pragmatic problem solver who’s comfortable working outside of familiar mobile patterns.

  • Work independently on well-scoped tasks. When scope is unclear, flag it, reach out to the right people, and get the answers and support you need to unblock yourself. Plan the work, communicate progress early, and deliver end to end.

  • AI-native coding is how you work. You build with AI agents daily, you have a sharp setup, and your output shows it. If your last six months of work doesn't look meaningfully different because of AI, this isn't your role.

✨ Why join us?

  • 💰 A salary between 66-89k yearly (incl. 8% holiday allowance)

  • 📈 Equity through our Aquablu for All plan: it's not just about shares, it's about shared success.

  • 🏋️ Urban Sports Club Membership

  • 🌱 Healthy (heavily discounted) lunches

  • 🎯 Purpose with Impact: shape how the world hydrates while wiping out single-use plastics.

  • 📋 Scale-up pace means fresh challenges (and new skills) every quarter.

  • 🤝 Join an ambitious, bold, and fun crew that's always got your back.

  • 🌱 Company-sponsored gym membership keeps mind and body in sync.

  • 💰 Pension plan with Zwitserleven (50/50 split) so you grow while your savings do, too.

  • 🎵 What kind of vibe can you expect at our office? Check out our very own Spotify playlist "Akwablues"

  • 🎬 Curious about our story & culture? Check our documentaries on Youtube!

Everfield: Senior Data Engineer

The Company

Everfield is a platform with a mission in acquiring, building, and operating vertical market and specialist software companies, focused on European businesses. We invest in and provide support and best practices to software companies in order for them to live up to their full potential by offering a very established approach to promote growth.

Everfield is looking to be the leader in European Vertical and specialist software solutions across myriad niche industries who provide mission-critical applications, service, and support to their clients.

Everfield seeks to deliver innovation and growth to its acquired companies by providing best practices and operational support to help identify opportunities and install proven methodologies to accelerate customer and market share. Everfield is located throughout Europe, with offices in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, France, Poland, Spain, and Latvia.

The Position

As a Senior Data Engineer at Everfield, you will leverage your expertise and experience to:

  • Continuously improve scalability and stability of our data platform called the Lakehouse

  • Create new data pipeline solutions on various data sources (ERP, CRMs, etc.)

  • Design and model data in a common data model and Kimball-style dimensional models, making it ready for consumption in Power BI and other tools

  • Further developing Lakehouse Lumen, our MCP server that makes Lakehouse data available to Claude for end users

  • Improve existing solutions to improve value add for various stakeholders

You’ll be working as part of the Business Intelligence (BI) team. Currently the team consists of a Lead Data Engineer, three Data Analysts and a hands-on team lead. The BI team creates value for various stakeholders (CEO, Finance, COO, Sales, Marketing, and Everfield’sportfolio companies), by creating insights, delivering analysis, automating reporting processes and improving data quality.

The team builds pipelines with Azure Databricks and Azure Synapse Analytics to ingest the data into our data platform, uses Azure Databricks for data transformation, Power BI for data visualization and Azure Container Apps to expose data via a MCP server to Claude. For most solutions, the team uses Python and SQL.

For many use cases we work in an agentic way, using Claude to plan and implement them. To support this, we built the "Lakehouse DevKit". A set of agents and skills that we plan to keep extending and improving.

This role is hybrid from Amsterdam area.

Responsibilities

Adhere to the DevOps methodology by:

  • Collaborate with the Lead Data Engineer and Team Lead to plan and prioritize tasks.

  • Develop data pipelines in Azure Databricks and Azure Synapse Analytics, along with data ingestion and process scripts using PySpark and Pandas, while managing version control through Git.

  • Improve and extend the MCP server that provides data to Claude.

  • Create unit tests, test your own work and review work of colleagues (via Pull Requests), to ensure quality control.

  • Extend the Lakehouse DevKit to support and accelerate agentic development workflows.

  • Enhance and maintain deployment pipelines to facilitate smooth releases to end users.

  • Monitor the data platform (including data pipelines, ingestion/processing jobs, and alerts), while continuously improving logging and monitoring practices.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Hard Skills

Required:

  • 3+ year of experience as Data Engineer, and 5+ years of professional experience within Data or related fields.

  • Expert in PySpark and Pandas for data processing.

  • Experience with Databricks for advanced analytics.

  • Strong knowledge of SQL and data modeling (especially star schema).

  • Familiarity with financial systems (ERP, NetSuite, SAP) and/or experience with CRM systems and customer data.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Claude Code (agents, skills)

  • Knowledge of Power Query and Power BI for data visualization.

  • Experience deploying Azure resources like Azure Container Apps.

Soft Skills

  • Independent Worker: Ability to operate autonomously while contributing effectively to team goals.

  • Business Acumen: Strong understanding of business and economic principles, with an ability to apply them in a data context.

  • Analytical Mindset: Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills.

  • Collaborative: Actively seeks alignment with team members and participates in planning sessions.

  • Quality-Focused: Committed to reviewing both your own work and that of others to maintain high standards.

  • Strategic Planner: Consider alternative solutions and refine features before implementation.

  • Purpose-Driven: Demonstrates a deep understanding of tasks, ensuring they align with business objectives.

What’s in it for you?

  • Grow your career in a fast-paced and growing organization.

  • Enable growth by building a robust and scalable data platform.

  • Working with the latest Data Engineering & Data Modeling technologies.

  • Long term career opportunities.

  • Working from home for up to 4 days per week.

  • Flexible work environment with offices around Europe (Netherlands, UK, Spain, France, Poland, Germany).

Continue the Conversation

Interested? We would love to hear from you!

Apply now with your CV, and if you are selected, our Talent Manager will contact you to schedule the first call and start our hiring process.

Do you want to help an entire organisation turn AI opportunities into solutions that deliver real business value, while still being the person who gets hands-on and builds those solutions?

As Senior AI Solution Specialist at Sunweb Group, you take the lead on our more complex AI initiatives. You turn ambiguous business challenges into working prototypes and scalable solutions, while actively building, configuring and testing those solutions yourself.

You’ll join our five-person Architecture team and work closely with the AI PMO, connecting business teams with architecture, product, engineering, data and security.

This is a hands-on senior technical role, not a purely strategic, architectural or people-management position. Seniority here means tackling more complex challenges, having greater autonomy and impact, and helping others grow. We’re looking for someone who has recent practical experience building technical solutions and wants to continue doing so. You’ll design, prototype, configure, integrate and build, while also providing technical direction when needed.

Location: Rotterdam (Hybrid – 50% in office)
Start Date: January/February 2027

Availability: Fulltime

Your impact

  • Lead complex AI discovery
    Turn unclear, cross-functional or strategically important business challenges into concrete AI opportunities. Take them from problem definition and validation through to a working prototype.

  • Build AI solutions yourself
    Design, develop, configure and test agents, assistants and automated workflows that connect different departments, data sources and systems. You won’t only define what should be built or hand it over to others. You’ll be actively involved in building it.

  • Shape enterprise AI initiatives
    Identify when an AI solution needs to move beyond experimentation into a business-critical or customer-facing product, and work with product and engineering teams to make that transition successful.

  • Design for production
    Define solution architecture, integrations and non-functional requirements, while considering scalability, security, supportability, cost and business value.

  • Create reusable AI patterns
    Develop approaches for grounding, identity, integration, monitoring and evaluation that can be reused across teams, and identify opportunities for shared AI capabilities.

  • Coach and challenge others
    Review solutions, share technical expertise and coach colleagues and business users. You’ll work closely with our AI Solution Specialist and help raise the quality of AI solutions across Sunweb Group, while remaining an active builder yourself.

  • Strengthen responsible AI
    Contribute to our AI framework and guardrails, promote responsible use of AI and help create visibility around our AI initiatives.

Who you are

You’re curious, pragmatic and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You combine strong technical judgement with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

You know the difference between an impressive AI demo and a solution that creates measurable business value. You enjoy working independently, bringing different perspectives together and sharing what you learn along the way.

Most importantly, you’re a builder. You enjoy getting hands-on with technology, experimenting, developing prototypes and turning ideas into working solutions. You may have led technical initiatives, defined architecture or coached others, but you haven’t moved away from building things yourself, and you don’t want to.

What you bring

Must-haves

  • A proven track record of delivering complex AI, automation, integration, data or cloud solutions

  • Strong solution design skills across applications, APIs, identity, data, integrations and cloud services

  • Experience taking ambiguous business problems from discovery through prototyping, testing and solution design

  • Experience defining architecture options, non-functional requirements and production readiness

  • The ability to translate between business needs and technical possibilities

  • Confidence working with business leaders, architects, product owners and engineers

  • Strong technical leadership skills, with the ability to review, challenge and coach others without stepping away from hands-on delivery

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector search and enterprise knowledge solutions

  • Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, OAuth, connectors and/or MCP

  • Development or scripting experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C# or PowerShell

  • Experience working with AI agents, assistants or orchestration workflows

  • Experience in the travel or tourism industry

Our technology

Our AI and technology landscape includes Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Power Automate, Teams, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Azure AI services, Microsoft Foundry, ChatGPT/OpenAI, Claude/Anthropic, MCP, Entra ID and Git.

Let us introduce Sunweb Group  

Sunweb Group is one of Europe’s largest online travel agencies, sending over 1.3 million holidaymakers annually to unforgettable destinations. Operating in eight international markets, we cater to all travelers through our brands, Sunweb and ‘Eliza Was Here.’ With a team of 600 colleagues and operational hubs in Rotterdam, Girona, Paris, Copenhagen, Stockholm, Antwerp, Chambéry, and Zurich, we deliver seamless, high-quality holiday experiences at competitive prices. Our Fast Forward culture fosters focus and trust, enabling us to shape the future of holidays while helping our customers press pause and create lasting memories.   

Why join our journey?

  • Monthly gross salary between €6500,- and €8000,- plus 6 ATV days (based on full-time employment, excluding 8% holiday allowance). Please note: ATV days do not apply to part-time contracts.

  • Enjoy up to 20% off when booking with our brands for you, your family, and your friends.  

  • As an international company we support a hybrid way of working. We provide you with office furniture and IT equipment. 

  • We enjoy the journey so enjoy 25 holidays based on fulltime employment. 

  • Access to LinkedIn Learning and a personalized Reflect & Develop Plan to support your career growth.  

  • Benefit from coaching sessions designed to support your well-being.  

  • Receive work-from-home and travel allowances to ease your daily routine.

arbeitnow:software-engineer-python-cloud.description:
Build the software behind large-scale battery storage

Solar and wind power are not always available when we need electricity. Large-scale battery storage helps by storing electricity when supply is abundant and releasing it when demand rises. This keeps the grid flexible and reduces reliance on fossil fuels.

But how do you connect a battery site of hundreds of megawatts to a central IT platform? And how do you build software that is ready for the projects still to come? As a Software Engineer at GIGA Storage, these are the challenges you will work on.

About GIGA Storage

Founded in 2018, we are an international scale-up growing across the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany. Our purpose, ‘Unlock every Green Watt’, is about making the energy system better and more affordable for future generations. We aim to have 1.5 to 2 GW of battery power operational by 2030. At 2 GW, that is theoretically enough peak power to supply more than a million homes simultaneously.

We pioneer at a scale where many solutions are still being developed. We take ownership, share knowledge and make decisions together. Rapid growth also calls for adaptability: priorities shift and not everything is defined in advance.

Your role

You develop and grow our Giga platform. You build software in Python, working with technologies including SQL, Terraform, Grafana and data processing. You do not need to know everything already: you enjoy learning beyond your own specialism.

What will you work on? When a new battery site goes live, data on capacity, performance and equipment status needs to flow reliably into our platform. You build the software and integrations that make this happen. At the same time, you strengthen the foundations: fewer manual steps, better-documented code and reusable solutions for future sites. We work by the principle ‘you build it, you run it’. You can propose tools and improvements; important technical decisions are made together with the team and our IT Lead.

What will you do?

  • Build software. Develop and maintain Python services and integrations for new battery sites.

  • Make data reliable. Build and improve data pipelines, quality checks and monitoring.

  • Work smarter. Automate repeatable tasks and improve documentation, standards and maintainability, using AI tools where useful.

  • Own what you build. Test, deploy and support your software, and discuss technical improvements with the team.

  • Add knowledge, creativity and fun to the IT team.

What do you bring?

  • Higher professional education (HBO) level of thinking and working, and at least four years of relevant software development experience.

  • Python experience; one year may be sufficient if you have also programmed in other languages.

  • Experience with at least one cloud platform: GCP, AWS or Azure.

  • Interest in data engineering and DevOps; Terraform, SQL and CI/CD knowledge is a plus.

  • A broad technical mindset, ownership and a willingness to automate, document and share knowledge.

  • Good English communication skills and availability to work from our Amsterdam office at least three days a week.

Energy-sector experience and Dutch language skills are not required.

Why join GIGA Storage?

  • Visible impact. Your software helps bring new battery sites into operation.

  • Technical variety. Combine software, data and cloud while broadening your skills.

  • Room to contribute. Help automate our platform and prepare it for the next stage of growth.

  • Build together. Join five international IT colleagues in our new Buitenveldert office, close to Amsterdam Zuid.

What do we offer?

  • A competitive salary plus holiday allowance (8%)

  • A fixed year-end bonus (7-9%) and performance-related bonus (max 10%).

  • 28 days of annual leave for full-time employment

  • A pension plan.

  • A €750 annual learning budget, laptop, phone allowance and e-bike scheme.

  • Hybrid working: at least three days a week in our Amsterdam office; choose home or office for the remaining days.

  • Healthy lunches and occasional fun activities

Ready to build with us?

Want to develop software that matters while working on the energy transition? Apply through our website. We look forward to meeting you!

This is not your typical AE role. You'll be joining a high-performing commercial organization with real ownership, real impact, and uncapped potential to hit your goals. It's a role for an ambitious closer looking for a high-growth company that's redefining the global food industry.

Why you should join us

  • Own Your Success: You have complete control over the sales cycle. No silos, no hand-holding; just real responsibility and the opportunity to make a massive impact.

  • Work With Customers Around the World: Start your morning with prospects in Asia, connect with European decision-makers by midday, and close deals in the Americas in the afternoon. You'll gain exposure to international markets and sharpen your skills across cultures.

  • Hone Your Sales Mastery: You'll be selling to procurement managers, some of the toughest negotiators out there. This isn't just another sales job; it's an elite training ground for top-tier closers.

  • Supported by a Top Marketing & BDR Team: Our demand gen engine is strong. You'll work alongside a highly effective marketing team and a dedicated BDR team that books you qualified meetings with ICP accounts. Cold calling works in our business.

  • We Invest in Your Growth: We regularly bring in trainers, run the internal Vesper Academy, and provide coaching to sharpen your pitch, negotiation, and closing techniques.

What you will bring

  • Industry Knowledge: You've worked in the Market Intelligence industry before and understand the value we deliver to our clients.

  • Full-Cycle Sales: You'll own the end-to-end sales process: running high-impact discovery calls and demos, demonstrating value through proofs of concept, and converting prospects into paying customers. Our sales methodology is called Value-Based Selling.

  • Strategic Targeting: You'll work closely with BDRs to refine messaging, target high-value accounts (€1bn+ revenue), and optimize our approach to maximize conversions.

  • Closing Deals: You'll multi- and single-thread accounts, design the right subscription packages, navigate complex negotiations, and secure high-value contracts with key decision-makers (VP and C-level).

jobicy:164481.title: Senior Security Engineer, Offensive Security
jobicy:164481.description:
Role Description

As a Senior Offensive Security Engineer within Dropbox Security, you will investigate how attackers could compromise our products and infrastructure, including AI-enabled applications and agentic systems. You will help identify meaningful attack paths and improve the controls intended to prevent, detect or contain them.

This is a hands-on offensive security and threat research role with broad scope and meaningful impact. You will independently define and lead complex investigations and multi-phase red team exercises, prioritize work based on risk, develop new attack techniques, and build tooling and automation that expand the reach of our security testing. You will combine practical AI security expertise with broader offensive security skills across applications, cloud infrastructure, and identity systems. Working closely with Product Security, Detection & Response, Threat Intelligence, Privacy, and engineering teams, you will translate technical findings into clear business risk, recommend practical improvements, and validate their effectiveness through retesting. Sound judgment, clear communication, responsible execution, and ownership through verified outcomes are essential to the role. You will help shape the Red Team’s technical direction while strengthening its tools, research methods, and testing practices. Alongside experienced researchers, you will bring your own areas of expertise, investigate emerging technologies, and advance Dropbox’s offensive security capabilities, with opportunities to deepen your expertise, publish research, and see your work directly influence security decisions across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute offensive security assessments by defining objectives, scope, rules of engagement, and safeguards, adapting your approach as new evidence emerges.
  • Investigate unfamiliar applications, infrastructure, APIs, and trust boundaries to identify and trace meaningful attack paths.
  • Develop and safely demonstrate exploits and attack chains that clearly establish potential impact to Dropbox.
  • Build and improve offensive security tools, agents, automation, and testing harnesses, ensuring results are reliable, repeatable, and appropriately validated.
  • Assess security risks across AI-enabled applications, agents, tool integrations, and supporting infrastructure, including the responsible use of AI-assisted research techniques.
  • Partner with security, privacy, legal, and engineering teams to communicate risk, strengthen prevention and detection capabilities, address root causes, and verify improvements through retesting.
  • Share research, mentor colleagues and improve the team’s methods through lessons from completed work.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 9+ years in offensive security, vulnerability research, red teaming or closely related security engineering, or equivalent demonstrated capability.
  • A track record of independently leading complex investigations or engagements and discovering and exploiting non-trivial vulnerabilities.
  • Understanding of application security, authentication and authorisation, cloud infrastructure, APIs and software supply chains, with deep practical expertise in one or more areas and the ability to trace attack paths across systems and trust boundaries.
  • Hands-on experience attacking or evaluating LLMs, AI agents, ML systems, AI-enabled applications, or agentic architectures.
  • Familiarity with security risks in AI-enabled applications, agents and tool integrations, and the ability to investigate unfamiliar technologies.
  • Ability to write code to build or adapt offensive tools and automation, and to read and investigate unfamiliar production codebases.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing novel attacks, repeatable security evaluations or testing frameworks for AI-enabled systems, or building and validating AI-assisted offensive research capabilities.
  • Expertise across multiple attack surfaces, or advanced specialist capability in areas such as exploit development, reverse engineering, endpoint security, cloud exploitation or software supply-chain attacks.
  • Experience developing automated vulnerability discovery, fuzzing, program analysis or evaluation systems across large codebases or complex environments.
  • Experience conducting coordinated exercises with defenders to measure detection and response effectiveness and validate improvements against realistic attack techniques.
  • Contributions through original research, vulnerability disclosures, open-source tools, technical publications, internal training or mentoring.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

The focus of this role is around owning stability and deployment of our internal databases. Supabase’s internal databases are the backbone of our service offerings. You will play a critical role in architecture and optimizations of the databases in partnership with the platform service teams, both strategically and tactically.

In this role, your primary responsibilities will include:

  • Automation and Improvement to operations, including infrastructure as code and scripting

Familiarity with extensions, performance optimization, and best practices is essential. Experience with connection management (RDS proxy, Pgbouncer, Supervisor) is a huge plus.

We anticipate you to be a dynamic self-starter, thriving in asynchronous collaboration across diverse teams. Your knack for spotting areas of improvement and commitment to realizing those enhancements will be key. You'd rather ship a safe, incremental fix today than wait for the perfect redesign next quarter.

What you’ll do

  • Drive best practices across service teams; assisting with migrations and operations

  • Own tooling and solutions within the Supabase ecosystem.

TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.

Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.

We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.

At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.

The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

We are looking for an analytical and commercially minded Lead Growth Analyst to join our Marketing Analytics team. Our aim is to help the business understand what is driving growth, where performance is changing, and where the biggest opportunities and risks are.

In this role, you will lead analysis on some of our most important growth questions. You will take ownership of analytical workstreams end to end, from framing the business question and exploring the data through to clear recommendations and supporting execution.

A key part of the role will be helping teams make better growth and investment decisions. You will bring together signals from channel performance, customer behaviour and experimentation to understand what is driving performance.

You will partner closely with Growth, Marketing and Product teams, acting as a trusted thought partner.

Key responsibilities

  • Drive end-to-end analysis on priority growth questions, from problem definition through to recommendation and measurement.

  • Proactively identify and investigate changes in growth performance, including the key drivers, risks and opportunities behind them, rather than waiting for questions to be handed over.

    Identify and size growth opportunities across channels, customer journeys and Product.

  • Support investment decisions by bringing together MMM, channel performance and customer behaviour.

  • Build clear growth narratives from complex analysis, translating data into concise, understandable insights with a strong “so what”, and clearly articulating the implications and actions for stakeholders.

  • Contribute to wider commercial questions such as forecasting, pricing and scenario analysis where they materially affect growth.

  • Build scalable analytical approaches that improve the speed, consistency and quality of decision-making.

  • Act as a trusted analytical partner, bringing a clear analytical point of view that shapes key growth decisions.

  • Own key stakeholder relationships and help ensure analytical recommendations are followed through into action and measurable impact.

  • Mentor other analysts and help raise the analytical bar across the team.

Experience and competencies

  • Significant experience in growth, marketing, or commercial analytics within a digital, marketplace, subscription or consumer technology business.
  • Strong understanding of growth, customer acquisition, funnel performance and the interaction between Marketing and Product.
  • Experience analysing customer journeys across multiple stages of the funnel, including cohort behaviour, lifecycle performance and longer conversion or nurturing journeys.
  • Good knowledge of marketing effectiveness approaches such as MMM, incrementality testing, experimentation and attribution.

jobicy:157445.title: Senior Product Manager, Data Products
jobicy:157445.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

When the world's largest organizations bet on Mural, Govern & Trust is the team that earns that trust at scale. We build the experiences that help enterprises roll out Mural with confidence, keep it secure, and see the impact it has on how their people work. Data sits at the center of it all. Admins are Mural's most demanding data consumers: they need to prove ROI to their leadership, guide adoption across thousands of people, and account for every action. If data products can meet their bar, they'll work for everyone.

Mural has a modern data platform, strong data engineering and analytics teams, and a wealth of data on how teams collaborate. The next step is treating that data as a product in its own right, with a dedicated owner for what it means and how it's used.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Product Manager you'll define the metrics that describe how Mural creates value, and make them the shared foundation for everything built on top. The same definitions will power internal product decisions, the Insights experience Admins use in the product, and the reporting API and MCP server that customers and AI agents query.

This role starts upstream. You'll work from raw product events to decide what each metric should measure, how it's calculated, and what the data needs to look like for customers and internal teams to rely on it. Then you'll turn those metrics into experiences that help organizations understand and grow their use of Mural.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • The evolution of data products. Shape how Mural's data products move from reporting on what happened to guiding what happens next. Work across the Govern & Trust portfolio to define how insights become part of how organizations run Mural.

  • The metric layer. Define Mural's shared, cross-product metrics, like activity, collaboration, and adoption. Set the standards that let product teams define and publish their own metrics consistently. Data Engineering builds and runs the layer; you shape what goes in it and how it evolves.

  • Internal product analytics. Be a thought partner to domain PMs as they set their north-star metrics, and make product data easy for them to explore on their own. Work with Business Analytics to keep product-facing and business-facing reporting working together.

  • Customer-facing data products. Own the strategy and roadmap for Insights: in-product reporting and dashboards, exports and APIs, audit logs, and the methodology behind every number customers see.

  • AI and agent access. Package and launch Mural's customer-facing reporting MCP server: which data it exposes, which plans get it, and what guardrails apply. Define how natural-language and agent-driven analysis extends Insights.

  • Instrumentation. R&D teams own emitting events. Your job is to raise the bar on what they emit. Set per-product requirements for granularity and retention, which differ for audit logs, activity data, and product analytics. Partner with Data Engineering on event standards so metrics start from good data.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including shipping at least one analytics or reporting product used by paying business customers. You defined the metrics behind it, not just the UI.

  • A track record of making messy or conflicting data trustworthy: reconciling competing definitions, writing metric specs engineers could build from, and getting instrumentation changed upstream.

jobicy:157444.description:

AlphaSense is the market leader in AI driven search and due to client demand, AlphaSense is expanding our Enterprise Suite Team. jobicy:157442.title: Account Executive, Influencer Marketing
jobicy:157442.description:
Position: Account Specialist
The Account Specialist position is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel may be required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events. Please note: This position requires verbal and written fluency in German.

The Role:
As an Account Specialist, you will provide white glove service to diverse brands investing in influencer marketing campaigns. This role is particularly focused on campaign execution, including but not limited to driving influencer recruitment, managing influencer partnerships, and owning campaign deliverables, tracking, and reporting. The Account Specialist will also drive strategy by analyzing campaign performance, identifying success areas and/or challenge areas, and proactively implementing strategic measures to continuously optimize programs towards goals and objectives.
The successful candidate will have strong experience in developing and managing successful, KPI-driven influencer marketing campaigns for consumer products and/or services companies. They will have working knowledge of the overall partner marketing landscape, including affiliate, and the ability to both develop comprehensive strategy as well as capably execute. The successful candidate will be a self-starter that can confidently plug in to any challenging situation with ease and can balance competing priorities well. The Account Specialist must be flexible, willing and able to pivot quickly, and excited to operate successfully in an “intrapreneurial” situation. This person will also have a history of working well with their peers, quickly establishing relationships easily and leading through influence.

You’ll work closely with your manager and peers to maximize program effectiveness and create opportunities for growth.

Top 5 Responsibilities:

  • INFLUENCER RECRUITMENT, NEGOTIATING & ONBOARDING –Sources new partnership opportunities and creates influencer casting lists. Diligently vets opportunities to ensure brand alignment, authenticity and relevancy prior to presenting to client for approval. Conducts outreach to approved partners and skillfully garners their engagement and participation in the campaign, negotiating when necessary. Supports influencers through campaign onboarding by developing and providing resources to streamline processes.
  • INFLUENCER PARTNERSHIPS MANAGEMENT – Crafts program-wide influencer communications and vital creator resources. Guides influencers on content strategy and creation. Works with influencers to develop content timelines and ensures influencers stay on track with the schedules discussed. Collects content drafts and leads the content review process, including screening to ensure FTC guidelines are met. Closely works with influencers to adjust content strategy as needed, troubleshooting any signs of poor performance to optimize campaign towards goals and objectives.
  • AUDITING, REPORTING & ANALYSIS – Accountable for auditing program content to ensure compliance with FTC regulations and brand guidelines. Ensures content is tracked accurately and regularly shared with client, along with placement insights, partner insights, and campaign pace towards KPI goals. Performs robust analysis of influencer campaigns using both social analytics and conversion metrics to identify performance trends and areas of opportunity. Proactively provides actionable recommendations to client backed by data and continuously refines strategy to drive growth at scale. Supports team in creation of customized strategy plans, detailed campaign performance summaries and comprehensive hindsight presentations that are delivered to clients.
  • CLIENT SERVICE & COMMUNICATION- Consistently provides superior client service and escalates issues or key risks as appropriate. Works to ensure client develops trust in our team by delivering client outputs and communications in the AP way, consistently maintaining quality, accuracy, and precision. Develops and nurtures excellent relationships, supports team in promoting very high client satisfaction and retention rates, and an average 8.5 client rating.
  • PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT- Own and manage client tasks with minimal supervision, ensuring deadlines are met and tasks are completed accurately. Manages multiple campaigns with solid organizational skills and the ability to focus on and prioritize tasks based on client objectives, flagging any potential delays and keeping the team informed. Has full grasp of each client’s scope of work, delivering what is due under terms; maintains ability to identify new opportunities to drive client success while conjunctively identifying possible goal misalignments, getting to the root of an issue, and working with their team to bring solutions to resolve.

What Success Looks Like:
BY 3 MONTHS:

  • The Account Specialist is contributing across a portfolio of influencer programs, collaborating with their team closely to ensure strong alignment with the campaign strategy in place.
  • You are working with key client contacts to ensure brand alignment with recruitment efforts and content creation.
  • You have become familiar with AP’s tools and solutions and are equipped to conduct casting for prospective influencers, execute content timelines with influencers, audit content, and ensure performance is tracked and measured.

By 6 MONTHS:

  • You are owning execution of the day-to-day operations of multiple influencer programs with little guidance from your team, including reporting, processing applications, recruiting and casting creators, and crafting partner communications.
  • Challenging client or team situations are being managed with guidance from managers and directors collaborating closely to bring a solutions-oriented approach to these situations proactively.
  • You are regularly analyzing client data and strategically leveraging insights to optimize campaigns.
  • Client accounts are being handled effectively and strategically, without dropping any balls, and clients are aware of and pleased with this outcome. Clients are being serviced profitably with AP targets, client KPI’s being met, and an average 8.5 client rating is being upheld across campaigns.
  • You will regularly present new campaign ideas to managers and demonstrate a clear understanding of program performance

By 1 YEAR:

  • You will troubleshoot and resolve account and creator issues independently, providing valuable insights and actionable recommendations to clients and internal teams.
  • You will be an integral part of each program, developing new ideas and improving processes to create efficiencies.
  • You will take on new account responsibilities with support from your manager and serve as a thought leader within the team, contributing to relationship-building and firm development.

Qualities of the Ideal Candidate

  • Has a strong internal motivation to get the job done and done well
  • Only provides superior results and unsurpassed customer service
  • Exhilarated by managing change and comfortable with ambiguity and moving targets
  • Passionate about the digital marketing industry and how influencer relates to the greater digital landscape
  • Ensures that influencer strategies and tactics have measurable results
  • Has incredible attention to detail and is capable of multi-tasking and coordinating several projects at once
  • Translates data and insights into actionable next steps for clients
  • Strong with data analysis, is easily able to pinpoint issues and opportunities within a data set
  • Prioritizes competing objectives and manages time with skill
  • Displays accountability, always meeting deadlines and keeping commitments
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys bringing order to chaos
  • Likes to share and collaborate with peers in a remote environment
  • Possesses superior written and verbal communication skills
  • Possesses mature and measured judgment, and the ability to solve problems on their own
  • Works independently with minimal supervision
  • Has confidence, poise, and eloquence in client meetings and difficult situations
  • Hears and incorporates feedback from other team members, clients and partners

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Fluency in German
  • 2+ years working for an influencer marketing agency and experience executing influencer campaigns and managing both client and influencer relationships
  • Solid understanding of omni-channel and digital marketing, with a track record of successfully running influencer campaigns for consumer products and/or services companies
  • Excellent at communicating, presenting and approval from clients on new campaign strategies and initiatives
  • Working knowledge of attribution in digital marketing
  • Strong understanding of how influencer and affiliate marketing can work together
  • Tools (CreatorIQ, Grin, Izea, etc.) experience preferred, not required
  • Knowledge of Affiliate Networks or SaaS platforms (Impact, ShareASale, Commission Junction, etc.) experience preferred, not required
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
  • Ability to travel up to 15%
  • Advanced Excel capabilities and comfortable with formatting, formulas, customizing reports, etc.

WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?
Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing.

AP PERKS & BENEFITS - WHAT WE OFFER

  • 100% remote work for everyone
  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits)
  • 401K with matching
  • Open Paid Time Off
  • Summer & Holiday company-wide shut-down weeks in July and December
  • Volunteer and Birthday Time Off
  • Focus Fridays
  • Paid Parental Leave Benefits
  • Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances
  • Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!!
  • Target Salary is £27–37K depending on location and experience.

Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.

Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual’s age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

jobicy:157441.description:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

This role involves collaborating with the Partner ecosystem to develop and manage partnerships, help drive joint business development initiatives, and ensure effective communication and coordination with our channel partners.

  • Assist in coordinating and participating in joint business planning activities with partners.

  • You have a good understanding of the Australia and New Zealand market.
  • You are currently working in the SaaS industry, but working in Cyber Security and SaaSwill move you right to the top of the list.
  • Understanding of channel sales strategies and partner ecosystems.

  • Good CRM opportunity hygiene (Salesforce preferred).
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills and the ability to work cross functionally with presales, marketing, professional services, customer success etc.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to changing priorities and responsibilities.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to travel domestically as required and 1-2 international trips per year (US).
  • …and have fun and enjoy the ride working in a very high growth dynamic environment for a great company headquartered in Denver Colorado

Other:

  • Previous experience or exposure to channel sales, alliances management, or partner enablement is a must.
  • Interest in the software industry and identity access management sector.
  • Knowledge of marketing and demand generation practices.
  • Understanding of partner training and sales enablement processes.
  • Ability to analyse data and generate insights to drive partner performance.
  • Proactive and positive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.

Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

jobicy:157432.title: Senior Account Executive (Education) - ROMENA
jobicy:157432.description:
At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.

You’ll play a pivotal role in expanding the reach of the Instructure Learning Platform across the ROMENA region, helping Higher Education institutions and K-12 organizations modernize and simplify their approach to teaching and learning.

  • Ability to conduct detailed needs analyses and develop tailored proposals

jobicy:157404.title: Senior Business Value Engineer | UK | Remote
jobicy:157404.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Labs is seeking to grow our Business Value Engineer team and support defining, articulating, and quantifying business value across our products and services. As a member of the business value engineering team, you'll play a critical role in shaping the direction of this high-impact function.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Customer Insights: Collaborate with customers to uncover new opportunities for growth and profitability through personalized storytelling.
  • Value Quantification: Develop compelling ROI/TCO models that identify value areas driven by new products, emerging trends, and market challenges.
  • GTM Enablement: Enable pre/post sales teams through training, content development and support; ensuring our sales organization is equipped to showcase Grafana's value with customers.
  • Value Storytelling: Partner with cross-functional teams to create a unified narrative that showcases Grafana's value proposition, aligning internal stakeholders and external messaging.
  • Strategic Partnerships: Collaborate closely with Account Executives, Solutions Engineers, Observability Architects to define and articulate the business value of our products and services.

What Makes you a Great Fit:

  • Innovative Mindset: Possess a growth mindset, willing to learn new technologies and adapt quickly
  • Value Engineering Expertise: 3-5+ years of experience in value management, consulting, or engineering; deep understanding of building quantitative and qualitative analyses.
  • Data Storytelling Skills: Ability to analyze complex data sets, create compelling customer-facing stories, and communicate findings effectively from technical to executive level audiences.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Experience partnering with GTM leaders (Sales, Customer Success, Marketing & Finance) to define and align on Grafana's value propositions.

Bonus Points For:

  • 3+ years of Observability experience, preferably with Open Source tools like Grafana, Prometheus, or Loki
  • Familiarity with the Open Source landscape and community

If you're ready for a high-impact role that combines data analysis, storytelling, technology enablement, and partnership-building with cross-functional teams – we'd love to hear from you!

Compensation & Rewards:

In the UK, the OTE compensation range for this role is £130,000 - £155,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the role:

The VP of Partnerships, EMEA based in the United Kingdom will be responsible for defining and executing Cresta’s partnerships strategy across the EMEA region as a senior individual contributor. This role will focus on identifying, structuring, and closing high-impact strategic partner-led deals that accelerate customer acquisition, expand Cresta’s enterprise footprint, and drive revenue growth through partner resell and co-sell motions.

This senior leader will develop deep insight into regional market dynamics and build the foundational partner ecosystem across system integrators, resellers, BPOs, and technology partners. While this role does not include formal people management, it carries significant ownership and influence, requiring close collaboration with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success teams globally.

Success will be measured by partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue, new logo acquisition, expansion of product usage through partners, and the establishment of scalable partnership models that can be operationalized as the business grows.

Responsibilities:

Partnership Strategy & Execution

  • Define and execute the EMEA partnerships strategy in alignment with Cresta’s global objectives and regional go-to-market plans
  • Identify, prioritize, and secure strategic partnerships across system integrators, channel partners, BPOs, and complementary technology providers
  • Develop partner value propositions, commercial frameworks, and engagement models tailored to EMEA market needs
  • Establish repeatable partnership structures, playbooks, and success metrics that can scale over time

Channel & Revenue Impact

  • Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue through direct execution of partner-led deals
  • Work closely with regional and global Sales teams to integrate partners into account planning, co-selling, and deal execution
  • Support partners in positioning, selling, and delivering Cresta’s solutions, including joint value propositions and customer use cases
  • Own and report on partner-related pipeline, deal progression, and revenue outcomes in the EMEA region

Strategic Business Development

  • Personally lead high-value partnership discussions and complex commercial negotiations from inception through contract execution
  • Identify new routes-to-market and market entry opportunities via partnerships in both established and emerging EMEA geographies
  • Act as the primary point of contact for strategic partners in the region, managing executive-level relationships and ongoing collaboration

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to represent partner and market feedback, influencing roadmap and integration priorities
  • Collaborate with Marketing to develop joint go-to-market initiatives, partner messaging, and demand-generation activities
  • Work with Customer Success and Services teams to ensure successful partner-led deployments and long-term customer outcomes

Thought Leadership & Market Presence

  • Represent Cresta as a senior partnerships leader in the EMEA region with partners, customers, and at industry events
  • Maintain a strong understanding of competitive dynamics, buyer trends, and ecosystem shifts across the region
  • Provide strategic input to global partnerships leadership on regional insights and growth opportunities

Qualifications We Value:

  • 15+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, alliances, or enterprise sales within SaaS, AI, or enterprise software companies
  • Proven track record of personally sourcing, structuring, and closing strategic partnerships that drive revenue
  • Experience operating as a senior individual contributor with high ownership and autonomy in fast-growing or early-stage companies
  • Strong understanding of partner-led go-to-market models, including system integrators, resellers, and co-sell motions
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with C-level executives at partner and customer organizations
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to translate market insight into executable partnership initiatives
  • Highly self-directed, hands-on, and comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-paced environments
  • Deep familiarity with EMEA enterprise markets and cultural nuances (regional experience strongly preferred)
  • Willingness to roll up sleeves and do what it takes to drive results without formal team authority

  • We offer Cresta employees a variety of medical benefits designed to fit your stage of life
  • Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend
  • Paid parental leave to support you and your family

jobicy:157407.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰 £138,000 to £176,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | Hear from the team ✨

About the role

Borrowing is one of Monzo’s most important growth engines. We’ve built strong scale in the UK, and the next phase is even more ambitious: grow in the UK, expand into new customer segments, and build the underwriting capability needed to scale into Europe.

We’re looking for a senior ML leader to help shape that next phase.

You’ll lead a high-calibre team of ML scientists and help define Borrowing’s ML roadmap across UK growth, new customer segments, and EU expansion. You’ll work across underwriting, pricing, limits, and lifecycle decisioning — improving today’s models while helping build the next generation of capability for Monzo.

This role combines near-term commercial impact with long-term strategic advantage:

  • improving performance across our range of products
  • unlocking new data and faster model development
  • helping Monzo build underwriting that scales into new markets
  • shaping how advanced ML and AI can create real value in Borrowing

You’ll partner closely with leaders across Credit Strategy, Product, Engineering, Model Validation, Data, and Platform, and influence decisions that shape both business performance and the long-term architecture of credit decisioning at Monzo.

What you’ll own

  • Borrowing ML roadmaps across UK optimisation, new customer segments, and EU expansion
  • Faster model improvement through new data and feature engineering
  • How Monzo uses Open Banking, transaction intelligence, and external data in credit decisioning
  • More portable underwriting capabilities across products, customer segments, and markets
  • Hiring, leading, and developing a high-performing ML team
  • Raising the bar on model quality, governance, tooling, and speed of iteration

What you’ll be working on

Examples of the challenges you could help lead:

  • Improving underwriting models across Loans, Flex, and Overdrafts
  • Expand the data we use in our models
  • Building better feature engineering and model shipping capability
  • Improving transaction intelligence for credit use cases
  • Developing underwriting capabilities for new customer segments and EU markets
  • Shaping Monzo’s approach to advanced ML and AI

Our technology stack

We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies, although we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all of them:

  • Google Cloud Platform
  • BigQuery SQL and dbt
  • Python and the PyData stack
  • Google AI Platform
  • AWS
  • Python for ML services
  • Go for backend services
  • AI tooling for productivity
  • Google Workspace including Gemini
  • ChatGPT Enterprise
  • Claude Code

You should apply if

  • You want to shape the next phase of credit decisioning at one of Europe’s most ambitious fintechs
  • You enjoy combining strategic leadership with strong technical judgment
  • You’re excited by the intersection of underwriting, data, product, and platform capability
  • You like building teams as much as building models
  • You care about real customer and business impact

You must have

Credit and machine learning

  • Strong knowledge of machine learning, statistics, and decisioning systems
  • Deep experience in credit risk and lending
  • Experience building, deploying, and iterating credit models in production
  • Experience pushing the innovation frontiers of the credit industry

Leadership and delivery

  • Experience leading and developing senior ML scientists
  • Strong cross-functional leadership with Product, Credit Strategy, Engineering, and Validation
  • Track record of turning strategy into practical delivery in a regulated environment

It would be great if you also have

  • Experience across more than one market
  • Experience with advanced ML methods and AI on structured financial data

The interview process

  • 30 min Recruiter Call
  • 45 min Initial Call
  • 60 min ML technical interview
  • 60 min People Leadership interview
  • 60 min Product / Credit ML interview

All interviews will be conducted through Google Meet.

💰 £138,000 to £176,000 ➕ plus stock options & benefits

✅ We can sponsor visas
