jobicy:164414.title: Account Executive | HCLS | New Logo
jobicy:164414.description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you’ll do at Jamf

At Jamf, we empower people to be their best selves and do their best work. As an Account Executive focused on new logo growth in Healthcare & Life Sciences, you’ll open doors at organizations that don’t run Jamf today, build relationships with decision makers across IT, clinical, and research teams, and establish Jamf as a trusted partner in your territory. Your efforts will drive sales of our Whole Product Experience (WPE), build qualified pipeline from the ground up, and bring in new customers. You’ll work closely with Sales Development Representatives and Sales Engineers to take new business from first conversation to signed contract. As a member of the Jamf family, you’ll bring our high-energy, collaborative, and fun spirit to every deal.

This role if offered as remote in the Western & Midwest Territory. You may be required to work periodically at a Jamf office or collaborative work location with other Jamf employees in your area for certain events or moments that matter. We are only able to accept applications for those based in the Western & Midwest Territories and have sponsorship to live and work in the United States.

What you can expect to do in this role

  • Own the full sales cycle for net-new healthcare and life sciences accounts, from prospecting through close, presenting to multiple levels of each organization to demonstrate the value of Jamf’s full suite.
  • Build a targeted prospect list in your territory and create qualified pipeline through outbound research, referrals, and partner introductions.
  • Research each prospect’s environment, including Apple device fleets, compliance requirements, and clinical or research workflows, and partner with Sales Engineers to design solutions that fit.
  • Engage executives and key stakeholders early to position Jamf as a strategic option and turn first meetings into long-term customer relationships.
  • Build trusted relationships across the sales ecosystem, including Channel Partners and Apple, to open doors and co-sell into healthcare and life sciences organizations.
  • Forecast sales activity and revenue achievement monthly and quarterly, and share what you learn in the field to sharpen our approach to the vertical.
  • Leverage industry leading sales tech stack including SalesForce.com, Clari, Groove, ZoomInfo , LinkedIn Navigator, and much more

What we’re looking for

  • Minimum of 1 year experience in a sales role (Required)
  • Demonstrated ability to carry a quota and consistently meet or exceed targets (Preferred)
  • Proven experience prospecting and closing new logos, building pipeline without relying on an existing book of business (Preferred)
  • Minimum of 2 years health-tech, med-tech, biotech, or life sciences sales experience, including selling to health systems, hospitals, pharma, biotech, or research institutions (Preferred)
  • Minimum of 2 years software sales experience (Preferred)
  • Familiarity with the Apple ecosystem or SaaS sales is a plus, but not required.
  • #LIRemote

Education and certifications

  • HS Diploma / GED (Required)
  • 4 Year / Bachelor’s Degree (Preferred)
  • A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered

How we help you reach your best potential

  • Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News
  • Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Gen Z
  • Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024
  • Named a 2024 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Parents & Families
  • Named a 2024 PEOPLE Companies That Care by PEOPLE® and Great Place To Work®
  • We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf.
  • We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.
  • You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class, sales-focused Bootcamp gives you the technical and product knowledge to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.
  • We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.

Pay Transparency

At Jamf, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is set within a defined range. These ranges can vary based on hiring location. Where an individual's pay falls within that range depends on several factors, including role scope, location, budget, skills, experience, and qualifications. This approach helps ensure fair, competitive pay and provides room to grow as you develop in your role.

For sales and commission-based roles, we post On-Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus estimated commission based on achieving 100% of performance targets. Commission is not guaranteed and varies based on individual performance results.

The national pay transparency range below represents all U.S. locations and accounts for geographic differences in pay, resulting in a broader range.

National Pay Transparency Range

$58,100—$133,200 USD

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

What does Jamf do?
Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Get social with us and follow the conversation at #OneJamf

Jamf is committed to creating an inclusive & supportive work environment for all candidates and employees. Candidates with disabilities or religious beliefs are encouraged to reach out if they need additional support or alternative options to our recruiting processes to accommodate their disability or religious belief. If you need an accommodation, please contact your Recruiter or Recruiting Coordinator directly. Requests for accommodation will be handled confidentially by Recruiting and will not be shared with the hiring manager. Jamf is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against individuals who request reasonable accommodation for disability or religious beliefs. To request accommodations please email us at recruiting@jamf.com

jobicy:164413.title: Account Executive - Enterprise, Spotify Technology
jobicy:164413.description:
Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.

As an Account Executive on our Enterprise team, you will drive new business for Spotify Technology. You'll focus on organizations with 1,000+ employees, where engineering environments are complex, buying committees span engineering, finance, procurement, security, and legal, and large deals can take many months to close. Success in this role comes from long-term strategy: building account plans, developing deep relationships, and positioning our products as a strategic investment in how large engineering organizations work.

You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to close new business, expand existing customer relationships, and cross-sell products across our portfolio. Your ability to understand both the technical depth of our products and the strategic priorities of senior engineering and business leaders will be key to your success.

What You'll Do

• Identify and pursue new business opportunities with organizations of 1,000+ employees. This is a “Hunter” role with significant inbound and SDR support.

• Research and prospect into target accounts, building strategic account plans that map stakeholders, priorities, and opportunities for long-term growth.

• Lead complex enterprise sales cycles, proactively engaging multiple stakeholders, including CTOs, VPs of Engineering, Product leaders, platform teams, developer experience leaders, procurement, security, and legal.

• Build multi-threaded relationships across each account and develop multiple internal champions to secure new deals and support expansion over time.

• Achieve and exceed revenue targets while maintaining accurate pipeline and forecast data for long-cycle deals.

• Structure and negotiate agreements that support customer adoption, expansion, and long-term success.

• Articulate how Backstage Portal and Confidence solve developer experience challenges at scale, including how AI is reshaping software development in large organizations.

• Build business cases and return-on-investment (ROI) narratives that resonate with executive buyers.

• Partner closely with Sales Engineering on technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and integration planning.

• Collaborate with Customer Success to support retention and identify expansion opportunities across business units, while sharing customer feedback with Product and internal teams to help shape the roadmap.

• Travel up to 30% of the time to meet existing and prospective customers in your regional market, strengthen relationships, and support business growth.

Who You Are

• You have 5+ years of experience in a quota-carrying sales role, including experience selling enterprise software, ideally in SaaS, developer platforms, or cloud services.

• You have a proven track record of closing large, complex enterprise deals and achieving or exceeding revenue targets.

• You are experienced in strategic account planning, building multi-threaded relationships, and navigating long sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.

• You have experience selling to technical and executive stakeholders, such as CTOs, VPs of Engineering, platform teams, and DevOps leaders.

• You are familiar with software development, DevOps tools, or developer ecosystems, and understand how engineering organizations make buying decisions.

• You are comfortable managing procurement processes, security reviews, and legal negotiations for multi-year agreements.

• You can translate technical value into business outcomes and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• You bring strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills, along with a strategic approach to long-term account development.

• You are excited to help build a scalable sales motion with AI and enjoy working with innovative products in an evolving technology landscape.

Where You'll Be

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best!

For this role, you can be within the North Americas region as long as we have a work location.
This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration.

Compensation

Additional Information

The United States base range for this position is $110,392-157,704 plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays, paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

  • Serve as a credible, trusted advisor to C-level and senior decision-makers at target organizations, deeply understanding their strategic priorities and articulating exactly how Flex creates value for their borrowers and their business
  • Close complex, multi-stakeholder deals — structuring partnership economics that work for both parties while navigating legal, compliance, and procurement processes with urgency and rigor
  • Shepherd each partnership from signed agreement through technical deployment and go-live, working closely with Product and Engineering to ensure strong execution and early performance metrics
  • Translate partner feedback and competitive dynamics in the auto loan market into actionable input for Product, Marketing, and Pricing — continuously sharpening Flex's positioning and offering for the vertical
  • Build and refine the auto loan sales playbook — documenting learnings, establishing scalable processes, and developing the repeatable partner acquisition motion that enables efficient growth beyond initial market entry
  • Leverage AI-assisted sales tools to drive pipeline efficiency, inform competitive strategy, personalize outreach at scale, and accelerate deal progression — and set the standard for how the team uses AI to amplify sales impact

What you’ll bring

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise sales, business development, or strategic partnerships — with meaningful experience selling into or partnering with OEMs, dealership groups, auto lenders, auto insurtechs, or adjacent automotive platforms.
  • A track record of closing complex, first-of-kind deals in new markets, ideally involving embedded financial products, consumer payments, or BNPL programs in high-ACV, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Deep knowledge of the auto ecosystem: You understand the dynamics between OEMs, dealers, lenders, and consumers — and you know how payment flexibility fits into the purchase and ownership lifecycle.
  • Executive presence and influence: You've operated confidently at the C-suite level, building trust with senior decision-makers and navigating complex organizations to drive deals to close.
  • Financial and legal acumen: You can build and defend deal models, structure partnership economics, and negotiate agreements — balancing commercial rigor with pragmatic deal-making.
  • High agency and comfort with ambiguity: You're energized by building in undefined spaces, don't wait for direction to take initiative, and bring clarity and momentum to evolving situations.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: You've successfully aligned Product, Engineering, and Marketing around partner priorities and used those relationships to accelerate deal outcomes.

Compensation

The compensation range for this role will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and Flex's internal leveling guidelines and benchmarks. This is a commission earning role. The OTE (On Target Earnings) listed below:

OTE (NYC/Bay Area, Los Angeles, Seattle)

$262,000—$330,000 USD

OTE (Austin, Washington D.C. Philadelphia, San Diego, Chicago, Atlanta)

$232,000—$296,000 USD

OTE (Salt Lake City, all other USA cities)

$221,000—$279,000 USD

Life at Flex

Building a successful company takes a diverse team of intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self-aware people. Our headquarters is in New York City, with employees across the US, Australia, Canada, and South America. We’re growing quickly and deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture. We value the perspectives our people bring and take pride in being an equal opportunity workplace.

Offices

Benefits

jobicy:164411.title: VP, Sales
jobicy:164411.description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer

Location: Remote, US (Eastern time zone preferred)

Work model: Remote, with travel of approximately 30–40%

Salary range: $175,000 – $190,000 USD base salary, plus uncapped variable with accelerators

About Agile Fleet

Agile Fleet is a leading provider of fleet and motor pool management software that helps organizations improve vehicle utilization, reduce costs, and streamline operations. Our platform, FleetCommander, supports more than 250 customers, including federal agencies, state and local governments, higher education institutions, utilities, and commercial fleets across North America. We are a profitable, remote-first vertical SaaS company. FleetCommander is the only motor pool reservation and fleet management platform with FedRAMP authorization, and our cooperative purchasing contracts make us easy to buy.

The Opportunity

You will own our revenue number and lead the next stage of growth. This is a player-coach role for a proven public-sector sales leader who runs a disciplined, predictable revenue engine, ideally one who has also won in the commercial market.

You are accountable for net bookings, forecast accuracy, pipeline health, and growth of our customer base. You will lead the sales team, personally run our most strategic pursuits, and report to the CEO as a member of the Executive Leadership Team.

Marketing and Customer Success also report to this role. It's a lean, hands-on team, so the full customer revenue engine (new logos, expansion, and renewals) sits with one leader. Expect to spend roughly 40% of your week coaching and leading the team, 30% selling personally, and 30% building how we sell.

We run the company on EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System), managed in Bloom Growth, and you will run your teams the same way. You will do well here if you understand RFPs, contract vehicles, and long public-sector buying cycles, and still run a disciplined forecast every week.

Why Agile Fleet

  • Own the full revenue engine. Sales, marketing, and customer success with a direct line to the CEO, in a role built to grow as the company grows.
  • Lead the go-to-market for what's next. New tiered packaging, keyless vehicle access, and AI-powered reporting.
  • A defensible market position. Sell the only FedRAMP-authorized motor pool reservation and fleet management platform to a loyal customer base and a large, stable public-sector market where we already hold the contract vehicles.
  • A permanent owner. A profitable company backed by Banyan Software, which buys, holds, and grows software businesses for the long term.
  • A community of peers. Join Banyan's global community of sales leaders, with peers, playbooks, and resources across its portfolio.
  • Real influence. A collaborative, accountable team, competitive compensation (uncapped variable, with accelerators), and real influence on how we grow.

What You Will Own

Revenue and Forecasting

  • Own the company net bookings plan across new logos, expansion, and renewals; set quotas and territories that add up to plan
  • Run the weekly forecast and pipeline review; deliver accurate monthly and quarterly commits and explain any variance above 10% with a recovery plan
  • Keep Salesforce the single source of truth for stages, net bookings reporting, deal inspection, and activity standards
  • Drive pricing and discount discipline, including our tiered packaging at new sales and at renewal
  • Build the annual sales plan with the CEO and Finance; partner on compensation plan design and accurate commission payment
  • Own the sales, marketing, and customer success budget, including COMMAND and events, and manage it so the spend more than pays for itself in net bookings

Strategic Selling

  • Personally lead a named list of strategic pursuits across federal (FedRAMP), state, county, municipal, university, and large commercial fleet opportunities
  • Build pursuit plans for RFPs, sole-source, and cooperative purchasing (Sourcewell, GSA, and reseller channels), working with Legal, Delivery, and Finance on contracts, pricing, and terms
  • Build executive relationships with fleet directors, procurement officers, CIOs, and business officers
  • Represent the Agile Fleet brand at several fleet-industry and public-sector conferences each year, such as the NAFA Institute & Expo and Government Fleet Expo, turning each one into qualified pipeline
  • Turn channel and technology partnerships (telematics, keyless access, resellers) into sourced pipeline, and bring customer and RFP feedback into product planning
  • Put our existing AI agents to work for outbound prospecting, deal inspection, and Salesforce hygiene, and check their output against the system of record

Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop account executives and account managers: inspect deals, join calls, and raise the team's skill in discovery, demos, negotiation, and closing
  • Run sales, marketing, and customer success on our EOS cadence in Bloom Growth: set and deliver quarterly Rocks, own weekly scorecard measures, run weekly team meetings, and use IDS (Identify, Discuss, Solve) to resolve issues
  • Get the most from the current team: set clear expectations, manage performance, and reward results; recommend structure changes as the business grows
  • Hire well when roles open, onboard quickly, and build the enablement that gets new sellers productive quickly

Marketing, COMMAND, and Customer Success

  • Marketing: Lead a small marketing team focused on qualified pipeline: target-account programs, campaigns, events, website, content, and sales enablement, measured on pipeline and cost per opportunity
  • COMMAND conference: Own COMMAND, our annual customer conference, every year: agenda, customer content, attendance, budget, and the expansion and renewal pipeline it creates
  • Customer Success: Lead a small Customer Success team focused on retention and expansion: renewal forecasting, at-risk account plans, business reviews, and churn prevention, in partnership with Customer Delivery

What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months

  • Team delivers the annual net bookings plan, with net recurring revenue making up at least 55% of net bookings
  • A forecast leadership can rely on: the quarterly commit lands within 10% of actual
  • Pipeline coverage of at least 3x the forward-quarter target, with slipped deals held under 15% of quarter-open pipeline
  • Steady new-logo growth across government, higher education, and commercial fleets: at least one new logo per month
  • Protect and grow a loyal customer base: keep churn low and grow net revenue retention above 100% (toward 110%) through renewal pricing, tier upgrades, and expansion
  • Profitable growth that meets or exceeds the Rule of 50 (EBITDA margin plus net recurring revenue growth), with sales and marketing spend that more than pays for itself in net bookings
  • Every seller productive and earning their commission on plans tied to net bookings

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • 10+ years of B2B SaaS sales, including at least 5 years leading quota-carrying teams
  • Proven, recent success selling to the public sector (state and local government and/or higher education), including RFPs, contract vehicles, cooperative purchasing, and long, multi-stakeholder buying cycles
  • Hands-on player-coach: you lead a quota-carrying team and still coach and close deals personally
  • Forecasting discipline: you can show how you called the quarter and how close you landed, with command of Salesforce reporting and pipeline management
  • Has led, or held clear accountability for, sales together with marketing and/or customer success
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Ability to travel approximately 30–40%: about half a dozen conference weeks a year (heavier in the first half) plus customer visits, including some travel to Canada and potential international travel

Strongly Preferred

  • Commercial enterprise (private-sector) sales experience in addition to public sector
  • Federal selling experience, ideally with FedRAMP-authorized or other compliance-authorized solutions
  • A record of meeting or beating team targets at a company of roughly $5M to $50M in recurring revenue, with numbers you can walk us through
  • Strong financial acumen: net bookings, annual recurring revenue (ARR), net recurring revenue, net revenue retention, gross margin, and EBITDA, and how pricing, discounting, and product mix affect each
  • Hands-on use of AI in sales leadership: tools or agents for prospecting, forecasting, or pipeline management

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in fleet management, telematics, transportation, mobility, asset management, or government technology
  • Experience selling combined hardware and software solutions, such as key management or keyless vehicle access
  • Experience in a private-equity-backed company
  • Existing relationships with fleet, transportation, or procurement leaders in government and higher education
  • Experience operating on EOS or a similar cadence of quarterly priorities and weekly scorecards; familiarity with Bloom Growth or Ninety is a plus

Compensation

The expected base salary for this position is: USD $175,000 – $190,000 excluding variable compensation (on-target earnings of approximately $250,000 at plan). Variable compensation is uncapped, with accelerators, and is tied to company net bookings across new logos and existing customers, with net recurring revenue and customer retention guardrails. Salary is based on a number of factors including market conditions, location and may vary depending on job-related skills and experience.

jobicy:164410.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Robotics
jobicy:164410.description:
Build the Path Forward

At Path Robotics, we’re building the future of embodied intelligence. Our AI-driven systems enable robots to adapt, learn, and perform in the real world closing the skilled labor gap and transforming industries. We go beyond traditional methods, combining perception, reasoning, and control to deliver field-ready AI that is risk-aware, reliable, and continuously improving through real-world use.

Big, hard problems are our everyday work, and our team of intelligent, humble, and driven people make the impossible possible together.

We're seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Robotics team. You'll use machine learning to improve how our robots plan, scan, and act. You'll frame real robot problems as well-defined ML problems, train models on data that a fleet of production robotic cells generates every day, and ship them into a production stack where they work alongside classical planning and perception. Your models run on live robots doing real work for customers.

What You'll Do

  • Frame open-ended problems in planning, scanning, and robot behavior as well-defined ML problems.
  • Train models that work with classical methods, such as initial guesses and learned costs for trajectory optimization, plan quality and feasibility predictors, and learned collision models.
  • Develop viewpoint planning policies that choose where and how to scan, and predict scan quality before the robot commits.
  • Apply imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and generative models such as diffusion and flow matching where they outperform classical baselines.
  • Build production ML pipelines: datasets from fleet logs and simulation, training, and metrics.
  • Evaluate models in the loop, with offline metrics that predict gains on the robot, failure-mode analysis, and calibrated confidence that determines when the system falls back to classical methods.
  • Own your models end to end, from prototype to deployment on live robotic cells, with low-latency inference and monitoring.

Who You Are

  • An MS or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of applied machine learning for robotics or autonomy, in research or industry.
  • Fluent in Python with PyTorch or JAX, and experienced training, evaluating, and deploying deep learning models.
  • Strong foundations in linear algebra, 3D geometry, kinematics, and optimization.
  • You've run your methods on real robot hardware.
  • You explain model results and their limits clearly, so planning, perception, and field teams know when to trust them.

Preferred

  • C++, and experience deploying models into a C++ or ROS 2 production stack.
  • Motion planning, trajectory optimization, or collision checking.
  • Active perception, next-best-view or informative path planning, or 3D point cloud learning.
  • Uncertainty estimation and calibration, or Bayesian and information-theoretic planning.
  • GPU inference optimization (CUDA, TensorRT, ONNX).
  • Simulation and sim-to-real transfer (Isaac Lab, MuJoCo).
  • Publications at RSS, CoRL, ICRA, IROS, NeurIPS, ICML, or similar venues.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Daily free lunch to keep you fueled and connected with the team
  • Flexible PTO so you can take the time you need, when you need it
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 6 weeks fully paid parental leave, plus an additional 6–8 weeks for birthing parents (12–14 weeks total)
  • 401(k) retirement plan through Empower
  • Generous employee referral bonuses—help us grow our team!

Who We Are

At Path Robotics we love coming to work to solve interesting and tough challenges but also because our ideas are welcomed and valued. We encourage unique thinking and are dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application process or any part of the hiring process, please contact HR@path-robotics.com. We are committed to providing equal access and will work with qualified individuals to ensure a fair and accessible hiring experience. We will respond to your request within 48 hours.

jobicy:164409.title: Head of Channel Sales & Alliances
jobicy:164409.description:
Job Title: Head of Channel Sales & Alliances

Location: United States, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Revenue is complex, and clarity is rare. Our mission at Salesloft is to transform revenue complexity into clear, decisive action for every team driving growth.

We’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, where humans and AI work together to make confident decisions based on real signals. Thousands of customers run on our platforms every day, which gives us Revenue Context: a view into what happens in a deal, when, and with what outcome.

Our vision is a future where revenue growth is predictable and the teams driving it are unstoppable. If you want to help build it, alongside people who Move as One and let Evidence over Ego guide the work, we’d love to meet you.

THE OPPORTUNITY
Own the partner channel that sources a meaningful share of Salesloft’s new closed-won revenue.

As our Head of Channel Sales & Alliances, you'll build and run a quota-carrying Channel Sales & Alliances organization focused on four motions: private equity partnerships, cloud marketplace and strategic platform alliances, ISV and MCP partnerships, and VAR, BPO, and services partnerships. The primary measure is closed-won revenue sourced through partners, supported by partner-influenced revenue and the retention and expansion of partner-sourced customers. Relationships, programs, and pipelines are critical in producing signed deals. You will be the executive face of Salesloft to our most strategic partners and the owner of the plan, the team, and the results.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

Private Equity Partnerships

  • Build relationships with private equity firms and their operating partners to position Salesloft as the revenue platform for their portfolio companies.
  • Structure portfolio-wide agreements and programs that turn a firm-level relationship into sourced, closed-won deals across multiple portfolio companies.
  • Work with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to run portfolio-specific plays, from the initial introduction through close.

Cloud Marketplace and Strategic Platform Alliances

  • Own Salesloft's go-to-market with AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, including marketplace listings, private offers, and co-sell programs that let customers buy against their existing cloud commitments.
  • Build strategic alliances with the CRM and productivity platforms our customers run on, such as Salesforce, Microsoft, and HubSpot, including their app and agent marketplaces.
  • Turn platform relationships into sourced and co-sold pipeline by aligning with these partners' field sellers, not only their partner teams.

ISV and MCP Partnerships

  • Identify, recruit, and sign independent software vendors and AI platforms that integrate with, embed, or distribute Salesloft, including through MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations and agent ecosystems.
  • Define co-sell and co-marketing motions with ISV partners so that integrations produce sourced pipeline and closed-won revenue, not only technical listings.
  • Work with Product and Engineering to shape the partner integration roadmap and make sure partners can build, launch, and sell with confidence.
  • Design partner economics for AI and agent partners, including revenue share on usage- and consumption-based pricing alongside seat-based models.

VAR, BPO, and Services Partnerships

  • Recruit and onboard value-added resellers and business process outsourcing providers that resell, bundle, or deliver Salesloft as part of their sales services.
  • Recruit systems integrators and RevOps consultancies that influence enterprise buying decisions and deliver implementations, and build a services partner motion that speeds time to value and improves retention.
  • Negotiate reseller and partner agreements, pricing, margin structures, and business terms that support profitable, repeatable revenue.
  • Equip partner sellers with value-selling playbooks, competitive positioning, and qualification criteria so deals are sourced and closed consistently.

HOW YOU’LL WORK HERE

  • Move as One: You’ll partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Legal, and RevOps on joint plays and partner attribution, and share credit for partner-sourced wins.
  • Evidence over Ego: You’ll plan, forecast, and report on partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue using real signals, and say so when the data changes your mind.
  • Lead from the Front: You’ll be the executive face of Salesloft to strategic partners and set the quotas, coverage models, and standards your team is held to.
  • Make Your Mark: You’ll shape how Salesloft shows up in private equity, cloud marketplaces, ISV and MCP ecosystems, and services channels, not just run the playbook.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
You’re a senior partner and alliances leader who has sourced and closed partner-driven revenue in B2B SaaS and led teams to quota. You build the relationships and programs that turn into signed deals, and you are credible with C-level partners and technical teams alike. If you want to learn more, do more, and become more, this is your next move.

YOU’LL BRING

  • 12+ years of experience in partner sales, channel sales, alliances, or business development in B2B SaaS, with senior leadership experience managing teams
  • A track record of sourcing and closing partner-driven revenue and meeting or exceeding quota, with results you can describe in terms of closed-won revenue
  • Experience building or working with private equity relationships, ISV or technology integration partnerships, cloud marketplace and co-sell programs with AWS, Microsoft, or Google Cloud, or VAR, BPO, and services channel programs. Experience in more than one of these is strongly preferred
  • Experience building a partner program from the ground up, or rebuilding one after a merger or acquisition
  • An established network of private equity operating partners and portfolio company leaders
  • Familiarity with AI, API, and MCP-based integration ecosystems, and the ability to talk credibly with technical partners about how Salesloft fits
  • Proven ability to negotiate complex partner, reseller, and revenue-sharing agreements
  • Ability to coach and lead a team, including setting quotas and holding people accountable to them
  • Strong sales acumen and fluency with CRM and partner tools such as Salesforce, partner relationship management platforms, and account-mapping tools, including building partner attribution models. SaaS experience is required
  • Executive presence, including comfort presenting at conferences, events, and webinars and influencing C-suite stakeholders
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives across Product, Marketing, and Revenue teams

THE TEAM
You’ll lead the Channel Sales & Alliances team of partner sales and alliance professionals and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Legal, and RevOps. It’s a place to grow as the executive owner of a channel plan, a team, and the results.

BENEFITS:

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a competitive, holistic benefits program designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health at every stage of your life and career. For full details on coverage options, wellness incentives, and perks, explore our benefits overview at https://salesloftbenefits.com/

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

#LI-Remote

Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Salesloft will come from @ salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.

It is Salesloft’s intent to pay all Lofters competitive wages and salaries that are motivational, fair and equitable. The goal of Salesloft’s compensation program is to be transparent, attract potential employees, meet the needs of all current employees and encourage employees to stay with our organization.

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location.

The total compensation package for this position may also include performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.

Base Pay Range

$195,000—$262,000 USD

jobicy:164408.title: Director, FP&A
jobicy:164408.description:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the role

Every device we ship starts with a forecast. We're hiring a Director to own how we forecast product demand, from the topline view of the business down to the units we need to build and stock. This is a senior, hands-on role for a sharp, curious problem solver. Our data is rich but complex, spread across many systems and broken down by product, region, channel, and customer segment. Both new products and existing products entering new markets launch with little or no history. You'll set the strategy and do the work yourself, using AI and automation to get the reach that would normally take a team. You'll be the senior forecasting partner to Finance, Sales, Product, and Supply Chain leadership, and your numbers will drive what we build, buy, and stock. You don't need to be a supply chain expert. We care more about how you think than about years spent in operations. If you're strong at forecasting, great with complex data, and learn fast, we'll help you learn the supply chain side.

What you'll do

  • Own the topline product forecast. Build and be accountable for the forecast by product line, connecting pipeline, bookings, and subscription trends to the hardware units those deals require.
  • Set the forecasting strategy. Define how we forecast and plan across the company: the process, cadence, systems, and tooling roadmap (including connected planning platforms such as Pigment).
  • Forecast new product introductions. Own launch forecasts for products with no sales history, using analogs, pipeline signals, pricing, and adoption assumptions. Plan cannibalization, transitions from legacy products, and end-of-life ramps.
  • Forecast every product in every market. Build forecasts for each product as it enters new geographies and segments, where adoption curves, pricing, sales channels, competition, and regulatory requirements can differ sharply from markets we already know. Decide when to borrow from established markets and when local signals should take over.
  • Translate forecast into unit demand. Break the topline down accurately by SKU, region, and channel, and keep it current as the business changes.
  • Connect complex data into one view. Bring together detailed data from multiple systems (CRM, ERP, shipments, activations) into a consistent picture of demand. Partner with data and systems owners to strengthen how that data flows into forecasting.
  • Scale with automation. Build repeatable pipelines, scripts, and AI-driven workflows so the forecast refreshes quickly and reliably as the business grows.
  • Turn demand into inventory plans. Partner with Supply Chain on build plans, safety stock, and weeks-of-supply targets, balancing the cost of running out against the cost of holding too much.
  • Lead the monthly demand review. Present scenarios, risks, and assumption changes to executives, and drive alignment on a single demand plan.
  • Own forecast performance. Set accuracy and bias targets, report on them, explain misses, and keep improving the process.

What you need

  • 8+ years in forecasting, demand planning, FP&A, analytics, or a similar quantitative role.
  • You pick up new business models and processes quickly and are energized by figuring out how things work.
  • Skill with complex, disaggregated data. A track record of pulling together detailed data from multiple sources, reconciling it at different levels of granularity, and turning it into forecasts leaders trust.
  • Strong SQL or a comparable tool. You've built processes that run without manual rebuilding each cycle.
  • Experience forecasting new products or new markets where history is thin, choosing sensible analogs, and adjusting quickly as real launch data comes in.
  • You use AI tools (LLMs, coding assistants, agents) every day as your default way of working: to write and debug code, clean data, build models, and draft analysis. You can show concrete examples of work AI made faster or better, and you know how to check AI output before trusting it.
  • You understand concepts like lead times, safety stock, and inventory levels, even if you haven't worked in supply chain directly.
  • You've owned an important process end to end and driven decisions across teams without formal authority.
  • You can explain a forecast, its assumptions, and its risks to senior leadership in plain language and defend it under pushback.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Pigment (or another connected planning tool such as Anaplan or Adaptive Planning).
  • Experience in a SaaS business: subscriptions, ARR, attach rates, and how bookings translate into device shipments.
  • Prior new product forecasting at a hardware + software company, including launch ramps and legacy product transitions.
  • Experience forecasting international or new-market expansion, where each region has its own adoption pattern, channels, and requirements.

What success looks like

  • First 90 days: You understand our products, data sources, and current forecast process. You have a documented baseline forecast, a clear map of the data that feeds it, and a forecasting roadmap agreed with leadership.

jobicy:164406.description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

About Us:

Loan Vision is a PE backed (Banyan Software) high growth tech firm focused on providing loan-level accounting software designed to serve the mortgage banking industry. Since launching at the MBA Technology Solutions Conference and Expo in 2013, Loan Vision has helped reduce risk, streamline manual process, and lower operating expense for over 270 customers by combining a leading financial management solution with loan level accounting. Loan Vision strives to help transform accounting departments across the mortgage industry, aiding them in reaching maximum efficiency and offering tools to give them better insight into their profitability. We believe that every mortgage bank should have instant access to the financial information needed to make quick, strategic decisions and pride ourselves on providing, not only just the right tools, but also the right implementation approach and ongoing support to allow customers to maximize their use of our software. For more information, please visit: www.loan-vision.com. Our superior technology resides on the Microsoft Dynamics platform and is hosted in Microsoft Azure. This combination has allowed Loan Vision to grow to over 270 customers, including some of the top mortgage lenders in the nation and a growing base of banks.

In June of 2023, Loan Vision CEO/Founder Martin Kerr and Banyan Software appointed Paul J. Loftus to the CEO position to lead the next phase of hypergrowth. Having spent the majority of his career in technology and serving the accounting profession, Loftus was named to the 2014 40 Under 40 Honoree list by CPA Practice Advisor. His diverse experience spans 16 years at ADP directing go-to-market strategies, launching new tax and accounting cloud technology at Wolters Kluwer, and occupying the Chief Revenue Officer role at high-tech companies has uniquely positioned him to lead Loan Vision’s next phase of growth.

Position Summary

As an Account Executive focused on the Banking vertical, you will drive net-new business with regional and mid-sized banks and credit unions. Many of these institutions still manage loan-level accounting and profitability reporting in Excel and BI tools. This is a complex, consultative software sale: you will prospect and open doors yourself, build relationships with CFOs, Controllers, and other senior finance leaders, run discovery that uncovers their real accounting and reporting challenges, demo the product yourself, and guide each opportunity through a multi-stakeholder sales cycle to close.

Your impact will directly drive the growth of Loan Vision, giving you the opportunity to not only achieve substantial earnings through a competitive compensation package but also play a significant role in shaping the future of the mortgage finance industry.

jobicy:164404.description:
Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

About the Role:

We are looking for a highly skilled and proactive Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (Full Stack & AI) to work directly with business stakeholders, identify operational challenges, and design and implement AI-powered solutions that improve business efficiency.

jobicy:164403.title: Enterprise Account Director
jobicy:164403.description:
Job Title: Enterprise Account Director

Location: United States, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Salesloft, our Enterprise Account Directors are pivotal to our company's success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing sales team and will be our boots-on-the-ground solution to building personal relationships and making our customers successful. We believe that the most successful sellers have a passionate and supportive team behind them.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for:

  • Full-Cycle Account Ownership: Acting as the primary commercial lead for a portfolio of large-scale enterprise accounts, driving full-cycle accountability for high-value renewals, expansion opportunities, and complex cross-sell transactions.
  • Driving Net-New Revenue: Relentlessly identifying and closing net-new revenue within your install base. You will navigate complex organizational structures to displace incumbents and introduce new product lines, maximizing Total Contract Value.
  • Strategic Account Planning: Architecting and implementing sophisticated account success plans that align our technology's value proposition with specific business units and their long-term alignment between their business goals and our solutions.
  • Proactive Retention Management: Monitoring account health and usage patterns to identify potential churn risks early, implementing "save" strategies to protect existing recurring revenue.
  • Executive Relationship Building: Building a "multi-threaded" network of stakeholders. You will move beyond the day-to-day users to secure buy-in from VP and C-level executives, establishing yourself as a credible business partner.
  • Executive Business Reviews (EBRs): Leading regular business reviews with key stakeholders to demonstrate realized ROI, socialize new product capabilities, and ensure the platform remains indispensable to the client's evolving tech stack.
  • Forecasting & Pipeline Accuracy: Maintaining a rigorous, data-driven sales process. You will provide leadership with high-confidence forecasts for both expansion bookings and retention.
  • Market & Competitive Intelligence: Staying up to date of industry trends and competitor movements to effectively position our value proposition against market alternatives.
  • Orchestrating Internal Resources: Leading a cross-functional team (Solutions Engineers, Customer Success, and Product) to ensure your accounts receive a cohesive experience, effectively acting as the one accountable for all customer-facing initiatives.
  • Voice of the Customer (VoC) Advocacy: Synthesizing client feedback and market friction points to provide actionable insights to the Product and Engineering teams, influencing the roadmap to better serve the "Install Base" and drive future expansion.

In addition to working with amazing colleagues who live our core values every day, you will also have the opportunity to sell an impactful and revolutionary software that is changing the way sellers sell. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

We are seeking a results-oriented, motivated, and strategic Enterprise Account Director. You are a growth-minded advocate who is laser-focused on deepening and expanding relationships within our existing customer base. You don't just manage accounts; you hunt for untapped potential, identifying new use cases and scaling our footprint across organizations.

Specifically, you will play a pivotal role in helping us become an anchor technology company by securing high-value renewals and winning expansion deals that propel you past your quota.

If you're passionate about sales technology, obsessed with delivering a world-class customer experience, and thrive in a fast-paced, hyper-growth startup environment, then this is the career path for you!

THE TEAM:

Our Salesloft Enterprise Team is comprised of motivated sales professionals.

Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired.

The Enterprise Account Director team consists of results-oriented SaaS sales professionals with a strong desire to win. The ADs on our team share a few common traits: they are self-motivated, ambitious, and passionate about evangelizing the future of sales innovation.

THE SKILL SET:

  • 7+ years of proven relationship building and closing experience in a sales environment.
  • Experience establishing strategic C-level relationships
  • Ability to run a full sales lifecycle, start to finish, within the Enterprise segment
  • Experience executing detailed product presentations and web demonstrations of our software capabilities to C-level executives, directors, and sales managers
  • Adept at identifying and utilizing internal resources (Sales Engineers, Customer Success, Support etc.) to build Salesloft brand awareness, assist in sales cycles, and close deals.
  • Collaborative mentality by prioritizing 'we' and not focusing on 'me.'
  • Superb listening skills; you must understand objections and defeat them by turning sceptics into ecstatic new customers
  • High level of empathy - it's important for our AD's to be a good person to peers and prospects.
  • Experience managing, expanding, and renewing customer relationships.
  • Consistent overachievement of quota and revenue goals.
  • Proven ability to make strong connections and overcome rejection to achieve results.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct compelling on-site and virtual presentations to C-Level executives.

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you're excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

#LI-Remote

Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Salesloft will come from an @salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page (https://salesloft.com/company/careers/).

Why We Need You:

Findem is looking for a Senior UX Designer for a 6-month contract to help shape the experience of our AI-powered recruiting products. You’ll focus on the craft that makes software feel intuitive and complete: refining workflows, sharpening interactions, and bringing a cohesive, polished feel to products that customers use every day and that we put in front of prospects in demos.

As we scale our agent platform, you’ll design and ship new agentic patterns, defining how users direct, review, and collaborate with AI agents inside their daily workflows. You’ll also help define how our team uses AI tools in its own work, building an AI-native process that brings design and engineering closer together and shortens the path from idea to shipped experience.

As part of the Executive Search team, you’ll work daily with Product and Engineering and get in front of customers early. You’ll prototype with them, help win deals, and see your work through to production, so you can point to the deals and shipped features your designs made possible.

What You'll Do:

  • Leading-edge design for agentic and UX experiences across RRA, RaaS, and Exec Search.
  • Agent artifact design and experience — how multi-agent interactions and agent outputs are shaped, presented, and interacted with.
  • Early customer prototype UX and implementation (Exec Search exploratory work).
  • UX design and user workflows for RRA SaaS.
  • Committing UX code polish PRs (front-end polish only — no back-end code or API contracts).

Your Working Experience:

  • 5+ years designing and shipping digital products, with a portfolio of live, shipped experiences (not just concepts or handoff mocks).
  • Track record of moving quickly from idea to prototype in ambiguous, early-stage contexts.
  • Preferred: 0-to-1 or exploratory product work, ideally in SaaS or B2B.
  • Preferred: comfort collaborating directly in an engineering codebase and workflow (Git, PRs, design QA).
  • Portfolio and demonstrated ability weighted above formal credentials.
  • Bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Strong UX and interaction design fundamentals: user journey mapping, information architecture, and turning complex workflows into simple, intuitive flows.
  • Proven design-systems experience — building and applying reusable components consistently across multiple surfaces.
  • Hands-on front-end proficiency: comfortable committing polish-level PRs in a modern stack (React/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, component libraries), including responsive behavior, empty/loading/error states, motion, and accessibility.
  • Ability to take work from idea to design to working prototype, reusing existing services and APIs rather than building them.
  • Preferred: experience designing for AI-native or agentic products — agent artifacts, streaming outputs, chat/canvas interfaces, human-in-the-loop review, and non-deterministic states.

Compensation

Our compensation range reflects the cost of labor across multiple U.S. geographic markets. The base salary for this role is listed below by location, and the exact amount offered will depend on your skills, experience, and work location.

jobicy:164401.description:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that connect the dots across different functions and stakeholders. You will be the driving force behind high-impact, high-visibility strategic initiatives that are critical to scaling our business by facilitating communication and collaboration between departments to ensure alignment and effective execution.
  • Create robust analytical models and dashboards to provide actionable insights into go-to-market and product performance. You will take a hands-on approach to proactively identify trends, opportunities, and risks, translating data into clear recommendations for optimizing commercial results - leveraging AI throughout the process to drive scale and efficiency.
  • Champion operational efficiency by continuously identifying and addressing process inefficiencies - you never stop asking “can we be doing this better?” Design and implement innovative solutions to streamline workflows, enhance productivity, and drive a culture of continuous improvement across the organization.

What We're Looking For:

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in consulting, banking, private equity, or Strategy & Operations, combined with in-house at a SaaS company
  • Recent experience at a hypergrowth and rapidly scaling SaaS company
  • Recent Bachelor's degree required; MBA is a plus
  • Advanced communication, presentation, and organization skills
  • Executive presence and comfort communicating with the C-suite
  • Exceptional spreadsheet / data management skills, SQL proficiency preferred
  • Expert with Google Sheets & Excel, with the ability to build data models
  • Proficient in AI tools and comfortable leveraging AI to maximize effectiveness of daily work
  • Intellectual curiosity supported by exceptional analytical skill
  • Strong, demonstrated leadership capabilities
  • Experience working on cross-functional projects with various stakeholders and a demonstrated expertise in managing such projects
  • Able to work in ambiguous, fast paced, environments under tight and unpredictable timelines

jobicy:164399.title: Federal Emerging Partner Business Developer (BD)
jobicy:164399.description:
Radar Reinvented.

Echodyne offers the world’s first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

Echodyne is seeking a Federal Emerging Partner Business Developer (BD) to join our fast-growing team.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Federal Emerging Partner BD plays a critical role in supporting and enhancing the effectiveness of the sales team focused on federal accounts. This role involves partnering with Federal End Customer & Regional Sales Managers (RSMs) to identify opportunities, provide specialized knowledge, and drive strategic sales initiatives for Echodyne radars. The Federal Emerging Partner BD will work alongside the sales team to engage with prime/partner/integrator clients, develop tailored solutions, and support the sales process from lead generation to closing deals. They will be responsible for delivering high-impact presentations and demonstrations, addressing complex customer inquiries, and staying up-to-date with industry trends, product developments, and the competitive landscape. The ideal candidate has a proven track record in sales within the federal sector, exceptional interpersonal skills, and a deep understanding of the UAS / CUAS markets.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Function as a Counter-Drone SME, collaborating with Regional Sales Managers (RSMs) and BD personnel to advance Echodyne sales efforts with key Remote Weapon Systems (RWS) players.
  • Act as an overlay while aiding BD and RSMs in initiating and advancing sales activities.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal teams, including RSMs, Solutions Engineers (SEs), and BD personnel, as well as engage with customers to understand their needs and advance sales efforts.
  • Identify internal and external support needed to cultivate strategic partnerships.
  • Conduct high-level conversations with senior executives at prospective partners and customers.
  • Follow direction from the CRO and sales leaders while collaborating with RSMs, SEs, and BD personnel.
  • Work remotely, with travel as necessary.
  • Operate on a global scale.
  • Perform other related tasks as required to fulfill the needs of the business.

REQUIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE

  • Expert understanding of Counter-drone systems, especially in the non-kinetic and airborne interceptor space
  • Organized and detail-oriented with excellent follow-up skills
  • Demonstrated technical acumen and the ability to articulate technical concepts
  • Experienced in owning meetings/presentations at executive levels
  • Ability to work in a cross-functional team
  • Ability to travel up to 50%

DESIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE
(Looking for one or more as a complement to the core skills)

  • Bachelor of Science degree; preferably in Engineering/Science discipline (with MBA a plus)
  • Experience with perimeter security solutions
  • Experience working with federal partners/integrators
  • Expertise with RF and radar technology
  • Experience with UAS solutions and hardware

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5 years (minimum) of full-cycle, complex sales
  • 2 years (minimum) of experience representing technical hardware solutions

Echodyne’s technology is export controlled by the U.S. Government and we must evaluate an applicant’s eligibility to handle export-controlled information or obtain required Government authorizations.  Therefore, we will ask you as part of the application process to identify whether you are a U.S. Citizen or green card holder, or have asylum/refugee status in the U.S.

WHAT WE OFFER

The base salary for this position is $170k - $190k plus commission.

If your skills generally align but not perfectly, please apply anyway. There may be another role that’s a great fit for you!

We offer competitive compensation and benefits to our full-time, US-based employees, including:

  • RSU (Restricted Stock Units)
  • Generous Benefits:
    • Fully-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums for you
      • Choice of PPO or HDHP/HSA
      • Virtual Care – 98Point6
      • Employee Assistance Program
  • Mental Health coverage through Springhealth & Talkspace (Premera)

jobicy:164398.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
jobicy:164398.description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

How can we use vast amounts of proprietary and internet-scale healthcare data to build systems that enable access to significantly better health care? In this role as Principal Machine Learning Engineer, you will define and drive the architectural vision for large-scale, foundational machine learning models and applications that power care personalization, treatment intelligence, and automation at scale. Your work will directly impact every aspect of patient care, including but not limited to MedMatch, our AI-powered system that enhances provider-patient interactions, optimizes treatment recommendations, and expands into new verticals. This impact will be driven by architecting resilient, scalable, and extensible ML platforms that accelerate product development, unlock intelligent care delivery, and influence long-term ML strategy and engineering practices across teams.

You Will:

  • Define and drive the architectural vision for ML and LLM systems that support treatment recommendation, personalization, and intelligent care delivery at scale

  • Establish foundational design patterns and infrastructure practices that ensure systems are scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable

  • Work hands-on with Python and ML frameworks like PyTorch to prototype, optimize, and guide implementation of complex model pipelines and platform components

  • Align high-impact technical decisions with long-term product strategy by partnering with platform, product, and clinical teams

  • Architect and evolve robust ML infrastructure to support continuous training, real-time inference, evaluation, and observability

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that simplify system complexity, improve developer velocity, and increase organizational leverage

  • Shape quality strategies across teams by defining standards for testing, observability, performance, and operational risk

  • Mentor senior and staff engineers across squads, supporting their growth as systems thinkers and technical leaders

  • Champion a culture of sustainable speed, system ownership, and architectural clarity across product and platform teams

You Have:

  • 10+ years of experience in Machine Learning and/or Engineering, with a strong track record of technical leadership and system architecture across teams or business areas

  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and advanced ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlo

  • Demonstrated success in designing, scaling, and evolving ML platforms that support production-grade training, deployment, real-time inference, and monitoring

  • Deep experience in LLMs and NLP, including transformer models, summarization, conversational agents, and embedding-based retrieval

  • Advanced understanding of ML infrastructure, including continuous training, system observability, performance optimization, and platform reliability

  • Experience with ML infrastructure tools such as Databricks, MLFlow, SageMaker, or equivalent

  • A Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field (not strictly required)

  • Exceptional communication and cross-org leadership skills, with the ability to align diverse technical and non-technical stakeholders around ML strategy and long-term architecture

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

  • Offsite team retreats

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@forhims.com and describe the needed accommodation. jobicy:164397.description:
BlackCloak’s mission is to protect corporate executives and high-profile individuals in their personal lives, mitigating risks to their families, companies, reputation, and finances. We defend our clients’ digital lives from hackers, privacy leaks, and identity theft. If you are passionate about helping to protect others, then keep reading - this may be your next great opportunity.

As a BlackCloak Account Executive, you’ll be responsible for your territory strategy, pipeline development, and working as a trusted advisor with prospects, resulting in bookings and revenue attainment in excess of your goals. You will both develop your own pipeline from your outbound efforts, by working marketing leads, and responding to inbound inquiries. Reporting to the Head of Enterprise Sales, you will contribute directly to top line revenue of the company taking into account client satisfaction, profitability, and other corporate revenue objectives.

You should be the type of person who enjoys building something from scratch, especially developing a territory in a new product category. You will be a trusted advisor to your prospects and be a thought leader in the community.

This position will primarily support the sales activities in these regions: Texas, Oklahoma, Louisiana, or Arkansas.

Candidates must be located in convenient travel distance from locations listed above.

What You Will Do

  • Maintain Ultra-High Field Activity: Drive relentless top-of-funnel momentum by securing a high volume of net-new prospect meetings weekly through proactive outbound execution.

  • Engage Security Leadership Directly: Leverage deep industry credibility to navigate enterprise organizations and build direct, trusted relationships with CISOs, CSOs, and CIOs.
