  • Exceed Growth: Exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals to continue our explosive growth.

  • Foster Important Relationships: Build relationships with key decision-makers in information security departments across a variety of industries.

  • Develop Your Territory: writing plans for pipeline creation, reporting progress, and forecasting to the Enterprise Sales Management Team

What You Need to be Successful

  • High-Output Prospecting & Activity Track Record: Proven track record of maintaining high engagement metrics, outbound touchpoints, and consistently exceeding weekly net-new meeting targets.

  • Direct CISO Relationship Building: Demonstrated success in initiating contact with, presenting to, and closing enterprise deals directly with executive-level security leaders (CISOs/CSOs). Build your local CISO community and direct quarterly events

  • Targeted Channel Partner Execution: Strong knowledge of the enterprise reseller landscape with a demonstrated ability to identify and leverage account-specific strategic resellers to penetrate enterprise accounts.

Compensation

Salary range published is base salary and doesn't include additional variable commission. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to geographic location as well as candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

BlackCloak is an extremely fast-growing company in an entirely new product category. We have amazing product fit validated by industry awards and an impressive client base of Fortune 500 companies across all industries.

jobicy:164394.title: Certification Program Lead
jobicy:164394.description:
As Certification Program Lead, you will join the Customer Education and Training team and will take ownership of the strategy, execution, and expansion of our current certification initiatives. Your core mission will be to elevate the Datadog Certified practitioner program into the leading industry credential for individuals and enterprises across observability, security, and the diverse technical ecosystems that Datadog supports.

What You'll Do

  • Own program direction, roadmap, and long-term planning.
  • Define growth targets for increasing practitioner and enterprise adoption.
  • Manage the program budget and vendor relationships.
  • Direct the production and publication of new exams, including maintenance and localization of existing content.

  • You have managed budgets, vendors, and complex project timelines.
  • You understand the lifecycle of exam development, from role scopes to subject matter expertise to working with psychometric consultants, to publication and localization.

  • You have managed a certification program that features both multiple choice and performance-based exams.
  • You are comfortable using AI tools to plan, validate, and accelerate business processes.

  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing

jobicy:164392.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobicy:164392.description:
Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp is on a mission to champion the well-being in all of us and make mental healthcare more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As a Full Stack Software Engineer at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand.

At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way.

What are we looking for?

We're looking for a talented software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, learning continuously, and building products that make a meaningful difference. This role is ideal for someone who has delivered multiple challenging projects, takes pride in writing thoughtful, maintainable code, and enjoys both mentoring and learning from teammates.

You'll join an engineering culture that values ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and sound technical judgment. We embrace modern engineering practices and thoughtfully adopt new technologies, including AI, to help engineers focus on solving hard problems while keeping human expertise at the center of every decision.

What will you do?

  • You will develop end to end, owning features from technical design and development through deployment, monitoring, and continued improvement.
  • You will write clean, secure, readable, maintainable, and scalable code.
  • You will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and other cross-functional partners.
  • You will design, integrate, and build internal and external APIs.
  • You will develop new products and features while improving and modernizing existing systems.
  • You will write and optimize SQL queries and design relational database schemas.
  • You will create and maintain complex backend services and algorithms.
  • You will profile, troubleshoot, and optimize new and legacy code.
  • You will build experiences that work across mobile, tablet, and desktop environments.
  • You will contribute to code reviews, technical discussions, and engineering practices that improve quality, reliability, security, and developer experience.
  • You will ship thoughtfully and frequently in an agile environment with continuous deployment.
  • You will care about our product, mission, and long-term success, well beyond checking off development tasks.
  • You will thoughtfully use approved AI-assisted development tools to reduce repetitive work, explore solutions, and improve productivity while applying your own engineering judgment to architecture, implementation, security, privacy, and code quality. Engineers remain accountable for every technical decision.

We use a mix of established and modern technologies to support a platform serving millions of users. As our products evolve, we're continually improving our architecture, modernizing portions of our codebase, and evaluating technologies that help us build secure, reliable, and scalable software.

  • Backend: Linux, nginx, Laravel (PHP), MySQL, Redis
  • Frontend: React, Next.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS/SASS
  • Existing technologies you may encounter as we modernize the platform: Twig, Bootstrap, jQuery

We do not expect candidates to have worked with every technology in our environment. We value strong software engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems.

What will you NOT do?

  • You will NOT worry about funding. We have startup energy, with the support and resources of our parent company, Teladoc Health.
  • You will NOT be limited to a narrow set of responsibilities. We encourage employees to contribute ideas, develop new skills, collaborate across teams, and explore opportunities that support both their growth and the growing needs of the business.
  • You will NOT be expected to navigate a culture driven by ego or unnecessary hierarchy. We value respectful collaboration, thoughtful debate, and teammates who are committed to shared success.
  • You will NOT be expected to sacrifice your well-being to make an impact. We work hard and hold ourselves to high standards, all while supporting sustainable ways of working.
  • You will NOT have to wonder why your work matters. The work we do here helps to expand access to mental health care and supports people seeking help when they need it.

Can I work remotely?

Yes. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in the U.S. While we embrace the flexibility of remote work, we also value opportunities to bring teams together in person for collaboration and connection. BetterHelp covers approved expenses for company-requested travel, and reasonable accommodations are available for employees who are unable to travel.

Requirements

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Deep understanding of web development concepts and principles.
  • Examples of full-stack projects or significant product features.
  • At least one major demonstrable project that includes frontend code, backend code, and a database.
  • Ability to design, develop, and launch a web application or substantial feature from start to finish.
  • Ability to learn quickly, navigate an established codebase, and build new skills independently.
  • A strong sense of ownership and eagerness to build something meaningful.
  • Three or more years of professional web development experience in any stack, solving challenging problems and implementing new features from scratch.
  • Three or more years of experience with SQL, including relational schema design and complex queries.
  • Familiarity with web application, data, and SQL security best practices.
  • Comfort working outside the abstractions of a framework and understanding what is happening behind the scenes.
  • Experience using Git in a collaborative team environment.
  • Sound engineering judgment and a thoughtful approach to modern development tools, including AI assistants, with appropriate attention to security, privacy, and code quality.

Qualifications Expected for Position:

  • Bachelor's degree + 3 years of professional experience
  • Master's + 1 year of professional experience
  • PhD + 0 years of professional experience

Bonus (Helpful, but not required)

  • Experience working with PHP, Laravel, or the LAMP/LEMP ecosystem.
  • Experience with React or Next.js.
  • Experience modernizing established applications or incrementally replacing legacy systems.
  • Experience working in a startup, growth-stage company, or other fast-moving environment.
  • Experience building products in health care, mental health, or another highly regulated or privacy-sensitive field.
  • Experience mentoring or supporting the growth of other engineers.

Benefits

  • Remote work with regular in-person bonding experiences sponsored by the company
  • Competitive compensation
  • Holistic perks program (including free therapy, employee wellness, and more)
  • Excellent health, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution
  • The chance to build something that changes lives – and that people love
  • Any piece of hardware or software that will make you happy and productive
  • An awesome community of co-workers

The base salary range for this position is $110,000 - $160,000. In addition to the base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and the extensive benefits listed here (subject to eligibility requirements): Teladoc Health Benefits 2026. Total compensation is based on several factors – including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable to all full-time positions.

At BetterHelp we thrive on difference and individuality, and as part of the Teladoc Health family, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We never have and never will discriminate against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, ethnicity, religion, sex, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, medical condition, marital status, parental status, disability, or Veteran status.

Notice to Candidates:
BetterHelp has been made aware of fraudulent job postings and unaffiliated third parties posing as our recruiting team – please know that we have no affiliation or connection to these situations. We only post open roles on our career page (betterhelp.com/careers) or reputable job boards like our official LinkedIn or Indeed pages, and all official BetterHelp recruitment emails will come from the domain @betterhelp.com. Our commitment is to ensure a safe and transparent hiring experience for all candidates. We will never ask you for money, gift cards, or any form of payment during our hiring process, and we will never send money or checks to candidates. If you experience this, it is a scam.

jobicy:164391.title: Product Manager, Platform
jobicy:164391.description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

Hims and Hers is redefining wellness and healthcare with a fully integrated consumer, clinician, and pharmacy experience designed for the way consumers want to be treated today.

As a Product Lead on our Platform team, you will own the commercial core of Hims & Hers - the membership, catalog, pricing, and billing systems every category sells through, and everything in between - at the exact moment it's being transformed from category-specific builds into a headless, global platform. You will set the vision, build the foundation, and ship the systems that let the whole business grow faster. This is a leadership seat, owned through influence rather than headcount.

You Will:

  • Own the end-to-end platform, from subscriptions and catalog through pricing, billing, and the monetization logic underneath it all

  • Build the enablement tooling and configuration surfaces that let any category launch new products safely and fast

  • Take capabilities that no single category owns and get them owned, estimated, and sequenced

  • Set the reuse line: decide when a general capability is worth the extra quarter, and when shipping the specific thing is the right call

  • Partner with engineering and design to build AI into the core of the platform

  • Partner with our clinical, finance, and compliance teams to ensure safety, revenue integrity, and regulatory requirements are core to the platform

You Have:

  • 6+ years of experience in Product Management, working collaboratively with cross-functional teams

  • Experience owning platform, systems, or infrastructure products where other teams are your customers; experience with subscriptions, catalog, pricing, billing, or monetization is a plus

  • Experience in a consumer-oriented product role; experience in health, wellness, or category-defining products is a plus

  • A track record of building platforms teams love to build on, measured by how fast those teams ship

  • A track record of getting work owned, estimated, and scheduled without the org authority to force it

  • Comfort telling a partner team no and offering the reusable path instead, plus the judgment to know when that's the wrong answer

  • AI-native as your default operating mode, with the agents and workflows you actually run day to day to show for it

  • Strategic and tactical experience designing, building, and executing scalable processes and systems from scratch, ideally in an operations-intensive environment

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

  • Offsite team retreats

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Hims & Hers is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@forhims.com and describe the needed accommodation. Your privacy is important to us, and any information you share will only be used for the legitimate purpose of considering your request for accommodation. Hims & Hers gives consideration to all qualified applicants without regard to any protected status, including disability. Please do not send resumes to this email address.

jobicy:164390.title: HR Business Partner
jobicy:164390.description:
MissionWired and BWF Zuri are sister companies with a shared purpose: helping nonprofits and progressive organizations raise the money that moves their missions forward. Together, we walk alongside our partners through the whole donor journey, from building communities of supporters at scale to landing the transformational gifts that change what’s possible.

We know fundraising is getting harder. Fewer people are giving, everyone is competing for attention, goals keep growing, and technology and AI are changing how supporters connect with the causes they care about. Our partners need people who will dream big with them, then roll up their sleeves and make it happen.

At MissionWired, we help nonprofit organizations and Democratic campaigns advance their revenue and cause. By unifying direct response programs – from email, direct mail, and advertising to analytics, creative, and acquisition – we’ve helped raise over $5 billion for our partners. Our team brings tech intelligence, empathetic storytelling, and an unrivaled agility to every partnership. We proudly work alongside world-changing nonprofit clients including Human Rights Watch, Innocence Project, and the American Red Cross – as well as major Democratic committees and competitive Senate and gubernatorial races.

At BWF Zuri, the nonprofit sector’s most comprehensive fundraising consulting firm, we support every step of the donor journey. That means the systems and programs that keep supporters engaged, the strategies that inspire generosity, and the expertise it takes to secure major gifts and make every donor feel valued.

At heart, we’re progress-obsessed do-gooders who care deeply about social change. We bring deep expertise, fresh thinking, and talented people to every partnership, all in service of stronger fundraising, closer donor relationships, and lasting impact.

As an equal-opportunity employer dedicated to building and sustaining an inclusive community, we are deeply committed to equality, equity, and inclusion. Representation and diversity of thought strengthen our work with clients to change the world.

Every new team member broadens our perspective and allows us to think bigger. We’ll be at our best when people from underrepresented communities and people with a range of perspectives and lived experiences want to come, stay, and push the boundaries of what’s possible.

Overview: As HR Business Partner, you will support managers and employees at MissionWired and BWF Zuri in all things people-related. You will be an integral part of the People team, seamlessly delivering all aspects of the employee experience to various teams across the organization. Your deep understanding of people development and building engagement will empower leadership to attract and retain top talent. In your role, you will report to the Senior HRBP.

Successful candidates will be responsible for:

  • Proactively supporting managers and employees to enable them to make people-centric decisions while maintaining consistency across the organization;
  • Working side-by-side with your manager and the broader People team to deliver excellence in People programs, including performance management, talent development, learning and development, and employee engagement;
  • Supporting the Senior HRBP in coaching managers on how to develop their team members, navigate employee relations issues, and applying MissionWired practices and policies;
  • Being part of the team that is developing career path frameworks and supporting employee lifecycle changes from onboarding to exits;
  • Providing support on key people initiatives such as diversity and inclusion, manager enablement and organizational design;
  • Regularly pulling data and updating standard reports in the People and DEIB space;
  • Assisting with the creation and upkeep of records, and performance management software.

Must-have qualifications:

  • A proven record of effectively supporting managers as they navigate complex people situations;
  • A high bar for all things talent-related, and you’re willing to stay the course when challenges arise;
  • Experience working with people at all levels across the organization, and you proactively work with partners to provide support when needed;
  • Adaptable and flexible to evolving priorities and changing situations;
  • A clear affinity to data reporting and data-informed decision-making;
  • Experience as an inclusive operator that contributes to creating a sense of belonging and accountability;
  • Able to work high and low, fluidly transitioning from being a part of strategy one moment to diving deep into details and working tactically in the next;
  • An effective communicator with the ability to collaborate and influence at different levels in the organization;
  • Comfortable making trend-based decisions on a case-by-case basis at times;
  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent with 5-7 years of experience, with 5 of those years in Human Resources with a focus in People Operations and/or culture & engagement;
  • Knowledge of HR policy and regulations; other relevant training or certifications welcome.

Nice-to-have qualifications:

  • Ability to work in the DC office 1-2 days / week preferred
  • Experience working with employees in multiple states;
  • Experience in a professional services environment (e.g., agency or consultancy) with 200+ employees.

Compensation

Additional Information

Salary

The salary range for this role is $80,000 - $85,000 per year, depending on experience.

Location

We are currently working remotely with no return to office date. Applicants may reside in the following states: AZ, CO, CT, DC, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, KY, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NJ, OR, PA, SC, TX, VA, and WI. Due to FL legislation, MissionWired is required to participate in e-verify.

Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid premiums for platinum-level medical plan on a national health care network
  • 100% employer-paid life insurance and short-term disability
  • 50% employer-paid vision and dental insurance
  • 401(k) with 3% employer contribution
  • 20 vacation days in addition to 12 paid holidays, sick days, bereavement leave, and a volunteer day off.
  • Paid parental leave at 100% of your salary
  • Financial support for reproductive and transgender care
  • Flexible telecommute and remote work policies
  • Company-issued Mac products for home offices
  • Cell phone service reimbursement, meal and ride-share reimbursement, and other perks available

*Supporting your team on some nights and weekends as we approach high-volume times, such as elections, may be required.

If you feel you can do the job and are excited about this opportunity but are not sure if you meet all the qualifications, consider applying anyway. We’d love to hear from you!

jobicy:164388.title: Senior Data Engineer - Real Estate - Mexico
jobicy:164388.description:
About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

A tech-forward real estate brokerage headquartered in New York that grew from a top-ranked sales team into a full-service firm. The company combines traditional brokerage services with in-house media production, branding and a proprietary marketing technology platform, redefining how listings reach buyers in a fast-changing market.

Job Summary

We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Data Engineer to build the pipelines behind our client’s data advantage: listing data from dozens of MLS feeds, conversations from its AI assistant, and the deal outcomes that tie them together. Reporting to the Principal Data Engineer in a small, growing and AI-forward data team, you’ll own the ingestion of new data sources, make the listings pipeline failover-safe, and backfill years of listing history into the lakehouse. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys building reliable systems from messy real-world data and uses AI tools to do it faster.

Responsibilities

  • Build and run ingestion for new data sources, including additional MLS feeds, listing data partners, and public and private records.

  • Make the listings pipeline reliable: CDC that survives database failovers, freshness monitoring, and alerting when feeds lag.

  • Backfill three years of historical listing data into the lakehouse and build the archival access patterns that read from it.

  • Build raw, cleaned and modeled layers in dbt, including normalization across feeds and entity resolution for properties, agents and offices.

  • Add tests, data contracts and drift detection across roughly 160 listing fields, respecting each MLS’s data-use rules.

  • Model AI assistant conversations, product events and deal outcomes so product and leadership can measure what’s working.

  • Help consolidate and right-size the ClickHouse footprint for cost and performance.

  • Write specs before code and use AI coding tools daily to move faster.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of data engineering experience building production pipelines.

  • Strong SQL and Python; working knowledge of TypeScript is a plus.

  • Hands-on Postgres experience, including logical replication or CDC.

  • Experience with an analytical database (ClickHouse preferred; Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift are also a fit).

  • Experience with dbt, building tested and documented models.

  • Experience with lakehouse or object-storage formats (Parquet, Iceberg, Delta).

  • Experience normalizing messy, inconsistent third-party data into a reliable model.

  • Daily, practical use of AI coding assistants.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

Apply now!

jobicy:164386.description:

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. Our Client

This company is far more than a traditional real estate brokerage — it is a tech-powered media company reinventing how real estate is bought, sold, and experienced, combining elite sales talent, cutting-edge technology, and world-class content creation to build a completely new industry approach; its ecosystem spans luxury residential real estate, a powerful education platform, and an in-house creative agency, forming a vertically integrated model that is reshaping the real estate landscape, while offering engineers the opportunity to join an organization that treats technology as a core strategic differentiator, empowers small, autonomous, high-impact teams with full ownership, and values great design, clean code, and exceptional user experience, all within a company that is actively building the future of real estate.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join a high-impact fintech-focused engineering team building resilient, scalable, and data-intensive systems. This role requires deep expertise across the full stack, from designing PostgreSQL schemas and distributed backend services to delivering polished React/Next.js user experiences. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who values reliability, operational excellence, and clean architecture, with experience handling complex financial workflows, asynchronous event processing, and high-stakes transactional data. You will work in a fast-paced environment with strong ownership, leveraging AI-assisted development tools and modern engineering practices to deliver robust production-grade solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full lifecycle of product features, from database schema design and backend implementation to frontend delivery and production monitoring.

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable event-driven and distributed systems with strong guarantees around reliability and data consistency.

  • Develop and optimize complex PostgreSQL queries, migrations, and transactional workflows for high-performance financial operations.

  • Build resilient integrations with third-party systems using webhooks, queues, retry mechanisms, and reconciliation processes.

TAMs at ClickUp are the long-term technical and strategic partner for a portfolio of enterprise customers. You'll discover the business problem, build and implement the right solution, drive adoption, and prove the business impact, staying with your customers from first rollout through renewal and expansion, turning delivered value into a credible growth story.

jobicy:164383.title: Senior Product Manager, Fulfilment
jobicy:164383.description:
About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our marketplace connects jewellers with suppliers of diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery in 70+ countries, with more than $300M in annual transactions and a $350B industry still waiting to be modernised. We are scaling fast, and we are only getting started.

Our Mission

For decades, the diamond trade has been slow, opaque and inefficient: hard to find stock, hard to trust prices, hard to know when anything will arrive. Nivoda exists to change that. We give businesses of every size, in every location, the same access to inventory, the same transparent pricing and the same reliable delivery as the biggest players in the industry.

The Fulfilment & Express Team

The Fulfilment & Express team is where Nivoda's promise to buyers is kept. We own how an order travels from supplier to jeweller: the delivery date we promise, the hubs that hold and check stock, the carriers that move it, and the returns and quality checks that protect every purchase. We are a remote-first team of product, engineering, design and QA who work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Supplier Experience. We are low on hierarchy and high on ownership, and we like solving problems where software meets the physical world.

About the Role

As our Senior Product Manager for Fulfilment & Express, you will own how Nivoda orders get from supplier to jeweller: accurately promised, reliably tracked and delivered fast. You will set the strategy and roadmap for a complex, operationally heavy product area that spans diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery, with physical hubs, carriers and suppliers behind every screen. Your work decides whether a jeweller trusts Nivoda with their next order, so this is a role with real commercial impact and plenty of room to lead.

What would YOU be doing?

  • Setting the fulfilment strategy for the next 2 to 4 quarters, making trade-offs explicit, including what we are choosing not to do and why

  • Owning the roadmap and the numbers: running quarterly planning, sizing opportunities and setting targets for delivery-as-promised, delivery date accuracy and delivery speed

  • Making our Promised Delivery Dates trustworthy by rolling out SLA-based, dynamic delivery dates across every category and route, and shaping how they are used for delay communications and, in time, shown to buyers

  • Scaling Express, our hub-based fast-delivery offer, including hub workflows (receiving, inventory and RFID put/pick, QC and dispatch), ready-to-wear jewellery, consignment flows and speed options such as same-day pickup

  • Owning jewellery returns and on-platform QC, from the manufacturer through to the hub, including hallmarking and consignment returns to suppliers

  • Improving the delivery experience through carrier and rate/transit integrations, consolidation, last-mile cost and efficiency, and clear order visibility for buyers

  • Translating hub operations, carrier behaviour, customs and supplier handling into clear product requirements, designing for the exceptions as much as the happy path

  • Turning support tickets, delay breaches, supplier performance data and customer feedback into prioritised problems, then deciding what to build, buy or fix operationally

  • Partnering daily with Engineering and Design, and closely with Operations, Customer Support, Account Management, Sales, Supplier Experience and Fintech so delivery, credit and payments feel like one journey for the buyer

  • Writing sharp PRDs and decision records, and reporting progress openly through our weekly updates

  • Mentoring other product managers and designers on working in operationally complex domains

What do we need from YOU?

  • 5 to 8 years in product management, including experience owning a complex product area end to end

  • Experience in fulfilment, logistics, supply chain or other operations-heavy products. You are comfortable where software meets warehouses, carriers, SLAs and customs

  • Strong systems thinking: you can map a multi-party process, find where promises break, and design for failure modes, delays and edge cases

  • Data fluency: you define the right metrics, query and interrogate data yourself (Snowflake, Mixpanel or similar) and use it to decide what to build next

  • Sound prioritisation and commercial judgement: you weigh impact, effort and risk honestly, say no clearly, and can explain the return on a fulfilment investment to leadership

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership: you build trust with engineers, operators and commercial teams, and influence without authority across time zones

  • Clear written communication: concise PRDs, roadmaps and updates that make decisions easy

  • Customer and operator empathy, and high agency: you spend time with jewellers, support teams and hub operators, you take ownership, and you follow things through to the outcome

Nice to have

  • Jewellery, diamond or luxury goods experience

  • Marketplace or B2B commerce experience, ideally two-sided with supply and demand constraints

  • Experience with carrier or shipping APIs, rate and transit tools, 3PL integrations, inventory systems or RFID

  • Experience building predictive or SLA-based estimates, such as delivery dates or ETAs

  • Experience with cross-border shipping, customs, duties or compliance (for example hallmarking and HS codes)

Our culture and what we offer

Nivoda is collaborative, high-growth and built on empowerment. You will have real ownership from day one, a team that wants you to succeed, and the chance to keep learning as the company scales. We are remote-first with flexible hours, and we trust you to do your best work your way.

Our current benefits

  • ⏰ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

  • 🏡 Remote work

  • 🩺 Private health insurance

  • 📚 Opportunities for growth and learning

  • 💳 Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)

  • 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

  • 🚀 The chance to join during an exponential expansion phase

Equal opportunity

Nivoda is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome applications from everyone. Even if you do not meet 100% of our musts, do not let it stop you. If this role excites you, we would love to hear from you.

jobicy:164381.title: Market Development Representative
jobicy:164381.description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀

Everything we build now runs through one question: how do we supercharge productivity with AI?

ClickUp Brain and our agentic AI capabilities are the center of gravity for the company. We're not bolting AI onto a project management tool, we're building the platform where AI does real work: drafting, summarizing, routing, researching, and executing alongside the humans who use it. That focus is external and internal. We expect our customers to get radically more productive with AI, and we expect the same of ourselves. Every ClickUp employee is given the tools, the training, and the mandate to use AI in their daily workflow.

This is an AI-native role. You will use AI every day to research faster, personalize at scale, prep calls, and keep your pipeline clean. You will also be selling AI, so you need to speak about it credibly.

The Role

As a Market Development Representative (MDR), you'll serve as the critical bridge between our marketing efforts and the sales team, playing a pivotal role in accelerating our revenue pipeline. You will be responsible for meticulously following up on, nurturing, and qualifying all inbound leads generated from our diverse marketing channels. This role is fundamental to ensuring our sales team engages only with the most promising and well-prepared prospects.

In this position, you'll act as the first point of contact and a trusted educator for potential customers. Your mission is to understand their initial interest, assess their business needs, and articulate the value of our platform, including how our AI capabilities change what their team is capable of. You will manage the crucial early stages of the buyer's journey, building rapport and filtering for high-potential opportunities before seamlessly transitioning them to an Account Executive.

This is a high-velocity motion: sub-30 day cycles, pipeline generation at scale, and relentless execution. MDRs don't win by out-strategizing over weeks. They win by out-hustling, out-qualifying, and out-persisting, turning every inbound signal into a qualified opportunity that sticks downstream.

How We Hire, Coach and Measure: The Four Pillars

Every MDR is developed and evaluated against four behavioral pillars. They're not corporate values on a wall, they're the operating system of the team.

🔥 Ownership. The non-negotiable foundation. Extreme ownership of pipeline outcomes and no excuses when a lead goes cold because you didn't respond fast enough or log your work properly. Intellectual honesty: truth over ego. Going above and beyond for the team's collective success, not just your own number.

⭐️ Obsession. The refusal to plateau. This is a high-rejection motion, so you study objection patterns, perfect talk tracks, and learn from every no. You compound knowledge: every call makes the next one better because you document what works and share it.

⚡️ Effectiveness. Winning by design, not effort alone. Converting high volume into high quality through sharp qualification, deep discovery, and meetings that actually stick. Every touch is chosen for maximum conversion impact.

🤖 AI Native. Using AI to amplify your own output, and positioning ClickUp's AI credibly to prospects. The bar: you're leveraging AI across research, outreach, follow-up, and CRM hygiene, and you can articulate our agentic AI value proposition in every qualification conversation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Respond promptly (Zoom, phone, email) to all inbound leads generated by marketing activities: handraisers, account signals, content, webinars, social campaigns, and events.

  • Qualify marketing-qualified leads (MQLs) using a consistent framework to determine sales readiness and fit, and distinguish buyers from browsers.

  • Nurture leads through in-depth conversations, acting as an educator and advisor rather than focusing solely on immediate conversions.

  • Uncover real business pain beneath surface-level inquiries, quantify its impact, and document it clearly for the AE.

  • Position ClickUp's platform and agentic AI capabilities credibly and specifically, mapping them to the prospect's actual workflow gaps.

  • Use AI tools across your entire workflow: account and persona research, personalization at scale, call prep, follow-up drafting, and CRM hygiene. Edit every output for authenticity, never ship raw.

  • Maintain accurate, real-time records of lead interactions and qualification status in CRM.

  • Deliver comprehensive AE handoffs with a qualification summary, roles identified, pain documented, and competitive context.

  • Provide detailed feedback to sales and marketing on lead quality, content effectiveness, and channel performance, helping refine messaging and targeting.

  • Occasionally perform cold outreach as needed, with a primary focus on inbound.

  • Share what works: talk tracks, AI workflows, and objection patterns. Individual wins are good, team adoption is better.

Qualifications

This role is built for a highly motivated and tenacious individual who is eager to succeed and thrives on hard work. The most important qualifications are your personal drive and resilience, as you'll be connecting with a high volume of customers daily.

  • What's non-negotiable: a strong work ethic, the grit to overcome challenges, and the tenacity to consistently engage with customers.

  • Also non-negotiable: genuine curiosity about AI and a willingness to rebuild how you work around it. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be someone who reaches for AI first and figures it out.

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. jobicy:164377.title: Associate Director, Strategic Program Management
jobicy:164377.description:
Associate Director, Strategic Program Management, CDx/IVD

Position Overview

Natera is seeking an Associate Director of Strategic Program Management to lead IVD and companion diagnostic (CDx) programs from development planning through PMA submission. This leader will shape the development strategy with functional experts and own the integrated execution plan across assay development, software and bioinformatics, analytical and clinical validation, laboratory operations, Quality, and Regulatory Affairs.

The Associate Director will bring clarity to complex programs, connect decisions across workstreams, and drive teams toward critical development and submission milestones. This is a highly visible role requiring the ability to lead without direct authority, resolve competing priorities, and present clear recommendations to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT). The role focuses on internal CDx development and execution; dedicated partnership leaders own external pharmaceutical partner management.

Primary Responsibilities

Lead IVD/CDx program execution

  • Lead complex IVD/CDx programs through development, design transfer, validation, and PMA submission.
  • Build and maintain an integrated program plan covering deliverables, resources, dependencies, decision points, and regulatory milestones.
  • Partner with functional leaders to define objectives, development priorities, success criteria, and executable plans.
  • Anticipate risks, identify gaps and trade-offs, and drive timely decisions across functions.
  • Establish clear program governance, ownership, escalation paths, and accountability for commitments.

Drive development and submission readiness

  • Integrate assay development, design controls, software and bioinformatics, analytical validation, clinical validation, laboratory implementation, and submission activities.
  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs and Quality to align program execution with FDA interactions, applicable requirements, and PMA evidence needs.
  • Coordinate plans for assay changes, comparability or bridging studies, and transition to the final CDx configuration, as applicable.
  • Lead reviews at major development gates to confirm deliverables, readiness criteria, open risks, and decisions.
  • Track submission-critical evidence and documentation, and drive resolution of gaps that could affect PMA quality or timing.

Provide executive leadership and communication

  • Present program strategy, progress, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to the ELT and other senior governance forums.
  • Translate complex scientific, operational, and regulatory issues into concise, data-backed options and decisions.
  • Build alignment among leaders with different priorities and hold teams accountable for agreed actions and milestones.
  • Escalate material issues early, with a clear assessment of their impact and a recommended path forward.
  • Provide the internal program status and decision support needed by colleagues who lead external pharmaceutical partner relationships.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 10+ years of progressive program or project management experience in molecular diagnostics, in vitro diagnostics, medical devices, biotechnology, or a related regulated field.
  • Direct experience leading CDx or IVD development programs involving design controls, validation planning, and FDA submission preparation.
  • Experience building and driving integrated plans across technical, clinical, regulatory, quality, software, and operations functions.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead senior cross-functional stakeholders, resolve competing priorities, and deliver results without direct reporting authority.
  • Experience presenting complex programs, risks, and recommendations to executive leadership.
  • Strong ability to connect technical decisions, resource needs, regulatory evidence, and timelines to the overall program strategy.

Preferred

  • Experience leading a CDx or IVD program through PMA submission or a major PMA milestone.
  • Experience with next generation sequencing, genomic diagnostics, or biomarker-defined patient populations.
  • Experience coordinating analytical and clinical validation strategies and managing changes between clinical trial and final commercial assay configurations.
  • Familiarity with pharmaceutical development timelines and the dependencies between a therapeutic program and its companion diagnostic.
  • Advanced degree or program management certification.

Leadership Expectations

The successful candidate will lead the program beyond milestone tracking. They will understand the science and regulatory strategy well enough to ask informed questions, recognize when a decision in one workstream creates risk elsewhere, and bring the right leaders together to resolve it. They will foster trust and open discussion, make ownership clear, and give executives an accurate view of progress and the decisions needed to deliver the program.

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

Remote USA

$150,300—$195,150 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

jobicy:164376.title: Senior Regional Marketing Manager, EMEA
jobicy:164376.description:
Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process around 10 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Risk Operations Center, the AI platform where lean security teams run cyber risk end to end. It combines security ratings, threat intelligence and AI agents to give teams one view of risk across their vendors, attack surface and workforce.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

Where does this role fit in?

You’ll be UpGuard’s first marketer in EMEA, making sure the region gets what it needs to grow. That means two things. First, you’ll deliver partner marketing across EMEA, running programs and events with our channel and technology partners that create pipeline. Second, you’ll be the main marketing contact for the region, working with EMEA sales leaders every week and with our global marketing team to make sure events, campaigns, content, and collateral land well in local markets.

You won’t be expected to do everything yourself. Global teams own demand generation, product marketing, content, and brand. Your job is to bring the region’s needs to them, adapt what they build for EMEA, and run the activity that only someone on the ground can, especially partner events. You’ll work from a regional plan and budget. This is a hands-on role, and success is measured by the pipeline you help create.

What will you do?

  • Be the main marketing contact for EMEA, with a standing weekly check-in with regional sales leaders

  • Deliver the EMEA partner marketing plan agreed with your manager and our channel team, running joint campaigns, webinars, and enablement content with the resellers, MSPs, and technology partners most likely to produce pipeline.

  • Manage and organise EMEA partner events end to end, including co-hosted roundtables and executive dinners, sponsored partner conferences, and partner enablement sessions. That covers venue and vendor sourcing, logistics, joint promotion, on-site delivery, and making sure leads are shared and followed up with partners and sales.

  • Work with sales and demand gen on account-based programs and regional campaigns, coordinating events, outreach, and content around target accounts and contributing to regional lead generation.

  • Build UpGuard’s presence in the region through EMEA customer stories, references, and speakers, regional PR and media, and relationships with industry associations and CISO communities (e.g. ISACA and ISC2 chapters).

  • Localize global campaigns, content, and collateral for EMEA markets and languages, and feed regional regulatory developments (e.g. NIS2, DORA, GDPR) to product marketing so our messaging stays relevant.

  • Track market development funds and co-marketing spend for partner events and campaigns, and partner-sourced and influenced pipeline in the CRM, within agreed budgets.

  • Report on regional and partner performance against agreed goals, and share insights and recommendations to inform future plans.

What will you bring?

  • 6+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with significant time in partner/channel marketing, field marketing, or regional marketing in EMEA.

  • Experience selling to security, IT, risk, or compliance buyers, ideally in cybersecurity.

  • A track record of partner or regional programs that produced measurable pipeline.

  • Experience running account-based programs with sales, and building customer advocacy or regional PR.

  • Comfort working as a team of one in-region while collaborating closely with a global team across time zones.

  • Strong relationships with sales leaders and an instinct for turning field feedback into marketing action.

  • Working knowledge of Salesforce or HubSpot and of partner and event attribution.

  • Willingness to travel across EMEA.

What will give you an edge?

  • Knowledge of EMEA's security regulatory landscape, existing relationships with major regional distributors, MSPs, media, or CISO communities

  • Fluency in a second European language

What’s in it for you?

At UpGuard, we’re passionate about our work, but we’re also passionate about employee wellness and personal growth. We offer a competitive benefits package to help maximize the well-being of all UpGuardians. This includes:

  • Monthly Lifestyle subsidy: use this for financial, physical and mental wellbeing (all regions)

  • WFH set-up allowance: to ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set-up within your first 3 months at UpGuard (all regions)

  • $1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: to support your career development all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance (all regions)

  • Generous Annual Leave/PTO allowances: time to recharge your batteries (all regions)

  • 18 weeks paid Parental Leave: irrespective of parenting role (all regions)

  • Personal Leave allowance: this includes sick & carer’s leave (all regions)

  • Fully remote working environment: whilst we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate compulsory attendance (all regions)

  • Top spec hardware: all team members will be provided with top-spec laptops for their role (all regions)

  • Personal device security & online privacy protection subsidy: UpGuard provides team members with a paid subscription to personal device security & online privacy protection platform (all regions)

  • Generative AI subsidy: UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work (all regions)

UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work! Apply now to find out why!

As an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

jobicy:164375.title: Director, Product Design (AI Experience)
jobicy:164375.description:
About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Role:

We’re hiring a design leader to own the experience of AlphaSense’s most important frontier: the AI-native, agentic product our customers use to build on proprietary financial data.

AlphaSense is shifting from a research library into an end-to-end workflow platform: a "super analyst" with agentic, computer-use capabilities that lets analysts go from question to discovery to synthesis to finished work product (dashboards, decks, models, generated outputs) without leaving the platform. It’s an enormous opportunity, and today the experience is fragmented: years of incremental features, two search paradigms that don’t yet converge, no self-service onboarding, and a wide spectrum of AI fluency across our users.

You will own the design vision for the AI experience and lead a small team to ship it. You’ll set a clear point of view on where the UX is going, collaborate with Product and Engineering while constructively challenging decisions to raise the bar, and turn an ambiguous, cross-team problem space into a coherent, high-quality, trustworthy product.

This is a player-coach role: like all of our directors, you’ll lead a small team of senior designers while staying hands-on with the craft. We’re open to hiring at Director or Senior Director, depending on scope and experience, with a preference for candidates located in NYC, in a similar time zone, or able to travel.

Why this role matters

At AlphaSense, design is a core driver of how we win. As we build an AI-native platform, the quality of our user experience will define how effectively customers can navigate complexity, build conviction, and make high-stakes financial decisions with confidence.

In this role, you will set that standard through the AI experience you shape, the team you grow, and the craft bar you hold across the product.

What You’ll Do:

  • Set the UX direction for the core AI / agentic experience: a clear, opinionated vision for how analysts work with AI on high-stakes financial decisions, and a sequenced path from today’s product to that north star.
  • Lead through influence and craft: partner with an SVP of Product and multiple PMs (across NY and the UK), advocating for the best experience while working through business goals, timelines, and technical constraints to decide the real first step.
  • Solve the hard, data-dense UX problems: malleable UI with sensible defaults for hedge funds and banks (without overwhelming them), taming information overload, trust and transparency in AI-mediated workflows (citations, confidence, control, reversibility), and cohesion across surfaces.
  • Stay hands-on: prototype in code and with real data, contribute directly to the highest-leverage surfaces, and set the craft bar by doing the work, not just reviewing it.
  • Raise the bar for AI-native design: define how AI shows up as a first-party capability across the product, not just in one agentic pane.

jobicy:164371.title: Associate Director of Bioinformatics (Oncology Algorithms)
jobicy:164371.description:
Natera is seeking an Associate Director to lead a team in the Oncology R&D organization. You will oversee the planning and execution of development of AI-based diagnostic algorithms, taking them through the development phase, analytical validation and into commercial launch. You will hire and manage the team, support its professional growth, and set the development strategy for new products.

The role calls for extensive experience in algorithm development, NGS data processing across DNA, RNA and methylation, H&E image processing, and the full life cycle of diagnostic product development in a regulated setting. You will implement methods to optimize performance and help define the product profile from a computational perspective, with input from cross-functional teams.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership and Development: Lead, hire and mentor a team of Bioinformatics Scientists. Own their professional growth, their responsibilities, and build a culture of scientific rigor.
  • Development Strategy: Own the development strategy behind new products, from scoping through execution. Work with cross-functional stakeholders on what the team takes on and in what order.
  • Development To Launch: Lead algorithms through the development phase to CLIA readiness. This includes locking the algorithm and its intended use, supporting analytical validation studies by setting performance targets and acceptance criteria in collaboration with the biostatistics team. You will also support clinical validation and produce the documentation that quality, regulatory, and laboratory directors need to release the test.
  • Model Robustness and Performance: Develop and improve biomarker models and classifiers across modalities. Establish strategies for quality control, generalization across sites, scanners, and sequencing runs, and ongoing performance monitoring.
  • Production Readiness and Handoff: Move research prototypes into stable, validated production workflows. Hold the team to software engineering practice, including version control, testing, and containerization, and reproducibility under change control. Automate the routine parts of research data management, and reporting so the team's time goes to science.
  • Ways of Working: AI is a routine part of the work here. As the leader of this team, you set what correct use looks like: what an agent may conclude on its own, and what requires a scientist to sign off.
  • Cross-functional Partnership: Work with data science, molecular biology, pipeline engineering, biostatistics, quality assurance, and laboratory operations on new products and on the transition of research work into production. Act as the subject-matter expert those groups come to, and explain findings and the roadmap clearly at every level of the company.

Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Biostatistics, or a related field. (An M.S. with equivalent experience considered).
  • 7+ years in bioinformatics, including 3+ years leading scientists and working across functions.
  • Demonstrated experience developing algorithms from multimodal data including, DNA, RNA and/or methylation sequencing data, digital pathology for clinical diagnostic use.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a team that took an algorithm from research into real clinical use, including a successful CLIA or comparable regulated release, not only to a result.
  • Working knowledge of analytical validation for algorithms, including accuracy, precision, sensitivity, limit of detection, and reproducibility.

Preferred:

  • Deep expertise in next-generation sequencing analysis: hybrid-capture or amplicon-based target enrichment designs, sequencing quality control, secondary analysis, and variant calling.
  • Experience integrating multimodal data (DNA, RNA, histology and other omics data), into a single predictive model or classifier.
  • Working knowledge of how a diagnostic product moves through development in a regulated, accredited setting, including the practices and standards that apply (CLIA, CAP, design controls, and software validation and change control).
  • Strong Python, programming, and data analysis skills, with experience in machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow
  • Cloud computing (AWS, GCP) and workflow orchestration (WDL, Nextflow).
  • Containerization (Docker) for reproducible, production-grade analyses.
  • Clear communication of technical detail to people who do not share your background.
  • The ability to run several objectives and timelines at once without close supervision.
  • A desire to work in a fast-paced environment where a small team has high impact.

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

Remote USA

$177,800—$222,800 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

jobicy:164370.title: Sales Development Representative
jobicy:164370.description:
About Freshpaint:

Healthcare is a $4+ trillion industry in the U.S. alone, and it’s undergoing a rapid digital transformation.

Hospitals, digital health companies, and life sciences organizations rely on analytics and advertising tools to reach patients, measure performance, and grow. But those tools weren’t built for regulated healthcare data. That creates real compliance risk and forces teams to choose between growth and privacy.

Freshpaint eliminates that trade-off.

We’re a privacy-first data platform that helps healthcare organizations use modern marketing and analytics tools without exposing protected health information (PHI). Freshpaint sits between a company’s website or app and the third-party tools they use, automatically detecting and controlling sensitive data before it’s shared.

In short: we let healthcare teams move fast, safely.

Backed by Top Investors

Freshpaint is backed by some of the most respected names in technology, including:

  • Y Combinator (OpenAI, Stripe, Airbnb, Coinbase, DoorDash)

  • Intel Capital (Broadcom, Astera Labs, VMware, RedHat, MongoDB)

We’ve raised tens of millions of dollars in funding to build the privacy infrastructure layer for healthcare’s digital future.

Who we’re looking for
We’re looking for a driven, aspiring seller who wants to build a career in sales and get very good, fast. You don’t need years of experience. You do need drive, discipline, and the curiosity to learn a complex space. The right person is competitive, coachable, resilient, and relentless: they can take a “no” on a cold call and pick up the phone again with the same energy. They want to understand why healthcare marketing is hard (HIPAA, tracking pixels, privacy risk) and can turn that into short, sharp outreach that gets a busy executive’s attention. They run their own day in a remote environment, apply feedback on the very next call, and see progress as part of winning.

What you’ll be doing
As an SDR on our Provider team, you’ll build net-new pipeline by booking first meetings with marketing, digital, and privacy leaders at health systems and specialty groups. These are the people who decide how patient data is used in marketing, and your work gives our Provider AEs a steady flow of high-quality first conversations. You’ll start with a structured 2-week onboarding bootcamp, get certified on our pitch and objection handling, and be fully ramped by the end of your second month. After that, it’s about steady results: high activity, real personalization, and clean execution.

Primary responsibilities

  • Ramp quickly: complete onboarding and certification, book your first qualified meeting within 30 days, and hit full quota by the end of Month 3

  • Book qualified first meetings and source new opportunities with marketing, digital, and privacy leaders at health systems and specialty groups

  • Consistently hit quota after ramp (roughly 5–6 opportunities and 10 meetings per month)

  • Help source $1.6M+ in qualified Provider pipeline in your first two full quarters

  • Own your weekly activity: 400 calls, 75 net-new prospects added to sequence, and 10+ live conversations

  • Research accounts using ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and news triggers to write outreach that references something real about the account

  • Invite target accounts to Freshpaint-led events (Growth Clinics, House Calls, webinars) and turn attendees into opportunities

  • Keep HubSpot clean: log every activity, book through the right flow, and make sure every meeting is attributed correctly

  • Review your own calls in Gong, take coaching, and keep improving your messaging

Desired skills & experience

  • Up to 1 year of SDR, BDR, or outbound sales experience, or a background in a target-driven, customer-facing role and a clear reason you want to be in sales

  • Comfortable with high-volume cold calling; rejection doesn’t slow you down

  • Aggressive in pursuit of expanding your knowledge & becoming a subject matter expert

  • You own your development: You don’t wait for your manager to find your gaps and help you solve for them. You analyze self performance and spot the areas for growth and build action plans around them.

  • Strong, concise writing: you can write a short, direct email a VP would actually read

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn a new, regulated industry in depth (no technical background required)

  • Organized and process-minded; you see CRM hygiene as part of doing the job well

  • Self-starter who can manage your own schedule in a fully remote environment and asks for help early

  • Coachable: you look for feedback and act on it fast

  • Se

  • Adaptable in a startup where priorities, products, and plays change often

Nice to haves

  • Exposure to healthcare, health tech, or another regulated industry

  • Experience with HubSpot (CRM and sequences), Gong, ZoomInfo, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator

  • Familiarity with digital marketing concepts like ad platforms, analytics, or tracking pixels

  • A track record of competing and winning, whether in sales, athletics, or something else

Perks & Benefits

We take care of our team—here’s a peek at what you get when you join:

  • Competitive pay + generous equity

  • Half-day Fridays, every Friday

  • 16 weeks fully paid parental leave (eligible after 6 months; commission-based roles receive 100% base salary during leave)

  • Flexible PTO with a required 2-week minimum

  • Top-tier health, dental & vision (100% covered for you, 80% for dependents)

  • Intentional & engaging company offsites (past trips: Arizona, Jackson Hole, Nashville, New Orleans & more)

And more! Check out our careers page for the full list.
