jobicy:164351.title: Data Sales Director, South Korea
jobicy:164351.description:
Role highlights:

  • Data Sales Director

  • Location: Seoul, South Korea

  • Department: International Data Sales

  • Reports to: Head of International Data Sales

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Seoul, South Korea, with national and international travel

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening, as required for defence-related roles in South Korea

Why This Role Matters

As a Data Sales Director for South Korea, you'll be at the forefront of ICEYE's commercial growth: hunting, cultivating, and closing data sales opportunities across the Korean market. You'll build strategic relationships with defence, intelligence, and security customers in a country with deep roots in advanced technology and a growing focus on sovereign geospatial capability, driving adoption of the world's leading SAR satellite constellation.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1,000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Your Day-to-Day Responsibilities

  • Own territory planning and execute end-to-end sales campaigns across South Korea, from lead generation through to contract close

  • Initiate and develop executive-level relationships with defence, intelligence, and security customers across South Korea, directly and through the agency and vendor ecosystem

  • Lead contract negotiations and deliver customised proposals in coordination with marketing

  • Build and manage a healthy customer pipeline, accelerating adoption of ICEYE's satellite imagery data and products

  • Work with partners to extend reach and identify new opportunities across the assigned territory

  • Ensure long-term customer success and satisfaction within key strategic accounts

  • Engage with Korean defence procurement frameworks and government contracting processes (e.g. DAPA, Ministry of National Defense) to position ICEYE effectively in the region

What We're Looking For

Must Haves

  • Proven track record in a hunting sales role within the Korean market

  • Extensive existing customer network across South Korea, particularly in defence, intelligence, or security sectors

  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex contract negotiations and close high-value deals

  • Self-motivated and able to manage a pipeline independently with a high degree of autonomy

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in Korean and English

Nice to Haves

  • Background in geospatial, satellite imagery, or Earth Observation sales

  • Experience in Aerospace and Defence, consulting, or other relevant tech-focused industries

  • Familiarity with the agency and vendor ecosystem in the Korean and wider Asia-Pacific defence and intelligence market

  • Understanding of Korean sovereign defence programmes and procurement structures

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you'll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)

  • Make the impossible possible, we set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

  • Be curious, go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the 'why' behind decisions.

  • See the big picture, stay close to what's happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork, create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team, we win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun, what we do matters, and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We're committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us, we'll do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

jobicy:164350.title: Enterprise Account Executive | New Logo | Italy
jobicy:164350.description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you’ll do at Jamf:

The Enterprise New Logo Account Executive is a results-driven hunter responsible for identifying, pursuing, and closing new enterprise logos for Jamf. Focused exclusively on net-new acquisition within the enterprise segment (organizations with 1,000+ employees), this role requires strong prospecting discipline, the ability to manage complex multi-stakeholder sales cycles, and the consultative acumen to position Jamf's Apple Enterprise Management solutions at the executive level. Success in this role is defined by consistent pipeline generation, new logo attainment, and laying the foundation for long-term customer partnerships.

This role is offered in Italy only, preferably for candidates located in Milan and used to travel in the territory #LI-Remote

What you can expect to do this role:

New Logo Prospecting & Pipeline Development

  • Build and manage a targeted outbound prospecting motion to identify and engage net-new enterprise accounts within an assigned segment or territory (Italy, Greece, Cyprus, Malta)
  • Develop segment fluency — understanding buyer personas, common objections, industry-specific compliance needs, and Apple ecosystem maturity within target accounts.
  • Partner with Marketing, Business Development, and Channel partners to execute coordinated account-based prospecting that feeds a healthy, qualified pipeline.
  • Maintain consistent pipeline coverage and hygiene, ensuring sufficient volume and stage diversity to meet and exceed quota targets.

Enterprise Sales Cycle Management

  • Manage the full sales cycle from initial outreach and discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close — navigating the complexity typical of enterprise buying processes.
  • Identify and engage multiple stakeholders across IT, Security, Finance, Legal, Procurement, and executive leadership to build multi-threaded relationships within target accounts.
  • Apply a structured qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC) to assess deal health, prioritize effort, and improve forecast accuracy.
  • Navigate enterprise procurement processes, including security reviews, DPAs, and SLAs, with support from Jamf Legal and internal stakeholders.
  • Develop and deliver compelling business cases, demonstrations, and ROI presentations tailored to the priorities of diverse buying audiences.

Commercial & Deal Execution

  • Structure initial commercial agreements that are competitive, value-aligned, and appropriately sized to facilitate a strong land — with long-term expansion in mind.
  • Negotiate contract terms with support from Jamf Legal and Finance, maintaining deal momentum while protecting Jamf's commercial interests.
  • Maintain competitive positioning in deals where incumbents or alternatives are present; articulate Jamf's differentiated value with confidence.

Partner & Ecosystem Engagement

  • Build productive working relationships with Apple's enterprise sales team and Jamf's channel and reseller partners to generate introductions and support deal execution.
  • Engage partner resources appropriately to accelerate pipeline and strengthen account access, especially within named accounts or complex organizations.

Forecasting, Reporting & Team Contribution

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in Salesforce, including account activity, pipeline stage, and deal notes, to support individual and team forecasting.
  • Provide consistent, reliable monthly and quarterly forecasts, with clear visibility into deal status and expected close timelines.
  • Share learnings from the field — win/loss patterns, competitive intelligence, objection themes — to contribute to team and segment knowledge.

What we are looking for:

  • Minimum of 5 years of B2B SaaS or technology sales experience with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding quota (Required)
  • Professional working proficiency in English and Italian is required and Spanish is preferred.
  • Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, including IT and executive-level buyers (Required)
  • Proven ability to generate pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner engagement, and marketing collaboration (Required)
  • Familiarity with a structured sales qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN) and ability to apply it to assess deal health (Required)
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in both direct and indirect (channel/partner) selling models (Required)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to deliver clear and persuasive presentations to technical and business audiences (Required)
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or equivalent CRM for pipeline tracking, forecasting, and activity documentation (Required)
  • Consultative, solutions-oriented selling approach with the ability to connect technology to business outcomes (Preferred)
  • Familiarity with Apple enterprise ecosystem, endpoint management, or SaaS security solutions (Preferred)
  • Experience navigating enterprise procurement processes including DPAs, SLAs, and security reviews (Preferred)
  • Self-directed and resilient; able to manage long sales cycles and ambiguous buying processes with discipline and focus (Preferred)
  • Travel in EU territory around 50%.

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

  • Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.
  • Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches.
  • Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.

Why Jamf?

  • Named a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, 2021.
  • We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf.
  • We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.
  • You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.
  • We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 70,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.
  • We put people over profits – which is why our customers keep coming back to us.
  • We encourage you to simply be you. We constantly seek and value different perspectives to ensure Jamf is a place where everyone feels comfortable and can be successful.
  • 23 of 25 world’s most valuable brands rely on Jamf to do their best work (as ranked by Forbes).

OTE represents the total target annual compensation, consisting of a fixed base salary and performance-based sales commissions. Variable compensation is dependent on the achievement of sales targets and is not guaranteed.

Pay Transparency Range

€90.000—€124.700 EUR

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

jobicy:164349.title: Assistant VIP Relationship Manager
jobicy:164349.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a proactive and client-focused Assistant VIP Relationship Manager to join our Poland team.

In this role, you will support the VIP Relationship Management team in delivering an exceptional experience to high-value clients, including active traders, high-net-worth individuals, family offices, prop trading desks, and smaller corporate clients. You will assist with client onboarding, relationship management, retention initiatives, and day-to-day client requests, while developing your knowledge of OKX products and the wider crypto market.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Support VIP Relationship Managers in managing and retaining a portfolio of VIP clients.

  • Assist with onboarding, KYC documentation, account set-up, and ongoing client servicing.

  • Respond promptly to client queries and coordinate with internal teams to resolve account, product, or operational issues.

  • Maintain accurate client records, interaction notes, and follow-up actions in relevant systems.

  • Help identify opportunities to improve client engagement, retention, trading activity, and Assets Under Management (AUM).

    Client Engagement and Growth

    • Support the execution of client engagement and retention initiatives for the Poland market.

    • Assist with preparing client communications, account reviews, and market or product updates.

    • Identify potential VIP prospects and referral opportunities, escalating qualified leads to the VIP RM team.

    • Support local events, client meetings, and partnership activities where required.

    Product and Market Support

    • Develop a strong understanding of OKX products, including spot and derivatives trading, Earn, staking, and fiat products.

    • Gather client feedback and share insights with the VIP RM, product, and operations teams.

    • Monitor market developments and competitor activity relevant to VIP clients in Poland and the wider CEE region.

    Compliance and Operations

    • Support adherence to internal policies and regulatory requirements, including KYC, AML, and client due diligence processes.

    • Escalate potential compliance, operational, or client-risk matters promptly to the relevant teams.

    • Work closely with operations, compliance, legal, and product teams to ensure a smooth client experience.

What We Look For In You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

  • Fluency in English and Polish; additional CEE languages, such as Russian or Ukrainian, are an advantage.

  • Strong interest in cryptocurrency, financial markets, fintech, or wealth management.

Nice to Haves

    • 1–3 years’ experience in client services, account management, business development, sales support, or operations within crypto, fintech, trading, banking, or wealth management.

    • Experience supporting high-value or professional clients is preferred.

jobicy:164347.title: Clinical Research Associate
jobicy:164347.description:
Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. At Precision for Medicine we have brought together new technologies, expertise and operational scale to help the life sciences improve the speed, cost and success rate of bringing life-changing therapies to patients. What sets us apart is the way we integrate clinical trial execution with deep scientific knowledge, laboratory expertise and advanced data sciences. We have a strong focus on Oncology and Rare Disease.

Precision for Medicine is looking for Senior/Clinical Research Associate.

Position Summary:
The Senior/CRA has wide-ranging and broad experience and typically handles the most complex and advanced assignments. Responsibilities will be dependent upon the type and timing of the program to which the Senior CRA is assigned and will, at a minimum, include start-up and study implementation activities, on-site monitoring of clinical research studies as well as on-going site management.
Incumbents are expected to be able to manage appropriately sized or complex clinical trials, and support Clinical Trial Managers and/or Project Managers with trials as required. An increased focus on training and mentoring junior staff members may be expected.
Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:
• Independently oversees all aspects of study site management to ensure patient safety is protected, quality of data generated by managed sites resulting in consistently low query levels and in acceptable Quality Assurance reports.
• Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
• Establishes, updates, tracks and maintains study specific trial management tools/systems, and status reports.
• Manages site start up procedures including the feasibility and recruitment of potential investigators, preparation of EC/IRB submissions, collection and review of regulatory documents, review and adaptation in Patient Informed Consents, notifications to IRB, EC and regulatory authorities, as appropriate, translation of study related documentation, organization of meetings and other tasks as instructed by the Clinical Trial Manager/Project Manager.
• If required, assists the negotiation of study budgets and the execution of investigator contracts under directions of Site Contract Management department/designee.
• Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
• Independently conducts all forms of site visits, including pre-study/qualification, initiation, routine monitoring, and close-out visits, in accordance with the protocol, local laws, ICH-GCP and Precision SOPs. Performs Monitoring Oversight Visits to assess other CRA team members. Prepares and submits for review, accurate and timely monitoring reports from all site visits (on-site and remote).
• Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs, Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan and client requirements. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
• Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
• Communicates effectively and proactively with both site personnel and Precision Project and Clinical Trial Management to relay protocol/study issues including any deviations and implements necessary actions in response to those issues.
• Develops and maintains good working relationship with investigators and study staff, serving as an ambassador to promote Precision high quality and professional image.
• Performs investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. • Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
• Performs data review activities, including remote EDC CRF and patient profiles review, query resolution, and assists data management and clinical data quality personnel to resolve data discrepancies.
• Identifies and processes Serious Adverse Events according to the procedures defined by the study team. Also demonstrates a full understanding of the SAE reporting process.
• Identifies site risks and escalates those to Clinical Trial Manager/Project Manager with suggested contingencies. Owns the timely and appropriate resolution of the risk with oversight from project team.
• Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face-to-face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements. May prepare or assist in preparation of study-specific presentations/training materials and tools.
• Assists the team managers in the preparation and review of protocols and other study documentation.
• Supports the design and development of CRFs and clinical trial documents as they pertain to clinical monitoring activities (i.e. operating manuals, monitoring guidelines, etc.).
• Assists with review of clinical study reports.
• Functions as a mentor, assisting with the training and developing of new employees and junior monitors.
• Interacts with client, participates in proposal activities, including development and client presentations.
• Initiates payment requests for investigators.
• Travels as necessary according to project needs.
• Performs other duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelor's degree / international equivalent or equivalent combination of education and experience ideally in a business, scientific or healthcare discipline.
  • Minimum of 3.5 years of on-site monitoring experience; Oncology experience；
  • Global Clinical Trial experience

Other required:

  • High in proficiency in the Microsoft Office package of programs (Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).
  • Customer service demeanour; demonstrate flexibility and teamwork.
  • Ability to focus on detail for extended periods of time, high attention to accuracy.
  • Fluency in English communication, verbally and in writing.
  • Working knowledge of the drug development process.
  • Travelling required (60-70%)

Preferred:

  • Solid experience in clinical research or related experience.
  • Excellent organizational skills.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a remote work environment.

jobicy:164346.description:
GT was founded in 2019 by a former Apple, Nest, and Google executive. GT’s mission is to connect the world’s best talent with product careers offered by high-growth companies in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands.

On behalf of our client, a global cybersecurity company, GT is looking for an experienced Cyber Incident Commander interested in leading complex cyber incident response operations and contributing to the development of international cybersecurity capabilities.interested in leading complex cyber incident response operations and contributing to the development of international cybersecurity capabilities.

Work format: Remote, with readiness for international business travel.

About the Client & the Project

Our client is a global cybersecurity services and solutions provider helping government organisations, critical infrastructure providers, and businesses protect their operations against increasingly complex cyber threats.

The company brings together expertise in cybersecurity consulting, security monitoring, threat intelligence, technical security solutions, and incident response. Its mission is to help organisations strengthen their cyber resilience, minimise the impact of security incidents, and ensure effective recovery.

With an established international presence and a multidisciplinary team of cybersecurity professionals, the company is expanding its incident management capabilities.

The Incident Management function focuses on delivering a coordinated response to major cybersecurity incidents, combining technical investigations, operational coordination, crisis management, and strategic decision-making.

About the Role

As a Cyber Incident Commander, you will lead and coordinate the response to complex cybersecurity incidents, bringing together technical specialists, operational teams, and business stakeholders to ensure effective investigation, containment, remediation, and recovery.

This newly established leadership role offers an opportunity to shape incident response operations, manage and mentor cybersecurity specialists, and contribute to the continuous development of the company’s global incident management capabilities.

You will work closely with international teams and external stakeholders, combining strong technical cybersecurity expertise with leadership, crisis management, and decision-making skills.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the response to major cybersecurity incidents, ensuring timely investigation, containment, mitigation, and resolution.

  • Manage and mentor a team of incident responders and technical specialists.

  • Coordinate technical, operational, and strategic response activities throughout the incident lifecycle.

  • Collaborate with specialists in threat attribution, cyber investigations, and incident mitigation.

  • Build and maintain relationships with law enforcement agencies, national CERTs, and regulatory bodies.

  • Act as the central point of coordination during cyber crises, ensuring effective communication between technical teams and business stakeholders.

  • Develop and refine incident response procedures, playbooks, and escalation protocols.

  • Collaborate with international incident management teams to ensure consistent practices and knowledge sharing across regions.

  • Conduct post-incident analysis and reporting, identifying lessons learned and areas for improvement.

  • Support the development of Security Operations Centre (SOC) capabilities and other cybersecurity functions as required.

  • Contribute to threat intelligence initiatives and proactive risk mitigation strategies.

Essential knowledge, skills & experience:

  • Proven experience in cybersecurity incident response and crisis management.

  • Strong technical background in cybersecurity, with the ability to understand, oversee, and guide technical investigations.

  • Experience working within international organisations and managing cross-border cybersecurity incidents.

  • Strong leadership experience, with the ability to manage and coordinate technical specialists and multidisciplinary teams.

  • Experience communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Professional proficiency in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with international colleagues.

  • Willingness to travel internationally.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong leadership and decision-making skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to remain effective under pressure and lead during critical situations.

  • Strong organisational and coordination skills.

  • Collaborative mindset and adaptability in a fast-paced, international environment.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience managing complex or high-impact cybersecurity incidents.

  • Relevant cybersecurity certifications, such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC, or equivalent.

  • Experience with cyber crisis simulations or tabletop exercises.

  • Familiarity with threat intelligence platforms and digital forensic tools.

jobicy:164342.title: Solutions Integration Architect - Workday
jobicy:164342.description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

We’re looking for a Solutions Architect to help build the technical foundation that powers Zip’s ERP and integration ecosystem. This role focuses on internal technical enablement, navigating complex customer environments to architect the cleanest possible solutions, partnering closely with Product, and driving best-in-class standards across all of Zip’s integration workflows - with a specific focus on the Workday Financials ecosystem.

As Zip continues to scale rapidly across enterprise customers like Coinbase, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Snowflake, and Databricks, your impact will be foundational: creating reusable integration assets, defining standards of how the Zip product interacts with external systems.

You Will

You’ll work closely with our Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams while reporting to Engineering to design, maintain, and iterate on Zip-owned ERP and integration templates that power scalable, repeatable customer implementations. Your work will directly influence how hundreds of future implementations are delivered, raising the technical bar for both our EPD teams and our customer-facing technical consultant organization.

  • Architect & standardize Workday integrations: Design, maintain, and iterate on Zip’s core Workday Financials and Procurement integration templates, ensuring they deliver scalable, repeatable, and robust customer implementations.

  • Bridge product & the field: Work closely with Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) to ensure integration templates stay perfectly aligned with core product architecture, field insights, and emerging customer needs.

  • Turn nuance into scale: Analyze complex customer implementations to identify reusable data mapping patterns and system nuances, converting bespoke solutions into standardized internal assets.

  • Support pre-sales engineering: Partner with account teams during pre-sales to design and vet integration architectures, ensuring prospective customers are set up for smooth, best-practice deployments.

  • Drive technical implementation excellence: Define, document, and champion technical solution consulting best practices, raising the technical bar and driving consistency across all implementations.

  • Become a Multi-ERP expert: Leverage your existing Workday, P2P, and financial systems expertise to build deep fluency across additional ERP ecosystems, ultimately becoming the ultimate subject matter expert on integration architecture, data models, and Zip’s App Studio.

  • Build for permanent scale: Approach every technical challenge with an engineering mindset - designing and executing a solution thoroughly once so that future implementations happen effortlessly. You balance high-level architectural design with a willingness to dive directly into API configurations and template modifications to get the job done right.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience delivering integrations with Workday Financials.

  • Strong foundational knowledge of core Workday Financials business processes, data models, and the Foundation Data Model (FDM) layout, specifically within Core Financials, Procurement, and Supplier Accounts.

  • Familiarity with standard Workday integration methods and tools, such as Workday Studio, EIBs, Core Connectors, Web Services (WWS), and RaaS (Reports-as-a-Service).

  • Familiarity with iPaaS tools is preferred, but we welcome candidates with strong core integration logic who can learn new platform tools quickly.

  • Experience working with XML / REST based endpoints and standard authentication protocols.

  • Past ERP implementation, integration, configuration or administration experience is required.

  • Ability to translate highly technical information for audiences with varying degrees of technical knowledge.

  • Comfortable working with API documentation.

  • Comfortable testing and troubleshooting integration errors.

  • Able to understand customer requirements and document that information quickly, with little oversight

  • A continual learner and open to learning new technologies that Zip may integrate with in the future.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • Extreme attention to detail and pride yourself in being incredibly proactive.

  • Experience working with product and engineering teams.

  • Process-driven with a strong bias toward continuous improvement; you consistently look for opportunities to make systems better than you found them through systematic improvement.

The salary range for this role is $126,000 - $170,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 100% health, vision & dental coverage options

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • 🏋️‍♀️ ClassPass membership

  • 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

  • 💻 Home office stipend

  • 🛜 Phone/internet reimbursement

  • 🍼 Paid parental leave

  • 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Fertility stipend

  • 💸 401k plan

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobicy:164339.title: National Account Director, Enterprise Access
jobicy:164339.description:
Company Overview

Immunome is a clinical-stage targeted oncology company committed to developing first-in-class and best-in-class targeted cancer therapies. We are advancing an innovative portfolio of therapeutics, supported by a leadership team with deep experience in the design, development, and commercialization of cutting-edge therapies, including antibody-drug conjugates. Our pipeline includes varegacestat, an investigational gamma secretase inhibitor for which an NDA has been accepted by the U.S. FDA; IM-1021, a clinical-stage ROR1 ADC; IM-1617, a clinical-stage solid tumor ADC; and IM-3050, a clinical-stage FAP-targeted radioligand therapy. We are also advancing a broad portfolio of early-stage ADCs pursuing undisclosed solid tumor targets.

Position Overview

Immunome is seeking a highly experienced and strategic National Account Director, Enterprise Access to lead integrated account strategy across a U.S. national footprint in support of our oncology portfolio. This role will build and sustain relationships with national and regional health plans, pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs), and Key Account customer networks to advance launch readiness, appropriate coverage and reimbursement, formulary access, and therapeutic adoption following regulatory approval.

The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in payer access and institutional purchasing, recognizing the distinct operating models, decision processes, and account economics of each. This position combines direct account ownership, strategic negotiation, and executive relationship management with cross-functional leadership, serving as a primary resource for field teams and connecting headquarters strategy with local execution.

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute multi-year Payer / PBM and Key Account institution plans with defined access objectives, stakeholder engagement, procurement strategies, and measures of success.
  • Apply commercial, Medicare Part D, and Medicaid expertise alongside community and integrated delivery network (IDN) business acumen, tailoring strategies to payer coverage decisions and provider purchasing structures.
  • Translate oncology market trends, clinical differentiation, reimbursement, and clinical pathway dynamics into national account priorities and commercial planning.

Payer Access and Stakeholder Management

  • Build executive-level relationships with pharmacy directors, medical directors, clinical leaders, and pharmacy and therapeutics (P&T) decision-makers across national and regional health plans and PBMs.
  • Navigate formulary and preferred drug list (PDL) development, utilization management, and coverage and reimbursement policies across commercial plans, Medicare Part D, and Medicaid fee-for-service (FFS) programs and managed care organizations (MCOs).
  • Map decision authority and payer affiliates; coordinate internal account teams to identify access barriers, align engagement, and advance appropriate coverage outcomes.

Institutional Access and Stakeholder Management

  • Build relationships with CEOs, CFOs, COOs, medical directors, pharmacists, and practice administrators across oncology customers and their member organizations.
  • Extend engagement to IDNs, health systems, hospital and community oncology networks, and national clinical pathway organizations, aligning corporate relationships with local customer needs.
  • Use approved clinical and economic evidence to support appropriate preferred formulary and pathway positioning with relevant provider and pathway decision-makers, respecting independent clinical decisions.

Strategic Negotiation

  • Lead payer, PBM, and community account strategy and negotiations, including pull-through opportunity, within approved authority; balance coverage and purchasing objectives, rebate commitments, pricing dynamics, and long-term business value.
  • Partner with Market Access, Finance, Legal, and Compliance to evaluate contract economics, 340B considerations, and Medicaid Best Price implications and secure approvals before commitments.
  • Prepare negotiation strategies for sophisticated counterparties, execute approved agreements, and coordinate implementation, performance monitoring, and renewals.
  • Translate local access and coverage landscape into coordinated field pull-through plans, with clear account responsibilities and adherence to company policies.

Value Communication and Market Intelligence

  • Partner with Medical Affairs and health economics and outcomes research (HEOR) colleagues to translate clinical and economic evidence into account-specific value narratives using approved materials and appropriate scientific support.
  • Tailor compliant communications to payer evidence needs, population priorities, and coverage considerations, and to Key Account, provider, and pathway stakeholders’ clinical and business priorities.
  • Monitor formularies, utilization management, coverage policies, clinical pathways, and oncology market developments; synthesize account insights and evidence gaps into actionable recommendations for internal teams.

Leadership and Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary payer and corporate accounts resource for field sales, connecting headquarters strategy, national agreements, and local execution.
  • Partner with Commercial field and Market Access colleagues on shared accounts, aligning priorities, responsibilities, customer messaging, and coordinated action plans; provide proactive consultation to Sales, Marketing, Medical Affairs, HEOR, Finance, Legal, and Policy.
  • Lead cross-functional account teams and mentor colleagues, fostering accountability, consensus building, and coordinated execution without relying on direct reporting authority.

Launch Planning and Execution

  • Lead payer and key institutional account launch readiness, aligning access strategies, contracting timelines, stakeholder engagement, and field execution with applicable regulatory approvals.
  • Develop and execute educational programs through all available channels with appropriate internal partners and review processes, maintaining separation between commercial and medical activities.
  • Tailor rare disease and rare oncology launch strategies to clinical differentiation and account needs rather than relying on approaches designed for large, high-volume therapeutic classes.

Qualifications

  • Significant biopharmaceutical market access or commercial experience managing national or major regional payer accounts and national oncology GPOs.
  • Experience across commercial, Medicare Part D, and Medicaid FFS and MCO markets, as well as community and IDN purchasing structures.
  • Proven account-planning success, senior stakeholder relationships, and appropriate coverage, formulary or pathway outcomes and field pull-through.
  • Experience leading payer, PBM, and oncology negotiations and evaluating pricing and contracting implications with Finance and Legal.
  • Experience communicating clinical and HEOR evidence with Medical Affairs support and developing educational programs through appropriate channels.
  • Demonstrated success working in a highly matrixed environment influencing cross-functional strategy, and coaching or mentoring colleagues.
  • Prior product-launch experience required, including account readiness and coordinated field execution.
  • Rare disease or rare oncology experience strongly preferred, with examples of account differentiation from large, high-volume therapeutic classes.
  • Ability to engage customers nationally; ability to travel up to 50%.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Deep knowledge of payer and PBM business models, revenues and incentives, and how insurance-side coverage differs from community and IDN purchasing.
  • Knowledge of formulary and PDL development, utilization management, reimbursement policies, and provider formulary and clinical pathway decisions.
  • Financial and contracting acumen across rebates, pricing, 340B, Medicaid Best Price, and key account economics.
  • Deep oncology therapeutic-area knowledge, including biologic and biosimilar access dynamics where relevant.
  • Ability to translate clinical and HEOR evidence into account-specific value narratives and identify evidence gaps with subject matter experts.
  • Executive presence, sound judgment, negotiation, stakeholder mapping, and relationship management skills across complex payer and provider accounts.
  • Cross-functional leadership and influence, including consultation, consensus building, mentoring, and collaboration across headquarters and field teams.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, strategic planning, and problem-solving skills; accountability and effective prioritization in a dynamic biotech environment.

Washington State Pay Range

$240,000—$269,908 USD

Join Our Experienced, Passionate Team

Working at Immunome gives you the opportunity to make a difference in the lives of cancer patients, contribute to developing best-in-class targeted cancer therapies, and work with some of the brightest and most experienced minds in antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) development.

Immunome’s office is charged with the collective excitement and passion of people working together to develop life-changing cancer medicines. Our team thrives in an innovative, collaborative environment where employees are empowered to do their best work.

Immunome also offers a comprehensive benefit program for you and your family, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage for employees and their dependents, including 100% company-paid medical premiums for employees
  • A 401(k) with employer match
  • Employer-paid life insurance, short- and long-term disability insurance, and AD&D
  • Paid time off, company holidays, and a week-long winter break between Christmas and New Years.
  • Paid parental leave

Growth, Production & Market Impact

  • Drive national new business growth across priority real estate sectors, which may include multifamily, affordable housing, commercial office, industrial and logistics, retail, mixed-use, hospitality, development, and property management.

Carrier, Market & Industry Relationships

  • Build and maintain deep relationships with property and casualty carriers, wholesale and program partners, alternative risk providers, and other markets relevant to real estate clients.

Talent Development & Capability Building

  • Actively support specialty recruiting by identifying talent pools, target organizations, role profiles, and high-potential candidates, and by participating in interviews and selection.

  • Mentor and develop real estate-specialized talent across production, account management, technical placement, analytics, claims, and risk control.
  • Build a sustainable national bench of real estate experts and future leaders, with deliberate development and succession planning.
  • Reduce reliance on any one individual or market by converting expertise into repeatable solutions, playbooks, tools, training, service standards, and delivery models.

Collaboration, Growth Enablement & Internal Integration

  • Serve as a consultative growth partner to Market Presidents, Commercial Lines leaders, sales leaders, producers, and client teams.
  • Engage early in strategic prospects, complex client needs, and major opportunities to pressure-test assumptions, shape pursuit strategy, and connect the right expertise and resources.
  • Increase producer confidence and effectiveness through real estate insight, practical coaching, relationship support, and clear access to practice resources.
  • Lead national practice calls and cross-market collaboration, promoting knowledge sharing and the transfer of proven approaches across IMA.
  • Partner with Marketing on focused thought leadership, events, association involvement, and market-facing content aligned with practice strategy.
  • Help markets replicate proven growth plays while adapting them to local asset classes, relationships, talent, and execution realities.

Performance, Accountability & Enterprise Leadership

  • Establish meaningful goals and expectations for growth, talent, capability, client value, activity, and execution.
  • Maintain a regular review cadence with market and enterprise stakeholders, surface risks and barriers early, and recommend adjustments based on evidence.
  • Create shared accountability across specialty, market, sales, and service leadership by clarifying ownership, milestones, resource needs, and decision points.
  • Represent the practice in enterprise planning and provide an objective view of opportunity, capacity, performance, and investment needs.
  • Measure success through the capability and results of the practice, not simply the individual activity of the Practice Leader.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Extensive real estate-related brokerage, underwriting, risk management, consulting, or adjacent experience, with strong technical knowledge of real estate exposures and insurance solutions.
  • Demonstrated credibility across relevant real estate sectors, client operating models, risk exposures, insurance markets, and competitive dynamics.
  • Experience supporting complex real estate portfolios, sophisticated placements, development projects, strategic pursuits, or industry-specific solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of property and catastrophe risk, valuation, builder’s risk, complex casualty, contractual risk transfer, claims, and alternative risk considerations.
  • Demonstrated ability to build senior-level relationships with real estate executives, clients, carrier leaders, associations, centers of influence, and strategic partners.
  • Proven ability to lead through influence across markets, functions, and reporting lines.
  • Experience recruiting, developing, mentoring, or deploying specialized talent.
  • Ability to convert technical knowledge into practical solutions, clear communication, scalable tools, and measurable growth or client value.

Competencies

  • Real Estate Industry and Business Acumen
  • Strategic Leadership and Commercial Judgment
  • Capability Building and Talent Development
  • Market Partnership and Growth Enablement
  • Relationship Building with Real Estate Executives, Carriers, and Industry Partners
