jobicy:164302.title: Sr Data Platform Engineer
jobicy:164302.description:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

Dataiku is looking for a Sr. Data Platform Engineer to join our Enterprise Data and Analytics (EDA) team. As a member of the EDA Team, you will play a central role in delivering data & GenAI solutions to fuel analytics and data-driven insights to various stakeholders and teams within the company. You will be a key technical member contributing to the Data Platform that fuels centralized analytics, embedded analytics teams, and self-service users across the organization.

At this level of seniority, non-technical skills, learning & teaching, and business acumen are critical, along with the expectation of technical excellence, as you will help drive technical decision-making and solutioning of key technical challenges both within the team and across the Analytics Community. The technical day-to-day will primarily be within the Data Platform built using Snowflake, Dataiku & GitHub. The primary development will focus on GenAI Platform Capabilities, Python & SQL (among other languages), DataOps processes built within GitHub Actions & Dataiku, and data platform processes built within Snowflake & Dataiku. Strong software development lifecycle knowledge and DataOps skills are a must! The ideal candidate is naturally curious, has excellent verbal and written communication skills, has a sharp analytical mind, a positive attitude towards work and thrives when collaborating towards a shared goal. This is an internal and non-client facing role.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Be an expert-level engineer across Dataiku (Platform Automation, GenAI Capabilities, Plugin Development, maintenance & troubleshooting) and Snowflake (data engineering, security/governance), including building & maintaining GenAI Platform solutions with a security/governance focus
  • Build & maintain Python & SQL-based platform automation and DataOps processes for SDLC delivery
  • Build & maintain data quality, observability, monitoring, alerting, access management, and platform transparency systems
  • Assist Data Engineering with Python & SQL data replication & pipelines on large, complex datasets
  • Design data models (short- and long-term) to support data warehouse scalability
  • Collaborate with GenAI Engineering & Analytics Engineering to build scalable Data Platform solutions
  • Perform root cause analysis on complex errors to ensure pipeline availability
  • Help drive technical & architectural decisions on the data platform (architecture, engineering processes, data quality, security/governance frameworks, DataOps, consumption models)
  • Test new Dataiku and partner-tool features, provide feedback, and assess value for internal integration
  • Work closely with stakeholders (Infra, embedded analytics, Product, Engineering) on implementation & requirements gathering, while promoting the Data Platform internally through mentoring, innovation initiatives, and contributions to EDA team standards and best practices

Some expected outcomes for this role

  • A more secure, well-governed GenAI layer on top of the Data Platform, with clear standards for engineering delivery
  • Measurable improvements in data quality, observability, and platform reliability (fewer/faster-resolved incidents via RCA)
  • Stronger, more automated DataOps/SDLC processes reducing manual overhead across the team
  • Scalable data models that support the platform’s growth across Analytics, GenAI Engineering, and self-service users
  • Closer technical alignment between Data Platforms, GenAI Engineering, and Analytics Engineering on shared solutions

What you’ll need to be successful

  • Strong understanding of GenAI development, security & governance concepts — a must
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in Data Engineering / Data Platform Engineering / Data Architecture
  • Expert-level SQL & Python; Snowflake experience required
  • Prior experience with DevOps technologies (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins)
  • Strong understanding of data architecture & data modeling concepts
  • Prior experience building and maintaining replication & data pipelines in a cloud data warehouse or data lake environment
  • Experience working with complex stakeholders: dissecting vague asks and defining tangible requirements
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a high-trust remote environment, wearing multiple hats as needed
  • Excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with a passion for continuous learning and teaching, and the ability to produce clear, precise documentation

What will make you stand out

  • Dataiku DSS experience
  • Demonstrated track record of mentoring or upskilling other engineers on new technologies or platform practices
  • Experience delivering GenAI architecture guidance directly to business/senior stakeholders

jobicy:164301.title: Senior Sales Manager (NSW)
jobicy:164301.description:
StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.

The Senior Sales Manager ( Senior Account Executive) combines strategic sales, market development, and commercial partnership building. You will be responsible for driving new programmatic advertising revenue while establishing and expanding StackAdapt's presence across the independent agency segment in NSW.

This is more than a traditional territory sales role. You'll be responsible for building pipeline, accelerating revenue growth, and developing strategic partnerships with agencies that create scalable opportunities for long-term market expansion. Success in this role requires a positive and can do mindset, ability to build on an already wide network of contacts, strong commercial acumen, and the ability to identify, develop, and close new business opportunities while navigating evolving market dynamics.

A successful Senior Sales Manager will understand clients' long-term business objectives and identify opportunities to grow their business through StackAdapt's programmatic advertising solutions. You'll also work closely with Client Success, Product, Marketing, and sales leadership teams to shape go-to-market strategy, develop partnership opportunities, and establish StackAdapt as a trusted partner across Australia.

StackAdapt is a remote-first company, and our Sales teams are regionalised. For this role, we are prioritising candidates located in Sydney, Australia.

What you'll be doing:

  • Identify, prospect, and close new programmatic advertising opportunities with independent agencies, across multiple stakeholders and levels in NSW.
  • Build and execute the commercial strategy for your patch, creating sustainable pipeline and consistently converting opportunities into revenue.
  • Develop and grow strategic commercial partnerships that accelerate long-term revenue growth.
  • Identify new market opportunities through agency partnerships, strategic alliances, and evolving customer needs.
  • Manage and grow strategic agency relationships by identifying opportunities to expand partnerships and increase long-term customer value.
  • Partner closely with Client Success to deliver exceptional customer outcomes while identifying opportunities for continued account growth.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales Leadership, Product, Client Success, Marketing, and Operations to share market insights, influence regional strategy, and support commercial growth initiatives.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with agencies and key industry stakeholders across NSW, Australia.
  • Develop a deep understanding of local market dynamics, competitive activity, customer behaviour, and industry trends to uncover new revenue opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasting, and opportunity tracking through CRM while consistently exceeding revenue targets.
  • Represent StackAdapt at client meetings, industry events, and networking opportunities to strengthen brand presence and expand market relationships.

What you’ll bring to the table:

  • 8+ years of experience in digital advertising, AdTech, or programmatic advertising sales, with a proven track record of exceeding new business targets.
  • Experience selling digital advertising solutions to Holdco agencies, with deep knowledge of the Australian advertising ecosystem.
  • Demonstrated success building pipeline from scratch, winning net-new business, and consistently delivering revenue growth in quota-carrying sales roles.
  • Proven experience developing commercial initiatives, or driving growth within established or emerging territories.
  • Experience building strategic and long term agency alliances, and having maximum presence across your agency groups to build long-term revenue growth.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to identify market opportunities, prioritise effectively, and execute independently in fast-paced growth environments.
  • Experience selling a Demand-Side Platform (DSP), programmatic platform, or other AdTech solution is highly desirable.
  • Existing relationships with independent agencies in NSW are a must.
  • Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to engage senior stakeholders, uncover business challenges, and position solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.
  • Strong practical understanding of AI tools, with demonstrated ability to use AI to improve sales productivity, account research, prospecting, meeting preparation and day-to-day workflows.
  • Curious and proactive in adopting emerging AI capabilities, with the ability to identify new ways AI can improve client conversations, commercial strategy and overall sales effectiveness.
  • Experience using CRM platforms to manage pipeline, forecast accurately, and maintain high standards of sales discipline.
  • Excellent relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and build credibility quickly in new markets.
  • Comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy while collaborating effectively across the wider Australian team

jobicy:164300.title: Customer Engineering Manager
jobicy:164300.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Mexico City, Mexico

What you’ll do as a Solutions Engineer Manager

As a SE Manager for Cloudflare for the LATAM Markets you will be responsible for managing a cross functional, full sales life cycle and technical activities for Cloudflare customers. The role requires someone with strong leadership, interpersonal, and business acumen to work with Sales to grow our account base. The SE Manager will manage a team of SEs that are geographically distributed within the US and Mexico, covering all of the countries that make up LATAM for Cloudflare. The SE team partners with the Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Public Sector LATAM Sales teams that are also geographically distributed in the US and Mexico, as well as Customer Success and is responsible for providing the value of Cloudflare products to customers and prospects

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge, experience and goals

Our Solutions Engineers come from a wide range of backgrounds: financial consulting, engineering, software development, product management, customer support & project delivery. We're serious about building a diverse team. When hiring we look for diversity of experience combined with genuine curiosity for our technology.

Ultimately, you are passionate about technology and people, and have the ability to explain complex technical concepts in easy-to-understand terms, and you like coaching and teaching. You are naturally curious, and an avid builder who is not afraid to get your hands dirty. On the Solutions Engineering team, you will find a collaborative environment where everyone brings different strengths and jumps in to help each other and you will be an integral part of driving that culture.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Management Information Systems or another related field or its equivalent.
  • 3+ years of experience with internet technologies / protocols and / or cloud technologies
  • Minimum 1 year of team lead/team management experience
  • Experience managing opportunity sales cycles and identifying technical proof activities
  • Demonstrated operations and organization skills implementation and driving best practices with cross functional organizations.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills.
  • Outstanding interpersonal skills with a proven track record of successfully building collaboration around important initiatives.
  • Successful track record of working and influencing matrixed organizations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to effectively present technical and business related subjects to all audiences.
  • Demonstrated problem solving skills, drive for results, interpersonal savvy, and customer focus.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

jobicy:164299.description:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

jobicy:164298.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

What you’ll do:

  • Manage Mozilla’s root store: Make root store management your primary responsibility, through public review processes, and policy and audit evaluations and using certificate analysis tools, the Common CA Database (CCADB), to process root inclusions, trust changes, and removals and maintain accurate trust and revocation data.
  • Evaluate CA compliance and investigate incidents: Review certificates, CA policies, audit reports, and incident responses. Identify gaps, ask precise follow-up questions, assess corrective actions, and support informed trust decisions.
  • Develop security policy and standards: Contribute to Mozilla’s Root Store Policy, program guidance, and CCADB and CA/Browser Forum requirements through technical analysis, clear drafting, and constructive public discussion.
  • Coordinate work and build program expertise: Collaborate with CAs, Mozilla engineers, auditors, and other root store operators to resolve issues and advance projects. Work closely with the CA Program Manager, document processes and decisions, and take on increasing responsibility.
  • Improve tools and automate CA program tasks: Maintain and enhance supporting tools and workflows. Use AI coding assistants and software tools to streamline certificate analysis, compliance review, data reconciliation, reporting, and documentation, with appropriate validation and human review.

What you’ll bring:

  • Understanding of the Web PKI and internet security: Working knowledge of digital certificates, public key cryptography, TLS, certificate chains, and revocation, including how technical requirements and CA practices establish trust. Awareness of emerging threats and developments, including post-quantum cryptography, and an interest in evaluating their implications for browser trust and CA operations.
  • Practical software engineering and automation skills: Experience developing, maintaining, testing, and debugging tools or services using existing codebases, APIs, structured data, Git-based workflows, and cloud applications.
  • CA compliance and audit evaluation: Ability to critically evaluate Certificate Policies and Certification Practice Statements (CP/CPS), independent audit reports, and incident analyses against applicable requirements. Familiarity with industry requirements and WebTrust and ETSI audit frameworks and the ability to identify gaps, assess supporting evidence, and formulate precise follow-up questions.
  • Analytical judgment and program management: Ability to investigate technical evidence, interpret specifications and policy requirements, and reach evidence-based conclusions. Prioritize competing requests, coordinate stakeholders, and follow complex issues through to resolution.
  • Clear communication and effective collaboration: Excellent written communication and facilitation skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions, write precise documentation and constructive questions, guide public discussions, and navigate disagreement professionally. Work effectively with distributed teams and external stakeholders, seek feedback, and share knowledge while developing broader technical and program expertise.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

This position requires proven experience working with reporters to secure earned media, along with a deep understanding of the German media landscapes, PR trends, and digital best practices.

We collaborate with content and SEO teams to amplify brand presence in different international markets, including the UK, France, Poland, Germany, Spain, Brazil, and Italy. jobicy:164295.title: Customer Marketing Manager, EMEA

Customer advocacy and proof

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of EMEA customer advocates based on customer outcomes, engagement, use cases, and willingness to participate.

  • Partner with Customer Success Managers and account teams to identify customers for case studies, video testimonials, customer quotes, social content, references, and events.

  • Manage customer participation from outreach through briefing, approvals, production, publication, and follow-up. Coordinate logo rights, quotes, and other customer permissions with the appropriate internal teams.

jobicy:164294.title: Sr. Customer Success Manager
jobicy:164294.description:
Who we are:

BigID is an innovative tech startup that focuses on solutions for data security, compliance, privacy, and AI data management. We're leading the market in all things data: helping our customers reduce risk, drive business innovation, achieve compliance, build customer trust, make better decisions, and get more value from their data.

We are building a global team passionate about innovation and next-gen technology. BigID has been recognized for:

  • BigID named one of Forbes America's Best Startup Employers 2026 - ranked #15 overall and #1 in Security
  • BigID named Hot Company in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning at the Global InfoSec Awards
  • Citizens JMP Cyber 66 List of Hottest Privately Held Cybersecurity Companies
  • CRN 100 list named BigID as one of the 20 Coolest Identity Access Management and Data Protection Companies (3 years running)
  • DUNS 100 Best Tech Companies to Work for
  • Top 3 Big Data and AI Vendors to Watch in the 2023 BigDATAwire Readers and Editors Choice Awards
  • 2024 Inc. 5000 list for the 4th consecutive year!
  • Shortlisted for the 2024 AI Awards in the category of Best Use of AI in Cybersecurity

At BigID, our team is the foundation of our success. Join a people-centric culture that is fast-paced and rewarding: you’ll have the opportunity to work with some of the most talented people in the industry who value innovation, diversity, integrity, and collaboration.

About the role

As AI adoption accelerates, security, privacy, and data leaders are rethinking how they find, protect, and govern their most sensitive data. BigID is the platform many of the world’s largest organizations rely on to do it.

As a Senior Customer Success Manager for our West/Central region, you’ll own a portfolio of 10-15 large enterprise accounts and act as a trusted advisor to CISOs, privacy officers, and data and governance leaders. You’ll turn BigID’s platform into measurable business outcomes, spot risk and opportunity early, and lead cross-functional teams to deliver results. You’ll join a Customer Success team of 7, working alongside Sales, Support, Professional Services, Product, and Engineering.

What you’ll do

  • Drive measurable outcomes. Build and run success plans tied to each customer’s business goals, and standardized engagement models and playbooks so every customer gets a consistent experience as we scale.
  • Lead the customer relationship at every level. Run onboarding, adoption programs, health checks, and QBRs/EBRs, from practitioners through executives.
  • Protect the base. Track usage, executive dashboards, and health indicators to catch churn signals early, and build and run mitigation plans for at-risk accounts.
  • Grow accounts with Sales. Partner with Sales on renewals, cross-sell, and upsell, aligning BigID capabilities (data discovery, classification, privacy, security, and AI governance) to each customer’s priorities.
  • Clear the path. Orchestrate Support, Professional Services, Product, and Engineering to resolve blockers and deliver key outcomes.
  • Be the voice of the customer. Bring customer feedback and product needs to Product and Engineering, and keep customers informed on upcoming releases and enhancements.

What success looks like in your first 12 months

  • Customers in your portfolio reach their agreed success milestones, with executive-level relationships established at each key account
  • Gross and net retention at or above target, with at-risk accounts identified early and moved back to healthy
  • A qualified expansion pipeline built in partnership with Sales
  • Customer health tracked consistently and reviewed with leadership on a regular cadence

What you’ll bring

Required

  • 5+ years in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or consulting, including 2+ years managing large enterprise accounts
  • Background in data security, privacy, data governance, or cybersecurity, as a customer or a vendor
  • Working knowledge of multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), on-prem, and SaaS data environments, and of structured and unstructured data
  • A record of driving adoption and managing risk to deliver renewals and expansion
  • Comfort presenting to a CISO and running an executive business review
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills in complex data environments
  • Based in the West/Central US
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

Nice to have

  • DSPM, DLP, or AI governance experience
  • Understanding of recurring-revenue value drivers
  • CIPP, CIPM, CISSP, or cloud certifications
  • Experience in a high-growth, scale-up environment

What’s in it for you (BigBenefits)

Our people are the foundation of our success, and we offer a wide range of benefits that help our team be happier and healthier.

  • Equity participation, so everyone shares in our success
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) participation from Day 1
  • Flexible PTO / holidays / parental leave
  • Knowledge training and career development tracks

Our values

We look for people who embody Care, Do, Try & Shine:

  • Care: We care about our customers and each other
  • Do: We do what it takes to make a positive impact
  • Try: We try our best and we don’t give up
  • Shine: We shine and make it our mission to always stand out

The annual base salary range is $120,000 to $150,000. Actual salaries vary based on a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and competencies. Salary is one component of our Compensation Philosophy. Variable/bonus compensation and equity incentives align with individual and company performance.

We’re committed to creating a culture of inclusion and equality – across race, gender, sexuality, and disability – where innovation and growth thrive, every voice is heard, and everybody belongs. Learn more about us here.

Job Candidate Privacy Notice

Must be able to exercise independent judgment with little or no oversight.

BigID is an E-Verify Participant.

jobicy:164293.title: Paralegal
jobicy:164293.description:
What is Teamshares?

Teamshares Inc. (Nasdaq: TMS) is a tech-enabled acquirer of high-quality businesses that intends to be a permanent home for the businesses it acquires. Part holding company, part fintech, Teamshares programmatically acquires companies with $0.5 million to $5 million of EBITDA from retiring owners, integrates them with the Teamshares platform, and helps their employees earn company stock. Founded in 2019, Teamshares is on a mission to create $10 billion of new wealth for lower-income Americans through employee ownership—addressing a longstanding gap, as before Teamshares there wasn't an easy way for the small businesses that make up 98% of U.S. firms to become employee-owned.

What You Will Do:

  • Assist Teamshares’ legal team with various legal projects and responsibilities.

  • Support Teamshares’ obligations as a publicly traded company, including assisting with Section 16 filings (Forms 3, 4, and 5), Exchange Act and Nasdaq compliance matters, D&O questionnaires, insider trading policy administration, equity plan administration, and Board and annual meeting logistics.

  • Help manage the closing process in the acquisition of businesses. This includes acquisitions of varying types and legal structures (e.g., stock purchases, asset purchases, and mergers); coordinating and reviewing diligence deliverables such as lien, UCC, and title searches; and drafting and negotiating ancillary transaction documents (e.g., bills of sale, assignment and assumption agreements, secretary’s and officer’s certificates, payoff letters and lien releases, and escrow agreements).

  • Iterate on a document management and legal compliance system for each of Teamshares’ network companies, including corporate minute books, organizational charts, and governance records for the parent company and each subsidiary.

  • Help implement and maintain the employee ownership program in each Teamshares network company, including equity administration and cap table maintenance.

  • Develop thoughtful and innovative strategies to improve the existing acquisition process.

  • Collaborate with the product development team and drive continuous discussions of opportunities where software can be leveraged to augment efficiency and scale.

  • Support corporate governance matters for Teamshares and its subsidiaries, including preparing and maintaining materials for Board and committee meetings, drafting Board and stockholder/member resolutions and written consents, maintaining and coordinating receipt of good standing certificates, and maintaining minute books and equity records.

  • Form new subsidiaries in connection with acquisitions, including drafting and filing certificates of incorporation/formation, bylaws and operating agreements, organizational resolutions, and IRS Form SS-4 applications.

  • Support outside counsel and the Legal team on routine litigation and pre-litigation matters affecting Teamshares and its network companies, including responding to wage garnishments and income withholding orders, coordinating compliance with HR/payroll, and tracking litigation deadlines and maintaining litigation files.

  • Manage relationships with the registered agent, corporate filing agents, and other outside vendors; maintain the Legal team’s contract repository and compliance calendar (e.g., annual reports, franchise tax filings, and business license renewals); and assist with trademark and other intellectual property docketing.

What You Bring:

  • 8+ years of paralegal experience, including M&A transaction experience gained in a law firm setting as well as on the in-house legal team of a publicly traded company.

  • A paralegal degree, certificate or similar training is preferred, but not required.

  • Self-starter with strong communication and organizational skills.

  • Exceptional verbal, written and interpersonal communication capabilities.

  • Ability to take initiative and ownership of work streams and work independently.

  • Hands-on experience with most of the following:

  • Ability to manage and drive an M&A closing process (putting together signature pages, creating closing sets, overseeing closing checklists, etc.)

  • Capability forming legal entities (filing formation or incorporation documentation and SS4s, etc.), including in connection with the formation of new subsidiaries for acquired businesses

  • Prior experience drafting Board and Shareholder/Member Consents. Equity administration experience is preferred, but not required.

  • Experience with routine litigation and pre-litigation matters (e.g., garnishments, income withholding orders, subpoenas, and collections) is a plus.

  • Experience supporting the corporate governance and public-company compliance function of a publicly traded company (e.g., SEC/Exchange Act reporting, Section 16 filings, Board and committee support) is a plus.

  • Notary public commission is a plus.

  • Familiarity with legal technology and contract management tools (e.g., document automation and e-signature platforms) is a plus.

This role presents a fantastic opportunity for an individual who is self-driven and wants to be part of a mission-driven team where collaboration, work-life balance, trust and initiative (among other core values) are part of the fabric of the company. The paralegal will be an integral part of a legal team that is responsible for Teamshares’ transition as a newly-public company and the continued acquisition of small businesses. In addition, this role will collaborate with the product team to find and implement creative ways to improve and automate current processes.

Why You Should Join Us:

We believe in supporting every team member with a competitive salary and a generous benefits package, including equity for all employees, exceptional medical/dental/vision benefits plans for employees and their families, 401k plan, and paid parental leave. We value time off and actually take our vacations, and we have a healthy work-life balance culture that checks egos at the door and truly unplugs at the end of the day. We embody a growth mindset and provide the support you need to grow in your career.

Compensation

From its roots as a leader in SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM), AppOmni is driving the next evolution of SaaS security - bringing intelligence, automation, and agentic capabilities into security operations. AppOmni empowers organizations to move beyond traditional visibility and posture management toward more intelligent, proactive, and autonomous security.

Recognized as a Frost Radar™ 2025 Leader and Great Place To Work®, AppOmni continues to set the standard for innovation and customer value in SaaS security.


About the Role

This position in a rapidly growing security engineering company is an opportunity to become AppOmni's expert on how the world's most widely used enterprise SaaS platforms are configured, administered and secured. AppOmni's SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) platform connects to applications such as Microsoft 365, Salesforce, ServiceNow and Workday through their APIs, collects their settings and permissions, and tells customers which configurations put their data at risk.

As a Senior Engineer on the Data Platform team, you will build and maintain those integrations, and you will decide what they should look for. You know these platforms the way an experienced administrator does: which settings matter, how permissions are really granted, which APIs expose what, and where vendors change behavior between releases. You will turn that knowledge into integrations, posture checks and insights that our customers rely on. These are challenging problems in a part of the security industry without defined solutions.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build and maintain integrations with flagship enterprise SaaS platforms, including
  • Microsoft 365, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday and others in AppOmni's catalog.
  • Determine which configuration settings, permissions, roles and sharing models matter for security posture in each platform, and translate them into posture rules and risk logic.
  • Map each platform's admin settings to the APIs that expose them, find gaps in API coverage, and design ways to collect the data reliably.
  • Track vendor release cycles, API deprecations and new security features, and update integrations and posture content before they affect customers.
  • Define the least-privilege permissions and OAuth scopes AppOmni needs in each platform, and document why each one is required.
  • Act as the internal subject matter expert on these platforms for Product, Detection
  • Engineering, AppOmni Labs, Customer Success and Sales, and help answer complex customer questions.
  • Write clear guidance on secure configuration for each platform, for customers and for internal teams.
  • Mentor engineers on SaaS platform internals and review integration designs and code.


What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of combined experience in software engineering, application security, or SaaS platform implementation and administration.
  • Deep, hands-on administration experience with at least two of Microsoft 365 (including Entra ID), Salesforce, ServiceNow or Workday, and working familiarity with others.
  • Strong understanding of each platform's security model: identity and authentication settings, roles and permission sets, sharing and data access controls, connected apps and third-party integrations, and audit logging.
  • Experience working with SaaS platform APIs such as Microsoft Graph, Salesforce Metadata and Tooling APIs, ServiceNow Table API or Workday web services, including authentication, rate limits and pagination.
  • Professional software development experience in Python, with the ability to write production-quality, tested code.
  • Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OIDC and SAML as used by enterprise SaaS platforms.
  • Ability to explain why a configuration is risky in terms both engineers and customer security teams understand.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.


You Might Also Have

  • Platform certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator or Platform Developer,
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, Microsoft 365 or Azure security certifications or Workday Integrations or Security certifications.
  • Experience as an implementation consultant or architect for one or more of these platforms.
  • Experience with PowerShell for Microsoft 365 and Exchange administration.
  • Familiarity with security benchmarks and guidance for SaaS platforms, such as CIS
  • Benchmarks or vendor security guides.
  • Experience with Go.
  • Prior experience at an SSPM, CASB, identity security or other SaaS security vendor.
  • Experience with additional platforms such as Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, GitHub, Atlassian, Box or Zoom.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: Learn how AppOmni's integrations and posture engine work and how data flows from a SaaS platform to a customer finding. Take ownership of the integration for at least one flagship platform. Deliver a review of that platform's posture coverage, identifying missing settings and rules that should change.

The Technology You'll Work With

  • Python (Django, FastAPI, Celery) and Go
  • Microsoft Graph, Salesforce, ServiceNow and Workday APIs, and PowerShell
  • Google Cloud Platform: GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, BigQuery
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse
  • Kubernetes

Our talented team is collaborative and supportive as we move quickly to research and develop new ideas, deliver new features to our customers, and iterate on ideas and innovations. We accomplish this by focusing on our five core values: Trust, Transparency, Quality, Customer Focus, and Delivery. Our team is determined to make a difference to positively impact our way of life by securing the technology that is changing the world.

AppOmni is proud to be Certified by Great Place to WorkⓇ, as we seek to build a culture where all employees feel appreciated and supported, especially with clear and honest leadership, employee recognition, and an environment that fosters innovation and collaboration.

We believe diversity fuels innovation and drives growth by bringing a wealth of different perspectives and skills. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every employee feels valued, heard, and empowered to reach their full potential. Join us in building a workplace where we can all thrive.

Compensation & Benefits

AppOmni is committed to supporting our employees' financial, professional, and personal well-being. To do this, we take a holistic view of compensation, one that values not just the immediate financial package but also the long-term growth of both our employees and our company.   • Stock Options: Our vision is to not just grow as a company but to grow together. By offering stock options, we are inviting you to be an integral part of our journey forward.

Responsibilities

- Strong attention to detail, especially on subtle differences like model suffixes, volume, color, and count.

- Ability to apply rules consistently and document the reasoning.

- Proficiency with Excel/CSV.

jobicy:164280.description:

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.

Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com

Job Overview

Want to help bring a world-class digital product to audiences around the globe? As a Production Coordinator on our client’s Localization team, you’ll support the localization of product features, marketing campaigns, editorial content, and web experiences across multiple markets. You’ll work alongside Senior Coordinators and Project Managers to deliver high-quality work on time, while building your expertise in localization operations and cross-functional collaboration.

This role is built to grow. The localization function is shifting toward AI-first workflows, and over the next 12 months you’ll move from supported operational work toward independently running AI-assisted localization workflows. You’ll run traditional processes while building the skills to be the human judgment layer for AI output, and you’ll take on greater cross-functional ownership along the way. We’re hiring for today’s work and for where this role is heading.

Main Responsibilities

  • Facilitate the end-to-end localization workflow for product features, marketing campaigns, editorial, and web content, with guidance from Senior Coordinators or Project Managers
  • Work with designers, product owners, engineers, marketers, and internal reviewers to gather localization requirements and track open action items
  • Collaborate with external vendors on query management, file handoffs, and delivery timelines
  • Monitor project status and flag risks or blockers to stakeholders early
  • Manage day-to-day translation operations, including testing, bug triage, localizability reviews, and design audits
  • Help prioritize and balance incoming work across shifting priorities
  • Follow established translation workflows and contribute ideas to improve efficiency and reduce time to market
  • Use AI tools and automation to streamline repetitive tasks, and look for new ways to apply them as your skills grow
  • Assist with project retrospectives, internal reports, and presentations
  • Support new team members by sharing knowledge and documenting processes
  • Partner with Project Managers and Program Managers to make sure program operations align with business needs and localization best practices

Job Requirements

  • Clear, proactive communication: you’re comfortable asking questions and raising issues early
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with a knack for keeping multiple workstreams on track
  • Comfort with change and ambiguity: you’d rather figure it out than wait for perfect instructions
  • Ownership of your work, and the discipline to follow through
  • Enthusiasm for AI and automation. The mindset matters more than prior experience

Skills & Experience

  • Curiosity and self-drive: when you meet a new tool or process, you dig in rather than wait to be shown
  • The ability to build strong working relationships through empathy, respect, and reliability
  • Experience in project coordination, localization operations, or a similar role is helpful, but not required if you bring the right mindset
  • A willingness to keep growing as your role expands

Education

Join us and help bring great digital experiences to every audience, in every language. You’ll learn quickly, take on more every month, and help shape how AI-first localization works. month, and help shape how AI-first localization works.

jobicy:164277.title: Staff QE, Mobile
jobicy:164277.description:
About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Team:

Our diverse Product & Engineering team values innovation, collaboration, and the continuous improvement of our platform. We offer a dynamic work environment where employees can grow and thrive while working on cutting-edge technology that shapes the future of AI and search.

At AlphaSense, we believe that diverse experiences and perspectives are critical to our success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves.

About the Role:

Investors and analysts open our app between meetings, on a train, before a call, and act on what they see. Mobile releases go through app stores and cannot be rolled back, so a problem can stay in customers' hands for days.

Our mobile product is growing fast, with new AI workflows arriving on iPhone, iPad and Android at the pace of the rest of the platform. Our quality practice has real foundations, including Appium and native UI test suites and real-device runs, but our newest features are ahead of our automated coverage, and release confidence still depends too much on individual effort.

As Staff Quality Engineer, you own one question: can we ship mobile with confidence, every release, on all platforms? You decide what we test and what we deliberately leave out, and you turn what you build into a way of working that Mobile Engineering owns with you.

You will report to the head of Quality Engineering and work day to day with the iOS and Android teams, alongside backend, web and platform QE.

What Makes this a Staff role:

  • You set direction, not a task list. Nobody hands you a test plan. You look at the product, the release risk and the team, and decide what matters most and why.
  • You own the outcome across platforms. Your scope is the quality of the product across clients, not one app or one team.
  • You work through influence. You are an individual contributor. Your standards stick because engineers see their value, and success means they write more testable code, make better release calls and need you less over time.

What You’ll Do:

  • Define mobile quality strategy. Set the long-term strategy built on "Quality by Design" and "Automation by Default": test layers, device and OS matrix, and release criteria for iOS and Android.
  • Set metrics the team can act on. Define quality metrics and coverage standards with Mobile Engineering and Product, so quality is measurable and sustainable without you.
  • Turn release day into a clear call. With no instant rollback, own the quality gates, staged rollouts and evidence behind every go or no-go decision.
  • Connect mobile to the rest of the platform. Mobile shares APIs and services with web, and customers update apps slowly, so changes elsewhere can break mobile after they have shipped. You are accountable for that risk.
  • Make the test platform dependable. Keep real-device and CI runs stable and fast (Bitrise, BrowserStack, GitLab, Allure), including test data and enterprise (Intune/MDM) builds.
  • Use AI where it earns its place. Use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot yourself, and help the team decide where they help and where human judgment must lead.
  • Leave the team stronger. Coach engineers and QEs, review designs for testability, and leave behind standards other teams adopt.

What Success looks like:

  • First 90 days: You have audited current coverage, agreed a prioritized plan with Mobile Engineering and delivered your first measurable improvement.
  • By 6 months: Critical mobile journeys are covered in the right layers on both platforms, and release readiness is an evidence-based call.
  • By 12 months: Mobile quality is a practice the team owns, and other portfolios borrow your ideas.

Who You Are:

  • A quality engineer with 8+ years of experience, including 2+ at Staff or Lead level. You have connected quality strategy across web and mobile, not just worked on mobile alone, and set direction across several teams or apps as an individual contributor without people-management authority. You can show what changed because of it.
  • Strong hands-on experience testing native mobile apps on at least one platform (iOS or Android), with working knowledge of the other. You are comfortable with real-device cloud and CI/CD for mobile builds, can work with tools such as XCUITest, Espresso, Compose UI testing or Appium, and code in at least one language such as Kotlin, Java, Swift or Python.
  • Strong debugging skills across the mobile stack, from crash reports to network traces, and a good understanding of how mobile releases move through the app stores.
  • Excellent test design and API testing, and comfortable in the backend: you can read APIs, debug across the client and service boundary, and work with contracts.
  • Strong understanding of continuous delivery and release gating, with experience in test management systems such as Allure TestOps.
  • An active AI tool user, with examples of where it helped and where it fell short.
  • Practical about trade-offs, and able to explain a release call to engineers and to non-technical leaders.

Bonus points:

  • Enterprise mobile experience (MDM/MAM, Intune, SSO, mobile security standards such as OWASP MASVS).
  • Experience building a mobile quality practice from an early stage.
  • Mobile performance testing (app start time, memory, battery) and release monitoring (crash and performance signals, staged rollouts).
  • Experience across both iOS and Android.

What we offer:

  • Playing a part in the story of a fast-growing company
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Lunch and recreational benefits
  • Occupational health care

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

jobicy:164276.title: Principal Engineer, Balance of Plant Auxiliary Systems
jobicy:164276.description:
Company Overview

Kairos Power is a new nuclear energy technology and engineering company whose mission is to enable the world’s transition to clean energy, with the ultimate goal to dramatically improve people’s quality of life while protecting the environment. This goal will be accomplished through the commercialization of the fluoride-salt-cooled, high-temperature reactor (FHR) that can be deployed with robust safety, affordable costs, and flexible operation to accommodate the expansion of variable renewables.

Job Summary

Kairos Power is seeking an experienced Principal Engineer to lead the technical deployment of KP-FHR balance of plant (BOP) auxiliary systems engineering, including service water, treated water, chilled water, component cooling water, and compressed air systems. Reporting to the Balance of Plant (Power Generation System and Turbine Island) Leader, you will develop technical design solutions to enable the rapid deployment and integration of KP-FHR Balance of Plant Structures, Systems and Components (SSCs). This role requires a senior individual contributor with extensive experience in thermal and balance of plant technologies to ensure efficient, safe, and reliable operation of the plant's balance of plant auxiliary systems.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the design and deployment of the balance of plant auxiliary systems, focusing on service water, treated water, chilled water, component cooling water, and compressed air systems including pumps, valves, and related auxiliary systems that meet Kairos Power’s FHR deployment objectives.
  • Manage and coordinate external partners, suppliers, regulators and vendors related to BOP auxiliary systems.
  • Support supplier technical oversight, including review of supplier deliverables, technical deviations, test plans, and component qualification evidence while performing independent verification calculations as necessary.
  • Develop and approve system documentation deliverables as required by the project.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate the balance of plant auxiliary systems with overall plant design and operations.
  • Lead or support formal design reviews, interface reviews, hazard reviews, and technical readiness reviews for balance of plant components and subsystems.
  • Apply engineering principles and engineering codes & standards, such as ASME and ANSI, to the design, analysis, and evaluation of systems.
  • Lead design trade studies, performance analyses and optimization of balance of plant auxiliary systems to meet commercial and regulatory needs.
  • Oversee the preparation of technical specifications, design documents, and system drawings for all balance of plant auxiliary systems components.
  • Perform feasibility studies and risk assessments related to commercial balance of plant auxiliary systems technologies and subsystems.
  • Present findings and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders, ensuring clear communication of technical concepts and strategies.
  • Support commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting of the balance of plant auxiliary systems during the plant's startup phase.
  • Stay abreast of industry advancements, best practices, and emerging balance of plant technologies.
  • Develop and maintain system requirements, interface control documents, design bases, and verification/validation plans for balance of plant components.
  • Perform work within established scope, budgetary and schedule requirements.
  • Resolve complex technical issues and system/interface conflicts affecting BOP auxiliary system design, procurement, installation, testing, or commissioning.
  • Evaluate proposed design changes and technical deviations for impact on system requirements, interfaces, design basis, safety, quality, and configuration control.
  • Establish and maintain technical acceptance criteria for BOP auxiliary system components and subsystems, including criteria used for procurement, testing, and verification.
  • Provide technical disposition and recommendations for nonconforming conditions, test results, or equipment performance issues within assigned BOP systems.
  • Ensure design decisions, analyses, and technical resolutions are documented and traceable to applicable requirements, design inputs, and verification evidence.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • M.S. degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Nuclear Engineering, or a related field
  • 10+ years experience in the design and operation of balance of plant systems, particularly in the nuclear or thermal power sectors
  • Demonstrated experience in managing complex engineering projects and leading technical teams, with thorough understanding of evaluation, design, and licensing of a new technology
  • Demonstrated experience of physical hardware deployment in heat transfer and water treatment systems
  • Experience with requirements management, systems engineering, or design control processes for complex engineered systems.
  • Experience reviewing or developing technical specifications, procurement documents, test plans, or acceptance criteria for major equipment.
  • Experience applying engineering codes and standards relevant to BOP auxiliary systems, including applicable ASME, ASTM, ICC, ISO, and MSS standards. Experience with one or more of the following is preferred:

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Demonstrated vendor engagement and management skills
  • Strong understanding of heat transfer principles, thermodynamics, and fluid mechanics as they relate to balance of plant systems
  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry standards for balance of plant systems. Experience with nuclear power applications is a plus.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of optimizing system performance in novel applications
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills; must be able to interact and communicate effectively at all levels of the organization including external partners
  • Ability to work with a highly collaborative team
  • Ability to solve problems quickly and efficiently
  • Prioritizes and demonstrates a nuclear safety culture
  • Ability to proactively collect, manage and transfer knowledge
  • Ability to seek different and novel ways to create efficiencies when working on problems, challenges, and issues
  • Knowledge of system integration, interface management, and verification/validation practices.
  • Ability to apply safety, quality, and configuration management principles to engineering design activities.
  • Ability to apply engineering judgment to evaluate design alternatives, technical risks, and trade-offs and develop defensible technical recommendations.
  • Knowledge of requirements development, allocation, traceability, and verification for complex engineered systems.
  • Ability to evaluate technical specifications, supplier deliverables, test plans, deviations, and qualification evidence against design requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Ability to interpret and apply applicable engineering codes, standards, and design criteria to BOP system and component design.

Physical Demands

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing, or sitting for prolonged periods
  • Moving about to accomplish tasks or moving from one worksite to another
  • Communicating with others to exchange information

Environmental Conditions

  • General office environment
  • Prototyping/Testing environment
  • Manufacturing/Industrial Environment
  • Assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned
  • High-concentration, demanding and fast-paced

Safety and PPE

  • Reading and interpreting hazardous warning signs
  • Reporting issues with equipment or unsafe conditions
  • Wearing proper PPE, to include face mask, face shields, gloves, safety shoes, etc.

Travel

  • Some travel may be required, up to 25%

Additional Requirements

  • Requires occasional schedule flexibility
  • Requires occasional extended hours to support testing, commissioning, and critical project timeline

The salary range for this position is $175,019 to $218,774 for employees working onsite at our Alameda, CA headquarters. The range provided in this job posting represents the typical range or starting rate of candidates hired in California. jobicy:164275.title: Technical Account Manager (AI Driven) - Curveglass
jobicy:164275.description:
Curveglass is a startup incubated by AE Studio that provides a flight-level correction layer for airline revenue management, helping airlines make better decisions through advanced data science and modeling.
As part of the AE Studio ecosystem, Curveglass combines the speed, focus, and ownership of a startup with access to a broader network of engineering, AI, and product expertise.
Curveglass runs directly inside each airline's cloud environment. Our product consists of a common Core and a client-specific Adapter, which handles everything needed to make Curveglass work within each airline's environment — including the web application, APIs, data integrations, business rules, and exports into the airline's systems.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Technical Account Manager at Curveglass, you'll own the technical implementation of Curveglass for airline clients end-to-end.
This is a hands-on engineering role with broad ownership. You'll build and maintain client-specific Adapter code, work across frontend and backend systems, integrate with airline data and infrastructure, and deploy and operate Curveglass within client cloud environments.
You'll also work directly with clients. That means understanding their technical and business needs, participating in and leading meetings, troubleshooting issues, analyzing recommendation results in collaboration with revenue management teams, and managing technical expectations as needed.
You'll work closely with the Curveglass core team to determine what should be solved within a client's Adapter and what should become part of the shared Core. You'll bring client needs back to the team as roadmap input and Core change requests, while owning the implementation of client-specific functionality yourself.
We're looking for someone who enjoys the full lifecycle of software engineering: understanding the problem, building the solution, deploying it, and seeing how it performs in the real world.
You'll have meaningful ownership over the systems you build and the opportunity to influence Curveglass's architecture and product as we grow.
If you enjoy owning technical problems end-to-end and working closely with the people using what you build, we'd love to talk.

ABOUT YOU

You're a strong, pragmatic engineer who enjoys owning systems beyond just writing the code.
You're comfortable working across different parts of the stack and taking responsibility for an implementation from beginning to end: understanding requirements, designing the solution, building integrations and product functionality, deploying infrastructure, troubleshooting issues, and continuing to improve the system once it's live.
You're comfortable operating in a startup environment where problems may not always come neatly defined. You can take ownership, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and move from an ambiguous problem to a reliable production solution.
You also communicate well with people outside of engineering. You can understand the business context behind a technical request, explain technical decisions clearly, and lead conversations with clients when needed.
You work well independently, collaborate closely with data science and product teams, and care about building software that is reliable, maintainable, and genuinely useful.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong software engineering experience: You can independently design, build, debug, and maintain production systems.
  • Fluency in Python: You're highly proficient with Python and comfortable using it in production environments.
  • Full-stack development: You're comfortable working with TypeScript and React and can own frontend functionality when needed.
  • SQL and data integration: You can work confidently with relational data, APIs, client datasets, and production data flows.
  • Cloud infrastructure: You're comfortable deploying and maintaining applications in AWS or Azure.
  • Containers and infrastructure as code: You have hands-on experience with containers and tools such as Terraform.
  • End-to-end ownership: You're comfortable taking responsibility for a system across application code, integrations, infrastructure, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Client-facing communication: You're comfortable interacting directly with clients, leading technical meetings when needed, explaining decisions clearly, managing expectations, and pushing back thoughtfully when appropriate.
  • Business thinking: You care about why something is being built and the outcome it needs to create, not just the technical implementation.
  • Production-minded development: You write maintainable code and care about reliability, observability, debugging, and how systems behave in real-world environments.
  • AI-powered development: You use modern AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow and know how to use them effectively without sacrificing quality.
  • Self-management: You can take ownership of complex problems, navigate ambiguity, and deliver without constant oversight.
  • Effective communication in English: You're fluent in spoken and written English and can confidently communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Timezone flexibility: You're comfortable occasionally adapting meeting hours to work with clients across the Americas, Europe, and the Middle East.

Bonus Points for

  • Enterprise implementation experience: You've implemented enterprise or data products where customers require meaningful integration and customization rather than a purely self-service SaaS product.
  • Airline or revenue management experience: Familiarity with airline pricing, forecasting, revenue management, or related systems.
  • Data engineering experience: You've worked with production data pipelines and technologies such as Parquet, Snowflake, or similar data infrastructure.
  • Spanish or Portuguese: Professional proficiency in either language.
  • Startup experience: You thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy ambiguity, and are comfortable taking ownership beyond a narrowly defined job description.
  • Cloud deployment experience: You've deployed and operated applications or infrastructure within enterprise AWS or Azure environments.
  • Strong product instincts: You understand when something should be solved as client-specific functionality versus becoming part of a broader product.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Startup environment, backed by AE Studio: Join a focused, fast-moving startup while benefiting from the broader engineering, AI, and product ecosystem of AE Studio.
  • High-impact engineering: Build production systems that directly shape the Curveglass product and how airlines use it.
  • End-to-end responsibility: Own your work from architecture and implementation through deployment, integration, and ongoing operation.
  • Real-world problems: Work on complex engineering and data problems within airline revenue management, where the software you build directly supports business decisions.
  • Direct product exposure: Work closely with the people using what you build and bring those insights back into technical and product decisions.
  • Product influence: Help shape Curveglass's architecture, roadmap, and approach to client-specific versus shared product functionality.
  • Small, collaborative team: Work closely with engineering, data science, product, and leadership, with significant autonomy over how you solve problems.
  • Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere, or connect with the broader AE Studio team and community.
  • Flexible schedules: We care about outcomes, ownership, and impact—not micromanagement.
  • Competitive compensation: Competitive pay and the opportunity to grow alongside the company.
  • Opportunities for growth: Help shape how Curveglass approaches engineering, infrastructure, integrations, and technical decision-making as we scale.

jobicy:164274.title: Software Engineer III | Framework
jobicy:164274.description:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary

As a Software Engineer III, you will drive key architectural and technical decisions, lead the design and execution of complex engineering initiatives, and elevate technical standards across the Framework team. You’ll partner closely with principal engineers, product leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver resilient, scalable, and secure systems that power core ExtraHop products. This role is designed for an experienced engineer who combines deep technical expertise with strong ownership and is motivated to grow their impact through excellent engineering and active collaboration.

Our team builds high-performance network detection and monitoring systems that operate at scale across increasingly complex protocols and data volumes.Our services and features are written primarily in C and C++ with a focus on security, scalability, stability, and reliability. Our team is focussed on enhancing, maintaining and optimizing core components of the system and functional areas related to protocol parsing, metrics publishing, continuous packet capture and Time Series DB.

This role focuses on designing and optimizing these core systems with an emphasis on performance, reliability and deep protocol awareness. This role will serve as the technical leader for tax platforms, partnering closely with Tax, Finance, Accounting, IT Engineering, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, compliant, and automated tax solutions that support CoreWeave's rapid global growth.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in multiple tax engines (Vertex, Avalara, 1Source etc.), with strong indirect tax domain knowledge, and hands-on experience integrating tax platforms with ERP, billing, procurement, and enterprise applications. This individual will drive the modernization of tax technology while ensuring compliance, operational efficiency, and enterprise scalability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design scalable tax technology solutions supporting Sales & Use Tax, VAT, GST, excise tax, withholding tax, and other indirect tax requirements.
  • Partner with Global Tax, Finance, Accounting, Revenue, Procurement, and Engineering teams to define and implement tax system strategies.
  • Design, implement, and maintain integrations between tax platforms and enterprise applications including NetSuite, SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Coupa, billing platforms, e-commerce platforms, procurement systems, and data warehouses.
  • Support global tax determination, tax calculation, exemption certificate management, tax reporting, tax returns, and audit requirements.
  • Lead tax technology projects from requirements gathering through architecture, development, testing, deployment, and post-production support.
  • Drive automation of tax processes to improve accuracy, compliance, operational efficiency, and scalability.
  • Ensure tax systems comply with SOX controls, audit requirements, data governance policies, and regulatory standards.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to evaluate new tax regulations and implement required system changes.
  • Develop technical designs, integration specifications, and solution documentation.
  • Troubleshoot complex tax calculation, integration, and compliance issues across enterprise applications.
  • Establish best practices for tax technology architecture, integrations, monitoring, and operational support.
  • Serve as the primary technical subject matter expert for tax platforms and enterprise tax systems.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 15+ years of experience implementing and supporting enterprise tax technology solutions.
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience with multiple tax platforms.
  • Strong understanding of indirect tax processes including:
    • Sales & Use Tax
    • VAT
    • GST
    • Global indirect tax compliance
  • Experience implementing tax systems integrations with one or more ERP platforms such as:
    • NetSuite
    • SAP
    • Oracle
  • Experience integrating tax systems with procurement, billing, e-commerce, and financial applications.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise integration technologies including APIs, middleware, and iPaaS platforms (Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft, or similar).
  • Experience with REST/SOAP APIs, web services, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Knowledge of tax content updates, jurisdiction management, tax rules, and exemption certificate management.
  • Experience supporting tax audits, SOX controls, and regulatory compliance.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to resolve complex tax system issues.

Preferred Qualifications

The base salary range for this role is $188,000 to $275,000. The starting salary will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).
