Once you apply for the job, our team will review your resume. If it meets the requirements, we will contact you and move forward in the process.

Note for Candidates Approached Directly:
If you were contacted directly by a member of our team and are interested in this opportunity, please do not apply through this link. Instead, reach out to the person who contacted you to coordinate a meeting.

Thank you!

jobicy:164227.title: Director, Security Operations & Detection Engineering
jobicy:164227.description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

About the Team

The Security Operations Team at Harness is a small, high-leverage organization responsible for how we detect, investigate, and respond to threats across our cloud environment and the platform we run for customers. We measure ourselves against NIST CSF 2.0 and work closely with Cloud Security, IAM, Product Security, and Platform Engineering. We design for assume-breach: layered preventive controls, strong identity as the perimeter, and fast detection and response.

The Role

We are looking for a Director to own Security Operations (SOC), Detection Engineering, and Incident Response at Harness. You will build and lead the team that monitors our environment, engineers high-quality detections, and responds to incidents, and you will be accountable for how quickly and reliably we find and contain threats.

This is a player-coach leadership role. You are expected to stay close to the technical work, set the detection and response strategy, and build the team, tooling, and metrics that make Security Operations scalable.

What You Will Do

Security Operations & Incident Response

  • Lead the SOC, including monitoring, triage, escalation, and on-call coverage, and manage any external SOC or managed detection and response (MDR) partners.
  • Own the incident response lifecycle: runbooks, tabletop exercises, executive communication for high-severity incidents, and post-incident reviews that drive lasting fixes.
  • Define and report operational metrics such as detection coverage, alert quality, mean time to detect, and mean time to respond.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Privacy, and Customer Success on incident communication and customer or regulatory notification obligations.

Detection Engineering

  • Set the detection strategy and roadmap, with detections mapped to attacker techniques (MITRE ATT&CK) and prioritized by real risk to Harness and our customers.
  • Build a detection-as-code practice with peer review, testing standards, and a managed detection backlog.
  • Ensure the right telemetry is collected across cloud, Kubernetes, identity, endpoint, SaaS, and CI/CD systems, and partner with platform teams to close gaps.
  • Validate detections through purple-team exercises and testing, and tune continuously to reduce noise.

Automation & Tooling

  • Own the SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and cloud-native logging stack, including roadmap, budget, and vendor relationships.
  • Reduce manual work through automation and AI-assisted triage and investigation, with human review where it matters.
  • Integrate threat intelligence and threat hunting into detection and response workflows.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Hire, coach, and develop SOC analysts and detection engineers, and build a sustainable on-call culture.
  • Partner with Cloud Security and IAM to align detection coverage with infrastructure and identity controls.
  • Translate NIST CSF 2.0 goals into a prioritized roadmap with clear owners and executive-ready reporting.
  • Support customer trust by contributing to security briefings, questionnaires, and architecture reviews.
  • Present security operations posture, risk, and progress to senior leadership.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 10+ years in security operations, incident response, detection engineering, or security engineering, with 5+ years leading technical teams.
  • Experience leading a SOC or detection and response function, including leading team leads or senior engineers.
  • Hands-on depth in detection engineering: you have written, tuned, and retired detections across SIEM, EDR, and cloud telemetry.
  • Proven experience as incident commander or senior leader on significant security incidents.
  • Strong experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and cloud-native logging, and with automation using scripting (such as Python).
  • Working knowledge of cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure) and Kubernetes from a detection and response perspective.
  • Working knowledge of security frameworks and compliance regimes (NIST CSF, SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP or similar).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting to executives and to customer security teams.

Preferred

  • Experience at a SaaS, DevOps, or developer-tools company, especially one with customer-hosted or hybrid components.
  • Experience building detection-as-code pipelines and measuring detection quality.
  • Experience managing MDR or co-managed SOC relationships with accountability for outcomes.
  • Experience applying AI to triage, investigation, or detection engineering.
  • Experience with threat intelligence and threat hunting programs.
  • Relevant certifications (CISSP, CISM, GCIH, GCFA, GCDA, or similar) are a plus, not a requirement.

Pay transparency

$248,000—$300,000 USD

Harness in the news:

  • Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
  • Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
  • How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
  • Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
  • Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

jobicy:164226.title: Mission Director - Army
jobicy:164226.description:
This position offers a base salary of $145,000 - $185,000. (Total on-target earnings of $290,000 to $370,000)

Role Description:

The Mission Director is a quota-carrying, full-lifecycle business owner responsible for identifying, shaping, closing, and executing new business within the Army specifically targeting PAE Maneuver Air.

You will build trusted relationships with Mission Heroes (our customers), identify meaningful problems, shape solutions using Defense Unicorns products, and lead opportunities from initial discovery through contract award. Once awarded, you will remain accountable for the contract throughout its lifecycle, including cost, schedule, performance, staffing, margin, and customer satisfaction.

This role is designed for someone who wants broad ownership. As the portfolio grows in size and complexity, Mission Directors will increasingly lead through program managers and delivery leaders while retaining accountability for portfolio outcomes.

Responsibilities:

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise.

Build the Business

  • Identify and develop net-new Army Aviation opportunities and build trusted relationships with Mission Heroes and key stakeholders.
  • Own a quota and grow a diversified portfolio of business.

Shape and Close Opportunities

  • Define customer problems, scope, and desired outcomes to shape solutions using Defense Unicorns products and the right acquisition approach.
  • Lead opportunities through proposal, negotiation, and contract award.

Own Contract Execution

  • Serve as the program leader for new contracts you close, with direct responsibility for execution until the portfolio reaches the scale where additional program management support is warranted.
  • Manage delivery risks, scope changes, and mission outcomes.

Build and Lead the Team

  • Define and build the team required to execute each contract. Personally lead contract execution and, as the portfolio grows, lead program managers and other delivery leaders across the portfolio.

Grow the Portfolio

  • Maintain an active pipeline and continue developing new opportunities while executing existing contracts by identifying follow-on work, expansions, and adjacent opportunities.
  • Own customer retention, portfolio growth, and gross margin.
  • Grow from individual contract ownership into a broader portfolio leadership role.

Preferred Experience and Qualifications:

  • Experience within Army Aviation or a closely related defense environment.
  • Strong understanding of the culture, mission, stakeholders, and terminology within the domain you support.
  • Experience in one or more of the following: military operations, government program management, acquisition, contracting, business development, or defense industry program leadership.
  • Working knowledge of federal acquisition, including contract vehicles, acquisition strategies, and contract negotiations.
  • Strong commercial judgment and comfort owning revenue-generating activities.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams and hold accountability for outcomes.
  • Willingness to operate across business development, contracting, staffing, and execution, personally driving critical work while building and leading the teams required to scale.
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity, identifying opportunities, and creating a path forward without a predefined playbook.
  • Technical fluency sufficient to understand and communicate Defense Unicorns products, cloud-native technologies, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and modern software delivery concepts.

Candidates located near major Army hubs are preferred.

Ability to travel approximately 25-40%.

Who We Are

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market.

What We Do

We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily.

Who We Serve

Defense Unicorns’ customers are mission-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products.

What We Work On

  • Kubernetes
  • Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP and Azure)
  • Infrastructure-as-code (like Terraform/Pulumi)
  • Continuous Delivery and automation tooling
  • GitOps
  • Containers
  • CNCF projects and open source products and packages
  • Helm/Kustomize-Value Stream Mapping
  • Building and improving security delivery
  • Building Kubernetes and cloud native applications

Benefits Our Unicorns Enjoy

Health:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • Premiums are 100% Company Paid
  • Health Savings Account
  • Life Insurance
  • Disability Insurance

Financial:

  • 401k Retirement Plan
  • Company Stock Options
  • Home Office Budget

Leave:

  • We offer all full-time Unicorns Flexible Time Off (FTO) plus all Federal Holidays, one week for Thanksgiving, and two weeks for Christmas and New Year’s
  • Paid Parental Leave

Learning:

  • Reimbursement for approved trainings/subscriptions
  • Conferences (travel, lodging, and fees)

Don’t have all the preferred experience or qualifications? Studies show that underrepresented groups like women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs if they don't meet every requirement listed.

At Defense Unicorns, we're committed to diversity. If you're enthusiastic about the role but don't match every criteria, we encourage you to apply. You could be the perfect fit for this or another role! Defense Unicorns is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

CCPA DISCLOSURE

jobicy:164223.title: Head of Financial Planning & Analysis
jobicy:164223.description:
About the role

At NetBox Labs, we're building the future of network automation. Our products power network and infrastructure management for thousands of organizations, from fast-growing startups to global Fortune 500 enterprises.

We're hiring a Head of FP&A to own how NetBox Labs plans, allocates capital, and measures performance. Reporting to the CFO, you'll run the company's planning and forecasting engine, be the finance partner to the executive team, and build the FP&A team that scales with us. This is a leadership role. You'll take on complex, ambiguous problems with no clean answer, own the finance relationship with every executive and budget owner, and lead the team that does the work.

What you'll do

Own the planning engine

  • Own annual budgeting, quarterly reforecasts, scenario planning, and the long-range plan end to end; set the calendar, the guidance, and the bar for accuracy

  • Own the integrated three-statement operating model, with driver-based forecasts for ARR, bookings, GAAP revenue, collections, burn, and runway

  • Run the budget-owner operating cadence: monthly budget-vs-actual reviews with each VP, clear spend guardrails, and accountability for variances

Steer capital allocation

  • Manage the day to day finance relationship with each executive and budget owner; be their first call on where to invest

  • Take on the company's hardest cross-functional business questions, often undefined and with imperfect data; frame them, bring a point of view, recommend tradeoffs, and make the case for them

  • Partner with People team on headcount planning and workforce cost

Own the financial narrative

  • Own company KPIs (ARR, NRR/GRR, CAC payback, capital efficiency, Rule of 40, margin, productivity) and benchmark them against best-in-class enterprise software peers

  • Own financial data quality, metrics, and the narrative in management and investor reporting

Build the function

  • Make AI and automation the default way the team works, scaling output without scaling headcount linearly

  • Lead and grow the FP&A team: hire, set goals, coach, and develop

  • Drive the FP&A systems roadmap

  • Partner with the Controller on close, flux, and forecast hygiene so actuals and plan tell one story

What you'll bring

  • 8+ years in FP&A, strategic finance, investment banking, private equity, or venture capital, including 4+ years in high-growth enterprise software (Series B through IPO-track)

  • You've been the senior FP&A leader at a venture-backed company and owned company-level planning, cash forecasting, and the three-statement model

  • You've hired, developed, and led an FP&A team, and built process and systems from scratch, not just inherited them

  • Deep fluency in SaaS metrics, enterprise value drivers, subscription unit economics, GTM capacity and productivity, and sales compensation design

  • Board- and investor-ready: you've built and presented Board materials and supported a priced equity round or diligence process

  • GAAP literacy: revenue recognition, deferred revenue, accruals, and the timing gap between bookings, revenue, and cash in high-ASP enterprise deals

  • You own executive relationships end to end: VPs seek you out, trust your numbers, and accept a "no" or "not yet" from you

  • Strong problem solving in ambiguity: you break down complex problems with no clear owner or clean data, land on a recommendation, and balance precision with speed without over-engineering

  • Hands-on with AI and automation in your own workflow; advanced spreadsheet modeling; SQL or BI fluency is a plus

  • Nice to have: open-source or developer/infrastructure software experience; EPM implementation experience

Our stack

  • Financial planning & analysis: Spreadsheets

  • General Ledger: QuickBooks Online

  • Billing & AR: Tabs

  • CRM: HubSpot

  • AP & corporate cards: Ramp

  • Payroll: Justworks, Deel

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

jobicy:164222.title: Senior Manager, Sales Technology & AI Enablement
jobicy:164222.description:
Reports to: VP, Sales Enablement 

About Axiom

Axiom, a leading global marketplace for on-demand legal talent, is leading a revolution in the legal industry. The Axiom model disrupts the traditional allocation of work to law firms and in-house teams. By matching highly credentialed lawyers and legal talent with legal work across industries and practice areas, Axiom enables clients to become more agile and efficient and empowers lawyers and legal talent to pursue more of the work they love. Axiom serves over half the Fortune 100 with market leading NPS ratings from both its clients and employees.

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Sales Technology & AI Enablement translates commercial technology, sales processes, AI-enabled workflows, and Axiom's AI-enabled client solutions into practical ways of working for sellers and managers. This role serves as the Enablement lead for the commercial technology ecosystem: helping the field use core sales technologies and AI to work more effectively, while partnering with Technology & Talent and AI Client Solutions leaders to build field readiness to position Axiom's evolving AI solutions. The role partners closely with Revenue Operations, GTM Transformation, IT, Marketing, Product, Technology & Talent, and sales leadership to ensure sellers and managers can leverage internal technology and AI effectively and confidently bring Axiom's AI-enabled solutions into client conversations.

The role does not own enterprise system administration or design Axiom's client AI solutions. It owns the field activation layer: understanding the seller experience, translating technology, process, and solution capabilities into clear seller and manager behaviors, building the enablement experience, and measuring whether the field can use internal tools and position Axiom's AI-enabled solutions effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Technology and Workflow Expertise

  • Serve as the Commercial Enablement subject matter expert for Gong, Salesforce, Clay, ChatGPT and other AI capabilities, sales engagement tools, and related commercial platforms, while building sufficient fluency in Axiom's AI-enabled client solutions to translate them effectively for the field.
  • Develop a deep understanding of end-to-end seller and manager workflows, including prospecting and outreach channels, opportunity management, pipeline inspection, forecasting, and account planning.
  • Understand Axiom's sales process, sales stages, required activities, data expectations, and handoffs well enough to translate system and process changes into clear field behavior.
  • Stay current on platform capabilities, releases, integrations, emerging commercial AI use cases, and Axiom's evolving AI-enabled client solutions; identify opportunities to simplify internal work, improve seller productivity, and strengthen the field's ability to position relevant solutions with clients.
  • Identify practical opportunities for sellers and managers to use generative AI and other AI-enabled capabilities to improve productivity, quality, and consistency across the sales workflow, including research, account planning, meeting preparation, outreach, opportunity management, follow-up, and manager coaching.
  • Translate those opportunities into usable field practices, prompt guidance, examples, demonstrations, job aids, and reinforcement that help sellers apply AI effectively in the flow of work rather than treating AI as a stand-alone tool.

Cross Functional Design and Influence

  • Partner with Revenue Operations, GTM Transformation, IT, Marketing, Product, Technology & Talent, AI Client Solutions, and other functional teams early in the design or introduction of new tools, workflows, process changes, and AI-enabled client offerings that require field activation.
  • Represent the seller and manager experience in technology and process decisions, influencing requirements, workflow design, launch sequencing, communications, and measures of success.
  • Assess whether an initiative requires formal enablement, manager-led activation, targeted communications, performance support, or another adoption approach.
  • Clarify ownership across system administration, process design, communications, enablement, and field reinforcement so launches are coordinated and sustainable.

AI Solution Sales Enablement

  • Partner with Technology & Talent and AI Client Solutions leaders to translate Axiom's AI-enabled offerings, use cases, and value propositions into practical field enablement for sellers and managers.
  • Build seller readiness to recognize relevant client needs, conduct effective early-stage discovery, position Axiom's AI-enabled solutions, articulate business value, navigate common questions and objections, and engage the appropriate solution experts.
  • Translate complex AI solution concepts into clear, commercially relevant messaging, talk tracks, playbooks, learning experiences, demonstrations, job aids, and manager reinforcement without requiring sellers to become technical AI experts.
  • Create repeatable field guidance that clarifies what sellers should know and do at each stage of the commercial conversation, including when to bring in Technology & Talent or AI Client Solutions expertise.
  • Maintain field readiness as Axiom's AI-enabled offerings and go-to-market approach evolve, using seller and manager feedback to identify knowledge gaps, improve enablement, and reinforce effective positioning.

Enablement Design and Delivery

  • Create activation plans that connect each technology, process, or AI-solution launch to the specific seller and manager knowledge, behaviors, and actions required for success.
  • Build clear, engaging self-paced learning modules, live demonstrations, short instructional videos, job aids, workflow maps, step-by-step guides, FAQs, and manager discussion materials.
  • Deliver live demonstrations and working sessions for leaders, managers, sellers, and cross-functional partners when direct instruction or practice is the right intervention.
  • Design manager-first activation approaches that equip leaders to introduce changes, reinforce expectations, coach application, and address adoption barriers with their teams.
  • Ensure learning and performance-support materials are accurate, commercially relevant, easy to use in the flow of work, and maintained as platforms, processes, and AI-enabled client solutions evolve.

Adoption Measurement and Reinforcement

  • Define readiness and adoption goals, leading indicators, usage measures, and qualitative feedback mechanisms for technology and process launches and for field enablement supporting AI-enabled client solutions.
  • Use data from Gong, Salesforce, learning platforms, and other sources to evaluate adoption, identify friction, and recommend targeted reinforcement.
  • Distinguish activity from effective use by assessing whether tools, AI-enabled workflows, and field practices are improving seller productivity, execution quality, manager visibility, data quality, and commercial outcomes.
  • Establish feedback loops with the field and functional owners, including Technology & Talent and AI Client Solutions partners, and convert insights into workflow improvements, updated guidance, and ongoing reinforcement.

Enablement Operations

  • Help establish a consistent intake and prioritization process for technology, systems, and sales-process enablement requests.
  • Maintain visibility into upcoming commercial launches and dependencies so Enablement can engage at the right point rather than after implementation.
  • Contribute to enablement planning, program governance, documentation standards, reporting, and the ongoing evolution of the Enablement technology ecosystem.

Qualifications

  • Seven or more years of experience in sales enablement, revenue enablement, sales operations, revenue operations, commercial excellence, or a related function, including substantial ownership of technology or process adoption.
  • Deep working knowledge of Gong, including how conversation intelligence, workflows, coaching, and usage data can support seller and manager effectiveness.
  • Strong Salesforce or comparable CRM expertise and a practical understanding of opportunity management, pipeline, forecasting, sales stages, and data discipline.
  • Experience with sales engagement and prospecting technologies such as Clay, as well as generative AI tools including ChatGPT and other emerging commercial AI capabilities; able to help sellers apply AI practically across the sales workflow and quickly build fluency in AI-enabled offerings to translate complex solution concepts into clear commercial guidance for the field.
  • Demonstrated ability to map seller workflows, diagnose adoption barriers, and translate complex systems and processes into simple, usable field guidance.
  • Experience creating self-paced learning, videos, live demonstrations, job aids, and manager-led reinforcement materials.
  • Strong cross-functional influence and the ability to work credibly with Sales, Operations, Technology, Marketing, Product, and senior leaders without relying on direct authority.
  • Strong project management, communication, facilitation, and analytical skills, with the judgment to select the right intervention rather than defaulting to training.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting a complex B2B sales organization with multiple sales motions, segments, or geographies.
  • Experience supporting enterprise technology launches, AI-enabled seller workflows, commercial transformation initiatives, or field enablement for technology- or AI-enabled solutions.
  • Experience using adoption and performance data to improve enablement programs and influence system or process design.
  • Experience with learning platforms, digital adoption tools, content management, or enablement platforms.

Success Measures

  • Commercial technology and process initiatives include an activation and adoption strategy before launch, and AI-enabled client solutions have a clear field-readiness approach for sellers and managers.
  • Managers have the context, capability, and materials to activate new workflows with their teams.
  • Sellers can use core technologies and AI confidently in the flow of work to improve productivity and execution, and can identify relevant client needs, position Axiom's AI-enabled solutions at the appropriate level, articulate value, and engage the right subject matter experts when deeper solution expertise is required.
  • Adoption is measured through meaningful usage, quality, and behavior indicators, with targeted reinforcement when results fall short.
  • Enablement has early visibility into commercial initiatives and evolving AI-enabled client solutions and engages selectively where it can materially improve field execution and business outcomes.

Axiom’s total rewards philosophy is to be transparent and equitable with all job candidates. The salary range for this Senior Manager-level U.S.-based remote role is $180,000–$222,000 OTE. You can also participate in our benefits programs, which include healthcare, life and disability coverage, a 401(k) with company match, paid sick and personal time off, paid parental leave, and more. Please note that final compensation is determined by several considerations, including the quality of your experience and expertise, your ability to immediately contribute to Axiom, your potential to progress to the next level, the market in which you are located, and other business considerations.

Accommodation for Individuals with Disabilities: Upon request and consistent with applicable laws, Axiom will attempt to provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities who require an accommodation to participate in the application process. To request an accommodation to complete the application form, please contact us at benefits@axiomlaw.com and include “Applicant Accommodation” in the subject line.

jobicy:164221.title: Senior Field Hardware Engineer
jobicy:164221.description:
Who we are:

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.

Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.

Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram.

Who you are:

Geotab is seeking a Senior Field Hardware Engineer who will provide technical leadership to the Geotab Video field team and coordinate its pilot support. Reporting into Geotab's Video Product team, this role works closely with Video development to make sure GO Focus pilots work as intended from readiness through close, provides technical input to pilot intake alongside Revenue Delivery, triages complex onsite hardware issues as an escalation point and coordinates diagnosis and resolution with the accountable owner, and oversees field data-collection activities that support new AI behaviors. The Senior Field Hardware Engineer also establishes repeatable field processes, manages program risks, mentors junior engineers, and provides clear status updates and recommendations to leadership. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

The Senior Field Hardware Engineer is the technical lead for Geotab Video's field team. Success in this role means pilots that work as intended. This role coordinates the team's assignments, travel and equipment; works with Video development to pre-vet new or complex features before pilots; provides technical input to pilot intake, which Revenue Delivery owns; and manages stakeholder communication with Video development, Field Service, third-party installers, resellers and internal teams. The role triages complex system issues across hardware, connectivity, firmware and configuration as an escalation point, coordinates deeper troubleshooting with the accountable owner, and travels approximately 30-40% of the time, including internationally and at short notice, to support high-priority pilots. The role also oversees controlled field data-collection activities, including vehicle rental, equipment readiness, scenario design, testing, and delivery of high-quality training footage to the Vision team. As a senior technical contributor, this position establishes repeatable field processes, manages program risks and dependencies, mentors junior team members, and provides clear status reporting and recommendations to leadership.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Serve as the escalation point for onsite triage of complex Geotab Video issues spanning hardware, power, connectivity, firmware, configuration, and SD cards, and drive them to resolution with the right owner.
  • Ensure readiness for enterprise pilots, including pre-pilot reviews, pilot support, troubleshooting, validation, and pilot closeout, coordinating the field team's execution.
  • Travel to customer and pilot locations when escalations require it, to triage issues and drive them to resolution within days, minimizing pilot disruption and supporting successful conversion from pilot to contract.
  • Serve as the technical escalation point for junior engineers, customers, partners, installers, and internal teams during high-priority field issues.
  • Guide the team's assessment of vehicle types and operating conditions that may affect pilot performance.
  • Verify and document that camera and telematics systems perform as intended end to end against the pilot test plan, including video capture and quality, event detection, connectivity, calibration, and data reaching MyGeotab.
  • Develop practical triage and diagnostic plans, coordinate root-cause analysis, recommend and drive corrective actions, and document permanent or preventative solutions for recurring issues.
  • Partner with Video development, Computer Vision, Hardware, Product, Field Service, Revenue Delivery, Customer Success, Support, Sales, and Engineering teams, as well as third-party installers and resellers, to communicate field findings and coordinate resolution of technical issues.
  • Oversee training-data generation for new AI behaviors, including renting or accessing representative vehicles, installing camera kits, staging target scenarios, conducting controlled drives, and collecting video with known ground truth, on designated development and test vehicles, with the field team carrying out the work.
  • Review collected footage and test results for completeness, quality, environmental coverage, and alignment with the Vision team’s requirements.
  • Create clear diagnostic procedures, test plans, field reports, pilot-readiness checklists, and training-data documentation.
  • Maintain, or oversee the team's, accurate records of hardware kits, tools, components, vehicle configurations, pilot results, defects, and follow-up actions.
  • Identify trends across customer deployments and recommend improvements to hardware design, installation processes, field tooling, training materials, and product requirements.
  • Coach and support junior field engineers through hands-on guidance, knowledge sharing, field shadowing, and review of technical documentation.
  • Support the creation of repeatable operating practices for the Video field team, including deployment readiness, travel preparation, equipment management, safety procedures, and escalation paths.
  • Work with Video engineering and product to pre-vet new or complex features before pilots begin.
  • Plan field team assignments, travel, equipment and coverage across active pilots.
  • Manage stakeholder communication with Video development, Field Service, installers, resellers and internal teams, and report pilot status, risks and recommendations.
  • Provide technical input to pilot intake and prioritization, such as feature complexity and readiness. Revenue Delivery owns pilot intake, commercial prioritization and customer success criteria.
  • Agree pilot plans with Field Services, including who provides installation and rework support, backup coverage and escalation contacts, and route installation or service issues to them with clear evidence.
  • Follow all applicable workplace, vehicle, customer-site, data-handling, and health and safety requirements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What you'll bring to the role:

  • Bachelors in a related field. Equivalent combination of education and/or work experience in related field may be substituted.
  • Post-secondary diploma, degree, or certificate in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Automotive Technology, Automotive Engineering.
  • Ability to travel approximately 30-40% of the time, including internationally and at short notice.
  • Experience coordinating technical work across teams, including stakeholder communication with engineering, partners and customers.
  • Strong experience diagnosing and resolving vehicle hardware, electrical, installation, connectivity, or telematics issues in field environments.
  • Working knowledge of vehicle electrical systems, power management, wiring, fuses, grounding, harnesses, connectors, and safe routing practices.
  • Knowledge of vehicle-mounted cameras, telematics devices, GPS, cellular connectivity, SD cards, sensors, calibration procedures, and related diagnostic tools.
  • Ability to interpret wiring diagrams, installation instructions, vehicle documentation, and technical specifications.
  • Strong root-cause analysis and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to work effectively when information is incomplete or conditions are changing.
  • Ability to plan and execute safe, repeatable field work across different vehicle types, customer sites, and operating environments.
  • Ability to collect high-quality video and test data under controlled conditions and document scenarios, expected outcomes, and observed results.
  • Strong technical writing and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex issues to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple customer-impacting issues and make sound decisions under time pressure.
  • Ability to work independently in the field while maintaining effective communication with remote team members and stakeholders.
  • Ability to coach junior engineers and promote consistent installation, diagnostic, documentation, and safety practices.
  • Experience with fleet management, telematics, connected vehicles, automotive technology, computer vision, or AI-enabled camera systems is an asset.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Jira, MyGeotab, diagnostic applications, spreadsheets, and documentation platforms is an asset.

jobicy:164220.title: Solutions Consultant
jobicy:164220.description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 700 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

Who We Need

We are building an accounting & finance software that will be industry-defining, and we need someone to help Rillet transition to the next company phase. We’ve grown quickly over the past few months and are expanding our GTM team to accelerate this trajectory. You’ll work directly with the CEO, the GTM, and the Product teams to help prospects evaluate Rillet as their next ERP. As an early member of Rillet's GTM team, you’ll be uniquely positioned to build strategies, test hypotheses, and lay the foundation for Rillet’s GTM motion for the future.

We’re primarily looking for teammates who are based near our New York City, San Francisco or Chicago offices, or those willing to relocate. For this role, we’re also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States.

Office-based team members work in person Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day. Certain roles may require more in-office time based on the needs of the function.

What You'll Do

  • Remove technical objections
    You’ll play a key role in the sales cycle by addressing all technical questions of potential customers. Specifically, you’ll understand their business requirements and existing technology stack, clearly articulate how Rillet will be integrated, and improve their processes. You’ll take part in sales conversations and will be able to answer the vast majority of technical questions immediately, without the need to circle back with the Product team.

  • Perform sales demonstrations
    You’ll set up the sandbox environment and tailor the data to showcase each customer's key specific use cases. You’ll deliver high-impact demonstrations, answering questions along the way and adapting based on the customer’s needs. You’ll be their consultant in the purchase process.

  • Execute relentlessly
    Work cross-functionally to provide front-line prospect feedback to founders and product teams in close to real-time. You will experiment with different demo styles, help write thoughtful follow-ups to customers, and become a highly responsive advisor to our prospective customers. You’ll roll up your sleeves and accelerate velocity.

  • Represent Rillet
    You’ll be the face of the company and will apply high customer empathy and structured problem-solving to ensure every prospect interaction is delightful. You’re comfortable marketing to a user with high finance and accounting proficiency, and your knowledge about the domain will be furthered in the process.

Who We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of industry accounting experience, involving various accounting areas including revenue recognition, month-end close, and multi-entity consolidation.

  • 2+ years of experience supporting the sales cycle with implementation and/or customer support for accounting/financial solutions.

  • Knowledge of the ecosystem of tools in the office of the CFO.

  • Excellent communicator who can make complex concepts easy to understand and knows how to write and speak conversationally.

  • Thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment while keeping a high attention to detail.

  • CPA certification or having started your career in audit, a plus.

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.

Life at Rillet

  • Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

  • Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

  • Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

jobicy:164219.title: Business Development Representative (North America)
jobicy:164219.description:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

🎯 The Role

We’re looking for a Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our Revenue team and help us expand Filigran’s footprint across the North America region. Your mission is to identify, engage, and qualify new enterprise opportunities — fueling our growth by connecting security leaders with Filigran’s open-source and commercial solutions.

You’ll collaborate closely with Sales and Marketing to turn market interest into meaningful conversations, driving the pipeline that powers Filigran’s mission to make cyber defense more proactive and connected.

💼 Your Responsibilities

  • Identify, research, and engage potential enterprise customers across the NA region.

  • Proactively generate outbound opportunities through targeted outreach.

  • Build relationships with CISOs, security engineers, and threat intelligence professionals.

  • Qualify prospects through outreach (phone calls, emails, social media) and structured lead scoring to ensure strong fit and intent.

  • Collaborate with Account Executives to book and hand off high-quality meetings that lead to new revenue.

  • Maintain accurate and organized activity tracking within HubSpot.

  • Partner with Marketing to refine messaging, campaigns, and regional strategies.

  • Represent Filigran at virtual and regional industry events to expand awareness and engagement.

🤝 Who You’ll Work With

  • Reports directly to Sam Weiss, Manager – BDR

  • Collaborates daily with Account Executives and Marketing teams

  • Works closely with the global Revenue organization to align on pipeline goals and regional strategies

  • Joins a team that values collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement

🧬 Profile We’re Looking For

  • 1+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, ideally in cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise software

  • Track record of success in outbound prospecting and lead qualification

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills across multiple cultures and time zones

  • Comfortable working in a remote, async-first environment

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and resilience in a fast-paced environment

  • Familiarity with HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar tools

  • Bonus: Experience engaging enterprise customers in the NA market or cybersecurity domain knowledge

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 What you can expect

  • Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

  • 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

  • Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

  • Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

  • Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify.

🚀 Ready to Join Us?

Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

jobicy:164218.title: HR Business Partner
jobicy:164218.description:
KnowBe4 empowers the modern workforce to make smarter security decisions every day. Trusted by more than 70,000 organizations worldwide, KnowBe4 is the pioneer of digital workforce security, securing both AI agents and humans. The KnowBe4 Platform provides attack simulation and training, collaboration security, and agent security powered by AIDA (Artificial Intelligence Defense Agents) and a proprietary Risk Score. The platform leverages 15-years of behavioral data to combat advanced threats including social engineering, prompt injection, and shadow AI. By securing humans and agents, KnowBe4 leads the industry in workforce trust and defense.

Remote positions open to the US only.

The HR Business Partner (Global Functional Lead) is a strategic global lead responsible for defining the "what" of the talent agenda for their assigned business functions. Operating within a matrixed global model, this role owns the talent strategy, organizational design, and leadership coaching for their functional client groups worldwide.

The HRBP acts as the primary strategic architect, partnering with Regional HR Leaders (who own the "how" and local execution) to ensure a consistent, high-performance employee experience across all geographies.

Responsibilities:

Functional Talent Strategy & Org Design (The "What")

  • Global Strategic Lead: Identify root-cause business challenges for assigned functions and translate them into a multi-year global HR roadmap.
  • Organizational Architecture: Lead organizational design and restructuring initiatives for the function, ensuring global scalability and alignment with company goals.
  • Succession & Talent Reviews: Own the annual global talent review and succession planning process for the function, identifying high-potential talent and bridging leadership gaps.
  • Workforce Planning: Partner with Finance and Functional Heads to lead global headcount planning and talent acquisition prioritization.

Matrix Collaboration (Functional vs. Regional)

  • Regional Partnership: Collaborate with Regional HR Leaders (Americas, EMEA, APJ) to adapt global functional strategies to local legal and cultural requirements.
  • One Voice to Leadership: Serve as the primary point of contact for the function's senior-most global leaders, ensuring they receive coherent and coordinated HR support.
  • Global Consistency: Ensure HR programs (Performance, Compensation, DEI) are implemented with consistency across all regions for the specific function.
  • Operational Handoffs: Manage explicit handoffs to Regional HR for local Employee Relations, compliance, and office-specific culture initiatives.
  • Information Exchange: Ensure vital information is flowing between yourself, the function you’re supporting, and the regional HR leaders. Empowerment through coordination and collaboration is the way!

Leadership Coaching & Performance

  • Executive Advisory: Act as a trusted sounding board and coach for senior executives on people-related decisions, org health, and leadership behavior.
  • Proactive Performance: Partner with Employee Relations and Regional HR to inculcate a high-performance culture, guiding managers on talent assessment and complex performance management.
  • Compensation Strategy: Collaborate with the Total Rewards COE to broker scalable compensation and pay-equity strategies that align with functional benchmarks.

COE & Operational Integration

  • COE Liaison: Interface with Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and Total Rewards to deliver specialized solutions that address functional pain points.
  • Systems Optimization: Advocate for and help accelerate "Manager Self-Service" and automation in partnership with HR Operations to improve the functional user experience (UX).

Employee Relations Support

  • US Case Support: Partner with Employee Relations to help cover and support any overflow cases (US only). This includes direct work on disciplinary items, investigations, grievance resolution, and offboards.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in HR, Business, or a related field (Master’s/MBA preferred).
  • 10+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 5 years in a strategic HRBP capacity supporting global/matrixed organizations.
  • Matrix Navigation: Proven ability to influence across reporting lines—balancing global functional needs with regional operational realities.
  • Outside-In Thinking: Ability to develop HR solutions starting with the business client’s needs and moving toward process design.
  • Strategic Diplomacy: Exceptional communication skills; ability to manage "Functional vs. Regional" tensions and escalate issues via defined protocols.
  • Systems Fluency: Proficiency with Workday and a data-driven approach to HR analytics.
  • Discretion: Expert-level judgment in handling highly confidential executive-level matters.
  • Exceptional Collaboration: This role will need to collaborate with HRBPs, regional HR teams, and COE teams.

  • Preferred Location: Proximity to our Arlington, Clearwater, or New York offices is an added bonus.

The compensation for this position ranges from $100,000 - $120,000, which will vary depending on how well an applicant's skills and experience align with the job description listed above.

Application deadline: 12/11/2026. This is our good-faith estimate of the date the application window is anticipated to close. KnowBe4 reviews applications on a rolling basis and reserves the right to close the application window early if a qualified candidate for the position is identified.

Our Fantastic Benefits

We offer company-wide bonuses based on monthly sales targets, employee referral bonuses, adoption assistance, tuition reimbursement, certification reimbursement, and certification completion bonuses - all in a modern, high-tech, and fun work environment. For more details about our benefits in each office location, please visit www.knowbe4.com/careers/benefits.

Note: An applicant assessment and background check may be part of your hiring procedure.

Individuals seeking employment at KnowBe4 are considered without prejudice to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please visit www.knowbe4.com/careers/request-accommodation.

No recruitment agencies, please.

jobicy:164217.title: Manager, Customer Success
jobicy:164217.description:
ABOUT US

Trusted by 800,000 monthly active users, UpCodes (YC S17) is a comprehensive compliance and product research platform that accelerates design to construction in the AEC space. The construction industry suffers from unnecessary costs and complexity; every year billions of dollars are wasted on rework. We’re committed to delivering easy-to-use tools that help designers and builders spend less time finding the right compliance and product resources and more time doing what they love — designing and building. We make a real-world, tangible impact on the lives of our users and their work of constructing our homes, schools, hospitals, and offices.

ABOUT THE ROLE

UpCodes has grown organically across architecture firms, government agencies, and key players in the AEC industry. We have one Customer Success Manager today, and we’re hiring our first Manager of Customer Success to shape how the function works from here.

You’ll define how we measure customer health, set targets for the team, and create the processes that allow Customer Success to scale with our customer base. You’ll also stay hands-on with customers while the team grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As Manager of Customer Success, you’ll have a direct and significant impact on how our customers succeed with UpCodes and how we grow with them. You’ll be responsible for:

  • Team Leadership: Manage and mentor our current CSM, and plan, hire, and train a high-performing team as we grow, ensuring alignment with cross-functional teams such as Sales, Support, and Product.

  • Hands-On Leadership: Until the team is in place, you’ll be on customer calls, running onboardings and trainings, and handling escalations. You’ll stay hands-on as the team grows.

  • Strategy and KPIs: Work backward from company priorities to set goals for the team. Evaluate our current metrics, such as retention, expansion, and adoption, set ambitious targets for improvement, and lead the team in achieving them.

  • Customer Health: Develop a customer health score based on product usage, engagement, and renewal signals, and monitor it regularly to flag at-risk revenue and expansion opportunities early.

  • Scalable Systems: Create the playbooks, workflows, and automations that enable the team to efficiently support a growing customer base.

  • Customer Knowledge Base: Build and maintain a knowledge base of guides and help articles so customers can find answers on their own.

  • Reporting and Dashboards: Build reports and dashboards that give the team and leadership clear visibility into customer health and trends.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

  • Experience in Customer Success: 7+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related customer-facing role at a B2B SaaS or tech company, including at least two years managing CSMs.

    • Have hired, trained, and mentored team members

    • Have built a scalable Customer Success system, such as health scoring, playbooks, or lifecycle automation

    • Have owned KPIs and driven measurable improvements

    • Have hands-on experience building reports and dashboards

  • Data-driven: You use data to set the right targets and find the most effective solutions. Your decisions are backed by clear, defensible reasoning, but you also appreciate the role of intuition and conviction.

  • Open to feedback: You ask for feedback, take it well, and use it to get better. You're comfortable juggling several priorities at once and learning as you go.

  • You sweat the small stuff: You notice the details, like a missed follow-up or a messy handoff, and you set a high bar for quality on your team.

NICE TO HAVE

  • AI Fluency: You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and have used them to make your team more efficient, whether that’s analyzing account data, building reports, or automating parts of the CS workflow.

  • Startup Experience: You’ve worked at a fast-moving tech startup or an AI-native company, and you’re comfortable building without a playbook.

jobicy:164216.title: Staff Software Engineer, Tech Lead - NetBox Core
jobicy:164216.description:
NetBox Labs is seeking a Staff Software Engineer and Tech Lead for NetBox Core, a team in our Applications group.

NetBox is a product that reaches people in a few ways: our open source community runs NetBox OSS; commercial customers use NetBox Cloud (SaaS) or NetBox Enterprise (self-managed). NetBox Core builds NetBox and its core plugins, the code that runs everywhere NetBox runs. We work closely with NetBox Delivery, the team that ships NetBox and runs it on Cloud and Enterprise.

As Tech Lead, you set the technical direction for NetBox Core and stay hands-on in the code. You bring deep Django and Python skills, experience running Django in production SaaS at scale, and a good understanding of Kubernetes and SRE practices.

In this role you will:

  • Design and build NetBox and its core plugins, across the data model, business logic, APIs, and integrations

  • Own the technical direction and architecture of NetBox and its core plugins, as the team's primary technical decision maker

  • Keep NetBox fast and reliable as data and usage grow, from query performance to background jobs

  • Drive NetBox releases, including versioning, release notes, and the release cadence

  • Lead and mentor the team's engineers through design and code review, and set the team's standards for testing and documentation

  • Take part in community contributions and public design discussions on GitHub

  • Work with NetBox Delivery and the Cloud, Enterprise, and Foundations teams to build observability into NetBox, define release contracts, and drive cross-team changes through RFCs

  • Act as a technical escalation point during incidents and make sure postmortem actions get done

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of software development experience, including technical ownership of a production system or platform area

  • Deep Python and Django expertise, including running a Django SaaS application in production at scale

  • A track record of finding and fixing Django performance problems, including ORM query optimization, Postgres indexing and query plans, schema design, and migration risk on large tables

  • Production experience with background job queues such as RQ or Celery, and message brokers such as Redis or RabbitMQ

  • Experience building observability into applications, including error reporting, distributed tracing, metrics, and structured logging, with tools such as OpenTelemetry and Sentry

  • A working understanding of how Python applications run on Kubernetes, and of SRE practices such as SLOs, incident response, and postmortems

  • Experience leading engineering work without formal manager authority, including mentoring other engineers

  • Hands-on experience building inside an AI-augmented development harness, including Claude Code and the workflows that make agentic tooling reliable

  • A track record of making technical decisions under ambiguity and driving work across team boundaries, from writing the RFC to getting a cross-team migration done

  • Comfort working in the open, including discussing designs in public issues, reviewing community contributions, and writing user-facing documentation

Nice to haves:

  • Experience building deep inside Django's internals, such as the app registry, model metadata, and the schema editor, for example to create models at runtime as our Custom Objects plugin does

  • Experience with the parts of the Django ecosystem NetBox uses, such as Django REST Framework, GraphQL with Strawberry, django-filter, and django-mptt

  • Experience with advanced Postgres features, such as schemas for multi-tenancy or branching, advisory locks, and connection pooling

  • Hands-on experience with several tools in our delivery stack: AWS, Kubernetes and Helm, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD or FluxCD, Terraform, and Prometheus and Grafana

  • Experience working in a B2B software startup or high-growth organization

  • Familiarity with the NetBox ecosystem or network automation

  • Contributions to or maintenance of an open source project

  • Experience with self-managed or on-premises delivery

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

jobicy:164215.title: Marketing Programs Associate
jobicy:164215.description:
About Axiom

Axiom, a leading global marketplace for on-demand legal talent, is leading a revolution in the legal industry. The Axiom model disrupts the traditional allocation of work to law firms and in-house teams. By matching highly credentialed lawyers and legal talent with legal work across industries and practice areas, Axiom enables clients to become more agile and efficient and empowers lawyers and legal talent to pursue more of the work they love. Axiom serves over half the Fortune 100 with market leading NPS ratings from both its clients and employees.

About the role

We're looking for an energetic, detail-obsessed Marketing Specialist to support our Marketing Programs team. Each channel (email, events and social) already has an owner who sets its strategy. You'll partner with those owners and take on the hands-on, task-level work that brings their plans to life, side by side with marketers in the US, UK and APAC.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes a fast pace and a full plate. You'll turn approved plans into finished campaigns, keep projects moving on deadline, and make sure everything we put out sounds and looks like us.

It's also a role with room to grow. You'll see how a global B2B marketing engine works end to end, and you'll build skills across strategy, content, operations and events.

What you'll do

Each channel owner sets strategy and makes final decisions. Your focus is execution: building, coordinating, tracking and quality-checking the work so owners can spend more time on strategy.

Email marketing

  • Support the email owner by building, designing and QA-ing campaigns in HubSpot, from newsletters to event invitations to nurture sequences.
  • Draft and edit email copy, subject lines and calls to action that match our brand voice.
  • Manage lists and segments in partnership with marketing operations, using HubSpot and Salesforce data.
  • Run A/B tests and report on opens, clicks and conversions, and share findings with the email owner.

Events

  • Support event owners with planning and logistics for client events, webinars, conferences and sponsorships across regions.
  • Coordinate vendors, venues, timelines, shipping and onsite materials within approved budgets.
  • Run event promotion, registration and attendee communications before and after each event.
  • Track event leads and attendance in Salesforce and support post-event follow-up.

Social media

  • Draft and schedule LinkedIn and other company posts, following the social owner's content strategy.
  • Repurpose thought leadership, case studies and event moments into short, engaging posts.
  • Maintain the social content calendar and report on engagement and growth.

Program support and project management

  • Support integrated campaigns across all channels, from brief to launch to results.
  • Keep projects on track in our project management tool (Wrike, Asana or Monday.com), including timelines, tasks and approvals.
  • Help produce campaign reporting and dashboards for the Marketing Programs team.
  • Proofread and quality-check materials for accuracy, consistency and brand standards.

Cross-team and global collaboration

  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for every member of the marketing team.
  • Partner with our UK and APAC field marketing leaders to localize and execute campaigns and events in their regions.
  • Work with sales, practice leaders and subject matter experts to gather content and align on priorities.
  • Coordinate across time zones and keep stakeholders informed on status and next steps.

What you bring

  • 2–3 years of hands-on marketing experience, in-house or at an agency.
  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Working experience with HubSpot (email, lists, landing pages, reporting) and Salesforce (campaigns, leads, contacts).
  • Experience with a project management tool such as Wrike, Asana or Monday.com.
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with a portfolio or samples of email, social or campaign copy.
  • Exceptional attention to detail. You catch the typo, the broken link and the wrong date before anyone else does.
  • Ability to juggle multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment without dropping the ball.
  • Clear, proactive communication with colleagues at every level and across regions.
  • High energy, a positive attitude and a genuine willingness to roll up your sleeves.

Nice to have

  • Experience in professional services (consulting, legal, accounting, advisory) or another B2B environment.
  • HubSpot Marketing Hub or Email Marketing certification.
  • Experience supporting global or multi-region marketing teams.
  • Basic design skills in Canva, Adobe Creative Cloud or Figma.
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Campaign Manager, social scheduling tools or event platforms such as Cvent or ON24.
  • Comfort with marketing analytics and building simple reports in Excel or HubSpot.

What success looks like

In your first 90 days, you'll:

  • Learn our brand voice, audiences, systems, and campaign calendar.
  • Independently build and launch HubSpot email campaigns from approved briefs.
  • Own logistics for at least one event or webinar from planning through follow-up.
  • Take over day-to-day scheduling of company social content.

By the end of your first year, you'll:

  • Be the go-to person for campaign execution across email, events and social.
  • Support regional programs alongside our UK and APAC field marketing leaders.
  • Bring data-backed ideas to improve engagement and campaign results.
  • Help free up senior team members to focus on strategy and growth.

Axiom’s total rewards philosophy is to be transparent and equitable with all job candidates. The salary range for this Associate-level U.S.-based remote role is $63,250–$80,500 OTE. You can also participate in our benefits programs, which include healthcare, life and disability coverage, a 401(k) with company match, paid sick and personal time off, paid parental leave, and more. Please note that final compensation is determined by several considerations, including the quality of your experience and expertise, your ability to immediately contribute to Axiom, your potential to progress to the next level, the market in which you are located, and other business considerations.

Accommodation for Individuals with Disabilities: Upon request and consistent with applicable laws, Axiom will attempt to provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities who require an accommodation to participate in the application process. To request an accommodation to complete the application form, please contact us at benefits@axiomlaw.com and include “Applicant Accommodation” in the subject line.
